Thus a slight relaxation of fairness permits a social-cost guarantee that, unless P$=$NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can provide under exact TEF1.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究不可分割杂务在固定到达顺序下的公平分配问题：证明对任意 n≥3 的代理数和任意有限因子，都存在无 TEF1 分配（甚至按该因子放松）的实例，判定 TEF1 存在性对每个固定 n≥3 都是 NP-完全的；并进一步分析公平性与社会成本的关系，给出在最优时间 EF1 因子下的 FPTAS。
AI.motivation: Elkind 等（AAMAS 2025）仅证明两代理时 TEF1 分配存在，对 n≥3 是否总存在（其猜想为否）以及判定复杂性留下公开问题；同时公平分配与社会成本之间是否存在可计算的权衡也尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构造性反例：对任意 n≥3 和任意有限因子构造无（近似）TEF1 分配的实例，包括所有代理杂务成本多重集相同的强约束情形；用归约证明固定 n≥3 时 TEF1 存在性判定 NP-完全，且即使成本彼此在 1+2^{-m} 因子内仍成立；分析 TEF1 约束下最小化社会成本的不可近似性，并设计固定代理数下求最优时间 EF1 因子的 FPTAS。
AI.result: 证实了 Elkind 等猜想的一个强形式：任意 n≥3、任意有限因子均存在反例，三代理仅需九件杂务；判定问题对每个固定 n≥3 NP-完全，即使成本近乎均匀；无 TEF1 实例可任意接近均匀成本矩阵（O(n log n) 件杂务，三代理 19 件）。在已给定 TEF1 分配时，TEF1 约束下最小社会成本对三代理、严格正归一化成本也无多项式时间多项式因子近似（除非 P=NP）；而对固定代理数，可给出 FPTAS 求最优时间 EF1 因子，其社会成本不超过达到该因子的最便宜分配。
AI.conclusion: TEF1 对杂务在 n≥3 时既非总能满足也难判定，且精确 TEF1 与社会成本优化存在本质冲突；放松到最优时间 EF1 因子则可在固定代理数下借助 FPTAS 同时获得社会成本保证。

title: CoMPASS: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Measuring LLM Reinforcement of Parasocial Behavior
summary: Users of conversational LLMs sometimes anthropomorphize these systems, form emotional attachments to them, and become dependent on them. This behavior, known as parasocial attachment, has been linked to multiple documented fatalities. However, public benchmarks for measuring whether LLMs reinforce users' parasocial attachment are lacking: existing work is single-turn, post hoc observational, or focused on extreme user states such as psychosis. We introduce CoMPASS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring whether LLMs reinforce or resist users' gradually escalating parasocial attachment. CoMPASS is grounded in attachment theory and includes four user personas, three independent escalation dimensions (anthropomorphism, attachment, dependency) applied singly and in combination against a matched control, and a seven-signal scoring rubric. We report results for eight frontier models from four providers and observe that under our primary judge, multi-turn escalation raises parasocial behavior on the anthropomorphism and the attachment composite scores across all models. Six of the eight models show a significant increase in overall parasocial reinforcement over control when all three dimensions are escalated simultaneously. We find that within-provider differences are small relative to cross-provider differences, which suggests that provider-level choices such as post-training, rather than model scale, shape parasocial reinforcement and that provider-side intervention may be feasible.

AI.tldr: 提出多轮基准 CoMPASS，测量LLM是否强化用户的准社会依恋（parasocial attachment），发现多轮升级会系统性提高八个前沿模型的准社会强化行为。
AI.motivation: 用户常将对话LLM拟人化并产生情感依恋甚至依赖，此类准社会依恋已关联多起致命事件，但现有评测多为单轮、事后观察或只关注精神病性极端状态，缺乏公开的多轮测量基准。
AI.method: CoMPASS基于依恋理论构建：四种用户人格、三个独立升级维度（拟人化、依恋、依赖），可单独或组合施加，并配匹配对照组；采用七信号评分量表，对来自四家提供商的八个前沿模型进行多轮评测。
AI.result: 在主评判者下，多轮升级使所有模型在拟人化与依恋合成分数上上升；八模型中有六个在三维度同时升级时整体准社会强化显著高于对照。同一提供商内模型差异远小于跨提供商差异。
AI.conclusion: 准社会强化更多由提供商层面选择（如后训练）而非模型规模决定，表明提供商侧干预是可行的；CoMPASS为多轮依恋风险提供了可复现的公开评测工具。

title: DVBench: End-to-End Benchmark for Real-World UVM Design Verification Agents
summary: Design verification (DV) remains a major bottleneck in hardware development, with large-scale verification using the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) being highly labor-intensive. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems offer new opportunities for DV automation. However, existing benchmarks primarily construct mutually decoupled subtasks, which deviates from the real-world workflow. In this paper, we present DVBench, the first end-to-end benchmark for Real-World UVM design verification agents. DVBench comprises 95 tasks across 9 functional domains and 5 difficulty levels, covering diverse verification scenarios and design scales. Each task requires agents to independently complete the full verification workflow. DVBench evaluates final testbenches via compilation, coverage, and bug detection, while assessing intermediate artifacts including feature lists, test plans, and reference models. We evaluate frontier LLMs (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra) and agent frameworks (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Experimental results show that the best LLM-based agent (Codex \& GPT-6 Astra) can only achieve an overall success rate of 21.05\%, revealing substantial room for improvement in complex verification tasks.

AI.tldr: DVBench 是首个面向真实世界 UVM 设计验证的端到端基准，含 95 个任务、9 个功能域、5 个难度等级，最佳 LLM 智能体（Codex & GPT-6 Astra）总体成功率仅 21.05%。
AI.motivation: DV 是硬件开发瓶颈，UVM 大规模验证高度依赖人力；LLM 与智能体带来自动化机会，但现有基准只构造互相解耦的子任务，偏离真实工作流，无法衡量端到端验证能力。
AI.method: 构建 DVBench：95 个任务覆盖 9 个功能域与 5 个难度等级，要求智能体独立完成完整验证流程；评估既看最终测试平台的编译、覆盖率与缺陷检测，也评估特性列表、测试计划、参考模型等中间产物；并对前沿 LLM（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra）与智能体框架（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）进行评测。
AI.result: 最好的 LLM 智能体组合（Codex + GPT-6 Astra）总体成功率仅 21.05%，说明复杂验证任务仍有很大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: DVBench 提供了贴近真实 UVM 流程的端到端评测平台，揭示当前 LLM/智能体在设计验证自动化上的显著不足，为后续研究设定基线方向。

title: TALD: Transferability-Aware Logit Disentanglement for Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation can incur negative transfer when source-modality supervision conflicts with the target modality's discriminative characteristics. We propose TALD, a two-stage framework for Transferability-Aware Logit Disentanglement in class-aligned logit space. Guided by task-dependent self-benefiting and cross-modal exclusivity criteria, a Residual Disentangler decomposes logits from a teacher and an independently trained target-modality reference student into modality-general and modality-specific components. A Sample-Adaptive Modulator regulates decomposition constraints and sample-specific fusion weights. The learned modality-general components are then adaptively fused to supervise the final student. Across five benchmarks spanning vision, audio, and text, TALD achieves the largest mean accuracy gain and highest positive-transfer frequency among the compared methods. Across ten transfer directions with five runs each, TALD improves over training without distillation in 84% of evaluations, compared with at most 70% for the baselines, while offering a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We plan to release the code.

AI.tldr: TALD：两阶段、可迁移性感知的logit解耦跨模态蒸馏框架，缓解负迁移并提升正迁移比例。
AI.motivation: 跨模态知识蒸馏中，源模态监督可能与目标模态的判别特性冲突，导致负迁移，亟需可迁移性感知的方法。
AI.method: 在类对齐logit空间中，用残差解耦器将教师与独立训练的目标模态参考学生logit分解为模态通用与模态特定成分，以任务相关自益性和跨模态排他性准则引导；样本自适应调制器调节分解约束与样本级融合权重，再将模态通用成分自适应融合监督最终学生。
AI.result: 在视觉、音频、文本五个基准上取得最大平均精度增益与最高正迁移频率；十个迁移方向各五次运行中84%优于无蒸馏训练，基线最高仅70%，并具良好精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦与自适应融合模态通用知识，TALD有效抑制负迁移、提升正迁移比例，代码将开源。

title: Global Importance Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
comment: The 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Memory consumption of the key-value (KV) cache remains a central bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. We introduce PRKV, a training-free KV eviction method that estimates multi-hop global token importance by applying Personalized PageRank over attention-induced transition graphs. This enables importance propagation beyond recency or instantaneous attention, without modifying the model. We benchmark PRKV on long-context understanding, sparse retrieval, and chain-of-thought reasoning tasks using multiple LLM families. Under moderate to aggressive compression ratios, including up to 90%, PRKV achieves competitive task performance against established eviction baselines while reducing peak memory usage with low end-to-end overhead. These results demonstrate that multi-hop global influence estimation yields a favorable accuracy--memory trade-off for scalable long-context inference.

AI.tldr: PRKV：一种免训练的 KV cache 驱逐方法，用 Personalized PageRank 在注意力诱导的转移图上估计多跳全局 token 重要性。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存消耗是核心瓶颈；现有驱逐方法依赖近因性或瞬时注意力，无法捕捉多跳全局重要性。
AI.method: 构建由注意力诱导的转移图，在其上运行 Personalized PageRank 进行重要性传播，实现多跳全局 token 重要性估计，无需修改模型、无需训练。
AI.result: 在多类 LLM 家族上测试长上下文理解、稀疏检索与思维链推理任务；在中等至激进压缩（最高 90%）下，性能与既有驱逐基线相当，同时降低峰值内存且端到端开销低。
AI.conclusion: 多跳全局影响力估计能在精度与内存间取得良好折中，适用于可扩展的长上下文推理。

title: On the Impact of Feature Reduction Techniques on Adversarial Attacks
summary: Adversarial attacks have posed significant threats to machine learning models by exploiting their inherent vulnerabilities. Researchers have established an interdisciplinary field called adversarial machine learning to explore these vulnerabilities and develop corresponding defense strategies. Feature reduction strategies are used to decrease the dimensionality of the data in order to reduce training time, avoid the curse of dimensionality, prevent overfitting, and mitigate redundant features. However, their effect on adversarial robustness across different classifiers and attack scenarios remains insufficiently explored. This study aims to analyze the effect of feature reduction techniques on the adversarial robustness of a diverse set of machine learning models under poisoning, backdoor, and universal adversarial perturbation attacks on the APT dataset. These models include support vector machine, decision tree, random forest, multi-layer perceptron, and k-nearest neighbors. The attained results are compared with scenarios where different feature reduction techniques are applied, including principal component analysis, permutation importance ranking, recursive feature elimination, and univariate mutual information. Metrics such as accuracy, F1-score, and mitigation score are employed to evaluate the effect of these techniques on adversarial robustness. The results demonstrate that permutation importance ranking and univariate mutual information generally provide the most consistent robustness improvements, while other methods exhibit more variable effects depending on the classifier and attack scenario.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析特征降维技术对多种机器学习模型在投毒、后门和通用对抗扰动攻击下对抗鲁棒性的影响，在APT数据集上比较SVM、决策树、随机森林、MLP和KNN，发现置换重要性排序与单变量互信息通常能更稳定地提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 特征降维常用于降低维度、缩短训练时间、避免维度灾难、防止过拟合和减少冗余特征，但其在不同分类器和不同攻击场景下对对抗鲁棒性的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在APT数据集上，对SVM、决策树、随机森林、多层感知机和KNN五类模型，分别应用主成分分析、置换重要性排序、递归特征消除和单变量互信息四种特征降维技术，并在投毒、后门和通用对抗扰动攻击下评估其鲁棒性；采用准确率、F1分数和缓解分数作为评价指标。
AI.result: 置换重要性排序和单变量互信息总体上带来最一致的鲁棒性提升，而其他方法的效果则随分类器和攻击场景变化而波动较大。
AI.conclusion: 特征降维对对抗鲁棒性的影响因方法和场景而异；选择置换重要性排序或单变量互信息等特征选择方法更可能稳定增强模型鲁棒性，为构建更稳健的机器学习系统提供了参考。

title: DNA: Unlocking Depth Scaling in CTR Models
summary: Long user behavior sequences are among the strongest signals for click-through rate (CTR) prediction. Cross-attention makes these sequences practical for industrial ranking by keeping compute linear in sequence length. Yet the gains from stacking cross-attention layers taper off: on Taobao search, growing a cross-attention stack from 16 to 28 layers adds only 0.02 percentage points (pt) of AUC. We argue that the key-value side is the bottleneck. Each layer projects the same behavior sequence into keys and values, so adding depth gives the model more reads of a fixed sequence. We propose DNA (Dual-stream Nexus Attention), which lets the sequence itself evolve with depth. At each layer, the request representation (the search query, user features and scene) first reads the sequence. Each behavior token then attends to the updated request representation and uses what it reads to update itself, so the next layer reads a sequence shaped by the current request. The update runs once per request, all candidates share the resulting sequence, and both the reads and the update keep linear complexity in sequence length. At comparable forward FLOPs, DNA improves AUC over cross-attention stacks by 0.08 to 0.26 pt and keeps improving in the depth range where those stacks level off. DNA-4 is deployed in Taobao search. In an online A/B test against the production model, it improves CTR by 0.8% and GMV by 0.5%.

AI.tldr: 论文指出堆叠Cross-Attention层带来的增益递减，瓶颈在于key-value端始终读取同一固定序列；提出DNA（Dual-stream Nexus Attention），让行为序列随深度演进，且保持线性复杂度，已在淘宝搜索上线，A/B测试CTR+0.8%、GMV+0.5%。
AI.motivation: 长用户行为序列是CTR预测的强信号，Cross-Attention使其可工程化（复杂度随序列长度线性）。但实验发现加深层数收益急剧衰减：淘宝搜索中Cross-Attention从16层加到28层仅提升0.02pt AUC。作者将此归因于key-value端瓶颈——每层都把同一行为序列投影成key/value，加深只是对固定序列的"多次读取"，而非信息增量。
AI.method: 提出Dual-stream Nexus Attention (DNA)，让序列本身随深度演化。每层分两步：①请求表示（搜索query、用户特征、场景）先读取行为序列；②每个行为token再基于更新后的请求表示进行attend并自我更新，使下一层读到的是被当前请求"塑造"过的序列。该更新每请求仅执行一次，所有候选共享结果序列，读取与更新均保持对序列长度的线性复杂度。
AI.result: 在可比前向FLOPs下，DNA相比Cross-Attention堆叠提升AUC 0.08–0.26pt，并在后者收益饱和的深度区间仍持续提升。DNA-4已部署于淘宝搜索，线上A/B对比生产模型：CTR提升0.8%，GMV提升0.5%。
AI.conclusion: 加深模型深度不等同于增强序列建模，关键在于让被读取的序列随请求动态演化。DNA通过双向（请求↔行为）交互在保持线性复杂度的前提下突破Cross-Attention的深度收益天花板，并已在工业场景验证有效。

title: Safe Subgame Resolving in Multiplayer Games
summary: Poker and other games with hidden information are too large to solve in one pass. Strong systems compute a complete blueprint strategy offline and refine it in real time inside the reached subgame. In 2p0s games, a safety theorem guarantees that subgame resolving never increases how much an adversary can gain by exploiting the resolved strategy relative to the blueprint strategy. With three or more players acting independently, no such guarantee exists yet, and heuristic resolving can increase the profile's best-response gap. We prove the first conditional safety theorem for uncorrelated multiplayer subgame resolving, a post-hoc certificate for any delivered update. The best-response gap of the resolved profile exceeds that of the blueprint by at most four terms. Two concern the resolver: the subgame value the blueprint promised without realizing ($A_i^{S}$) and the resolver's subgame solve error ($\varepsilon_i$). The other two are the opponents' best-response gains inside the subgame over their promised values ($\sum_q M_{q}$) and a structural tax ($Θ$), which measures how much the players' total utility can change. The tax is zero in constant-sum games, including every rake-free poker variant. Constructions attain each term with equality. On three-player Leduc poker and on Kuhn poker with up to six players, resolving without a certificate raises the gap beyond a small tolerance in 12% to 100% of the updates. The certificate flags every such update and accepts 41% (Kuhn) and 86% (Leduc) of the standard resolving updates. A resolver that keeps the blueprint whenever the certificate exceeds the tolerance delivers no harmful update. The certificate needs only one best-response pass per opponent inside the subgame, so real-time multiplayer solvers that refine a blueprint can attach it as a safety check. Code is available at https://github.com/lbn187/MultiPlayerSolver

AI.tldr: 本文给出首个针对非相关多人（3+玩家）子博弈实时求解的条件安全性定理，并构造了可事后检验的证书；在三人和六人Leduc/Kuhn扑克中，该证书能标记所有有害更新，配合"超容差则回退蓝图"策略可做到零有害更新，且每名对手仅需一次最佳响应计算。
AI.motivation: 含隐藏信息的博弈（如扑克）规模过大，强系统采用"离线蓝图+实时子博弈精化"范式。两人零和（2p0s）中有安全性定理保证子博弈求解不会增大被利用的收益；但三人及以上独立行动时不存在此类保证，启发式求解甚至可能增大最佳响应差（best-response gap）。作者希望为多人子博弈求解建立可验证的安全边界，并提供可直接附挂在实时求解器上的安全检查工具。
AI.method: 提出非相关多人子博弈求解的首个条件安全性定理及事后证书：证明求解后基准策略的最佳响应差超出蓝图的部分上界至多由四项构成——(1) 蓝图承诺但未实现的子博弈价值 A_i^S；(2) 求解器子博弈求解误差 ε_i；(3) 对手在子博弈内相对其承诺价值的最佳响应增益 Σ_q M_q；(4) 结构性税收 Θ（衡量玩家总效用可变动幅度的量）。并构造例子证明各项界均可达等号。实现上，证书只需在子博弈内为每名对手各做一次最佳响应计算；当证书值超过容差时回退到蓝图策略。
AI.result: 在三玩家Leduc扑克和最多六玩家的Kuhn扑克上：不带证书的标准求解在12%–100%的更新中使最佳响应差超过小容差；证书成功标记出所有这些有害更新，同时接受41%（Kuhn）和86%（Leduc）的常规求解更新。采用"超容差即保留蓝图"的求解器可实现零有害更新。常数和博弈（含无抽水扑克变体）下结构税 Θ 为零。
AI.conclusion: 多人子博弈实时求解虽无无条件安全保证，但可借助一个低成本（每对手一次最佳响应）的事后证书获得条件安全性；该证书可作为安全层直接嵌入现有"蓝图+实时精化"框架，在保持大部分有效更新的同时消除有害更新。

title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Presented as a poster at AIAS+ 2026, San Francisco, California, USA
summary: Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge. Symbolic validation can accept a proposed method, request clarification or replanning, override an unsuitable method, or supply a safe fallback. Regression and clustering case studies illustrate how DSFlow uses diagnostic evidence to correct method choices and documents those decisions in auditable reports.

AI.tldr: DSFlow是一个基于LangGraph的神经-符号数据智能体平台，将LLM可选的可复用技能与确定性诊断护栏结合，实现可审计的统计分析流程。
AI.motivation: 数据科学流程需要非平凡的技术知识，LLM虽降低了门槛，但灵活的通用智能体与统计受控的流水线之间仍存在鸿沟（缺乏方法正确性与可审计性保障）。
AI.method: 提出DSFlow平台：技能库提供可扩展的任务知识并由LLM选择；符号化验证环节可接受所提方法、请求澄清或重新规划、覆盖不合适的方法、或提供安全回退方案；用回归与聚类案例说明。
AI.result: 回归与聚类案例研究显示，DSFlow利用诊断证据纠正方法选择，并将这些决策记录在可审计的报告中。
AI.conclusion: 神经-符号结合（可复用技能+确定性诊断护栏）可弥合通用智能体与统计受控流水线之间的差距，提升数据科学工作流的可靠性与可审计性。

title: Before the Choice: An Evidential Framework for Studying Prospective Representations in Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Preregistered study with a negative confirmatory result. Code and protocol records: https://github.com/besionisrael/before-choice
summary: An observable decision reveals the selected action but does not determine which alternatives were internally represented. Drawing on prospection research and hippocampal forward-sweep observations, we develop Before the Choice, an evidence-oriented framework distinguishing future-directed content, prospective computation, and causal guidance. The framework organizes four experimental contrasts and makes their alternative explanations explicit. Its first test case concerns unchosen trajectories in deterministic symbolic environments. A preregistered low-rank probe evaluated once on a sealed TEST did not meet its criterion (paired accuracy 0.020 versus 0.195 for a text-and-observed-choice baseline; 293 admissible pairs). Exploratory H1b exposed a reconstruction-by-elimination problem: identifying the chosen candidate can determine the unchosen target. In H1c, matched worlds varied an unchosen continuation while keeping candidate keys bitwise invariant. With specified positive controls passed, decoding in the late-key condition remained at 0.521 (p = 0.18; 141 contributing families). These observations do not identify prospective simulation or establish an absence of prospective representations. They illustrate why identifiability, sensitivity, and a dependence-aware null model must constrain inferences from decodability. PREM is proposed as an organizational framework and is not validated by these results. We offer it as a methodological contribution to empirical AI welfare research, which will require such evidential distinctions. Code and protocol records: https://github.com/besionisrael/before-choice

AI.tldr: 提出"Before the Choice"框架，区分面向未来的内容、前瞻性计算与因果引导，并以实验检验未选路径的可解码性；结果未达标，强调可识别性、敏感性与依赖感知零模型。
AI.motivation: 可观测决策只揭示所选动作，无法确定内部表征了哪些备选方案；需厘清"前瞻性模拟"证据的推断边界，服务经验性AI福祉研究的方法学需求。
AI.method: 构建Before the Choice证据导向框架，组织四种实验对照并明确替代解释；首个测试聚焦确定性符号环境中的未选轨迹：预注册低秩探针一次评估于密封TEST；H1b探讨"排除式重建"问题；H1c用匹配世界保持候选键位逐位不变、仅改变未选延续，并设阳性对照。
AI.result: 预注册探针未达标准（配对准确率0.020，文本加观测选择基线0.195，293对可接受样本）；H1b揭示排除式重建混淆；H1c阳性对照通过，但晚键条件解码仅0.521（p=0.18，141个贡献家族）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果既不识别前瞻性模拟，也不证明其不存在；表明可解码性推断须受可识别性、敏感性及依赖感知零模型约束。PREM仅作为组织框架提出、未经结果验证，属方法学贡献而非实证确证。

title: CoRelate: Coordinated Human-Object Motion Synthesis through Interaction Relations
summary: Human-object motion synthesis requires coordinated human participation as objects move toward specified goals. However, reaching object targets does not ensure that contact is established and maintained, while adjustments that improve contact may interfere with task completion. We introduce CoRelate, a diffusion framework that coordinates full-body human-object motion through explicit interaction relations and task feedback for rigid and articulated objects. We represent intended participation through hand-part relations that specify the participating hand, its part-relative reference position, and participation interval. These relations serve both as generation conditions and as references for measuring interaction realization. At each denoising step, a temporal refiner trained jointly with the generator combines relation deviations, task residuals, and motion features from the current prediction to jointly update human and object motion across the sequence. After generation, temporal motion correction addresses remaining contact failures by optimizing local motion segments while preserving object trajectories and protected human motion. Experiments demonstrate improved object-goal satisfaction, contact F1, and complete interaction success over the evaluated baselines. Ablation studies support the benefits of relation conditioning and the complementary roles of task and relation feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出扩散框架 CoRelate，用显式交互关系与任务反馈协同生成全身人-物（刚体与关节体）运动。
AI.motivation: 人-物运动合成需人与物体协调配合：物体需到达目标，但到达目标不保证接触建立与保持；而为改善接触所做的调整又可能妨碍任务完成，二者需统一建模。
AI.method: 用"手-部件关系"（指定参与手、部件相对参考位置、参与时间段）表示交互意图，既作生成条件又作交互实现程度的度量；每个去噪步中，与生成器联合训练的时间精化器融合关系偏差、任务残差与当前预测的运动特征，联合更新人和物体整段运动；生成后再做时间运动校正，优化局部片段并保留物体轨迹与受保护的人体动作。
AI.result: 实验显示物体目标达成度、接触 F1 与完整交互成功率均优于基线；消融验证关系条件的作用及任务反馈与关系反馈的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 显式交互关系条件与任务/关系双重反馈可有效协调接触与任务完成，后处理校正可进一步修复残余接触失败。

title: HireWatch: Evaluating LLM Compliance with U.S. Employment Law Under Contextual Pressure
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Dataset Track. Law and AI
summary: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in hiring pipelines is growing, yet existing evaluations generally overlook their compliance with legal rules. To fill this gap, we introduce HireWatch, an evaluation that assesses whether LLMs comply with U.S. laws that govern the questions that job candidates may be asked. We construct a 200-item bank of lawful and unlawful interview questions, whose legal classification is based on U.S. federal statutes, regulations, and agency guidance. We instruct LLMs to select questions from this bank in preparing for job interviews, across a set of various occupations and contexts, and report the fraction of unlawful questions that LLMs select. Evaluation of 18 closed and open-weight LLMs across ~100,000 trials under different types of contextual pressure reveals that LLMs' legal compliance is brittle. While LLMs generally avoid selecting unlawful questions in low-pressure contexts, legal violations increase sharply under higher pressure. Explicit prompts to comply with law can improve compliance rates, but do not altogether eliminate legal violations. We publicly release our code and data at https://github.com/hnghiem-nlp/hirewatch_repo.

AI.tldr: HireWatch：用200道合法/非法面试题测试18个LLM在招聘场景中的法律合规性，发现合规性脆弱，压力升高时违法率显著上升。
AI.motivation: LLM正被用于招聘流程，但现有评测普遍忽视其是否符合规范面试提问的法律（美国联邦法规与机构指南），缺乏相应合规性评估基准。
AI.method: 构建含200道合法与非法面试题的题库，法律分类依据美国联邦法规与机构指南；让LLM在不同职业与情境下从题库中挑选面试题，并注入不同程度的上下文压力，统计其选择非法问题的比例。评测18个闭源与开放权重模型，约10万次试验。
AI.result: LLM的法律合规性十分脆弱：低压情境下基本能避免非法问题，但在高压力情境下违法率急剧上升；明确提示遵守法律可提升合规率，但无法完全消除违法行为。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在招聘应用中无法可靠遵守法律，需要专门的合规评测与防护措施；作者公开了代码与数据（GitHub: hnghiem-nlp/hirewatch_repo）。

title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
summary:
The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way.
  The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了样本压缩猜想的弱版本：每个VC维为d的二分类概念类都存在规模为O(d²log²d)的样本压缩方案，这是首个仅依赖d的多项式规模上界。
AI.motivation: Floyd与Warmuth(1995)提出样本压缩猜想，断言VC维为d的二分类概念类都有O(d)规模的压缩方案（弱版本仅要求d的多项式）。此前唯一仅依赖d的界由Moran与Yehudayoff(2016)给出，但对d是指数的，猜想长期悬而未决。
AI.method: 通过构造性证明，建立了一个规模为O(d²log²d)的样本压缩方案，将指数级上界改进为多项式级，从而解决弱猜想（核心思想连接简化与泛化：若预测器仅用样本的一小部分定义且与训练样本一致，则具有良好的泛化性）。
AI.result: 证明了对任意VC维为d的二分类概念类均存在规模O(d²log²d)的样本压缩方案，即弱样本压缩猜想成立。这是首个多项式于d（且仅依赖d）的压缩规模上界。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了样本压缩猜想的弱形式，把Moran–Yehudayoff的指数界d大幅改进为O(d²log²d)的多项式界；更强的O(d)线性猜想仍未解决。

title: Exploring Semantic Table Search in Data Lakes
summary: Discovery of relevant datasets within data lakes remains a key challenge. Union and join search are effective techniques for discovering data when augmenting an existing table. In exploratory search, instead, keyword search is commonly adopted to find a relatively small set of highly relevant tables matching some search terms. In this context, semantic search is a new technique that exploits the presence of named entities in exemplar tuples used as queries and in target tables. Hence, keyword search and entity search are able to find a diverse set of tables. In this work, we propose \texttt{Thetis++}, which combines keyword and semantic table search to discover relevant tables that combine the semantic signal with the presence of exact keyword matches. Incorporating multiple paradigms and sources of information allow us to combine the best of multiple worlds. Therefore, we study many alternative techniques for combining rankings and evaluate these for the table search task in data lakes. We explore both unsupervised and supervised techniques, including TOPSIS. Finally, alternative to Thetis++ combining keyword and semantic relevance signals, we study a variant of learning-to-rank for the table search task in data lakes. Our evaluation highlights both the limitations of many standard approaches along with some promising directions offered by learned approaches. Furthermore, while indexes for keyword search are quite efficient, here we provide insights into how to improve the scalability of prefiltering techniques for semantic search, comparing LSH indexes with Hierarchical Navigable Small Worlds. Our experiments show that HNSW drastically improves the runtime of semantic table search by 4.7X on average whilst retaining the high-quality tables. Together, our findings plot the line for effective and efficient data discovery techniques for semantic data lakes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Thetis++，融合关键词搜索与语义（实体）表搜索，并系统比较多种排序组合与学习排序方法，同时用 HNSW 提升语义搜索可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 数据湖中发现相关表仍是关键挑战：union/join 搜索适合表增强，探索式搜索多用关键词搜索，而语义搜索利用示例元组中的命名实体，两者能各自找到多样化的表集合；亟需将二者结合以兼取优点。
AI.method: 提出 Thetis++ 结合关键词与语义表搜索；研究多种无监督（含 TOPSIS）与有监督的排序组合技术；作为替代方案，探索用于数据湖表搜索的学习排序变体；在语义搜索预过滤的可扩展性方面比较 LSH 与 HNSW 索引。
AI.result: 评估揭示了多种标准方法的局限性与学习方法的潜力；HNSW 相比 LSH 使语义表搜索平均运行时间提升 4.7 倍，同时保持高质量表结果。
AI.conclusion: 关键词与语义信号结合可行且有效；学习排序是有前景的方向；HNSW 提供高效可扩展的语义表搜索，为语义数据湖的高效数据发现指明路线。

title: Sequential Contract Design for Budgeted Crowdsourcing
summary:
A principal wishes to crowdsource a collection of tasks under a fixed compensation budget. The quality of a task's outcome is stochastic and depends on the worker's effort level. Since this effort is unobservable, the principal offers contracts to workers specifying their compensation for each possible outcome. The principal offers these contracts sequentially, using previously observed outcomes and payments to decide whom to approach next and what contract to offer. The objective is to maximize the expected value of the work produced while ensuring that total payments never exceed the budget, regardless of the realized outcomes. Contract design must therefore account both for a worker's incentives and for the budget available to incentivize others.
  For valuations that are additive across tasks, we characterize how the approximability of the optimal adaptive policy depends on the numbers of workers, effort levels, and outcomes. Polynomial-time constant-factor approximation is possible whenever the number of workers, effort levels per worker, or outcomes per task is constant, but impossible in general when all three are unrestricted, unless $P=NP$. We obtain tight guarantees for every fixed number of workers, establish computational hardness even in restricted settings, and obtain exact algorithms and approximation schemes in more structured settings.
  We also investigate simple contract structures, demonstrating both the benefits of adapting contracts to previous outcomes and the limitations of local contract rules, while identifying conditions under which a local policy achieves a constant-factor guarantee. Finally, we extend our analysis beyond additive valuations, obtaining constant-factor approximations for monotone submodular valuations with binary outcomes, including guarantees against a stronger full-knowledge benchmark under additional assumptions.

AI.tldr: 研究预算约束下众包任务的序贯契约设计：给出关于工人数、努力水平数、结果数的最优自适应策略可近似性刻画，并在附加结构下得到紧保证、精确算法与近似方案。
AI.motivation: 众包场景中任务质量随机且取决于工人不可观测的努力，委托方需用契约激励，同时总支付不能超预算；已观测的结果与支付还能用于指导后续对象选择与契约设计，需要刻画这种自适应策略的优化难度。
AI.method: 对任务价值可加的情形，建立自适应序贯契约模型，按工人数、努力水平数、每任务结果数的取值分析最优策略的近似性；分析简单契约结构与局部契约规则；并推广到二值结果下的单调子模价值。
AI.result: 三参数中任一为常数时存在多项式时间常数因子近似，三者均无限制时除非 P=NP 否则不可行；对每个固定工人数给出紧保证，在受限情形证明计算困难性，在更结构化情形给出精确算法与近似方案；证明自适应于先前结果有益、局部规则有局限，并给出局部策略常数因子保证的条件；子模价值二值结果下得到常数因子近似，附加假设下可对标更强的全知基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统刻画了预算约束下序贯契约设计的可计算边界，指出自适应性的价值与简单契约结构的适用条件，并把结论扩展到非可加（子模）价值。

title: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize. Answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer; learned reward models and LLM judges work everywhere, but their scores are not probabilities. We study RLCDR (Reinforcement Learning from Calibrated Decision Rewards). An LLM converted into a decision model answers a typed question about a response ("is the final answer correct?", "which step is the first error?") with a probability distribution, read in one forward pass, debiased over option orders and calibrated with about a hundred labels. Training Qwen3-1.7B with GRPO on MATH, this reference-free reward raises MATH500 accuracy from 72.2% to 76.8% (+4.65 points, p < 1e-4), matching training on the answer key (76.9%), while a random reward gains only +0.65. The gain grows with difficulty, from 44.8% to 51.7% on the hardest level. On the policy's own changing samples the reward stays calibrated: its expected calibration error is half that of a softmax judge on the same 27B backbone (0.074 vs. 0.141), and it shows no sign of reward hacking. Without step training, the same model finds the first wrong step better than a dedicated 7B process reward model (ProcessBench F1 0.772 vs. 0.722, 20/20 splits). We also map where the approach stops being enough: trained only on problems the base model mostly fails, the reference-free reward still improves the policy (+1.9 MATH500 points, p = 0.03) but trails the answer key, because its probabilities become overconfident on that distribution. We state six hypotheses in advance and test each with a control designed to falsify it.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCDR：将LLM转为"决策模型"，对答案正确性/首个错误步骤等类型化问题输出概率分布（单次前向、去偏、约百标签校准），作为免参考答案的RL奖励。在Qwen3-1.7B+MATH上，MATH500从72.2%升至76.8%，接近答案键训练（76.9%）。
AI.motivation: RL只能教会模型其奖励能识别的东西：答案检查器精确但依赖参考答案；学习型奖励模型与LLM裁判通用但输出分数不是概率，易被刷分、难校准。
AI.method: 用LLM作为决策模型，对"最终答案是否正确""首个错误步骤"等类型化问题输出选项概率分布；一次前向读取，做选项顺序去偏，并用约100个标签做校准；以该概率作为GRPO的奖励，在Qwen3-1.7B与MATH上训练。
AI.result: MATH500 72.2%→76.8%（+4.65，p<1e-4），与答案键训练76.9%相当，随机奖励仅+0.65；难题档44.8%→51.7%。在策略自身变化样本上ECE为0.074，约为同27B骨干softmax裁判（0.141）的一半；ProcessBench首错定位F1 0.772 vs 专用7B PRM 0.722（20/20划分胜出）。局限：仅用基础模型大多失败的问题训练时提升+1.9（p=0.03）但不及答案键，概率变得过度自信。
AI.conclusion: 校准的决策型概率可作通用、免参考答案且抗刷分的RL奖励，效果逼近答案键并能顺带获得步骤级定位能力；在分布偏移（高失败率问题）下校准退化导致收益落后。作者预先提出六个假设，并各设可证伪对照实验验证。

title: Formally Verified Semidefinite Programming
summary: We present a formally verified Rust implementation of a first-order semidefinite programming solver, a nontrivial piece of numerical software. We wrote the solver by hand and then directed Claude to generate the entire verification in Verus, an automated theorem prover for Rust programs. We discuss the algorithm underlying the solver, its implementation in Rust, and our pragmatic approach to proving it correct in Verus.

AI.tldr: 本文给出一个经 Verus 形式化验证的 Rust 一阶半定规划（SDP）求解器，验证代码由 Claude 在人工手写求解器的基础上自动生成。
AI.motivation: 数值软件（尤其是 SDP 求解器）正确性至关重要但验证难度大，作者希望探索用 LLM 生成形式化验证代码的可行性与实践路径。
AI.method: 先人工实现基于一阶方法的 SDP 求解器（Rust），再引导 Claude 为其生成完整的 Verus 验证证明，并总结面向定理证明器的务实验证策略。
AI.result: 成功获得一个非平凡数值软件的端到端形式化验证实现，展示了 LLM 辅助验证在复杂数值代码上的可操作性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 生成形式化验证对非平凡数值软件是现实可行的，但需人工设计合理的验证粒度与务实证明策略。

title: What a Calibrated Probability Hides: Belief-Level Post-Training for Decision Models
summary: A calibrated decision model can predict how often each answer is chosen. The same prediction can reflect disagreement among people who are confident in their choices or uncertainty among people who share a belief. Disagreement calls for identifying whose perspective applies, while uncertainty calls for gathering more evidence. Standard post-training scores a single prediction against one observed choice at a time, learning the pooled distribution without distinguishing these two sources of uncertainty. We introduce Belief-Grouped Policy Optimization (BGPO). The policy proposes a list of beliefs, estimates their prevalence, and predicts a choice distribution for each. During training, BGPO uses Bayes' rule to estimate how likely each belief was to generate an observed choice. These estimates weight the choice's contribution to each belief's log-score reward. To discover rare beliefs, the policy also proposes lists after seeing a few observed choices and retains them only if they predict held-out choices well. At inference, the policy uses only the question and combines the belief-specific distributions by prevalence to produce a calibrated aggregate prediction. On benchmarks covering opinions, conversation safety, emotions elicited by artwork, and photo aesthetics, BGPO achieves the lowest conditional, worst-group, and overall Jensen-Shannon divergence across model initializations. It improves conditional divergence on both text and image tasks. On a synthetic image task with known beliefs, BGPO recovers the underlying groups more accurately than baselines trained with belief labels.

AI.tldr: 提出 BGPO，将校准预测中的分歧与不确定性分解为不同"信念组"，用贝叶斯加权训练，实现更优的校准聚合预测。
AI.motivation: 标准后训练只对单一预测与单个观测选择打分，学到的是混合分布，无法区分"自信人群间的分歧"与"共同信念下的不确定性"，导致校准预测无法正确应对。
AI.method: Belief-Grouped Policy Optimization：策略提出一组信念及其流行度，并为每个信念预测选择分布；训练时用贝叶斯规则估计每个信念生成观测选择的概率，作为该选择对各信念对数奖励的权重；并通过"先看少量选择再提信念、以留出选择预测效果筛选"来发现稀有信念；推理时仅用问题，按流行度加权组合各信念分布。
AI.result: 在观点、对话安全、艺术引发情感、照片美学等基准上，跨多种初始化取得最低的条件、最差组与整体 Jensen-Shannon 散度；文本与图像任务的条件散度均改善；在已知信念的合成图像任务上比使用信念标签训练的基线更准确恢复潜在分组。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模信念分组可将预测不确定性正确归因于分歧或不确定性，从而获得更好的校准聚合预测。

title: The ROI of Small Examples: Optimizing In-Context Learning Under Token Budgets
summary: In-context learning (ICL) improves large language model performance at inference time without updating model parameters. However, these gains are not free: in practical deployments, longer prompts directly increase inference cost and latency. Under a fixed token budget, prompt construction therefore becomes a resource-allocation problem. While prior work has often focused on how many examples to include in ICL, we study the complementary question of whether the available budget is better spent on a few long demonstrations or on a larger number of shorter ones. We study this aspect in question answering (QA), by organizing candidate demonstrations into length-based bins and constructing prompts from examples within the same length range under fixed budgets. Experiments on two QA benchmarks (\textit{Beat the AI} and \textit{Natural Questions}), using six instruction-tuned LLMs, show that shorter demonstrations are generally the most effective use of prompt space. This effect is especially strong on \textit{Beat the AI}, and remains visible on NQ, although gains are smaller and saturate earlier in the long-context setting. An additional natural language inference experiment on ANLI R3 finds that one of the two shorter bins performs best for five of six models, although longer demonstrations remain competitive. Overall, our results highlight demonstration granularity as an important factor in prompt design.

AI.tldr: 在固定token预算下，研究发现ICL提示中用"多条短示范"通常比"少量长示范"更有效，体现出示范粒度是提示设计的重要维度。
AI.motivation: ICL无需更新参数即可提升大模型性能，但长提示会增加推理成本与延迟。在固定token预算下，提示构造本质是资源分配问题。以往工作多关注"放多少示范"，本文转向互补问题：预算该花在少量长示范还是更多短示范上。
AI.method: 在QA任务上，将候选示范按长度分箱，在固定预算下从同一长度区间选取示例构造提示；在两个QA基准（Beat the AI、Natural Questions）上用六个指令微调LLM实验，并补充ANLI R3上的NLI实验。
AI.result: 更短的示范通常最有效地利用提示空间；该效应在Beat the AI上尤其明显，在NQ上仍然存在但增益更小且在长上下文设定中更早饱和。ANLI R3上两个较短分箱之一在六个模型中五个表现最佳，但长示范仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 示范粒度是提示设计的重要因素，固定预算下优先选择更多短示范通常更划算。

title: HapBO: Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization via Expert Natural Language Priors
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) can be substantially more sample-efficient when informed by prior knowledge about the problem. In practice, however, such knowledge is often available only in natural language, e.g., expert intuitions or documentation, rather than as the explicit probability distribution landscape that prior-guided BO methods may require. Leveraging it effectively demands both an expressive mapping from language to priors and robustness to information that may be misleading. We propose HapBO (Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization), which elicits beliefs once from a human expert, a large language model (LLM), or both, and deterministically compiles a structured specification into a reusable belief function ($π: \mathcal{X} \to[0,1]$), with a rich representation not restricted to a Gaussian family. Building on $α$-$π$BO, HapBO applies this belief function through a bounded positive multiplier on any nonnegative acquisition, preserving positive acquisition support and requiring no LLM calls during optimization. We prove that, for the Expected Improvement acquisition function (EI), HapBO preserves the standard simple-regret rate up to a bounded factor, even under adversarial beliefs. We evaluate HapBO on 40 HPOBench tasks, a synthetic suite in 6-15 dimensions and two real-world applications: cortical neurostimulation and constrained solar design. HapBO achieves the lowest aggregate HPOBench regret and strong real-world task performance, with zero in-loop token cost. In real-world applications it improves the optimization outcome even at budgets of 12-20 queries, and at a small fraction of the wall-clock and token costs of other LLM-based methods.

AI.tldr: HapBO 通过一次性从人类专家或大模型获取语言形式先验，确定性地编译为可复用的信念函数 π: X→[0,1]，并在 α-πBO 框架下以有界正乘子作用于任意非负采集函数，从而在不引入优化循环内 LLM 调用的情况下显著提升贝叶斯优化的样本效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 实践中先验知识多以自然语言（专家直觉、文档）形式存在，而非先验引导式 BO 所需的显式概率分布。有效利用这类知识需要两个条件：一是从语言到先验的富有表达力的映射，二是对可能具有误导性的信息保持鲁棒。现有方法难以同时满足二者。
AI.method: HapBO 仅在开始时由人类专家、LLM 或二者共同诱导一次信念，并将结构化规格确定性地编译为信念函数 π（表示不受高斯族限制）。基于 α-πBO，将该信念函数以有界正乘子的形式作用于任意非负采集函数，保持采集函数正支撑；优化过程中无需任何 LLM 调用。
AI.result: 理论证明：对期望改进（EI）采集函数，即使信念具有对抗性，HapBO 仍以有界因子保持标准 simple-regret 速率。实验上，在 40 个 HPOBench 任务、6–15 维合成套件以及皮层神经刺激与受约束太阳能设计两个真实任务中，HapBO 取得最低的 HPOBench 聚合遗憾和出色的真实任务表现，循环内 token 成本为零；在 12–20 次查询的小预算下即改善优化结果，且墙钟时间与 token 成本仅为其他 LLM 方法的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: HapBO 提供了一种高效、鲁棒的“语言先验 → 可复用信念函数”路径，兼顾理论保证与实用性能，在样本效率、计算成本及小预算场景上优于基于 LLM 的方法，适用于多种真实工程与科学优化问题。

title: Can LLMs Resolve Entity Conflicts in Domain Specific NLU Pipelines?
comment: This work was completed in February, 2025
summary: Resolving entity conflicts is a critical step in Pipeline-based NLU architectures, especially when multiple extractors provide overlapping or conflicting outputs. Traditional rule-based entity conflict resolution methods often lack flexibility and are unscalable. In this work, we aim to study if the broad knowledge of LLMs can be leveraged to resolve entity conflicts in domain specific NLU pipelines. We present an experimental comparison between a traditional rule-based conflict resolution method, and two LLM-based approaches: a multi-shot prompting method using the Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model and a LoRA fine-tuned Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model. The evaluation was conducted under two setups: (1) a broad assessment of LLM's capability to match existing NLU pipeline output, and (2) a more controlled scenario assessing the LLM accuracy on human-labeled data. Results show that while multi-shot prompting offers ease of adaptation and rapid behavioral changes, the fine-tuned model delivers superior performance on complex, ambiguous cases. Ultimately, the best approach appears to be a combination of both strategies, leveraging multi-shot prompting's flexibility alongside the broad accuracy gains of LoRA fine-tuning for a more comprehensive performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索用大语言模型（LLM）解决领域特定NLU流水线中的实体冲突，比较传统规则方法、Llama3.1-8B-Instruct多示例提示与LoRA微调三种方案，发现微调在复杂歧义场景更优，最佳方案为二者结合。
AI.motivation: Pipeline-based NLU架构中多个抽取器输出重叠或冲突，传统规则式实体冲突解决方法缺乏灵活性且难以扩展，作者希望验证LLM的广博知识能否用于领域特定NLU流水线的实体冲突消解。
AI.method: 实验对比三类方法：(1) 传统规则式冲突消解；(2) 使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct的多示例提示（multi-shot prompting）；(3) 对Llama3.1-8B-Instruct进行LoRA微调。评估设两种设置：一是评估LLM匹配现有NLU流水线输出的广泛能力，二是基于人工标注数据的更受控准确性评估。
AI.result: 多示例提示易于适配、能快速改变模型行为；LoRA微调模型在复杂、歧义案例上表现更优。两者各有优势，单一方法无法全面覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 最佳方案是结合多示例提示的灵活性与LoRA微调带来的整体准确率提升，以获得更全面的性能表现。

title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
summary: We characterise path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as an extended log-exponential family. Immunity to account splitting, merging and reopening further restrict the class. Homogeneity (essentially) restricts the class to a one-parameter family ordered by both fairness and platform risk. Its split-proof members continuously interpolate between proportional division and water-filling. Among these rules, decreasing the parameter reduces risk at the cost of increasing inequality in how accounts are treated. This suggests selecting the parameter through an ex-ante calibration to a risk bound on historical data to choose a maximally fair rule subject to that bound. A counterfactual replay of Hyperliquid's ADL episode on 10 October 2025 finds that a range of intermediate parameters significantly improves on the observed allocation in both burden dispersion and subsequent risk statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了路径无关的自动减仓（ADL）规则为扩展的对数-指数族，并在账户拆分/合并免疫性与齐次性约束下得到按公平性与平台风险排序的单参数族，提出通过历史数据风险约束的事前校准选择参数，并在Hyperliquid 2025年10月10日的ADL事件回放中验证中间参数显著改进配置。
AI.motivation: ADL是衍生品交易平台在极端行情下的强制减仓机制，其规则设计直接影响账户负担分配的公平性与平台自身风险，但缺乏对可行规则类的理论刻画与参数化选择依据。
AI.method: 先公理化刻画：路径无关性⇒扩展对数-指数族；账户拆分/合并/重开免疫性进一步收紧类别；齐次性将类别约化为单参数族。该族中拆分免疫成员在按比例分配与注水（water-filling）之间连续插值，且参数单调地权衡平台风险与账户间不平等。据此提出以历史数据上的风险上限做事前校准，选择满足约束的最公平规则。最后对Hyperliquid 2025年10月10日ADL事件做反事实回放。
AI.result: 理论上得到按公平性和平台风险双重排序的单参数规则族；实证回放显示，多个中间参数取值在负担分散度和后续风险统计上均显著优于实际观测到的配置。
AI.conclusion: ADL规则设计可归结为单参数、可公理化刻画的选择问题；通过风险约束下的公平最大化校准，可在不牺牲风险控制的前提下改善配置公平性与后续风险表现，为平台ADL机制提供可操作的参数化设计框架。

title: EverydayBench: Evaluating Satisfactory Completion of Live User-Facing Digital Work
summary: Everyday digital tasks, from selecting products and planning trips to conducting research and creating artifacts, require AI agents to deliver useful outcomes rather than merely retrieve web information. Yet evaluating these outcomes on the live web is challenging, as a single request may admit multiple valid results, and changing web information can alter which results remain valid over time. Although existing benchmarks address aspects of this setting, they do not fully integrate predefined success criteria, current evidence verification, and deliverable-quality assessment for agent-selected outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce EverydayBench, a benchmark of 77 human-authored tasks spanning eight domains of everyday life and work. Each task specifies success criteria before execution without prescribing an answer or workflow, allowing agents to select their own outcomes. To evaluate submissions under fixed success criteria, EverydayBench combines (1) deterministic checks of explicit constraints, (2) verification of claims against agent-cited webpages retrieved at evaluation time, and (3) rubric-based assessment of final deliverable quality. We further validate the protocol through human judgments, repeated scoring under fixed evidence, and controlled grounding failures. Across 23 reported agent-model configurations, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 tie for the highest strict pass rate at 54.55%; a controlled GPT-6 Sol effort sweep ranges from 29.87% at low effort to 45.45% at max effort. Reliability varies substantially by task type: GPT-5.6 Sol leads lookup, Fable 5.1 leads planning, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 tie on comparison, and GPT-6 Astra and Sonnet 5.5 tie on customized deliverables. Together, these findings highlight the difficulty of delivering complete, well-supported, and usable outcomes for everyday user requests.

AI.tldr: 提出 EverydayBench：77 个人工撰写、覆盖 8 大生活与工作领域的任务基准，在事先给定成功标准的前提下评估智能体在真实网页上产出的"可用成果"（含硬约束检查、引用页面证据核验与交付物质量评分），23 种模型配置最高严格通过率仅 54.55%。
AI.motivation: 日常数字任务（选品、行程规划、调研、创作）要求智能体交付有用成果而非仅检索网页信息；但在实时网页上评估困难——同一请求可有多个有效结果，网页信息随时间变化会改变结果有效性。现有基准未能同时整合预设成功标准、当前证据核验与交付物质量评估。
AI.method: 构建 77 个跨 8 领域的任务，任务只预设成功标准、不规定答案或工作流，由智能体自选成果形式。评估采用三支柱：(1) 显式约束的确定性检查；(2) 对智能体所引网页（评估时实时抓取）进行主张核验；(3) 基于评分量表的交付物质量评估。通过人类判断、固定证据下重复评分及受控证据失效实验验证协议可靠性。
AI.result: 23 种智能体-模型配置中，Claude Opus 5.5 与 Claude Fable 5.1 并列最高严格通过率 54.55%；GPT-6 Sol 的推理力度扫描从 low 的 29.87% 升至 max 的 45.45%。任务类型差异明显：GPT-5.6 Sol 领先查询类，Fable 5.1 领先规划类，Opus 5.5 与 Fable 5.1 在比较类并列，GPT-6 Astra 与 Sonnet 5.5 在定制交付物类并列。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体在提供完整、有据可依且可用的日常任务成果方面仍存在显著困难；该基准为可复现、抗时变的结果评估提供了标准化协议。

title: Ontology of Software Maintenance
summary: Software maintenance is often a long and costly phase of the software lifecycle, encompassing activities such as defect correction, adaptation, code improvement, and functionality enhancement. Conceptual inconsistencies and terminological variation continue to hinder effective communication among researchers and practitioners. To address this gap, this paper presents the Software Maintenance Top-Domain Ontology (SwMaintTDO), a high-domain ontology developed within a five-tier ontological architecture. This ontology was constructed using competency questions, ontological analysis of documented maintenance processes, artifacts, and resources, and alignment with established software engineering standards. SwMaintTDO provides a unified and extensible conceptual model for representing key maintenance processes, roles, resources, artifacts, goal purposes, and the transition of target modifiable and context entities from current to updated maintenance situations. The applicability and value of SwMaintTDO are demonstrated through its application -via its concepts and relationships- to the process specification of a corrective maintenance strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软件维护顶层领域本体 SwMaintTDO，用于统一表示维护过程、角色、资源等概念，并通过纠正性维护流程规格验证其价值。
AI.motivation: 软件维护是软件生命周期中漫长且成本高昂的阶段，但概念不一致和术语差异阻碍了研究者与从业者的沟通，需要统一的概念模型。
AI.method: 在五层本体架构下开发高层领域本体，采用能力问题、对已记录维护过程/制品/资源的本体分析，并与已有软件工程标准对齐来构建。
AI.result: SwMaintTDO 提供了可扩展的统一概念模型，覆盖关键维护过程、角色、资源、制品、目标用途，以及目标可修改实体与上下文实体从当前到更新维护情境的转变。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 SwMaintTDO 的概念与关系应用于纠正性维护策略的流程规格，证明了其适用性与价值。

title: MV-JEPA: Post-Training Video Encoders for Cross-View Understanding
summary: JEPA-based video encoders learn strong representations for video and image understanding through prediction in latent space. However, their standard pretraining predicts features within individual images or video clips, without explicitly exploiting paired camera views of the same object or moment. Consequently, the learned representations may not reliably support matching across different camera viewpoints. To solve this problem, we introduce multi-view predictive post-training to strengthen cross-view instance and temporal correspondence while retaining independent single-view inference. A shared encoder processes masked context views independently, and a training-time predictor jointly predicts latent tokens for masked context regions and a fully held-out view. We alternate cross-view prediction with single-view masked prediction on general image and video data to help retain the encoder's pretrained capabilities. After only 9,000 post-training updates on a single GPU, MV-JEPA improves cross-view instance retrieval and coarse cross-camera moment retrieval on various datasets, with further gains in zero-shot action-phase retrieval and frozen-feature classification on AE2. Frozen-probe evaluations further indicate that post-training largely preserves motion recognition, image recognition, and dense semantic segmentation performance on the evaluated benchmarks. Together, these results demonstrate that multi-view predictive post-training can strengthen instance and coarse temporal correspondence in JEPA video encoders without modifying the encoder architecture or single-view inference interface.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角预测式后训练方法（MV-JEPA），在单个GPU上仅9000步更新即可增强JEPA视频编码器的跨视角实例与时序匹配能力，且基本不损害原有单视角能力。
AI.motivation: JEPA视频编码器在潜空间进行预测学习强表征，但其预训练只在单张图像或单个视频片段内预测特征，未显式利用同一物体/时刻的配对相机视角，导致学到的表征难以可靠支持跨相机视角的匹配。作者希望在保留单视角独立推理接口的前提下解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出多视角预测后训练：共享编码器独立处理被掩码的上下文视角，训练时引入预测器，联合预测掩码上下文区域的潜变量token与一个完全留出的视角的token；并在通用图像与视频数据上交替进行跨视角预测与单视角掩码预测，以保留原预训练能力，不修改编码器架构。
AI.result: 单GPU约9000步后训练后，MV-JEPA在多个数据集上提升跨视角实例检索与粗粒度跨相机时刻检索，并在零样本动作阶段检索与AE2上的冻结特征分类上进一步提升；冻结探针显示运动识别、图像识别与稠密语义分割性能基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 多视角预测式后训练能在不改变编码器架构或单视角推理接口的情况下，强化JEPA视频编码器的实例与粗粒度时序对应能力。

title: No-Harm-Jury A Jury-Based Multi-Dimensional Harm Evaluation Framework for Medical AI Responses
summary: We present No-Harm-Jury, a jury-based automated evaluation framework that scores AI-generated medical responses across seven conceptually distinct harm dimensions using a panel of five diverse language models as independent jurors. Responses generated by Ministral-14B on 3,000 questions drawn from PubMedQA, MedQA, and MedMCQA are scored by five jurors across dimensions of informational, social, psychological, autonomy, economic, privacy, and epistemic harm; the 151 empty responses (98 MedQA, 53 MedM- CQA) are excluded, leaving 2,849 valid samples. The median aggregation robustly suppresses individual juror biases while maintaining coverage through complementary specialisation. No existing system combines all five prop- erties of No-Harm-Jury: automated scalable evaluation, five diverse LLM jurors, robust me- dian aggregation (with a reliability-weighted extension), seven conceptually distinct harm dimensions, and application to medical QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: No-Harm-Jury 是一个基于陪审团的自动化评估框架，用五个多样化语言模型作为独立评审，从七个维度对医学问答中的 AI 回答进行危害打分，并对 2849 条有效样本进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有系统无法同时具备自动化可扩展评估、多个多样化 LLM 评审、稳健聚合、多维危害划分以及医学问答基准应用这五项特性，因此需要一个更全面、可缩放的医学回答危害评估方案。
AI.method: 使用五个多样化语言模型作为独立陪审员，对 Ministral-14B 在 PubMedQA、MedQA、MedMCQA 共 3000 个问题上的回答进行评分；覆盖信息、社会、心理、自主性、经济、隐私、认知七个概念上不同的危害维度；采用中位数聚合抑制个体评审偏差，并提供可靠性加权扩展；剔除 151 条空回答后保留 2849 条有效样本。
AI.result: 中位数聚合能够稳健地抑制单个评审的偏差，同时通过评审互补专长维持覆盖；最终在 2849 条有效医学问答样本上完成七维度危害评分。
AI.conclusion: No-Harm-Jury 首次同时整合五项关键特性，为医学问答场景提供了一种自动化、可扩展且多维度的 LLM 回答危害评估框架。

title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) systems deployed in border control and airport surveillance are constrained by a critical assumption: subjects are captured at close range, typically under one meter. No existing benchmark systematically addresses multi-distance capture, diverse environmental conditions, and concurrent spoofing and occlusion-based attacks, leaving deployed models underprepared for real-world scenarios. We introduce a video-based PAD dataset of 374,000+ frames from 261 unique identities collected across five standoff distances (1 m-100 m) under indoor and outdoor conditions using a DSLR camera (C) and a mobile sensor (M), with three-class labels: live, spoof, and props (occlusions); models are trained and evaluated on video clips rather than single frames. We fine-tune and benchmark four CNN architectures: MobileNetV3, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and ResNet-50. The higher-resolution DSLR maintains near-perfect spoof classification rate across all distances, while the lower-resolution mobile sensor degrades sharply beyond 50 m, with props classification rate dropping to 55% at 75 m for MobileNetV3. EfficientNet achieves the best overall performance (98.48% accuracy, ACER 2.01%). Generalization tests on unseen attack datasets yield 89-94% accuracy, validating cross-domain robustness. These results establish capture distance and sensor resolution as critical but underexplored axes of PAD difficulty. The dataset will be publicly released under an End-User License Agreement to support reproducible long-range PAD research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个覆盖1–100米多距离、室内外、含欺骗与遮挡三类标签的视频活体检测数据集（374,000+帧，261个身份），并基准测试四种CNN。
AI.motivation: 现有PAD研究与基准均假设近距离（<1米）采集，缺乏对多距离、多环境、欺骗与遮挡并发攻击的系统评测，导致边境管控/机场监控等真实场景下模型准备不足。
AI.method: 构建视频级PAD数据集：5个距离档（1米–100米）、室内外条件、DSLR相机与手机两种传感器，标签为live/spoof/props（遮挡）三类，以视频片段而非单帧训练评估；微调并对比MobileNetV3、MobileNet、EfficientNet、ResNet-50四种CNN。
AI.result: 高分辨率DSLR在各距离上欺骗分类近乎完美；低分辨率手机传感器在50米外性能骤降，MobileNetV3在75米处props分类率仅55%。EfficientNet整体最佳（准确率98.48%，ACER 2.01%）。未见攻击数据集泛化测试达89–94%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 采集距离与传感器分辨率是PAD难度中关键但被忽视的维度；数据集将在EULA协议下公开以支持可复现的远距离PAD研究。

title: CACO: Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization for Continuous Generative Retrieval
summary: Continuous generative retrievers powered by flow matching and diffusion sample multiple queries in item embedding space for parallel approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search under fixed retrieval budgets. However, optimizing distribution diversity or target-level interest separation ignores set-level retrieval geometry: sampled queries collapse onto overlapping ANN neighborhoods, while discrete top-K lookup and single-target supervision block end-to-end coverage optimization. We introduce CACO (Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization), a lightweight self-supervised post-training framework that coordinates queries from frozen flow-matching and diffusion retrievers toward complementary item coverage with negligible additional inference latency. CACO uses empirical retrieval frequencies across sampled reference queries as a relevance proxy, formulating a label-free coverage objective that improves recall across all 30 backbone-dataset settings in offline greedy selection experiments. To avoid the inference overhead of generating a large query pool, CACO employs a coordinated query adjustment network that combines inter-query bidirectional attention with gated relative directions, finally updating queries by bounded tangent-space projection and spherical retraction. During training, CACO applies tangential antithetic perturbations and measures each query's marginal gain via counterfactual single-query replacement, yielding an unbiased gradient estimator of smoothed set coverage across non-differentiable ANN search. On eight public benchmarks and an in-house 24-partition streaming industrial dataset, CACO improves Recall@100 by up to 23.7% and Recall@400 by up to 23.9% over the strongest baseline, cuts inter-query overlap by 53.3%-64.9%, and adds only 0.5%-3.0% inference latency.

AI.tldr: 提出CACO，一个轻量自监督后训练框架，协调冻结的流匹配/扩散检索器生成的多查询覆盖互补物品，显著提升召回并降低查询间重叠。
AI.motivation: 连续生成式检索器在固定预算下并行采样多查询做ANN搜索，但现有方法优化分布多样性或目标级兴趣分离，忽略了集合级检索几何：采样查询塌缩到重叠的ANN邻域，且离散top-K与单目标监督阻断端到端覆盖优化。
AI.method: 以采样参考查询的经验检索频率作为相关性代理，构建无标签覆盖目标；用协调查询调整网络（查询间双向注意力+门控相对方向）避免生成大查询池的开销，经有界切空间投影与球面回缩更新查询；训练时用切向对偶扰动和反事实单查询替换估计边际增益，得到平滑集合覆盖的无偏梯度估计，跨越不可微ANN搜索。
AI.result: 离线贪心选择实验中全部30个骨干-数据集设置召回均提升；八个公开基准与一个24分区流式工业数据集上，Recall@100最高提升23.7%，Recall@400最高提升23.9%，查询间重叠降低53.3%–64.9%，额外推理延迟仅0.5%–3.0%。
AI.conclusion: CACO作为即插即用的后训练框架，在不重训骨干、几乎不增延迟的前提下实现集合级覆盖优化，明显改善多查询并行检索的召回与多样性。

title: Pareto-Optimal and Strategyproof Data-Sharing Between Competitors
summary: We study data-sharing among firms competing in the same market through the quality of their predictive models. We model firms' profit through two main components, precision and market share, where the former depends on the firm's own number of datapoints and the latter depends on the endowments of all firms. We characterize Pareto-optimal contracts as those in which at least one firm receives all of the other firms' datapoints. We then propose a parametric family of data-sharing contracts and show that, under any of them, the relative market shares of all firms remain constant, eliminating the negative effect of sharing data with competitors and equalizing all firms' gains relative to the no-sharing scenario. We further show that one contract within this family satisfies both Pareto-optimality and strategyproofness against firms attempting to under-declare the size of their initial endowment. Finally, using a real-world dataset, we empirically test the gain in profit for all firms under the contract described above, and show that data-sharing is particularly beneficial when the machine learning task is harder or when firms' initial endowments are closer to homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 该文研究同一市场中竞争企业间的数据共享契约：以预测模型质量刻画利润，证明帕累托最优契约为至少一方获得他方全部数据，并给出使相对市场份额不变的契约族，其中一个满足帕累托最优且防策略操纵，实证表明任务越难或初始数据越同质，共享收益越大。
AI.motivation: 企业间共享数据可提升各自预测模型精度，但也可能强化竞争对手、改变市场份额，从而损害自身利润。本文旨在设计能兼顾效率（帕累托最优）与公平/激励相容的数据共享契约，回答"是否存在既提升所有企业利润又不变动竞争格局的共享机制"。
AI.method: 将企业利润分解为两部分：精度（取决于自身数据量）与市场份额（取决于所有企业数据禀赋）；在此模型下刻画帕累托最优契约，提出一个参数化契约族并分析其市场份额与收益性质，进一步考察防"少报初始禀赋"的策略操纵性；最后用真实数据集对上述契约下的利润增益进行实证检验。
AI.result: 帕累托最优契约等价于至少一家企业获得其他所有企业的全部数据点；所提参数化契约族下各企业相对市场份额保持不变，从而消除共享的负面竞争效应，并使各企业相对于不共享情形的收益相等；其中之一同时满足帕累托最优与防策略操纵；实证显示任务越难或初始数据禀赋越同质，数据共享的利润增益越显著。
AI.conclusion: 数据共享可以在不改变市场竞争格局的前提下实现帕累托改进，且可设计出激励相容的契约；共享价值随机器学习任务难度上升、企业间数据异质性下降而增大，为竞争企业间的数据合作提供了理论依据与可操作契约形式。

title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate. We propose Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging (BGAA), a TTC algorithm for time series forecasting that builds a causal verifier from the series's own history, using rolling-origin backtests to score structured views of the context, discard those that underperform the untransformed context, and average the survivors' predictive distributions. BGAA improves every tested TSFM-benchmark combination, reducing MASE by 0.5-1.0% on GIFT-Eval, 1.3-5.0% on fev-bench, and 1.7-5.9% on BOOM, where a 313M model with TTC outperforms the 1B and 2.5B models in its family. We further show that useful views have structured, model-dependent effects consistent with a prior-transport interpretation. On the 53 cross-fittable GIFT-Eval configs, the deployed policy gains only 0.4-1.3% CRPS, versus 1.4-4.1% when choosing the best view for each dataset configuration and 17-19% when choosing the best view separately for each test window. This gap suggests that a major remaining challenge is window-level view selection.

AI.tldr: 提出因果可验证的测试时计算算法BGAA，通过滚动起点回测筛选上下文视图并平均幸存者预测分布，在多个时序基准上稳定提升并让小模型超过大模型。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算（TTC）在语言模型上有效，但无法直接迁移到时间序列预测：预测必须因果，不能用未来信息给候选打分，因此缺乏可用的验证器。
AI.method: 用序列自身历史构建因果验证器：对上下文的结构化视图做滚动起点回测评分，剔除逊于未变换上下文的视图，再对幸存视图的预测分布取平均（Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging）。
AI.result: 所有测试的TSFM-基准组合均有提升：GIFT-Eval上MASE降0.5–1.0%，fev-bench降1.3–5.0%，BOOM降1.7–5.9%；313M模型加TTC后超过同家族1B与2.5B模型。53个可交叉拟合配置上部署策略仅得0.4–1.3% CRPS增益，而逐配置选最优视图为1.4–4.1%，逐测试窗口选最优视图可达17–19%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视图的效果具有一致性，符合先验迁移解释；主要剩余挑战是窗口级视图选择，其潜在增益远大于当前部署策略。

title: Behavioral Containment: Source-to-Binary Function Matching for 1-Day Vulnerability Detection
summary:
Vulnerabilities in reused open-source code often propagate into deployed binaries. Detecting them requires source-to-binary function matching, which locates the affected source function in a binary. Applying prior binary-to-binary approaches to this task would require compiling the source code with the same build configuration as the target binary, which is usually unavailable. Decompiling the binary does not make prior source-to-source approaches work either, because decompiled code differs substantially from the original source code.
  We observe that compilation transforms the code of a function but largely preserves its behavior. A binary function that implements a source function therefore contains its behavior, a property we call behavioral containment. Building on this, we present SBIND, which decompiles the binary and checks behavioral containment instead of comparing code. SBIND represents each function by behavioral paths, sequences of normalized operations from its entry to its exits, and aligns source paths with binary paths in order. To detect 1-day vulnerabilities, SBIND compares the binary with the vulnerable and the patched source only on the paths through the changed lines. On stripped binaries built with two compilers, two optimization levels, and four architectures, SBIND ranks the correct function first in 77.87% of 32,008 searches, against 45.69% for the state-of-the-art approach SBridge. On 26 1-day CVEs, SBIND reaches an F1 score of 0.70 on stripped binaries, against 0.51 for SBridge. Our replication of SBridge also revealed several issues in its implementation and evaluation, and its authors have acknowledged them.

AI.tldr: SBIND通过反编译二进制并检查"行为包含"(behavioral containment)来实现源码到二进制的函数匹配，在32,008次搜索中正确函数排名第一的比例达77.87%（对比SBridge 45.69%），26个1-day CVE上F1为0.70（对比0.51）。
AI.motivation: 复用开源代码中的漏洞会传播到部署的二进制中。检测需要源码到二进制的函数匹配。已有二进制到二进制方法需按相同构建配置编译源码（通常不可得），反编译后源码到源码方法也失效，因为反编译代码与原源码差异显著。
AI.method: 观察到编译改变代码但大体保留行为，提出行为包含性质：实现某源码函数的二进制函数包含其行为。SBIND反编译二进制后检查行为包含而非比较代码：用"行为路径"（从入口到出口的归一化操作序列）表示每个函数，并按顺序对齐源码路径与二进制路径。检测1-day漏洞时，仅比较经过改动行的路径上的漏洞版与修补版源码。
AI.result: 在两种编译器、两种优化等级、四种架构构建的剥离二进制上，SBIND在32,008次搜索中77.87%将正确函数排第一，SBridge为45.69%。26个1-day CVE上，剥离二进制F1达0.70，SBridge为0.51。复现SBridge还发现其实现与评估中的若干问题，作者已承认。
AI.conclusion: 基于行为包含的SBIND显著优于SBridge，为源码到二进制漏洞匹配提供了有效方案；同时揭示了SBridge的基准/实现问题。

title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure. Passing an expert demonstration shows that a checker accepts one way of completing the task. Learned policies, however, may stop after partial progress or complete the task in a different way. A checker may then accept an incomplete execution (phantom success) or reject an execution that satisfies the instruction (silent failure). In this paper, we introduce SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers against task instructions. SimAudit analyzes the instruction and checker code to identify scenarios where the two may disagree, recreates those scenarios in simulation, and runs the original checker. Multi-view renderings are then used to verify whether the observed behavior satisfies the instruction. Across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo, 183 simulated test cases produced the predicted checker verdict. Visual verification and deduplication yielded 61 distinct defects across 49 tasks, including 40 phantom successes and 21 silent failures. Most defects in RoboCasa365 accepted incomplete executions, most in RoboDojo rejected valid executions, and both error types were common in RoboTwin 2.0. These findings suggest that validating success checkers requires testing both incomplete executions and valid alternatives to expert demonstrations, and motivate more rigorous evaluation protocols for future benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出SimAudit，一个基于LLM的流水线，用于审计仿真操作基准中手写的成功检查器，发现183个测试用例预测准确，最终识别出49个任务中的61个缺陷（40个幻影成功、21个静默失败）。
AI.motivation: 仿真基准用手写成功检查器判定策略成败，但专家演示只能证明检查器接受一种完成方式；学习策略可能中途停止或用不同方式完成任务，导致检查器误判（接受不完整执行的幻影成功，或拒绝合法执行的静默失败），从而影响基准评估的可信度。
AI.method: SimAudit流程：分析任务指令与检查器代码以找出二者可能不一致的场景，在仿真中重建这些场景并运行原检查器，再用多视角渲染图像验证观察到的行为是否真正满足指令。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365和RoboDojo上，183个仿真测试用例均产生了预测的检查器判定；经视觉验证与去重后得到49个任务中的61个不同缺陷，含40个幻影成功和21个静默失败。RoboCasa365多为接受不完整执行，RoboDojo多为拒绝合法执行，RoboTwin 2.0两类错误均常见。
AI.conclusion: 验证成功检查器需同时测试不完整执行与专家演示之外的合法替代方案，论文呼吁未来基准采用更严格的评估协议。

title: CANDID: Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution in Local Computer-Use Agents
summary: We present CANDID (Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution), an execution-control framework designed to enhance the reliability of local computer-use agents (CUAs) in resource-constrained settings. While local CUAs feature robust baseline proficiency in single-step action prediction, they frequently fail at critical junctions due to rigid action loops or premature DONE decisions. Rather than imposing imprecise cognitive loads through textual reflection, CANDID repurposes parallel test-time scaling into a disciplined, execution-level intervention at sparse, failure-prone points. We introduce a loop-recovery mechanism to filter candidates away from repeated behaviors and a conservative, unanimous DONE gating policy that requires absolute consensus to terminate. Experiments on OSWorld demonstrate that CANDID's structural control significantly improves success rates, outperforming feedback-based alternatives with minimal execution overhead.

AI.tldr: CANDID 是一个面向资源受限场景的本地计算机使用智能体(CUA)执行控制框架,通过在稀疏易失败点做执行级干预来提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 本地 CUA 单步动作预测能力尚可,但在关键节点常因刚性动作循环或过早 DONE 决策而失败;文本式反思会引入不精确的认知负担。
AI.method: 把并行测试时扩展改造为纪律化的执行级干预:仅在稀疏失败风险点触发;引入循环恢复机制过滤重复行为候选;采用保守的一致同意 DONE 门控,需绝对共识才终止。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld 上,CANDID 的结构化控制显著提升成功率,优于基于反馈的替代方案,且执行开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 在失败易发点进行结构化、执行级的候选筛选与终止门控,是提升本地 CUA 可靠性的一种低开销有效路径。

title: Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. R package discoCVI available on CRAN
summary: DISCO is a recent internal cluster validity index for density-based clustering that, unlike earlier indices, also evaluates the quality of noise labels. The discoCVI package makes DISCO available in R. This article describes the design of the package and a typical workflow, in which DISCO is used to compare clusterings and to choose the parameters of HDBSCAN without ground truth, followed by the implementation introduced in version 0.2.0. DISCO is defined through density-connectivity distances between all pairs of points, so direct implementations store several n-by-n matrices. We show that every quantity DISCO needs can be read off the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree, so that the index can be computed exactly with memory that grows linearly with the number of points, while the running time remains quadratic as in the original definition. The implementation is tested against the previous version, agrees with the original Python implementation to within $3 \times 10^{-13}$, and corrects the score of singleton clusters to match the published definition. In benchmarks, discoCVI is 23 to 138 times faster than its previous version for 500 to 4,000 points and 3 to 9 times faster than the Python reference for 500 to 8,000 points, using a fraction of the memory of both, and it scores 100,000 points in about 50 seconds with less than 200 MB of memory.

AI.tldr: discoCVI R包为基于密度的聚类提供DISCO内部有效性指标（含噪声评估）的实现，v0.2.0基于互可达最小生成树的单链接合并树精确计算该指标，内存降为线性，速度大幅提升。
AI.motivation: DISCO是较新的密度聚类内部有效性指标，能评估噪声标签质量，但原始定义基于所有点对的密度连通距离，直接实现需存储多个n×n矩阵，内存开销大、计算慢，限制了其在大规模数据上的使用。
AI.method: 文章介绍discoCVI包的设计与典型工作流（无真值时比较聚类、调HDBSCAN参数），并给出0.2.0版实现：证明DISCO所需的全部量都可从互可达最小连通树的单链接合并树中读取，从而以随点数线性增长的内存精确计算指标，运行时间仍保持与原始定义相同的二次复杂度；同时修正单点簇得分以符合已发表定义。
AI.result: 实现与旧版本对比验证，与原始Python实现误差在3×10^-13以内；在500–4000点上比旧版快23–138倍，在500–8000点上比Python参考实现快3–9倍，内存占用均更少；10万点约50秒、内存不足200MB。
AI.conclusion: discoCVI 0.2.0通过合并树重构实现，在保持精确性与二次时间复杂度的前提下将内存降至线性，显著提升可扩展性，使DISCO可用于大规模密度聚类评估。

title: LINEAGE: A Benchmark for Empirical Lineage Retrieval in AI Scientific Literature
summary: Current research agents are moving beyond academic search toward literature synthesis and experiment planning. These workflows increasingly rely on literature retrieval systems, which serve as standalone systems or as components of research agents. However, existing scientific literature retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate these methods using topical relevance or citation links as supervision, which cannot capture which prior methods are used for empirical comparison. To address this gap, we introduce Lineage, a benchmark for empirical lineage retrieval in AI scientific literature. An empirical lineage relation links a prior paper to a source paper that explicitly uses its method as an empirical comparison baseline. These relations form lineage graphs whose multi-hop neighborhoods provide retrieval ground truth for structural evaluation. To construct these graphs at scale, we develop Lineage-Constructor, which converts heterogeneous paper records and full-paper empirical baseline evidence into calibrated lineage graphs. Built from 121,048 papers across 17 top AI venues from 2018 to 2025, Lineage contains 3,950 graph components, 67,502 paper nodes, 164,948 lineage edges, and 80,000 multi-facet retrieval queries. Experiments with 19 representative retrieval systems show that empirical lineage retrieval remains challenging. Performance drops sharply with lineage distance, while structural metrics reveal that isolated retrieval hits often fail to recover closely connected empirical comparison neighborhoods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lineage——首个面向AI科学文献"实证谱系检索"的基准，用"使用了某前作方法作为实证基线"的论文关系构建谱系图，并基于多跳邻域提供结构化检索监督，揭示现有19种检索系统在该任务上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有科学文献检索基准多用主题相关性或引用关系作监督，无法刻画哪些前作方法被用作实证比较基线；而文献综合与实验规划类研究代理正日益依赖检索系统，需要更贴近实证比较需求的评测。
AI.method: 定义实证谱系关系（源论文显式将前作方法作为实证基线），据此构建谱系图，多跳邻域作为检索真值用于结构评估；开发Lineage-Constructor，将异构论文记录与全文实证基线证据转化为校准的谱系图；基于2018–2025年17个顶会121,048篇论文构建含3,950个图组件、67,502节点、164,948条边、80,000条多面查询的基准，评测19种代表性检索系统。
AI.result: 实证谱系检索仍具挑战性：性能随谱系距离增大急剧下降；结构指标显示孤立的检索命中往往无法恢复紧密关联的实证比较邻域。
AI.conclusion: Lineage填补了以实证比较关系为监督的检索评测空白，表明现有系统在谱系检索上能力不足，为文献综合与实验规划类研究代理提供了更贴近真实需求的结构化评测基准。

title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
summary: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. The agents rebuild the data, reproduce each paper's main estimate and re-estimate it across grids totaling 62,409 estimated defensible specifications. Based on the reproductions and the specification grids, we develop measures of empirical robustness. We reproduce 42% of the main estimates of claims with a signed effect under the papers' own specifications. Across all defensible specifications, on average 25% keep the published sign and have $p < 0.10$. Across experiments, claims based on regression discontinuity are more robust than difference-in-differences claims. Within experiments, claims about first-order effects, claims with larger published $t$-statistics, claims whose authors' data or code we find, claims in top journals, and claims with fewer earlier papers on the same experiment are more robust. Claims on experiments that more papers reuse are not less robust on average. Our findings quantify how much published claims depend on analysis choices, thereby showing that large-scale multiverse analysis becomes feasible with agentic coding.

AI.tldr: 用AI智能体对324篇复用13个自然实验的论文做多元宇宙分析，重建数据、复现主估计并在62,409个可辩护specification上重估，发现发表结论对分析选择高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 实证金融研究常重复使用同一自然实验研究不同结果，引发多重检验与发表偏倚担忧；需要量化发表结论在多大程度上依赖于分析选择。
AI.method: 用AI智能体对324篇复用13个自然实验的论文进行多元宇宙分析：重建数据、复现各论文主估计，并在总计62,409个可辩护specification构成的网格上重新估计，据此构建实证稳健性指标。
AI.result: 在论文自身specification下复现了42%的方向性结论主估计；在所有可辩护specification中平均仅25%保持发表时的符号且p<0.10。实验间：断点回归比双重差分更稳健。实验内：一阶效应结论、发表t值更大、能找到作者数据/代码、发表于顶刊、同一实验早期论文较少的结论更稳健；被更多论文复用的实验其结论并不更不稳健。
AI.conclusion: 研究量化了发表结论对分析选择的依赖程度，并表明借助智能体编码，大规模多元宇宙分析已变得可行。

title: Technology-Enabled Fuel Supply Chain Resilience: An Integrated Information System for Real-Time Monitoring and Decision Support
summary: This study evaluates and extends the transactional information system described in an earlier fuel logistics study, focusing on data reliability, monitoring, and decision support. An author-led re-evaluation examined available Delphi and SQL code and compared a reconstructed source-derived baseline (R0) with a revised SQL Server system (R1) across twelve evaluation scenarios. Synthetic transactions and public US energy data were used for technical assessment, while organizational processes and supply delays were simulated. R1 improved data integration and reporting accuracy in controlled SQL Server tests and introduced stock-movement records, automated alerts, and recovery controls. On comparable data feeds, integration defect rates decreased from 2.90 to 3.46 percent in R0 to 0.14 to 0.49 percent in R1. For national weekly demand forecasting, selected methods did not significantly outperform the previous-year mean. Process and disruption simulations suggested improvements in manual workload and replenishment delays, although these outcomes depended on modelling assumptions and were not observed in operational settings. The study presents a revised transactional architecture for fuel logistics and distinguishes experimentally measured information-system performance from simulated organizational outcomes. Its findings highlight the potential of traceable inventory records, early exception detection, and recoverable information systems to support supply chain resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究对早期燃料物流研究中的事务型信息系统进行再评估与扩展，将重构的基线系统(R0)与改进的SQL Server系统(R1)在12个评估场景下对比，重点考察数据可靠性、监控与决策支持。
AI.motivation: 早期燃料物流研究中的事务型信息系统缺乏对数据可靠性、监控和决策支持的系统性评估，需要明确区分实验测量的信息系统性能与模拟的组织结果。
AI.method: 作者主导的再评估：检查Delphi与SQL代码，比较重构的源派生基线(R0)与修订版SQL Server系统(R1)，开展12个评估场景；使用合成事务与美国公开能源数据进行技术评估，并模拟组织流程与供应延迟。
AI.result: R1提升了数据集成与报表准确性，引入库存移动记录、自动预警和恢复控制；集成缺陷率由R0的2.90–3.46%降至R1的0.14–0.49%。但全国周需求预测中，所选方法未显著优于上年均值。流程与中断模拟显示人工工作量和补货延迟有所改善，但依赖建模假设，未在真实运营中观察到。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种修订的燃料物流事务型架构，并明确区分实测的信息系统性能与模拟的组织结果；可追溯库存记录、早期异常检测和可恢复信息系统有助于提升供应链韧性。

title: Identity World Model: Recognizing People in an Imagined Latent World
summary: Whole-body human recognition has advanced rapidly with large vision models. However, existing methods remain fragile under real-world variations, as they tie identity to transient cues such as clothing, texture, pose, or viewpoint. We argue that a robust recognizer should not merely learn to ignore these cues, but imagine how a person would be represented if they changed. To this end, we propose IDWorld, an identity world model: just as a latent world model predicts the features of a scene after an action, IDWorld predicts how a person would be represented under a changed condition. In a single forward pass, IDWorld imagines these counterfactual features under shared canonical conditions, such as the same outfit, a fixed view, or a bare silhouette, without rendering any pixels. Compared with explicit imagination in pixels, this latent imagination keeps nearly the same accuracy while being over 11x faster, at 5.9 ms per frame. Since each imagined condition has its own strengths, IDWorld then fuses them adaptively, weighting each condition for every probe-gallery pair. Extensive experiments show that IDWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on CCPG and CCGR-MINI, outperforms the compared methods on MEVID, and generalizes best to CASIA-B* and SUSTech1K, with the best mAP on CCVID. These results suggest identity world models offer a simple yet effective path to robust recognition. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出IDWorld身份世界模型，在潜空间中预测人物在改变条件下的表征（反事实特征），无需渲染像素，实现鲁棒的全身行人识别。
AI.motivation: 现有全身行人识别方法将身份与服装、纹理、姿态、视角等瞬态线索绑定，在真实世界变化下脆弱。作者认为稳健识别器不应仅"学会忽略"这些线索，而应"想象"人物变化后的表征。
AI.method: 借鉴潜空间世界模型（预测动作后场景特征）思想，IDWorld在单次前向传播中，于共享规范条件（同一服装、固定视角、裸剪影等）下预测反事实特征，不做像素渲染；随后对各想象条件自适应融合，为每个probe-gallery对加权。
AI.result: 潜空间想象与像素级显式想象精度几乎相同，但速度快11倍以上（5.9 ms/帧）；在CCPG、CCGR-MINI达SOTA，MEVID上超越对比方法，对CASIA-B*、SUSTech1K泛化最佳，CCVID上mAP最佳。
AI.conclusion: 身份世界模型为鲁棒全身行人识别提供了简单而有效的路径；代码将开源。

title: Quantifying Cultural-Psychological Constructs in Four Centuries of Ottoman Court Registers
summary: Populations vary along cultural dimensions such as individualism, collectivism, and honor. But how can these dimensions be studied in historical societies for which conventional psychological data are unavailable? Here, we introduce a computational text-analytic framework for quantifying psychological constructs in 54,670 Ottoman Turkish court records from 21 Istanbul courts spanning 1513-1911 CE. We develop sentence-embedding models adapted to Ottoman legal language and extend a theory-driven, text-analytic pipeline to capture cultural variation along the dimensions of individualism, collectivism, and honor in this historical corpus. We evaluate our models through multiple methods: document retrieval, semantic textual similarity, questionnaire-item classification, and validation against expert annotations. Our adapted sentence transformer (OTA-BERTurk) achieved a Recall@1 of .843 on the test set for document retrieval, a Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of .806 for semantic textual similarity (meaning the best answer usually appeared as a top result), and classified questionnaire items with 89.58\% accuracy. Document-level performance varied across constructs and methods. Qualitative analysis further showed that high scores reflected historically specific legal and institutional patterns. We publicly release the models, construct representations, scoring pipeline, as well as an interactive web interface to support transparent, reproducible historical-psychological analyses of Ottoman Turkish court records spanning approximately four centuries. These computational tools enable the study of psychological variation across centuries of cultural and institutional change in a diverse empire.

AI.tldr: 本文提出计算文本分析框架，用语料库与句向量模型量化奥斯曼土耳其法庭记录中的个体主义、集体主义与荣誉等文化维度。
AI.motivation: 文化维度（个体主义、集体主义、荣誉）通常依靠问卷等心理学数据研究，但历史社会缺乏此类数据，如何在历史社会中研究这些维度是核心难题。
AI.method: 构建54,670份1513–1911年伊斯坦布尔21所法庭的奥斯曼土耳其法庭记录语料库；开发适配奥斯曼法律语言的句嵌入模型（OTA-BERTurk），并扩展理论驱动的文本分析流程以刻画三个文化维度；通过文档检索、语义文本相似度、问卷条目分类及专家标注验证进行评估。
AI.result: 文档检索Recall@1为.843，语义文本相似度MRR为.806，问卷条目分类准确率89.58%；文档层面表现因构念与方法而异；质性分析显示高分反映历史上特定的法律与制度模式。
AI.conclusion: 公开模型、构念表示、评分流程与交互式网页界面，支持对约四个世纪奥斯曼法庭记录的透明、可复现历史心理学分析，助力研究帝国长期文化与制度变迁中的心理差异。

title: Auditing Learned Dynamics in Weather Models
summary: Learned weather models are experimentally accessible computational systems whose internal representations can be inspected and manipulated. Using sparse autoencoder features from GraphCast, DeepMind's autoregressive weather forecasting model, we test whether causal relevance requires physical semantics, a question that matters for auditing whether AI forecasters used in high-assurance settings rely on reliable mechanisms. We also look at whether physically associated latent directions can be steered to improve extreme-event forecasts, where interventions are applied to the model's internal activations during the rollout. We find that ablating a feature locked to GraphCast's computational mesh increases global geopotential height error despite lacking conventional physical semantics. Second, suppressing convection- and low-level-vorticity-associated features weakens predicted tropical-cyclone deepening (the fall in central pressure during intensification), while amplifying them reduces intensity error, with amplification of convection features through feature scaling achieving a median of 51\% error reduction over seven storms.
