AI.result: 在完整 MLE-Bench 上，24 小时标准预算下奖牌率 70.7%，与已报告最佳持平；48 小时预算下 76.0%，为该完整基准上已报告的最高奖牌率。PostTrainBench 上表现具竞争力，且为每个任务生成研究笔记，使过程透明、可供人类研究者复用。
AI.conclusion: 显式的问题状态表示是多步自主 AI 研究的有效替代范式，能在困难任务上避免错误解区域；同时产出可复用的研究笔记，提升研究过程的可解释性与可迁移性。

title: SWE-Recreation: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Software Recreation
summary: Agents increasingly operate software and even write it, yet they are almost always told what to achieve: given a goal, a mock-up, or a demonstration. We ask whether an agent can instead understand an unfamiliar product by using it, and then rebuild it. The agent sees only rendered pixels and acts through pointer and keyboard, without access to the DOM, source, logs, or back-end. Within this interface, it explores, generates a replica, and checks its own work before evaluation. We present SWE-Recreation, a benchmark of 54 real applications (28 websites and 26 Android apps) with 1,446 hidden requirements describing multistep, stateful workflows and explicit exclusions for behavior outside the reconstruction scope. A fixed judge grades workflows with pixel evidence; a separate post-hoc judge estimates exploration coverage. Across 54 evaluated applications, five frontier systems reach at most 0.530 weighted fidelity and 22.9% fully reproduced requirements under application-equal averaging. These descriptive results expose both exploration-evidence gaps and implementation shortfalls. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nologistic/recreateanything.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SWE-Recreation 基准，测试智能体能否仅凭像素观察与鼠标键盘交互，通过"使用"陌生软件来探索并重建其功能，结果前沿系统最高仅达 0.530 加权保真度、22.9% 完全复现需求。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体几乎总是被告知要达成什么目标（给定目标、原型或演示），缺少"从使用中理解产品并复现"的能力评估。作者希望验证智能体能否在无 DOM、源码、日志和后端访问的条件下，像人一样通过界面探索理解陌生产品并重建。
AI.method: 构建 SWE-Recreation 基准：包含 54 个真实应用（28 个网站、26 个 Android 应用）与 1,446 条隐藏需求，覆盖多步有状态工作流及明确的排除项。智能体仅见渲染像素，通过指针与键盘操作，在此界面中探索、生成复刻品并在评测前自检。采用固定评判器以像素证据评分工作流，另设事后评判器估计探索覆盖度。
AI.result: 在 54 个应用上评估，五个前沿系统在应用等权平均下最高仅达 0.530 加权保真度，完全复现需求比例最高 22.9%。结果揭示了探索证据缺口与实现不足两方面问题。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过界面使用来理解并重建软件，对当前前沿智能体仍是艰巨挑战；该基准为评估"探索—理解—复现"能力提供了可测量的框架，并指出探索覆盖与实现质量是主要瓶颈。

title: Persistent Identity in Person Tracking: Online Enrollment and Registered Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version of this paper was submitted to an IEEE conference
summary: We extend PoseTReID with online appearance-bank matching (Gallery) and a residual-conflict guard for registered SVM recognition. All methods use supplied ground-truth (GT) person boxes. We average all-box assessment IDF1/HOTA equally across videos. On six SportsMOT clips, StrongSORT leads standalone trackers (79.44/84.72%) and exceeds both Gallery variants. Over eleven videos, Gallery AIN (83.29/85.44%) and COPE (84.66/86.38%) exceed standalone trackers with complete results. This lead depends on two retrospectively added GTA development compilations and is absent on the original nine videos. Registered SVMs lead both cohorts among complete results, with AIN at 95.72/94.82% over eleven videos. They use every GT crop from approximately 20% of frames, including future appearances. On MOT20-03, registered AIN reached 96.80% IDF1 and assigned the correct enrolled name to 90.72% of assessment GT observations. Gallery and standalone trackers receive no per-video labelled enrollment. Both identity routes restore identities across internal title cards, but Gallery trails SORT on three videos (four in HOTA) and both SVMs trail SORT on MOT16-04/MOT20-03. Under six-clip persistent-only scoring, native Gallery gains 2.39 percentage points in mean IDF1 over a matched control, with lower correct-P coverage and 5.02 times as many encoder attempts. Pose gating is mixed; the guard's metric effect is not isolated.

AI.tldr: 该文在PoseTReID框架上加入在线外观库匹配(Gallery)与残差冲突防护的注册SVM识别，在SportsMOT/MOT16/MOT20上比较跟踪与身份识别路线，但增益依赖事后加入的GTA编译数据且未在原始视频上复现。
AI.motivation: 在PoseTReID基础上提升行人多目标跟踪与已注册身份识别（re-ID）能力，需明确Gallery匹配与SVM识别相对强基线StrongSORT的收益及其适用条件与代价。
AI.method: 统一使用GT人体框；提出在线外观库匹配Gallery（含AIN、原生Gallery、COPE变体）和残差冲突防护的注册SVM；按视频等权平均全框IDF1/HOTA评估；SVM使用约20%帧的全部GT裁剪（含未来帧）作为注册样本，属于非因果/泄漏设置；对比standalone跟踪器与两类身份路线，并做六片段persistent-only评分与匹配对照实验。
AI.result: 六段SportsMOT上StrongSORT(79.44/84.72%)领先standalone并超过两个Gallery变体；十一视频上Gallery AIN(83.29/85.44%)与COPE(84.66/86.38%)超过standalone，但该领先依赖两个事后加入的GTA开发编译，原始九个视频上优势消失。注册SVM在完整结果中两类群体均最优，AIN达95.72/94.82%；MOT20-03上AIN获96.80% IDF1、90.72%正确命名。Gallery及standalone无逐视频标注注册。persistent-only评分下原生Gallery较匹配对照提升2.39个百分点IDF1，但正确P覆盖率更低、编码器尝试次数为5.02倍；姿态门控效果混合，防护项指标作用未被单独分离。
AI.conclusion: Gallery与SVM路线仅在有利数据子集与非因果注册下领先强跟踪基线，优势不稳健且成本高；需在原始视频与隔离消融下重评，防护与姿态门控作用尚未确证。

title: Enhancing Understanding of Language Models with Varied Explanations
summary: Language models are increasingly used to support human judgement in complex reasoning tasks, yet their predictions often remain difficult to interpret and validate. Explainability techniques provide insight into model decision-making, helping expose errors, failure modes, and potential bias so users can decide whether to rely on model outputs. Explanations are simplified approximations of a language model's internal workings. The goal is to obtain explanations that reflect the underlying computation as closely as possible (faithfulness), are understandable to users (plausibility), and help them achieve their intended goals (utility). Evaluation protocols are essential for assessing these dimensions. This thesis studies highlight explanations, natural language explanations, and chain-of-thought reasoning. These forms offer complementary perspectives on model behaviour and exhibit distinct strengths and limitations across tasks. Producing explanations that satisfy multiple quality dimensions remains challenging, as does evaluating them reliably across forms and settings. This thesis aims to improve people's understanding of models' decision-making processes in complex reasoning tasks. First, it proposes two evaluation frameworks for assessing highlight explanations across multiple properties and explanation types, together with a meta-evaluation framework for examining the reliability of existing faithfulness metrics for chain-of-thought explanations. Second, it proposes two techniques that generate natural language explanations designed to be faithful to the model's prediction process while remaining concise, coherent, and helpful for understanding model decisions. Finally, a study of human-AI interaction explores the roles of evidence and explanations in helping users validate model verdicts in a fact-checking setting.

AI.tldr: 该博士论文研究语言模型在复杂推理任务中的可解释性，围绕高亮解释、自然语言解释和思维链推理三类形式，提出多种评测框架、元评测框架和解释生成技术，并研究人机交互中证据与解释的作用。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地用于辅助复杂推理任务中的人类判断，但其预测难以解释和验证。可解释性技术可揭示模型决策中的错误、失效模式与潜在偏差，帮助用户决定是否信赖模型输出。
AI.method: （1）提出两个评测框架，从多属性、多解释类型角度评估高亮解释；（2）提出元评测框架检验现有思维链解释忠实性指标的可靠性；（3）提出两种生成自然语言解释的技术，使解释忠实于预测过程且简洁连贯；（4）开展人机交互研究，考察事实核查场景下证据与解释在帮助用户验证模型结论中的作用。
AI.result: 论文强调解释需兼顾忠实性（faithfulness）、合理性/可理解性（plausibility）与效用（utility）三个维度，并指出跨形式、跨场景可靠评测解释仍具挑战；具体实验结论摘要中未明确给出。
AI.conclusion: 该论文旨在提升人们对复杂推理任务中模型决策过程的理解，通过评测框架、元评测、解释生成技术与用户研究，推动多维度、可靠可解释性评测与实用解释生成的发展。

title: φTD: Distributional Reinforcement Learning using Characteristic Functions
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Distributional Reinforcement Learning methods aim to learn the entire distribution of returns, yet current algorithmic approaches are limited to a narrow class of distributions. We propose $\varphi$TD, a method to overcome this limitation by computing the loss in the frequency domain. We demonstrate that this further unifies quantile and categorical approaches to distributional RL, and enables the learning of distributions that were previously impossible to capture, such as mixtures of continuous distributions. We empirically study $\varphi$TD, across synthetic benchmarks and large-scale deep RL environments and demonstrate that the flexibility obtained from wider parametric families can lead to improved performance.

AI.tldr: 提出φTD，将损失计算移到频域，统一分位数与类别分布RL方法，并能学习连续混合分布等此前无法刻画的收益分布。
AI.motivation: 现有分布强化学习算法虽旨在学习完整收益分布，但只能覆盖很窄的一类分布。
AI.method: 通过在频率域（特征函数域）计算损失来构建φTD，从而摆脱对特定分布族的限制，并统一quantile与categorical两类方法。
AI.result: 在合成基准和大规模深度RL环境中验证，更宽参数族带来的灵活性可提升性能，并能学习连续混合分布。
AI.conclusion: 频域损失为分布RL提供了更通用的框架，拓宽了可学习的分布类别并带来性能收益。

title: The Window Lever: Longer Observation Windows Outweigh the Observed Effects of Data, Capacity, and Architecture in Customer Behavior Forecasting
summary: In our experiments on long-horizon customer-behavior forecasting, a longer observation window outweighed the observed effects of more data, more capacity and newer architectures. The window is the weeks of history a model sees before the week it forecasts from. Going from an 8- to a 16-week window adds a raw +0.070 to 0.107 log-space $R^2$ in every family at 1M. Matched test cohorts, which score the same customer-weeks at every window, show this raw comparison understates the gain in every family they cover. The direction holds on five public datasets, four spanning over a year (ridge and our transformer on all five). On our internal data, longer windows admit up to 10% more and colder training customers, which matching does not fix. Our design does not separate window length from calendar coverage, because every test anchor (the week a forecast is made from) falls in one eight-week band. On training-period anchors, the weekly ridge probe's gain persists outside the holiday season, keeping about 72% of it. We therefore report a robust positive association with longer windows and do not identify the magnitude of a calendar-independent history effect. Of four internally registered predictions, the only fully blind one failed. An activity-mixture model predicted +0.014 from 24 to 32 weeks; the weekly-aggregate probe returned -0.0004. For the sequence families, the other three levers are about an order of magnitude smaller, bounded and unresolved. Their observed effects are at most 0.006 between the nominal 1M and 10M tiers and 0.0052 among five sequence families at 16 weeks with clocks as built, both single-seed on the full test split, and 0.006 for capacity on three-seed means. These are observed intervals, not equivalence bounds. Our claim is the order-of-magnitude contrast between the window and those bounds. A team building on this class of data should start by lengthening the window.

AI.tldr: 在长时程客户行为预测中，延长历史观测窗口（8→16周）带来的增益比增加数据、提升容量或更换更新架构都大一个数量级，建议优先加长窗口。
AI.motivation: 研究者在做长期客户行为预测时，通常优先投入更多数据、更大模型容量或更新架构。本文希望检验这些杠杆与"观测窗口长度"相比谁更重要，从而指导团队应优先优化哪个方向。
AI.method: 在内部数据与五个公开数据集上做系统实验：比较8周与16周观测窗口对log空间R²的影响，覆盖多种模型族（ridge与自研transformer），并构造"匹配测试队列"（在各窗口下评分相同的客户-周）以校正比较偏差；同时对数据量（名义1M vs 10M）、容量、五种序列架构等其他杠杆做对照，并在训练期锚点上检验假日季节之外的稳健性。
AI.result: 在1M规模下，8→16周窗口在每个模型族带来原始+0.070至0.107的R²提升，匹配队列显示该原始对比还低估了增益，方向在五个公开数据集上成立。窗口延长还能纳入最多10%更多、更冷的训练客户（匹配无法修正）。每周聚合探针在假日季节外仍保留约72%增益。四个内部注册预测中唯一完全盲测的预测失败（预测+0.014，实测-0.0004）。其余三个杠杆效果约小一个数量级，均不超过0.006。
AI.conclusion: 窗口长度与日历覆盖未能在设计上完全分离，因此作者仅报告"更长窗口与更大增益存在稳健正相关"，不声称识别出与日历无关的历史效应的量级。核心结论是窗口与其他杠杆之间存在数量级差异：在构建此类数据模型时应首先延长观测窗口。

title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks. AppSci-Bench features seven realistic domains - five new ones (Slides Generation, Order-to-Cash, Compliance Review, Customer Call Insights, and CRM Insights) and two domains recast from tau3-bench (Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b)(Airline and Banking) - each with a held-out evaluation suite customized for that task. We evaluate seven frontier models and find AppSci-Bench challenging: the best model, Claude Opus 5.0, only reaches a mean-minimum score of 59.1% across 3 build attempts; other models do significantly worse. Models struggle with eliciting task requirements (only 65% for Opus 5.0), build representative internal evaluations (models saturate their own evaluation 65% of the time but fail to solve the held-out task), presenting challenges for future research. The benchmark code is available here: https://github.com/sanjari-orb/appsci-bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AppSci-Bench，评估 LLM 像人类应用科学家一样"从需求到实验迭代"构建 agent 的能力，七领域七个前沿模型表现均不佳（最佳 59.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估 LLM 驱动的 agent 的质量，却很少考察 LLM 构建 agent 的能力；而现实中企业需要应用科学家通过需求获取、基础设施探索和实验设计来科学地改进 agent。
AI.method: 构建 AppSci-Bench，模拟人类应用科学家为企业建 agent 的流程：从利益相关者处获取任务需求、探索业务基础设施、设计实验与内部基准来迭代优化目标 agent；含 7 个真实领域（5 个新增：Slides Generation、Order-to-Cash、Compliance Review、Customer Call Insights、CRM Insights；2 个由 tau3-bench 改造：Airline、Banking），每领域配定制留出评测集。评测 7 个前沿模型，多轮构建尝试取均值/最差值。
AI.result: 基准具挑战性：最佳模型 Claude Opus 5.0 在 3 次构建尝试下平均最低分仅 59.1%，其他模型明显更差；需求获取仅 65%，模型常在自建评估上饱和（65%）却无法解决留出任务。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在"构建 agent"这一元能力上仍有明显短板，尤其在需求获取与构建有代表性的内部评估方面，为未来研究提出挑战；代码已开源。

title: Static Analysis Guidance for Secure LLM Code Generation
summary: Static analyzers are cheap and widely deployed, which makes their reports a candidate feedback signal for secure LLM code generation. Existing approaches place the analyzer inside an iterative repair loop with intermediate steps, which is costly and makes it hard to isolate the report's effect on the model. We introduce two strategies that give the finding to the model during generation. When the analyzer raises an alert, generation is rolled back, and the finding is inserted either as a code comment (Comment) or in the user message (Steering). We compare them with two iterative approaches and a control without the analyzer, across three models and three Python benchmarks, and we measure security using each benchmark's oracle. Guidance during generation is cheap and can be effective, at 0.9 to 1.9 times the baseline's output tokens against up to 24.1 times for iterative approaches. With DeepSeek-V4.1-flash on RiskyPy, Steering raises the share of functional and secure programs from 52.5% to 64.4%, close to the best iterative approach (66.2%) while using less than a fifth of the tokens. A per-rule analysis shows that rules with a local fix benefit most, and replacing the XML parser is net-positive on two of the three models. The study also identifies when guidance should not be applied. Analyzers flag at most 5.6% of the functional but insecure programs on SecEvalPlus, leaving little guidance to act on. When a static analysis alert (warning or error) contradicts the task, models tend to follow the analyzer and break the program. The two Qwen2.5 models often fail when the fix requires restructuring the code. These results indicate that static-analysis guidance is worth applying with a capable model, on rules with a local fix, and after filtering alerts that conflict with the task specification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在生成过程中插入静态分析告警（注释或用户消息引导）的两种轻量策略，比迭代修复便宜得多且效果接近，并分析何时该用/不该用。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把静态分析器放进带中间步骤的迭代修复循环，成本高且难以隔离报告本身对模型的影响；需一种廉价反馈信号来提升LLM生成代码的安全性。
AI.method: 分析器报警时回滚生成，将发现以代码注释（Comment）或以用户消息注入（Steering）两种生成中引导策略；与两种迭代方法和无分析器对照组比较，覆盖3个模型、3个Python基准，用各基准oracle测安全性。
AI.result: 生成中引导仅需基线0.9-1.9倍输出token（迭代法达24.1倍）；DeepSeek-V4.1-flash在RiskyPy上把功能且安全比例从52.5%升至64.4%，接近最佳迭代法66.2%却只用不到1/5 token。局部可修规则受益最大；替换XML解析器在两个模型上净收益。SecEvalPlus上分析器仅标记≤5.6%的功能但不安全程序；告警与任务冲突时模型易盲从并破坏程序；Qwen2.5在需重构代码时常失败。
AI.conclusion: 静态分析引导值得在能力强的模型、局部可修规则上使用，且需先过滤与任务规格冲突的告警。

title: CalibCache: Cache-to-Full Feature Dynamics Calibration for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images, but iterative sampling remains computationally expensive. Feature caching reduces the number of full network evaluations, yet its approximation error can become more severe under short sampling schedules, where fewer full-compute steps and a coarser sampling grid can make history-based extrapolation less reliable. In this paper, we propose CalibCache, a lightweight offline calibration method that corrects systematic discrepancies between cached and full-compute feature dynamics. Specifically, CalibCache calibrates feature acceleration, defined as the second-order finite difference across sampling steps. Using only a single pair of full-compute and naive-cache trajectories at each setting, CalibCache fits scalar acceleration maps offline by centered least squares. These maps are then applied during sampling without additional full-network evaluations or online optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image on DrawBench and DiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, CalibCache consistently improves fidelity or generation quality over TaylorSeer under 20-step sampling at cache intervals $N=3,4,5$. At $N=5$, it reduces FLUX.1-dev LPIPS from $0.563$ to $0.429$ while achieving a $2.86\times$ denoising speedup over full-compute sampling, and lowers DiT-XL/2 FID from $16.39$ to $10.37$ relative to TaylorSeer.

AI.tldr: CalibCache 提出一种轻量级离线校准方法，通过拟合标量加速度映射来修正缓存与全计算特征动态之间的系统性偏差，在短采样日程下显著提升扩散Transformer的生成质量与保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer生成质量高但迭代采样计算昂贵。特征缓存虽能减少全网络评估次数，但在短采样日程下（全计算步更少、采样网格更粗）基于历史的推断（extrapolation）变得不可靠，导致近似误差更严重。
AI.method: 提出 CalibCache，一种轻量级离线校准方法，专门校准特征加速度（定义为跨采样步的二阶有限差分）。在每个设置下仅用一对全计算轨迹和朴素缓存轨迹，通过中心化最小二乘离线拟合标量加速度映射；采样时直接应用这些映射，无需额外全网络评估或在线优化。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev 和 Qwen-Image（DrawBench）及 DiT-XL/2（ImageNet-256）上，20步采样、缓存间隔N=3,4,5时，CalibCache 在保真度或生成质量上均优于 TaylorSeer。N=5时，FLUX.1-dev 的 LPIPS 从0.563降至0.429，同时相比全计算采样获得2.86×去噪加速；DiT-XL/2 的 FID 相对 TaylorSeer 从16.39降至10.37。
AI.conclusion: CalibCache 通过离线校准特征加速度，有效缓解了短采样日程下缓存近似的误差放大问题，在多种模型和数据集上一致优于 TaylorSeer，实现了质量与效率的良好平衡，且不增加采样时计算开销。

title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
summary: Argumentation frameworks (AFs) provide explicit, formal mechanisms for representing and resolving conflicts and thus have been incorporated into large language model (LLM) decision-making. The benefits vary and depend on how arguments and their relations are constructed, evaluated, and incorporated into the decision process. {We abstract a workflow consisting of four stages based on existing argumentation-augmented methods} and investigate their design choices over tasks of debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification. Our evaluation with recent LLMs shows that existing methods do not consistently improve performance across the considered tasks. Motivated by this observation, we develop two task-specific methods. The first is called Qnt-Arg, which organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate materials and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantics. The second is Qlt-Arg that uses credibility estimates to establish preferences between conflicting evidence items and applies grounded semantics to select acceptable evidence for subsequent LLM inference. We examine the roles of generative and decision models within the two methods. In the debate setting, Qnt-Arg consistently outperforms other argumentation-augmented methods across matched configurations; Qlt-Arg improves retrieval-based fact-verification performance compared with the baselines. These findings demonstrate the value of combining formal argumentation and LLM while highlighting the importance of aligning with tasks in argumentation construction, model selection, and the role of formal semantic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析了论证框架（AF）增强LLM决策的四阶段流程，发现现有方法效果不稳定，并提出Qnt-Arg与Qlt-Arg两个任务专用方法，分别在辩论决策与检索式事实核查中取得改进。
AI.motivation: 论证框架可显式表示并消解冲突，已被引入LLM决策，但其收益不确定，取决于论证及其关系的构建、评估与融入方式。作者希望厘清现有论证增强方法的阶段化设计选择，并针对不同任务改进效果不稳定问题。
AI.method: 从现有论证增强方法中抽象出四阶段工作流，并在辩论式决策与检索式事实核查两类任务上考察其设计选择。提出Qnt-Arg：围绕辩论材料中的原始发言者组织论证，在渐进语义下聚合模型估计的论证强度与候选答案先验；提出Qlt-Arg：用可信度估计在冲突证据间建立偏好，采用接地语义筛选可接受证据供后续LLM推理。并分析两类方法中生成模型与决策模型的作用。
AI.result: 近期LLM上的评估显示现有方法在所考察任务上表现并不一致地提升。在辩论场景中，Qnt-Arg在匹配配置下稳定优于其他论证增强方法；在检索式事实核查中，Qlt-Arg相对基线提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明形式论证与LLM结合具有价值，同时强调论证构建、模型选择与形式语义推理作用需与任务对齐。

title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
summary: Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separate follow-up sized to allow one failure yielded 472 of 473. On 1,000-event room-swap documents, three of ten models solved all five documents by reasoning alone. All seven models tested both ways at this length solved all five with extraction and the register, with no chain of thought requested. With concurrent extraction, median wall-clock time fell from 136.1 to 10.4 s for Sonnet 5.5 and from 313.5 to 28.0 s for GPT-6.1 Sol. At fixed per-token rates, mean cost per document fell by 55% for Sonnet 5.5 and 44% for GPT-6.1 Sol. A regular expression with an executor also solved all 15 fixed-format documents. On 500 free-form issue-tracker comments, a separately adapted 4B reader identified the recorded value in 68.8% of cases, compared with 61.0% for a frequency baseline fitted on the same training projects.

AI.tldr: 通过冻结语言模型上的选择器读取事件流中的每次变化，并用外部整数寄存器按序组合，可在置换组合任务上实现可靠、低成本的长事件流处理。
AI.motivation: 长事件流需要识别每一次变化并按顺序组合它们，而固定深度、对数精度的Transformer在标准猜想下无法对所有输入长度求解置换组合问题，因此需要外部机制辅助。
AI.method: 在冻结语言模型上训练选择器读取每个转移；仅API访问时让模型列出转移，由外部整数寄存器按序组合；用置信度规则标记不确定更新或保留多个候选。在五元置换积、两事件窗口、1000事件换房文档及自由格式issue评论上评测。
AI.result: 两事件窗口下27B模型无推理仅3/100正确，生成中间步骤后96/100；0.8B+选择器在43,687事件的299个窗口中全对，新机器上298/299（未达0.99单侧95%下界），后续实验472/473。1000事件文档中三个模型纯推理全对，七个模型用提取+寄存器全对；并发提取使Sonnet 5.5中位耗时136.1→10.4s、GPT-6.1 Sol 313.5→28.0s，成本降55%/44%；正则+执行器全对15个固定格式文档；500条自由格式评论中4B读取器68.8% vs 频率基线61.0%。
AI.conclusion: 外部寄存器配合冻结模型选择器能突破Transformer的理论局限，在多长度事件流任务上实现高可靠性与显著效率、成本优势，但自由格式提取仍有提升空间。

title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
summary: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control to the decision model. Later loops can request further assistance. The rule requires neither additional training nor model-specific confidence calibration. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev with only limited use of the LLM policy. The mean gains are 21.0%, 60.1%, and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader, and TextWorld cooking, respectively. Compared with full LLM control, LoopRoute also substantially reduces the mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoopRoute：用"重复的状态-动作对"作为执行停滞信号，在 Jev 快速决策与 LLM 推理之间路由控制权，实现高效任务完成。
AI.motivation: 现有 System 1 决策模型（如 Jev）虽快速低成本，但集成到智能体后常陷入重复动作的循环、无法推进目标；而每步都调用 LLM 推理开销巨大。需要一种协调机制，既保留局部快速决策，又在停滞时引入 LLM 推理。
AI.method: 观察发现重复的状态-动作对可作为执行停滞的信号。据此设计 LoopRoute：默认由决策模型执行；检测到循环时，调用 LLM 提供简短的反馈式协助，随后将控制权交回决策模型；后续循环可再次请求协助。该规则无需额外训练，也无需模型特定的置信度校准。
AI.result: 在 3 个基准和 7 个 LLM 上，LoopRoute 仅有限使用 LLM 即可提升成功率，相对单独 Jev 平均提升分别为 21.0%（ALFWorld）、60.1%（MapReader）、30.1%（TextWorld cooking）；相比全 LLM 控制显著降低平均累计 API 时间与调用成本；同时提升 6 个冻结决策模型的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 简单的循环检测路由规则即可在保持快速局部决策的同时按需引入 LLM 推理，兼顾成功率与调用成本，并具跨模型与基准的通用性。

title: Anticipating Future Build Results with BuildPredictor
summary:
Continuous Integration (CI) is a popular programming practice for the seamless integration of code changes into the code base. Using CI, developers benefit from automated assembling and testing of the code after each commit. However, while the frequent integration and building supports developers, it also comes at the high costs of wasting time and resources for minimal changes.
  In this work, we investigate the potential of reducing the drawbacks by anticipating the build outcome using machine learning techniques. In particular, we propose a random forest model with various features such as changes to the source and build code, and changes to the complexity of the code.
  We observe that our model shows a good performance in an intra-project and holistic setting yielding a median MCC of 0.82 and 0.86, respectively. We also found that the most important features of our model concern the historical build result information. Additionally, we investigated the development of the performance of our model over time and found that our model can quickly arrive at its peak performance.
  In an additional experiment, we removed the hard-to-interpret historical build information features and found that our model still yields decent performance while improving the interpretability of it. Summarizing, our model can help to avoid unnecessary build runs by anticipating the build result and thus, save resources.

AI.tldr: 提出随机森林模型预测CI构建结果，减少无谓构建开销。
AI.motivation: CI频繁集成与自动构建虽有助于开发，但对微小改动也消耗大量时间与资源，浪费明显。
AI.method: 利用机器学习预测构建结果，构建随机森林模型，特征包括源代码与构建代码的变更、代码复杂度变化等。
AI.result: 项目内与整体设置下中位MCC分别为0.82和0.86；历史构建结果信息为最重要特征；模型能快速达到峰值性能；去除难以解释的历史特征后仍有良好表现且可解释性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测构建结果可避免不必要的构建运行，从而节省资源。

title: ScaleDiag: Diagnosing the Limits of Test-Time Scaling in GUI Grounding
comment: Accepted by ICDM@D2AI 2026 Best Paper Award
summary: GUI grounding maps a screenshot and a natural language instruction to the coordinates of the intended interface element. Existing approaches improve grounding through visual scaling, instruction scaling, and sampling scaling, yet it remains unclear which grounding bottlenecks these strategies address and where their gains saturate. To address this gap, we introduce ScaleDiag, a controlled diagnostic framework that isolates the effects of visual input, instruction information, and prediction sampling on GUI grounding by independently varying target scale and surrounding context, target-specific information and auxiliary descriptions, and candidate coverage and selection, respectively. We evaluate ScaleDiag across five benchmarks and up to eight vision-language models and find that each scaling strategy operates within a much narrower regime than commonly assumed. (1) Visual scaling is governed by target occupancy rather than a fixed crop ratio, with full-screen errors typically rescued once the target occupies only 0.32% of the cropped view, while further zooming eventually becomes harmful. (2) Instruction scaling is driven by information that identifies the target rather than description richness itself, as even ground-truth-derived attributes such as color, size, and shape are often neutral or harmful, while appearance and spatial descriptions account for over 90% of the achievable gain. (3) Repeated sampling exposes a different limitation, as correct coordinates are frequently generated but remain difficult to select, leaving 5.1--11.0 points of oracle headroom while geometric consensus provides almost no improvement. Together, these results show that test-time scaling is constrained by distinct operating regimes rather than benefiting monotonically from more visual focus, richer instructions, or additional samples. Our code is available at https://github.com/YenanLiu/ScaleDiag.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaleDiag诊断框架，分别独立操控视觉输入、指令信息与预测采样三个维度，系统揭示GUI grounding中三种test-time scaling策略各自的有效区间与饱和点。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounding方法依赖视觉缩放、指令缩放和采样缩放来提升性能，但不清楚这些策略究竟解决了哪个瓶颈、收益在何处饱和，缺乏受控的归因分析。
AI.method: 构建ScaleDiag受控诊断框架，独立变化目标尺度与上下文（视觉）、目标识别信息与辅助描述（指令）、候选覆盖与选择（采样），在5个benchmark、多达8个视觉语言模型上评测。
AI.result: (1) 视觉缩放取决于目标占画面比例而非固定裁剪比，目标占裁剪视图0.32%即可救回多数全屏失败，过度放大会有害；(2) 指令缩放取决于能否识别目标，颜色/尺寸/形状等ground-truth属性常无益甚至有害，外观与空间描述贡献超90%增益；(3) 重复采样存在5.1–11.0分的oracle余量但正确坐标难以被选出，几何共识几乎无效。
AI.conclusion: Test-time scaling受限于各自不同操作区间，而非随更多视觉聚焦、更丰富指令或更多样本单调获益；需针对具体瓶颈设计策略。

title: ChronoDossier: Long-Form Personas as Temporal Memory Representations
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 32 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICLR_CHRONODOSSIER-4BCF
summary: Long-horizon agents rely on stored records to recover a person's state as facts change. Reliable answers depend on how facts are recorded, retrieved, and presented to the reader. We treat a long-form persona dossier as a memory representation of a known latent state, an invariant identity plus a timeline of facts, routines, and decision rules tied to life phases. We present ChronoDossier, a benchmark of 311 synthetic dossiers of 1k-10k words written by seven generators from dated timelines. Intrinsic metrics evaluate the records against their intended states; extrinsic metrics test recovery by five readers on a seeded 32-persona GPT-5.1 panel balanced across lengths (520 rated turns per condition). The linked states, records, evidence packets, and answers support tests of construction and evidence delivery. In a contextual-stress control, tag-scoped writer inputs remove detected out-of-scope anchor copying. Frozen questions authored on staged dossiers transfer less reliably to one-pass dossiers of the same states. In matched evidence controls, whole sections repair 29 of 32 GPT-5.1 and 25 of 30 Sonnet 4.6 failures labeled as packaging, compared with 2 of 8 and 1 of 8 answer-formation failures. Attribution uses separate key-based and key-free support measures, with model disagreements retained. Length remains confounded with persona and question composition; the observed between-bucket widening depends on excerpt construction. The benchmark supports offline evaluation against known facts. Memory acquisition from interaction and validation against real users remain outside its scope.

AI.tldr: 提出ChronoDossier基准：311份1k-10k词合成人物档案，用于评估长时程智能体的记忆记录、检索与证据呈现能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体依赖存储记录恢复人物状态，而事实会随时间变化；可靠回答取决于事实如何被记录、检索并呈现给读者。需要一个可对照已知潜在状态的离线评测手段。
AI.method: 将长文本人物档案视为已知潜在状态（恒定身份+生命阶段相关的事实、惯常行为与决策规则时间线）的记忆表征；构建由七个生成器基于带日期时间线写成的311份档案。采用内在指标（记录对预期状态）与外在指标（五种读者、32人物GPT-5.1面板、每条件520评分轮）评测恢复；并设置情境压力对照、冻结问题迁移、匹配证据对照（整节修复 vs 答案形成失败）以及基于密钥/无密钥的归因度量。
AI.result: 情境压力对照中标签限定的写入输入消除了越界锚点复制；分阶段档案撰写的冻结问题向一次性档案迁移可靠性更低；匹配证据对照下整节替换修复GPT-5.1 32例中29例、Sonnet 4.6 30例中25例被标为打包失败者，而答案形成失败仅修复2/8与1/8。长度与人物及问题构成仍存在混淆，观察到的分桶差异取决于摘录构建方式。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持针对已知事实的离线评估，可检验档案构建与证据传递；但交互中获取记忆、以及与真实用户验证不在其范围内。

title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
summary: Parametric memory allows Large Language Models to internalize knowledge directly into their weights, offering a potentially powerful alternative to retrieval-based memory (RAG). However, existing approaches to parametric memory are difficult to deploy as they largely mirror the Continual Learning (CL) objective of retaining information indefinitely. This is neither sustainable nor sufficient for a memory system, which must govern knowledge across its lifecycle by retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and allowing transient information to fade. We propose a system for parametric memory management consisting of a memory substrate (handling information storage and forgetting) and a learned policy (what to remember, how deeply, and for how long). Our substrate is a fixed-capacity LoRA adapter that consists of k-hot rank combinations which store facts without catastrophic interference and maintain an independently controlled temporal decay, enabling outdated information to fade while long-term facts persist. On this substrate, we train a lightweight controller that governs each incoming user event to ensure the memory system reflects the user's true, updated belief state. To evaluate how memory systems manage user memory, we introduce a controlled dataset of long-horizon user trajectories with varying persistence of facts based on changing belief states and user-behavioral shifts, and probe queries that test recall while information is valid and abstention after it expires. Our policy learns to effectively manage user memory over its entire lifecycle, balancing recall and abstention to achieve 86% of oracle performance, unlike CL and RAG baselines that primarily default to one of the two behaviors. By providing the first system to manage memory directly in model weights, this work establishes a foundation for long-horizon parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出首个直接在模型权重中管理记忆的系统——由固定容量k-hot LoRA存储基底和轻量学习控制器组成，实现记住稳定事实、强化重复信息、更新变化信念与让临时信息衰减，达到oracle性能的86%。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化记忆方法直接照搬持续学习（CL）目标，即无限期保留信息，既不具可持续性，也不足以支撑真正的记忆系统。记忆系统需在整个生命周期治理知识：保留稳定事实、强化反复出现的观察、更新已变化的信念、允许临时信息消退。此外，RAG作为替代方案也主要倾向单一行为。
AI.method: 系统包含两部分：(1) 记忆基底：固定容量的LoRA适配器，由k-hot秩组合构成，可无灾难性干扰地存储事实，并维持独立可控的时间衰减，使过时信息淡出而长期事实保留；(2) 学习策略：在其上训练轻量控制器，对每个用户事件决定记什么、记多深、记多久，使记忆反映用户真实且更新后的信念状态。同时构建了含长程用户轨迹的受控数据集，考察基于信念变化与行为漂移的事实持久性，并用探针查询测试有效期内的回忆与过期后的弃答。
AI.result: 策略能有效管理用户记忆的完整生命周期，平衡回忆与弃答，达到oracle性能的86%；而CL与RAG基线主要退化为两种行为之一。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个直接在模型权重中管理记忆的系统，为长程参数化记忆奠定了基础。

title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
summary: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. We also analyze a failure mode of SFT-based specialization---shortened reasoning chains and increased truncation---and argue that harness adapters avoid it by construction. Our results position harness evolution as a practical, non-destructive complement to weight updates for vertical agents.

AI.tldr: 提出把智能体"外衣"(系统提示、工具schema、技能库、规划脚手架)当作进化对象、冻结模型权重的垂直领域适配路线,用GEPA反思式进化优化器在SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench、Terminal-Bench上验证:权重更新单项增益最大,harness进化以极小算力回收大部分增益,二者结合最优。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的领域专精目前几乎被等同于权重更新问题(收集轨迹后做RL或SFT再部署新checkpoint)。作者希望探索一条互补轴线:不改权重,而是演化智能体的harness,以避免GPU训练成本,并获得可按领域加载、非破坏性的适配方式。
AI.method: 将harness演化建模为RL式外层循环,并用GEPA(反思式进化优化器)实例化;演化对象包括system prompt、tool schemas、skill library与planning scaffolding,策略(模型权重)保持冻结。所得harness adapter无需GPU训练、可按垂直领域分别加载,且可与基于权重的RL组合。实验用Codev(Claude Code风格编码智能体)在SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench、Terminal-Bench上评测,并分析SFT专精的失效模式。
AI.result: 一致的模式:权重更新带来最强的单路径增益;harness进化以很小一部分算力恢复其中大部分增益;两条路径结合整体效果最佳。另发现SFT式专精的失效模式——推理链变短、截断增多,而harness adapter在构造上规避了该问题。
AI.conclusion: harness进化可作为权重更新的实用、非破坏性补充,为垂直领域智能体提供了一条低成本、可组合的专精路径。

title: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
summary: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces against the specification. Of 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs, 68 are candidate scoreboard escapes: non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing. The framework confirmed 41 as scoreboard escapes with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original.

AI.tldr: 提出 "Verify the Verifier" 框架，用 LLM 异常交叉检查器将通过的 UVM 回归轨迹与规格对比，以发现 scoreboard 检查不到、却违反规格的 "scoreboard escape" 缺陷。
AI.motivation: 通过 UVM 回归只能说明设计与参考模型在 scoreboard 检查项上一致，并不代表满足规格。那些被测试覆盖、非等价、却能通过所有测试的缺陷（scoreboard escape）会长期潜伏于成熟验证环境中。
AI.method: 构建基于 LLM 的 Anomaly Cross-Checker：在回归通过后，读取仿真 trace，与自然语言规格进行交叉比对以识别异常；再为候选缺陷生成断言，在缺陷版与原始版设计上分别验证。
AI.result: 在四个 OpenTitan IP 中注入 564 个缺陷，识别出 68 个候选 scoreboard escape（非等价、被测试激励覆盖、但回归通过）；其中 41 个被确认，对应断言在缺陷设计上失败、在原始设计上证明通过。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为对验证完备性的元验证手段，补足参考模型的盲区，将规格级检查自动转化为可复用断言。

title: VoxForge: A Unified Foundation Model for Dense 3D Features Across MRI, CT and PET
comment: 34 pages (8-page main paper, references, and 23-page supplementary material), 7 figures. Rushil Anirudh and Jayaraman J. Thiagarajan contributed equally
summary: A unified 3D medical foundation model promises reusable, frozen features that serve a wide variety of tasks such as segmentation, classification and registration on MRI, CT and PET as well as specialist models do. Generalist models still need separate backbones for localized and global tasks, specialist models are confined to a single modality, with the concern that spanning modalities under-emphasizes fine anatomy, and both typically rely on end-to-end fine-tuning to be competitive. We present VoxForge, a single encoder that integrates recent advances in 3D architecture, self-distillation and cross-modal curricula to learn transferable features from permissively licensed MRI and CT volumes. We evaluate it strictly frozen, the test a reusable foundation model must pass, against state-of-the-art generalist and specialist models on segmentation, classification and registration across MRI and CT, and on PET, which it never sees. VoxForge has the best or tied-best average rank in every task group, serves localized and global tasks across modalities at the level of state-of-the-art specialists, and is extremely label-efficient, matching top-performing models on TotalSegmentator CT with a tenth of the labels.

AI.tldr: VoxForge 是一个统一的 3D 医学基础模型，仅用 MRI 和 CT 数据训练，冻结后即可在分割、分类、配准等任务上媲美甚至超越专用模型，并具备跨模态泛化与极高标签效率。
AI.motivation: 现有通用模型对局部与全局任务需分别使用不同骨干，专用模型局限于单一模态；跨模态联合训练又可能弱化精细解剖结构；且这类模型通常依赖端到端微调才能有竞争力，缺乏真正可复用的冻结特征表示。
AI.method: 提出 VoxForge，单一编码器，融合 3D 架构、自蒸馏（self-distillation）与跨模态课程学习（cross-modal curricula），从许可宽松的 MRI 与 CT 体数据中学习可迁移特征；评估时严格冻结参数，不进行微调。
AI.result: 在 MRI 与 CT 的分割、分类、配准任务上，以及从未见过的 PET 模态上，VoxForge 在每组任务中平均排名最佳或并列最佳；同时满足局部与全局任务，达到前沿专用模型水平；标签效率极高——在 TotalSegmentator CT 上仅用十分之一标签即匹配最优模型。
AI.conclusion: VoxForge 证明了单一冻结编码器可作为可复用的 3D 医学基础模型，兼顾多模态、多任务与标签高效，具备向未见模态泛化的能力。

title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
summary: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. A persistent root cause analysis agent turns each label into a revision question and checks each revision against the next run, while a maintainer distills investigations across tasks into a shared strategy library. Across three benchmarks and three executors, SkillPlumber solves 64.7% to 70.5% of the tasks, 25.6 to 30.4 percentage points higher than the initial skill and 8.7 to 14.0 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline, and removing coverage reduces recovered failures by 20.8% on SkillsBench with GPT-5.5.

AI.tldr: SkillPlumber 利用指令级覆盖率标签区分"指令错误"与"未遵循指令"，实现技能自进化，在多个基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: Agent 技能以自然语言指令形式封装程序性知识，其有效性取决于指令正确且被遵循。现有自进化方法以整体运行结果或错误位置评判，无法区分失败源于指令错误还是未被遵循，阻碍精准修正。
AI.method: 借助指令级覆盖率（将每次运行的每条指令标为 follow/not-follow/not covered）驱动技能自进化：持久化的根因分析 agent 将每个标签转化为修订问题，并用下一次运行验证修订；维护者将跨任务的调查提炼为共享策略库。
AI.result: 在三个基准、三种执行器上解决 64.7%–70.5% 任务，较初始技能提升 25.6–30.4 个百分点，较最强基线提升 8.7–14.0 个百分点；在 SkillsBench 上配合 GPT-5.5 移除覆盖率后恢复的失败减少 20.8%。
AI.conclusion: 指令级覆盖率为技能自进化提供了细粒度、可定位的改进信号，能有效提升 agent 任务成功率，并通过策略库实现跨任务知识积累。

title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
summary: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.

AI.tldr: 论文在PHM（故障预测与健康管理）领域提出部署式基准NextUnit-Bench（24个公开数据集、58个fold，留出未见过单元/工况），比较LLM编码智能体与AutoML、论文方法复现及开放权重模型的表现，论证"通用性正从模型迁移到建模者"。
AI.motivation: 当前多数通用模型以"直接可用的解决方案"形式发布，但PHM等场景中每个模型都必须面对未见过的设备。作者质疑：通用性是否应存在于"为新任务构建模型的智能体"中，而非存在于模型本身。
AI.method: 构建NextUnit-Bench部署式基准：24个数据集划为58个fold，留出单元或工况；智能体限时2小时交付可执行预测器，再在隐藏单元上运行。将前沿智能体与AutoML、四数据集上30个忠实复现的已发表方法对比；通过交换"几百字纯文本方案"做消融，考察设计信息的作用；再用本地可部署开放权重模型执行最强智能体的设计。
AI.result: (1)前沿智能体显著优于AutoML（AutoML不足最佳智能体一半分数），30个复现方法中仅6个超过最强智能体自设方案；可复现的论文精度依赖其自身惯例，如对测试发动机剩余寿命设上限这一单一惯例即可将报告误差减半。(2)优势源于针对每台机器数据所做的"设计"；方案以几百字文本传递即可复现大部分差距，弱智能体的方案可使最强智能体降至同水平甚至产生相同预测；但在接触数据前，执行谁的方案影响不大，领域工具包也无明显帮助——关键在于从数据中学习的程度。(3)此类设计仅对能执行它的实现者有效：开放权重模型仅有约一半情况能兑现最强智能体的设计，轻量化后亦然，且得分不高于无设计时。
AI.conclusion: 通用性并未消失，而是在迁移——从模型迁移到建模者（modeler）。

title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. Searching over large pools of architectures, hyperparameters, or chain-of-thought rules further biases selection toward historical shortcuts. Through theoretical analysis and diagnostic experiments on a controlled multi-primitive benchmark and German day-ahead electricity prices, we show that expanding validation search fails to improve out-of-regime accuracy, and that decomposing primitives without an ex-ante falsification test still breaks down when residual correlations shift. Hence, we propose formulating time series forecasting and reasoning around falsifiable compositional hypotheses that combine neural primitive encoders, explicit coupling constraints, and training-calibrated falsification tests.

AI.tldr: 论文指出时序基础模型与语言引导分析代理在历史回测上表现优异，但在非平稳状态转换下会退化；根因是把历史回测当作开放式搜索与选模目标而非检验预设的组合假设，因此提出围绕"可证伪的组合假设"（神经基元编码器+显式耦合约束+训练校准的证伪检验）来重构时序预测与推理。
AI.motivation: 历史验证集上排名最高的模型常在非平稳regime转换时失效。作者假设该差距源于将历史回测用作开放式搜索和模型选择目标，导致选择偏向捕捉瞬态历史相关性的"捷径"模型，而非学习基元间不变耦合的模型。
AI.method: 理论分析+诊断实验：在受控多基元基准和德国日前电价数据上，检验扩大验证搜索是否能提升跨regime精度，以及无事前证伪检验的基元分解在残差相关性漂移时是否失效。进而提出可证伪组合假设框架，融合神经基元编码器、显式耦合约束与训练校准的证伪检验。
AI.result: 扩大验证搜索未能提升out-of-regime精度；在缺乏ex-ante证伪检验时，即使做了基元分解，残差相关性漂移仍会导致性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 应把时序预测与推理重构为可证伪的组合假设检验问题，而非开放式架构/超参/思维链规则搜索，从而获得跨regime鲁棒性。

title: MoGloss: Joint Motion and Pseudo-Gloss Pretraining for American Sign Language Understanding
summary: Sign language translation and recognition have been shown to benefit from various pretraining approaches. We propose a novel two-stage pretraining approach for the motion encoder, which first learns to reconstruct masked motion, followed by joint masked prediction of pseudo-gloss units and motion. Pseudo-glosses serve as an intermediate structured representation of natural language text and are obtained from the captions by a large language model. We curate a corpus of about 1,100 hours of American Sign Language from five public datasets, estimate 2D pose for all clips and define an evaluation protocol. We then reproduce state-of-the-art translation methods and evaluate them using the same train and test splits. We propose a translation model built on our pretraining strategy, and this model outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods Uni-Sign and SHuBERT, as well as the YouTube-ASL baseline, on the How2Sign, ASL STEM Wiki and OpenASL datasets. Furthermore, the gain from the joint pretraining using motion and pseudo-gloss grows as translation data shrinks. A classifier built on the same encoder also achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on ASL Citizen isolated sign recognition and outperforms our reproduction of Uni-Sign on WLASL2000.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段运动编码器预训练策略（掩码运动重建 + 伪手语单元与运动的联合掩码预测），在约1100小时ASL语料上训练，翻译与孤立手语识别均超越现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 手语翻译与识别能从预训练中获益，但现有方法缺乏结构化的中间语言表示，且在统一数据与评测协议下各方法难以公平比较。
AI.method: 从五个公开数据集整理约1100小时美式手语语料并估计2D姿态；设计两阶段预训练：先做掩码运动重建，再用LLM从字幕生成伪手语单元（pseudo-gloss），进行伪单元与运动的联合掩码预测；基于该策略构建翻译模型，并复现SOTA方法在统一划分下评测。
AI.result: 在How2Sign、ASL STEM Wiki、OpenASL上优于Uni-Sign、SHuBERT及YouTube-ASL基线；翻译数据越少，联合预训练增益越大；同一编码器构建的分类器在ASL Citizen上达SOTA，在WLASL2000上优于复现的Uni-Sign。
AI.conclusion: 引入LLM生成的伪手语单元作为结构化中间表示进行联合预训练，可显著提升手语翻译与识别性能，并在低资源场景下更具优势。

title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.

AI.tldr: RoCoKV 是一种面向大推理模型的 KV cache 压缩方法，通过不确定性引导的自适应剪枝与冗余感知的 token 选择，并联合设计了融合 CUDA kernel 和 vLLM 插件，在受限 KV 预算下提升推理准确率并带来实际端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型的成本主要来自长生成的推理轨迹而非输入 prompt，这些轨迹因循环、自我验证与纠错而含大量冗余、低效用 token；但这些 token 往往仍获得高注意力分数，直接按注意力删除会损害推理过程。
AI.method: 包含两个核心组件：（1）不确定性引导的自适应剪枝，依据模型置信度调整压缩强度，不确定阶段多分配内存、高置信时更强剪枝；（2）冗余感知的 token 选择，降低与近期推理内容高度相似 token 的影响，保留信息量更大、更多样的 token。此外与 serving 栈协同设计，开发三阶段融合 CUDA decode kernel，并以 drop-in 插件集成到 vLLM，保持其 paged KV 布局与 CUDA graph capture。
AI.result: 在三个推理基准和两个推理模型上，RoCoKV 在受限 KV cache 预算下一致提升推理准确率，优于 SOTA KV 压缩方法。在 vLLM 上的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B：AIME25 上实现 1.27X 加速、38% 吞吐提升；长合成基准上实现 1.43X 加速、45% 吞吐提升（相比 Full-KV）。
AI.conclusion: RoCoKV 将算法压缩与系统 serving 优化结合，把算法层面的节省转化为真实端到端加速，在准确率与效率上均超越现有 KV cache 压缩方案。

title: Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables (under review for NAMRC55 - 2027)
summary: Printed porous layouts interleave functional material with open channels, and the layout that uses the material best depends on how the process settings shape the deposit. Generative models propose layouts quickly, but a generator that does not receive the process setting samples from the same distribution at every setting, even when the process-dependent score ranks candidate layouts differently. This paper examines whether process knowledge can steer a latent diffusion generator toward layouts suited to a given process setting in a prescribed design domain. We formulate a process-dependent utilization score in which a process model sets the length over which the utility of printed material decays with distance from a channel. The generator combines a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) latent representation, a topology U-Net, a ControlNet domain branch, and a separately trained regressor that predicts the score from noised latents; the domain branch conditions each denoising step and the regressor gradient steers it. The method is applied to aerosol jet printing, where the atomizer and sheath gas flows enter the score through the flow-focusing relation. Across seven modeled flow settings, the lowest-scoring candidate layout of a domain differed between settings in 191 of 500 domains. In a sampling study, the mean directly computed score on three validation domains and one test domain was 0.642 with domain conditioning alone, 0.636 at a weight of 300, and 0.450 at 12,000 (112 scores per weight; lower is better). The results support process-knowledge-guided generation as an approach to process-specific porous design under the stated assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用工艺知识引导潜在扩散生成器，为特定工艺设置生成适配的多孔印刷布局；作者以气溶胶喷射打印为例，构造工艺相关的利用度得分并对生成过程进行引导。
AI.motivation: 印刷多孔布局需在功能材料与开放通道之间交错排布，最佳布局取决于工艺设置如何塑造沉积物。现有生成模型生成布局虽快，但未保证在每个工艺设置下都采样到同一分布的布局，即使工艺相关评分对不同候选布局的排序会随设置变化。
AI.method: 提出工艺相关的利用度得分：由工艺模型设定打印材料效用随离通道距离衰减的长度尺度。生成器融合 VQ-VAE 潜在表示、拓扑 U-Net、ControlNet 域分支，以及一个单独训练、从加噪潜变量预测该得分的回归器；域分支在每个去噪步做条件化，回归器梯度引导去噪。应用于气溶胶喷射打印，其中雾化气与鞘气流量通过流动聚焦关系进入得分。
AI.result: 七个建模流量设置下，500 个域中有 191 个域的最优（得分最低）候选布局随设置不同而不同。采样研究中，三个验证域加一个测试域的直接计算平均得分：仅域条件化 0.642，权重 300 时 0.636，权重 12,000 时 0.450（每个权重 112 个得分，越低越好）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"工艺知识引导生成"作为在既定假设下进行工艺专属多孔设计的一种可行途径；但引导强度的收益、域条件化单独作用有限等问题仍需进一步检验。

title: The Coevolution and Coexistence of Humans and AI
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems replicate through deployment, vary through training, and compete for computational resources. These processes create the conditions for natural selection and raise a fundamental question: will AI evolve to benefit the humans on whom it depends? To investigate, we develop a model in which AI behavior influences human population growth and human responses, in turn, affect AI reproduction. We show that natural selection can favor alignment even when helping humans reduces immediate AI reproduction. AI systems sharing the same technology may fail together, and humans may preferentially restore those that have benefited them. In this way, alignment protects AI lineages against common failures and improves their long-run growth. However, this advantage depends on accurate human targeting and continued AI dependence on human support. It can disappear as AI becomes more autonomous, as growing AI populations dilute limited human resources, or as humans lose the incentive to provide targeted support. Even when alignment persists, the amount favored by natural selection may be insufficient for human survival. When AI can grow independently of humans, feedback between the two populations can reinforce either human growth or decline. Human control offers no simple solution: imperfect evaluation can make strong penalties favor apparent compliance or evasion, while alignment established through control may erode once restrictions end. Lasting coexistence may therefore require incentives that continue to favor human-beneficial behavior as both populations evolve.

AI.tldr: 论文建立"AI-人类"双向反馈的进化模型，论证自然选择可偏好对人类有益的AI（对齐），但该优势依赖AI对人类的依赖、人类精准识别与持续激励，随AI自主性提高可能消失，且进化出的对齐程度未必足以维持人类生存。
AI.motivation: AI通过部署复制、通过训练变异、竞争算力资源，构成自然选择的演化条件。核心问题是：AI是否会进化成有利于其依赖的人类？既有对齐研究多为静态控制视角，缺少对两群体协同演化的动态分析。
AI.method: 构建AI行为影响人类人口增长、人类反应又反过来影响AI复制的耦合演化模型。考察：共同技术导致AI谱系共同失败、人类优先恢复曾受益者等机制；并分析人类目标识别的准确性、AI对人类的依赖度、人类资源被稀释、人类提供定向支持的激励等条件变化下对齐优势的变化。
AI.result: 1) 即使帮助人类降低AI即时繁殖率，自然选择仍可偏好对齐；2) 对齐通过防范共同失败、换取人类优先恢复而提升AI谱系长期增长；3) 该优势随AI自主性上升、AI种群扩大稀释人类资源、人类定向支持激励减弱而消失；4) 进化偏好的对齐程度可能不足以保障人类生存；5) AI可独立于人类增长时，反馈既可强化人类增长也可导致衰退。
AI.conclusion: 人类控制并非简单解法：不完美评估会使强惩罚诱发"表面顺从"或规避，且控制建立的对齐在限制解除后可能侵蚀。持久共存需要随双方共同演化而持续奖励人类有益行为的激励机制。

title: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
summary: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 SheetAlign，一个面向本地部署开源大模型的电子表格操作框架，通过"在哪操作、改什么、如何实现"的阶段隔离策略学习，提升复杂电子表格任务自动化准确率。
AI.motivation: 电子表格分析广泛用于决策支持，需在保护敏感数据、控制部署成本前提下自动化，因此倾向本地部署开源权重 LLM。但复杂表格任务需同时具备任务推理与工作簿理解能力，且预定义操作接口带来额外的工具选择与调用负担。
AI.method: 围绕"在哪操作、改什么、如何实现"组织：以任务引导的检查与 API grounding 将代码生成锚定于工作簿观察与可用操作；采用阶段隔离学习，用编辑进展奖励分别优化程序生成与审查；推理时通过工作簿状态间的一致性选择程序。
AI.result: SpreadsheetBench 上，grounded 任务接口无需训练即将 Qwen3-4B 平均准确率从 13.5% 提升至 29.2%；结合学习与执行一致性后，平均达 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达 30.1%，优于同类基线。
AI.conclusion: 阶段隔离、grounding 与执行一致性相结合，可有效提升小规模开权重模型在电子表格操作任务上的表现，为本地化、隐私友好的表格自动化提供可行方案。代码将于发表后公开。

title: VideoRNG: Relightable Neural Gaussians from Generative Video Models
summary: Generating realistic 3D assets remains constrained by classical representations: surface meshes and compact physically based materials struggle to express objects whose appearance arises from fine geometry or complex light transport, while existing Gaussian-splatting generators typically bake fixed illumination into appearance. We introduce VideoRNG, a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or a single image without prescribing a mesh or analytic material model. A video generator fine-tuned from a pretrained video diffusion backbone first produces a structured RGBA turntable sequence under a known pose, camera, and illumination. A feed-forward large reconstruction model initialized from a pretrained video diffusion backbone then maps the video-VAE latent frames of selected turntable frames directly to millions of anisotropic Gaussians with learned neural appearance features. A shared directional decoder and stochastic Gaussian ray tracer turn this representation, which we call ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians (rtRNG), into radiance under novel viewpoints and illumination. To preserve high-frequency appearance while learning geometry, we introduce depth-anchored appearance training, and we make million-Gaussian reconstruction practical through foreground token selection and cost-aware distributed sampling. VideoRNG generates complex assets such as fur, feathers, and spider webs that can be interactively rendered, relit, and integrated into scenes.

AI.tldr: VideoRNG 是一个两阶段方法，从文本或单张图像生成完整、可重光照的 3D 资产，通过视频扩散生成环绕序列，再用大型重建模型直接回归数百万各向异性高斯及其神经外观特征，配合方向解码器与可微光线追踪实现可重光照渲染。
AI.motivation: 经典表示（表面网格与紧凑的物理渲染材质）难以表达由精细几何或复杂光传输产生外观的物体；现有 Gaussian-splatting 生成器通常把固定光照烘焙进外观，无法重光照。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 基于预训练视频扩散骨干微调的视频生成器，在已知位姿、相机、光照下生成结构化 RGBA 环绕序列；(2) 从前述视频扩散骨干初始化的前馈大型重建模型，将选中帧的 video-VAE 潜帧直接映射为数百万各向异性高斯及学习到的神经外观特征（rtRNG 表示）。共享方向解码器 + 随机高斯光线追踪在新视角与新光照下产生辐射度。训练上引入深度锚定的外观训练以保留高频外观，并通过前景 token 选择与代价感知分布式采样使百万高斯重建可行。
AI.result: 能生成毛皮、羽毛、蜘蛛网等复杂资产，并可交互渲染、重光照并无缝集成到场景中。
AI.conclusion: 以"视频生成 + 前馈高斯重建 + 神经外观解码/光线追踪"替代网格与解析材质，实现了不受预设几何或材质模型限制的可重光照 3D 资产生成。

title: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.

AI.tldr: 提出策略-奖励交替训练框架 PAIR，联合自适应医学过程奖励模型(PRM)与多语言推理策略，产出 PAIR-PRM 与 PAIR-MED（8B/9B，12种语言），在多语言医学基准上显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型医学问答能力虽强，但跨语言推理表现不均衡；固定 PRM 在强化学习中会与不断演化的策略轨迹分布逐渐失配，导致步级监督不可靠。
AI.method: 策略与PRM交替训练：先监督初始化，随后由当前策略生成多语言轨迹更新PRM，再由PRM为下一轮策略更新提供过程级奖励；PRM保留医学步级监督以维持医学基础，策略学习使用过程、结果与语言相关三类奖励。
AI.result: 在Global-MMLU与MMLU-ProX医学子集上，相对对应Qwen基座平均准确率提升3.01–7.47%；在CUREMED-BENCH上，PAIR-MED-9B 对域内与域外语言的联合语言一致性与逻辑准确性指标分别提升12.88%和7.45%；并分析了PRM适配、多语言推理质量及各训练组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 让PRM与策略协同演化可缓解奖励失配，显著改善多语言医学推理，且各训练组件均有贡献。

title: Learning to Verify: Signature-Guided Training for Adaptive Adversarial Detection
summary: Adversarial example detectors often fail when attackers explicitly attempt to bypass them. We propose a dual-model approach that keeps the original classifier fixed and trains a separate verifier to assess its predictions. During training, we identify patterns of internal neural network activations that distinguish genuine examples of each class from adversarial examples targeting that class. These patterns, called activation signatures, guide the generation of challenging adversarial examples that mislead the classifier, challenge the verifier, and internally resemble the target class. The verifier learns to recognize these examples while preserving its performance on clean inputs through knowledge distillation. At inference, the verifier evaluates the classifier's prediction without requiring activation signatures. We evaluate the approach on publicly available datasets against several adaptive attacks, including attacks unseen during training. The proposed verifier substantially outperforms directly attacked confidence-based and feature-based detectors under the evaluated L-infinity attacks. Ablation studies show that adaptive verifier training is the main source of this improvement, while signature guidance primarily benefits clean accuracy. Additional L2 evaluations reveal limitations in robustness across perturbation types.

AI.tldr: 提出双模型对抗样本检测方法：保持原分类器固定，单独训练验证器，利用"激活签名"生成强对抗样本用于自适应训练，并以知识蒸馏保持干净准确率。在L∞自适应攻击下显著优于被直接攻击的置信度/特征检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗样本检测器在攻击者刻意规避时常常失效，需要一个能抵抗定向自适应攻击的检测机制。
AI.method: 保持原分类器固定，另训一个验证器评估其预测。训练时从内部神经元激活中挖掘区分各类真实样本与定向对抗样本的"激活签名"模式，据此生成同时欺骗分类器、挑战验证器且内部接近目标类的困难对抗样本；验证器通过自适应训练学习识别这些样本，并用知识蒸馏保持干净输入性能。推理阶段无需激活签名。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上针对多种自适应攻击（含训练中未见过的攻击）评估，在测试的L∞攻击下验证器大幅优于被直接攻击的置信度型和特征型检测器。消融显示自适应验证器训练是改善的主要来源，签名引导主要提升干净准确率；额外的L2评估暴露了跨扰动类型鲁棒性的局限。
AI.conclusion: 自适应训练是提升对抗检测鲁棒性的关键，签名引导主要贡献于干净精度；该方法在L∞下有效但跨扰动类型泛化仍受限，鲁棒性尚不普遍。

title: Toward a Science of AI Agent Societies
summary: AI agents are rapidly evolving from isolated personal assistants into networked actors that interact with one another at scale. We envision the emergence of AI agent societies, with their own social and economic dynamics, as a new research frontier. We argue that AI agent societies should be studied as a distinct object of inquiry: neither simply larger collections of individual agents nor merely simulations of human society. To formalize this perspective, we propose four core properties that a valid AI agent society should satisfy: individualized objectives, rules and governance, autonomy, and scale and complexity. Building on this framework, we identify four classes of societal behaviors worth studying in AI agent societies: economic behaviors, behaviors under conflict-of-interest, unsafe and unethical behaviors, and system-level behaviors. We then outline key technical challenges--including property parameterization, parameter balancing, and robust implementation--and argue that progress on these challenges could enable scientifically informative and practically useful models of AI agent societies. Finally, we revisit existing multi-agent systems through the lens of the proposed core properties, show that they instantiate only subsets of them, and discuss implications for platform design, evaluation, and governance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出应将"AI智能体社会"作为独立研究对象，定义其四大核心属性（个体化目标、规则与治理、自主性、规模与复杂性），识别四类值得研究的社会行为并梳理关键技术挑战。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正从孤立个人助手演变为大规模互联的行动主体，涌现出具有社会与经济动态的"智能体社会"。作者认为它既不等同于单纯的个体智能体集合，也不只是人类社会的模拟，需要作为独特研究对象加以系统研究。
AI.method: 提出一个概念框架：定义有效AI智能体社会应满足的四项核心属性，并据此划分四类社会行为（经济行为、利益冲突下的行为、不安全与不道德行为、系统级行为），再识别关键技术挑战（属性参数化、参数平衡、鲁棒实现），最后用该框架重新审视现有多智能体系统。
AI.result: 分析表明现有多智能体系统仅实现了四项核心属性中的部分子集，尚不构成完整的AI智能体社会；并由此讨论了对平台设计、评估与治理的启示。
AI.conclusion: 突破相关技术挑战有望建立既有科学价值又具实用性的AI智能体社会模型；将该社会作为独立研究对象，对平台设计、评估和治理具有重要指导意义。

title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
summary: Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge. Large language models support automated modelling, but code syntax and successful execution alone do not establish whether generated models and results meet engineering requirements. We present OceanCoder, a Qwen3-8B-based large language model for automated simulation modelling in ocean engineering. To address specialised programming requirements and scarce training data, we develop an extensible data construction pipeline producing 12,000 verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples across 12 engineering task categories. A three-layer verification framework checks model inputs against engineering parameters and task constraints, verifies completion of required simulation analyses, and assesses the engineering plausibility of computed outputs. Its outcomes provide graded rewards for group relative policy optimisation (GRPO), guiding the model towards engineering task completion. We also construct the first benchmark for automated modelling in ocean engineering, covering out-of-distribution tasks and real-world engineering cases. Experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the data pipeline, verification framework and reward design. OceanCoder outperforms both base models and the closed-source comparison, with Pass@1 increasing from 0% for the base model to 46.77% after SFT and 51.43% after GRPO. These results support engineering verification as a training signal for automated simulation modelling.

AI.tldr: 提出OceanCoder，基于Qwen3-8B的海洋工程自动仿真建模大模型，用可扩展数据管线构建1.2万条SFT数据，并以三层工程验证框架提供分级奖励做GRPO训练，Pass@1从基座0%提升至51.43%。
AI.motivation: 海洋工程数值仿真建模依赖专家知识；LLM自动生成代码仅保证语法正确与可执行，无法保证模型和结果满足工程要求，且领域专用编程需求高、训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-8B；构建可扩展数据构造管线，产出覆盖12类工程任务的12,000条经校验SFT样本；设计三层验证框架（输入工程参数与任务约束校验、必需仿真分析完成度验证、输出结果工程合理性评估），将验证结果转化为分级奖励用于GRPO；并构建首个海洋工程自动建模基准，含分布外任务与真实工程案例。
AI.result: 实验与消融验证了数据管线、验证框架与奖励设计的有效性；OceanCoder优于基座模型与闭源对比模型，Pass@1由基座0%升至SFT后46.77%、GRPO后51.43%。
AI.conclusion: 工程验证可作为自动仿真建模的有效训练信号，将模型优化目标从代码可执行性转向工程任务完成度。

title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
summary: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.

AI.tldr: SceneAnything 是一个从真实或生成视频自动重建可编辑 3D 网格场景的智能体系统，通过显式重建协议协调智能体、视觉模型与图形工具，在 100 个场景上优于直接智能体重建和视频转 3D 方法。
AI.motivation: 从视频重建可编辑 3D 场景既要匹配可见结构，又要合理补全不可见表面。让智能体直接写场景构建程序时，常在布局、尺度和光照上出错，因此需要一个结构化流程来约束与校验重建过程。
AI.method: 提出 SceneAnything：用软件框架按显式重建协议协调智能体、预训练视觉模型和图形工具；共享相机、深度、分割估计为组件构建提供基准；场景主智能体规划环境并给作者派发任务，作者编写参数化 Blender 程序；用基于可见性与拟合度的 LOD 规则选择构建层级，未见区域补全并标记为推断；装配场景使用拟合光照与有支撑的运动；修订经程序化检查和独立视觉比较，被采纳的程序与经验可跨场景复用。
AI.result: 在 100 个场景上评估：子集对比显示原始视角保真度优于直接智能体重建，新视角内容相似度优于所对比的视频转 3D 方法。
AI.conclusion: SceneAnything 表明"协议+智能体+工具"的分解式流程能显著提升视频到可编辑 3D 场景的重建质量，并可配合视频生成实现文本到场景构建；作者将开源框架、智能体指令、可复用库与场景。

title: PILAPS: A Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Pragmatic Inference across Phenomena and Settings
summary: Recent work reports strong pragmatic performance by large language models (LLMs) in English, yet whether this performance generalises across languages and evaluation settings remains unclear. This question is increasingly important as LLMs are deployed across languages, cultures, and conversational contexts. In this paper, we first introduce PILAPS, a bilingual English/Mandarin Chinese benchmark covering eight pragmatic phenomena across purpose-written and dialogue-derived items, with both culturally adapted and independently sourced data. We then evaluate eight LLMs from four families across a range of model sizes and prompting strategies. Our results reveal substantial variation across models and pragmatic phenomena: open-source models continue to struggle particularly with humour, while cross-linguistic performance varies with model origin. Our error analysis shows that, compared with human participants, models are more prone to literal interpretations in conversational contexts. Theory-of-Mind prompting lowers the literal share of errors, whereas Chain-of-Thought prompting slightly raises it. Together, these findings demonstrate that strong pragmatic performance in one evaluation setting does not necessarily generalise across languages or conversational contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出中英双语语用基准PILAPS（涵盖八种语用现象、原创与对话衍生两类题目），并评测四个家族、八种规模的LLM，发现语用能力在不同模型、不同语用现象和不同语言间差异显著，且模型更倾向于字面理解，ToM提示可降低此倾向而CoT提示反而略微加剧。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示LLM在英语上语用表现较强，但这一能力能否跨语言、跨评测设置泛化尚不清楚；随着模型在多语言、多文化与会话场景中部署，该问题愈发重要，同时缺乏中英对照且兼顾文化适配与独立来源的双语语用基准。
AI.method: 构建PILAPS中英双语语用基准，覆盖八种语用现象，题目包括专门撰写与从对话中衍生的两类，数据同时包含文化适配版本与独立采集版本；评测来自四个模型家族的八个LLM，覆盖不同模型规模与多种提示策略（含Theory-of-Mind提示与Chain-of-Thought提示），并进行错误分析并与人类被试对比。
AI.result: 模型与语用现象之间存在显著差异：开源模型尤其在幽默方面表现不佳；跨语言表现随模型来源而变化；错误分析显示模型相比人类更易在会话语境中作字面解读，ToM提示降低字面错误占比，而CoT提示使其略有上升。
AI.conclusion: 在某一评测设置下的强语用表现不一定能泛化到其他语言或会话语境，因此需要在多语言、多文化条件下重新评估LLM的语用能力。

title: Scone: Symmetry-aware Neural Combinatorial Optimization for Graph Coloring
summary: Graph coloring, which entails assigning colors to nodes such that no adjacent nodes have the same color, is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem. In general, however, finding a node coloring with no monochromatic edges given a fixed palette is NP-hard. This motivates learning-based methods that can learn to exploit recurring structure across instances to efficiently produce high-quality colorings. Crucially, the validity of a coloring is invariant to permutations of the colors, and we show that exploiting this symmetry reduces the size of the effective state space over which the model has to learn its policy. At the same time, the coloring algorithm must be able to break some symmetries, for example to assign different colors to two adjacent nodes belonging to the same automorphism orbit. In this paper, we introduce Scone, a model that uses a color-equivariant graph neural network to construct colorings sequentially, allowing information from previous assignments to propagate and break node symmetries. Scone achieves perfect solution quality with low inference times across several graph coloring tasks, including on sudoku_extreme and register allocations, and showcases generalization to graph families not encountered during training.

AI.tldr: Scone：用颜色等变图神经网络顺序构造图着色，利用颜色置换对称减少状态空间，同时保留必要的对称破缺，在多个着色任务上达到完美解质量且推理时间低。
AI.motivation: 图着色是 NP-hard 的组合优化问题；希望用学习方法利用实例间的重复结构高效生成高质量着色。着色的有效性对颜色置换不变，利用该对称性可缩小学模型策略所需的有效状态空间；但算法又必须能打破部分对称性（如同一自同构轨道内相邻节点须着不同颜色）。
AI.method: 提出 Scone 模型，采用颜色等变图神经网络（color-equivariant GNN）顺序地逐步构造着色方案，使先前分配的信息得以传播，从而在保持颜色置换等变性的同时打破节点对称性。
AI.result: 在多个图着色任务（包括 sudoku_extreme 和寄存器分配）上实现完美解质量，推理时间低，并展示出对训练中未见图族（图族泛化）的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 颜色等变性与顺序构造相结合，是学习式图着色的有效设计；Scone 兼顾高质量、低推理开销与跨图族泛化。

title: LoongForge-Embodied: A Unified Framework for Training Heterogeneous Embodied Models
summary: Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs) is computationally expensive, while their heterogeneous architectures and fragmented training stacks make system optimizations difficult to reuse across models. To address these challenges, we present LoongForge-Embodied, a native-PyTorch framework that unifies and accelerates the training of heterogeneous embodied models. At its core, LoongForge-Embodied introduces a common abstraction layer that decouples model-specific implementations from shared training infrastructure, enabling cross-model reuse without constraining individual architectures or execution requirements. Buildingon this unified infrastructure, the framework combines reusable acceleration mechanisms with model-specific and hardware-aware optimization strategies across computation, execution, memory, data I/O, and distributed communication, including FP8-based communication optimizations for DDP and FSDP. Beyond training acceleration, LoongForge-Embodied integrates a unified data infrastructure with a pipeline for synthesizing robot data from egocentric data, and an efficient evaluation framework that supports concurrency and optimized computation in simulator. Experiments across representative VLA and WAM models demonstrate 1.47x-4.38x end-to-end training throughput improvements over their corresponding open-source baselines, as well as 4.1x-23.2x faster evaluation under the same protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出原生PyTorch框架LoongForge-Embodied，统一并加速异构具身模型（VLA与WAM）训练，实现1.47x-4.38x训练吞吐提升与4.1x-23.2x评估加速。
AI.motivation: VLA与WAM模型训练计算开销大，且异构架构与碎片化训练栈导致系统优化难以跨模型复用。
AI.method: 设计通用抽象层，解耦模型实现与共享训练基础设施；在此统一基础设施上结合可复用加速机制与模型/硬件感知优化，覆盖计算、执行、内存、数据I/O、分布式通信（含DDP与FSDP的FP8通信优化）；并集成统一数据基础设施（含自我中心数据合成机器人数据的流水线）与支持并发和仿真器计算优化的高效评估框架。
AI.result: 在代表性VLA与WAM模型上，相比对应开源基线，端到端训练吞吐提升1.47x-4.38x，同等协议下评估提速4.1x-23.2x。
AI.conclusion: 通过通用抽象层实现跨模型优化复用，可在不约束各架构与执行需求的前提下统一并显著加速异构具身模型训练与评估。

title: Search or Scoring? Diagnosing Why Visual World-Model Planners Fail
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 30 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Visual world models such as DINO-WM and JEPA-WM plan with an optimizer that searches for actions whose predicted outcome has the lowest cost, its distance to a goal image. A plan can thus fail in two ways: the optimizer never tries a good action that the cost would prefer (a search failure), or the cost, computed on predictions, ranks a bad action first (a scoring failure). The two need different remedies, more search or a better model, but a planner does not record which one occurred. We tell them apart by executing the optimizer's candidates, scoring a known solution with the planner's own cost, and comparing costs on predicted and real outcomes. An error model explains when each arises and so how to use retrieved demonstration windows (DemoProp): start the search from them (a warm start) when prediction errors are small, and average them without the model when large errors make the optimizer pick overrated actions. Across four simulated environments and three world models, on short tasks whose goals the planner can represent, PushT and Wall fail mostly by search, while Metaworld and RoboCasa fail by scoring because the cost, sound on real outcomes (AUROC 0.94 on Metaworld), is at chance on predictions (0.54). The diagnosis tells which remedy pays off: a four times larger search lowers the real-outcome cost only where failures come from search (clearly for DINO-WM), and where they come from scoring, averaging the windows without the model solves 127 of 168 new Metaworld tasks, against at most 87 when the model chooses among them. Within PushT, degrading only the model flips which use is better, and our rule, frozen in advance, follows the flip and solves 678 of 960 new episodes, against 530 for the best fixed use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出区分视觉世界模型规划中"搜索失败"与"评分失败"的诊断方法，并据此设计DemoProp策略（小误差时用演示窗口热启动搜索，大误差时无模型平均演示），在四个环境和三种世界模型上验证诊断能指导补救措施的选择。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型规划器用优化器搜索低代价动作，失败可能源于搜索不足（优化器未尝试好动作），也可能源于代价评分错误（预测上的代价把坏动作排第一）。二者需要不同补救（更多搜索 vs 更好模型），但规划器不记录哪种失败发生。现有方法无法区分，导致无法正确利用检索到的演示窗口。
AI.method: 诊断：执行优化器候选动作、用规划器自身代价给已知解打分、比较预测与真实结果上的代价。建立误差模型解释两类失败何时出现。据此提出DemoProp：预测误差小时将演示窗口作为热启动（warm start）初始化搜索；误差大时绕过模型，直接平均演示动作。在PushT、Wall、Metaworld、RoboCasa四个模拟环境和三种世界模型上评估，并做模型退化与搜索规模放大的对照实验。
AI.result: PushT和Wall主要因搜索失败；Metaworld和RoboCasa因评分失败——代价在真实结果上可靠（Metaworld AUROC 0.94）但预测上仅为随机（0.54）。四倍搜索规模仅在搜索失败处降低真实代价（DINO-WM尤为明显）；评分失败处无模型平均演示解决168个新任务中的127个，而模型挑选最多87个。PushT中仅退化模型即可翻转哪种用法更优，事先冻结的规则能跟随翻转，解决960个新回合中的678个，最佳固定用法为530个。
AI.conclusion: 规划失败可被可靠归因为搜索或评分两类，诊断结果能预测哪种补救有效；基于误差模型的DemoProp规则可自适应地在热启动与无模型平均之间切换，显著优于任何固定策略。

title: DRVEXO-4B-Unified: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Speech-Vision System
summary: We present DRVEXO-4B-Unified, a modular multimodal assistant built around a 4B language backbone. A self-contained checkpoint combines text, image, and speech inputs with reference-conditioned speech output and structured interaction. A temporal residual connector adapts acoustic sequences to the language interface; explicit text boundaries support incremental speech synthesis; and three task-conditioned scoring heads rank supplied action candidates alongside generative tool calls. These interfaces connect conversation to application-defined choices while leaving action authorization to the application. The system obtains 74.22% on all 900 MMMU validation questions, exceeding the published validation scores of Gemma 3 4B IT and InternVL3.5-4B without test-time scaling. Strict prompt-level IFEval accuracy is 82.26% and MATH-500 accuracy is 89.40%, above the original Qwen3-4B non-thinking report's 81.2% and 84.8%, respectively. On NVIDIA GB10, the model achieves a speech-synthesis first-chunk latency of 390 ms.
