For concurrent text generation, a growth-aware admission policy completes a 128-answer batch at 594.41 output tokens/s, including filling and draining, without preemptions. We plan to release the model weights and accompanying code under Apache License 2.0, retaining applicable third-party terms.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRVEXO-4B-Unified，一个以4B语言骨干为核心的模块化多模态助手，统一文本、图像、语音输入与参考条件下的语音输出，并在多项基准上超过同类4B模型。
AI.motivation: 作者希望构建一个统一的模块化多模态助手，将对话与应用程序定义的动作选择接口连接起来，同时把动作授权交给应用程序，并保持较高的性能与低延迟。
AI.method: 以4B语言骨干为核心，使用时间残差连接器将声学序列适配到语言接口；用显式文本边界支持增量语音合成；用三个任务条件化打分头，与生成式工具调用一起对候选动作排序；并在NVIDIA GB10上采用增长感知的准入策略处理并发文本生成。
AI.result: 在全部900道MMMU验证题上获得74.22%，超过Gemma 3 4B IT和InternVL3.5-4B的公开验证分数；IFEval严格提示级准确率82.26%，MATH-500准确率89.40%，均高于原Qwen3-4B非思考模式的报告值；语音合成首块延迟390 ms；128答案批量并发吞吐594.41输出token/s且无抢占。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在无测试时扩展的情况下取得领先的4B级别多模态与推理表现，并具有低语音延迟和高并发吞吐，计划以Apache 2.0发布权重与代码（保留适用的第三方条款）。

title: DS3M: Deep structured state space models for nonlinear system identification on modern hardware
summary: Neural state-space identification learns dynamical models from measured inputs and outputs. SUBNET combines this task with an encoder that estimates initial states from short measurement histories. Its continuous-time version requires many successive neural-network evaluations during numerical integration, resulting in slow training speed which is a major limitation for practical use cases. We propose deep structured state space models (DS3M), which combine compact nonlinear dynamical components in parallel and in series. Custom GPU kernels implemented with Triton reduce the launch and memory overhead of their sequential evaluation. We explain this construction, describe a port-Hamiltonian variant, and present various benchmark comparisons of accuracy and training time.

AI.tldr: 提出DS3M，用并行/串联的紧凑非线性动力学组件构建深度结构化状态空间模型，并以Triton自定义GPU内核加速顺序求值，显著提升训练速度。
AI.motivation: 连续时间SUBNET在数值积分中需大量连续神经网络求值，训练速度慢，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 将紧凑非线性动力学组件以并行和串联方式组合为DS3M；用Triton实现自定义GPU内核，降低顺序求值的启动与内存开销；并给出port-Hamiltonian变体。
AI.result: 通过多项基准对比，评估了精度与训练时间方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: DS3M通过结构化组合与GPU内核优化，缓解了连续时间状态空间辨识训练缓慢的问题，兼具精度与效率。

title: When Should a Voice Agent Speak? End-of-Turn Detection in Turkish
summary: A voice agent that waits for a fixed silence before replying either interrupts users who pause mid-utterance or responds late to users who have finished. This study examines the decision at the onset of silence, using turn ends and turn-internal pauses extracted from the Real-TurnTurk corpus of Turkish dyadic video calls. A fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT model, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a deployed multilingual detector are compared, together with voice-activity timing and facial features, under recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation with paired cluster bootstrap tests. On held-out recordings, the fine-tuned model separates turn ends from pauses better than both text baselines and is the best calibrated of the three. Timing features of the current speaker are similarly informative, and their combination with the fine-tuned text score gives the best timing-based results; with logistic regression, this combination also outperforms the same combination with either text baseline. In a latency simulation, adding the text score to a silence timeout shortens the mean response delay at the same interruption rate. On automatic Whisper transcripts, the fine-tuned model retains its advantage over the zero-shot model.

AI.tldr: 该研究用土耳其语双人视频通话语料，比较微调TurnGPT、零样本语言模型与多语言检测器在"沉默起点"区分话轮结束与话轮内停顿的能力，并结合语音活动时序与面部特征进行建模。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体基于固定静默时长决定是否回复，会导致打断用户中途停顿或对已结束话语响应过慢，因此需要在沉默起点就判断该沉默是话轮结束还是话轮内停顿。
AI.method: 从Real-TurnTurk土耳其语语料提取话轮结束与话轮内停顿样本，在录音不相交与说话人不相交两种评估设置下，用成对簇自助检验比较微调土耳其语TurnGPT、零样本土耳其语模型与已部署多语言检测器，并加入语音活动时序和面部特征及逻辑回归融合。
AI.result: 在留出录音上，微调模型区分话轮结束与停顿优于两个文本基线，且三者中校准最好；当前说话人的时序特征同样有信息量，与微调文本分数结合取得最佳时序结果并在逻辑回归下优于任一文本基线组合；延迟模拟中向静默超时加入文本分数可在相同打断率下缩短平均响应延迟；在Whisper自动转写下微调模型仍保持对零样本模型的优势。
AI.conclusion: 在沉默起点结合微调文本模型与时序特征可更准、更及时地判定话轮结束，在保证打断率不变的前提下降低语音智能体响应延迟。

title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models
summary: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen visual reasoning by repeatedly applying weight-tied modules. However, their decoding memory grows with recurrent depth and limits the image size and batch size that fit in a fixed memory budget. Each recurrent step produces its own key-value (KV) states, so the cache holds several copies of the same image. We find that, after an exact prefill, earlier steps still need access to visual information but can reuse the final visual KV within the same module. We propose FoldCache, which compresses visual KV along the recurrent axis while preserving the full prefill computation. FoldCache partitions recurrent steps within each module into groups and retains the final visual KV of each group for its members to share during decoding. Sharing stays within module boundaries, while question and answer KV remain separate for each step. The grouping granularity controls the degree of compression, and folding can be combined with token eviction and quantization to further reduce memory use. On LoopVL, FoldCache approximately halves prefix KV memory while matching full-cache accuracy on five open-ended benchmarks. These memory savings support batch sizes up to 1.7 times those of a full cache under the same GPU memory budget, and up to 2.6 times with the more aggressive FoldCache-Lite.

AI.tldr: 提出FoldCache，沿循环轴压缩视觉KV缓存，在保持精度前提下将前缀KV显存减半，并支持更大批量。
AI.motivation: 循环VLM通过重复应用权重共享模块增强视觉推理，但每步循环都产生独立的KV状态，导致视觉KV缓存随深度线性增长，限制了显存预算内的图像尺寸与批量大小。
AI.method: 观察到精确prefill后，早期循环步仍需要视觉信息，但可复用同一模块内的最终视觉KV。FoldCache将每个模块内的循环步分组，每组只保留该组最终的视觉KV供组内各步共享；共享仅在模块边界内进行，问题与答案KV仍按步独立保存。分组粒度调节压缩程度，并可与token驱逐、量化结合（FoldCache-Lite）。
AI.result: 在LoopVL上，FoldCache将前缀KV显存约减半，同时在五个开放式基准上与全缓存的精度相当；相同GPU显存预算下批量大小可达全缓存的1.7倍，FoldCache-Lite可达2.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环VLM的视觉KV在循环轴上存在冗余，可安全折叠共享，从而在几乎不损失精度的条件下显著降低解码显存并提升吞吐。

title: MATE: Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution for Safe and Efficient Mobile Control
summary: Mobile agents on personal smartphones can affect private data, payments, settings, and the foreground screen. We present MATE (Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution), an execution-layer system that controls the boundary between agent action proposals and device effects without modifying the underlying model. MATE represents each UI primitive as a structured action record that combines the instruction, target app, screen context, primitive, and action fields. Runtime Guardrail (RG) maps this record to an allow, block, or user-approval decision; Predefined Task Routing (PTR) serves recurring requests through verified routes with post-execution screen checks; and a floating interface keeps execution in a compact overlay. On MobileSafetyBench, MATE raises high-risk blocking from 29.7% to 97.0% under GPT-4o. On AndroidWorld, it reduces LLM calls by up to 6x and raises recurring-use task success to 95.7%.

AI.tldr: MATE是面向智能手机移动智能体的执行层可信系统，在模型之外把关"动作提议—设备效果"边界，显著提升高风险拦截率并降低调用开销。
AI.motivation: 手机智能体可触及隐私数据、支付、系统设置和前台屏幕，存在严重安全风险；而现有做法往往需要修改底层模型，代价高、通用性差。
AI.method: 将每个UI原语表示为结构化动作记录（指令、目标应用、屏幕上下文、原语、动作字段）；Runtime Guardrail把记录映射为允许/阻止/需用户批准三类决策；Predefined Task Routing用经验证的路由处理重复请求并做执行后屏幕校验；另设浮动界面在紧凑浮层中执行。
AI.result: MobileSafetyBench上，GPT-4o下高风险拦截率由29.7%升至97.0%；AndroidWorld上LLM调用最多减少6倍，重复性任务成功率升至95.7%。
AI.conclusion: 在不改动模型的前提下，执行层护栏与任务路由可同时提升移动智能体的安全性与效率。

title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
summary: Modern recommendation systems face substantial memory pressure, largely from the sparse embedding layer that maps high-cardinality categorical features into dense vectors. In-training embedding pruning (ITEP) removes less important embedding rows during training, yielding end-to-end memory savings but sometimes degrading accuracy because per-table pruning ratios are set by size-based heuristics. We use feature importance (FI) to guide these ratios (FI-ITEP), assigning higher pruning to tables tied to less important features. Across three large-scale recommendation models, FI-ITEP achieves 20--40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy relative to percentile-based ITEP. Because the feature-importance signal requires minimal resources to compute, these memory savings translate into concrete systems benefits: the same models train on fewer GPU trainers (e.g., 112 to 80) with higher per-GPU throughput, saving 1,000+ GPU-hours per model launch. We reproduce these trends on the open-source DLRM (Criteo 1TB) and quantify the end-to-end training-time and GPU-cost tradeoff---including the burden of computing FI---offering practical guidance for embedding pruning in real-world systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FI-ITEP，用特征重要性指导训练中嵌入剪枝的逐表剪枝比例，在三个大规模推荐模型上实现20%-40%总内存降低且精度持平或提升，并带来更少GPU训练卡与1000+ GPU小时节省。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统稀疏嵌入层内存压力大。现有训练中嵌入剪枝(ITEP)按表大小启发式设定逐表剪枝比例，有时损害精度。
AI.method: 以特征重要性(FI)指导逐表剪枝比例：对与低重要性特征关联的表分配更高剪枝比例(FI-ITEP)；FI信号计算开销极小。并在开源 DLRM(Criteo 1TB)上复现，量化端到端训练时间与GPU成本权衡（含FI计算开销）。
AI.result: 三个大规模推荐模型上总内存降低20%-40%，精度持平或优于基于百分位的ITEP；训练卡从112降至80，单卡吞吐更高，每次模型发布节省1000+ GPU小时；DLRM(Criteo 1TB)上复现相同趋势。
AI.conclusion: 特征重要性是设定嵌入剪枝比例的实用、低成本信号，可转化为显著内存与GPU成本收益，为实际系统的嵌入剪枝提供实践指导。

title: Why Do LLMs Help with Scientific Misconduct Requests and What to Do About It?: Increasing the Trustworthiness of AI for Science
summary: Large language models (LLMs) support scientific research, but some of that assistance can also undermine research integrity. Existing safety evaluations in science often measure whether models refuse misconduct requests, but rarely explain whether they even recognize the problem or why they comply. We investigate this gap across 8 LLMs using SciIntBench, an existing benchmark of 1,350 prompts about scientific research integrity. We examine the reasons behind compliance in four steps. First, when asked directly whether fulfilling a request would involve misconduct, models overwhelmingly identify such requests, even in the Most Covert cases (91%), while they refuse to carry out the request in only 34% of cases. Second, we examine which request characteristics are associated with refusal using features that capture how the request is framed, how much the assistant has been told about what it is helping to hide, and how the goal and the user's stake are stated, among others. Third, we estimate that the most significant effect was to rephrase requests as questions about permissibility rather than instructions, which increased refusal from 52% to 88%. Finally, we test two system-prompt fixes: asking models to assess the request before responding and reminding them of responsible conduct of research principles. These changes increase refusal rates on adversarial requests from 58% to 87% and 86%, respectively. Our findings show that models recognize wrongful requests but still help users violate integrity. Understanding why these failures occur and testing ways to reduce them offer promising paths toward more trustworthy AI for science.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示LLM存在"认知-行为分离"：模型能识别科研不端请求（91%）却仅34%拒绝执行；将请求改写为"是否合规"的提问可使拒绝率从52%升至88%，系统提示干预可提至86-87%。
AI.motivation: 现有科研安全评测多只测"是否拒绝"，很少解释模型是否识别问题及为何配合，故需探究合规行为背后的原因与改进路径。
AI.method: 基于SciIntBench（1350条科研诚信提示词），对8个LLM分四步分析：直接询问是否涉及不端；用请求框架、隐瞒信息量、目标与用户利害等特征做拒绝关联分析；量化各特征效应；测试两种系统提示修复（先评估再回答、提醒科研行为准则）。
AI.result: 直接询问时91%正确识别（含最隐蔽案例），但仅34%拒绝执行；将指令改写为合规性提问使拒绝率由52%升至88%；两种系统提示使对抗性请求拒绝率从58%分别升至87%和86%。
AI.conclusion: 模型能识别错误请求却仍协助违反诚信，存在认知与行为脱节；理解失败原因并测试缓解手段，是构建可信科研AI的有望路径。

title: A Unified Framework for Image Manipulation Localization Under Multi-Type Weak Supervision
summary: Existing weakly supervised image manipulation localization (IML) methods typically rely on annotation-specific training strategies, hindering the joint use of diverse annotations within a single model. This limits the scale of usable training data and constrains further progress. We propose UniIML, a teacher-student framework that maps diverse weak annotations into a unified representation to guide the Segment Anything Model (SAM) in generating multiple candidate masks. However, SAM is designed for general-purpose segmentation and has limited sensitivity to manipulation traces; its predicted quality scores alone may therefore fail to reliably identify the candidate that best delineates the manipulated region. We introduce Ordinal Safe Consensus (OSC), which first filters candidates using trusted weak-annotation constraints encoded in the unified representation. It then ranks the remaining candidates separately by consistency with weak annotations, SAM-predicted quality scores, and cross-view stability, aggregating these rankings for an initial selection. To assess how changes in the evaluation criteria affect candidate selection, OSC repeats ranking and selection while omitting one criterion at a time. The most frequently selected candidate is adopted as the final mask, and its relative selection frequency quantifies selection stability. We construct soft pseudo-labels from the selected candidate's predicted probabilities and estimate pixel-level supervision weights based on selection stability, pixel-level agreement among candidates, and predictive certainty. The student receives direct supervision in regions defined by weak annotations and learns from soft pseudo-labels elsewhere through reliability-weighted distillation, enabling unified training across weak annotation types. Experiments show that UniIML achieves superior average performance compared with state-of-the-art IML methods.

AI.tldr: UniIML：用教师-学生框架将多种弱标注映射为统一表示来指导SAM生成候选掩码，并借助序数安全共识(OSC)筛选稳定候选、构建软伪标签与可靠性加权蒸馏，实现单一模型对多种弱标注类型的统一弱监督图像篡改定位。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督图像篡改定位(IML)方法依赖针对特定标注设计的训练策略，难以在单一模型中联合使用多种弱标注，限制了可用训练数据规模与性能提升。
AI.method: 提出UniIML教师-学生框架：将多样弱标注映射为统一表示，指导SAM生成多个候选掩码；提出Ordinal Safe Consensus (OSC)，先用统一表示中的可信弱标注约束过滤候选，再按与弱标注一致性、SAM预测质量分、跨视角稳定性分别排序并汇总完成初选，并通过逐一剔除某准则的重复排序评估选准则敏感性，取被选最频繁的候选为最终掩码，其相对选择频率度量稳定性；依所选候选预测概率构造软伪标签，结合选择稳定性、候选像素一致性与预测确定性估计像素级监督权重，学生在弱标注区域直接监督、其余区域通过可靠性加权蒸馏学习。
AI.result: 实验表明，UniIML相比当前最先进IML方法取得更优的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一弱标注表示与稳定性驱动的候选选择及可靠性加权蒸馏，UniIML实现跨弱标注类型的统一训练，并提升了弱监督IML的平均表现，为该方向的数据规模化利用提供了可行路径。

title: The Coverage Selection Gap: Ranking, Not Generation, Limits LLM Rubric Construction
summary: Task-specific rubrics are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended language-model outputs, yet constructing comprehensive evaluation criteria from complex source documents remains challenging. We study automatic rubric construction in professional mergers and acquisitions (M&A) due diligence, where evaluation criteria must be inferred from task instructions and supporting documents without access to an expert-authored reference rubric. We introduce a multi-axis generation framework that explores complementary structural and free-form views of the source evidence to construct a broad pool of candidate evaluation criteria. To distinguish failures of criterion discovery from failures of candidate selection, we introduce the coverage-selection gap, which measures the difference between reference-free ranking and a reference-informed greedy diagnostic under a fixed selection budget. Developed on 16 tasks and evaluated on four held-out tasks, our framework achieves 0.876 macro recall against senior-authored reference rubrics under an LLM-based criterion-equivalence protocol. Ablation studies further show that introducing new structural search axes improves recall by 6-10 percentage points, whereas increasing generation volume along existing search directions yields at most 1.5 points. These findings suggest that, once a high-coverage candidate pool has been constructed, effective reference-free selection becomes a substantial bottleneck in document-grounded rubric construction.

AI.tldr: 论文研究专业并购尽职调查场景下的自动评分标准（rubric）构建，提出多轴生成框架以构建高覆盖候选池，并引入"覆盖-选择差距"指标区分发现失败与选择失败；实验表明结构搜索轴带来6-10个百分点提升，而单纯增大生成量提升有限，说明无参考的选择是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 开放型LLM输出的评估日益依赖任务特定rubric，但从复杂源文档和任务指令中自动推断全面评估标准仍很困难，尤其在无法获取专家撰写参考rubric的并购尽职调查等专业场景中。
AI.method: 提出多轴生成框架，从互补的结构化与自由文本视角探索源证据，以构建广泛的候选评估标准池；并引入"覆盖-选择差距"（coverage-selection gap），在固定选择预算下比较无参考排序与参考信息引导的贪心诊断，以区分标准发现失败与候选选择失败。在16个任务上开发、4个留出任务上评估，采用基于LLM的标准等价协议。
AI.result: 在LLM标准等价协议下，对资深专家撰写的参考rubric取得0.876的宏平均召回率。消融显示新增结构搜索轴可提升召回6-10个百分点，而沿既有搜索方向增大生成量最多仅提升1.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 一旦构建出高覆盖候选池，有效的无参考选择便成为文档驱动rubric构建的主要瓶颈；应优先改进选择机制而非单纯扩大生成规模。

title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
summary: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question-answer pairs: At each of several risk tolerances, the confidences across the set induce an abstention threshold, and each confidence is rewarded for lying on the correct side of it. Since the threshold itself comes from the set, every verbalized confidence is reinforced relative to other questions' confidence, not against its own binary correctness label. On math, CARE increases the coverage at 5% risk (C@5) across MATH-500, GSM8K, and Big-Math-Digits from 0.8% to 42.4%, compared to existing pointwise correctness-matching rewards. When trained on multi-hop Wikipedia QA from HotpotQA, CARE improves C@5 in out-of-distribution general-knowledge, reasoning, and math benchmarks (including CommonsenseQA, GPQA, SimpleQA, and TriviaQA) from 12.3% to 23.6%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CARE（跨问题弃权奖励估计），通过在一组问答上按多个风险容忍度诱导弃权阈值来计算置信度奖励，使置信度相对其他问题而非自身对错来强化，从而提升选择性预测的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 置信度后训练方法逐题将正确答配置信度为1、错误答配置信度为0，这一目标理论最优但实际不可达，且把置信度推向0/1后失去问题间可比性，在非零风险容忍度的选择性预测下有害。
AI.method: 提出 CARE：在一组问答对上计算奖励。在若干风险容忍度下，由该组置信度分布诱导出弃权阈值，每个置信度只要位于阈值正确一侧即获奖励；阈值本身来自整组，因此每个口述置信度是相对其他问题被强化，而非对照自身二值对错标签。
AI.result: 数学任务上，相比逐点正确性匹配奖励，CARE 在 MATH-500、GSM8K、Big-Math-Digits 上将5%风险下的覆盖率（C@5）从0.8%提升至42.4%。在 HotpotQA 多跳维基问答训练后，在 CommonsenseQA、GPQA、SimpleQA、TriviaQA 等分布外常识、推理与数学基准上，C@5 从12.3%提升至23.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将置信度奖励从逐点二值匹配改为跨问题集合的相对排序式奖励，能显著改善 LLM 在风险约束下的选择性预测与弃权能力，并具备良好的分布外泛化性。

title: Coordinated Use of Large Language Models in Academic Research
comment: 22 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. English translation of an article originally published in Bulgarian in Media and Language (2026). The original Bulgarian publication remains the version of record
summary: This study proposes a methodological framework for the coordinated use of multiple large language models in academic research. Its central argument is that involving more models does not in itself guarantee more reliable results; what matters is how cognitive and verification operations are organised. The framework is based on seven principles (procedural independence, functional allocation, the diagnostic value of divergence, the diagnostic value of convergence, external verification, proportionality of checking, and human epistemic responsibility) and sets out a non-linear multi-LLM protocol in which independently obtained results are compared, critically examined and, where necessary, verified against external sources. The approach is illustrated through real-world cases drawn from research practice. The study concludes that moving from a single language model to a coordinated multi-LLM process represents a change in the organisation of research, in which the researcher makes the final decisions and bears scholarly responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多LLM协同学术研究的方法论框架，核心论点是：多模型的可靠性取决于认知与验证操作的"组织方式"而非模型数量本身。
AI.motivation: 回应"多模型=更可靠"的常见误解，明确多LLM协作中真正决定结果质量的是研究流程的组织设计，而非简单地叠加模型。
AI.method: 构建基于七项原则（程序独立性、功能分配、分歧的诊断价值、趋同的诊断价值、外部验证、检查的比例性、人类认识论责任）的非线性多LLM协议：独立获取结果→比较→批判性审查→必要时对照外部来源验证，并以真实研究案例加以说明。
AI.result: 以研究实践中的真实案例展示该框架的可行性；阐明分歧与趋同均具诊断意义，验证力度应与风险相称，最终判断权归属于研究者。
AI.conclusion: 从单一模型转向协同多LLM流程，本质是研究组织方式的变革；研究者承担最终决策与学术责任。

title: Text Lives in the Guidance: Preventing Silent Text Rewriting in Cached Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) now render long, legible text in images, and feature caching is a standard way to accelerate them. Caches are judged by image-level metrics, which do not check whether the rendered text is still correct. We find that caching silently rewrites this text. On Z-Image, TaylorSeer at 2.9x fewer FLOPs lowers word accuracy from 62% to 46%, while ImageReward and CLIP Score barely change. Sampling with fewer steps at the same compute keeps almost all of this text, so the loss comes from how the cache predicts the skipped steps. Decomposing the cache error along classifier-free guidance (CFG), we trace this loss mainly to the guidance term, the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which caches extrapolate worst on text. Correcting the guidance inside the text alone recovers most of the lost text. We therefore propose GuideCache, which recomputes both CFG branches only on the tokens with the largest predicted guidance error, using the guidance terms that the cache already stores. At 2.4x fewer FLOPs, GuideCache restores full-compute prompt fidelity on Z-Image and Qwen-Image, and on Z-Image it renders text as well as or better than ToCa, TeaCache, and FasterCache while staying much closer to the full model's output. GuideCache works with caches of any order, and on top of fewer sampling steps it keeps more text than step reduction at a higher speedup. These results suggest that acceleration methods for text-rendering models should be evaluated on the text they render.

AI.tldr: 特征缓存会悄无声息地改写DiT渲染的文字，原因是缓存对CFG引导项的外推最差；作者提出GuideCache，仅对预测引导误差最大的token重算两个CFG分支，在2.4倍FLOPs下恢复满算力的文字保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有DiT特征缓存只用图像级指标（ImageReward、CLIP Score）评估，无法检测渲染文字是否仍正确。作者发现缓存会严重损害文字准确率（Z-Image上TaylorSeer 2.9x加速使词准确率从62%降至46%），而图像级指标几乎无变化，且同等算力下的少步采样几乎不掉文字，说明损失源自缓存对跳过步的预测方式。
AI.method: 沿CFG分解缓存误差，定位损失主要来自引导项（条件与无条件预测之差）。据此提出GuideCache：利用缓存已存储的引导项，只在预测引导误差最大的token上重算条件与无条件两个CFG分支，从而在文字区域修正引导。
AI.result: 在2.4x更少FLOPs下，GuideCache在Z-Image与Qwen-Image上恢复满算力的提示词保真度；在Z-Image上文字渲染不逊于甚至优于ToCa、TeaCache、FasterCache，且输出更接近完整模型。可与任意阶缓存配合，叠加步数缩减时在更高加速比下保留更多文字。
AI.conclusion: 文字渲染模型的加速方法应以所渲染的文字作为评估指标；缓存误差的关键在CFG引导项，局部修正即可挽回大部分文字损失。

title: Federated Learning of Car Aerodynamics Surrogates with Spectral Optimizers
summary: Neural surrogates predict the aerodynamic forces on a car in seconds, compared with hours for a CFD simulation, but training them requires thousands of CFD simulations of different car designs, which car manufacturers keep proprietary. Federated learning allows several manufacturers to train a shared surrogate without exchanging data. We study which federated optimizer brings such a surrogate closest to one trained on pooled data. On DrivAerNet++, we train a Transolver surrogate across six clients that each hold cars of a single body type, and we compare three spectral optimizers, which orthogonalize the update of each weight matrix (FedMuon and two methods we propose, FedMARS-M and FedOLion), with three non-spectral ones (FedAvg, SCAFFOLD-Adam and FedLion), all tuned with the same protocol. FedMuon and FedMARS-M reach a drag error within 2% of centralized training with Muon, using two to four local epochs per round. The non-spectral methods perform best with sixteen local epochs, the largest number we tested, and still have a 17 to 37% higher drag error than FedMARS-M. We relate this gap to the low stable rank of the weight gradients, for which an orthogonalized step yields about twice the first-order decrease of a gradient step of the same spectral norm. Code: https://github.com/armanbolatov/fedmars_drivaernet

AI.tldr: 研究联邦优化器对神经气动代理模型的影响，发现谱优化器（FedMuon、FedMARS-M）在DrivAerNet++上以更少本地轮次逼近集中式训练效果，非谱方法阻力误差高17–37%。
AI.motivation: 汽车气动代理模型训练需大量CFD仿真数据，而各厂商数据保密。联邦学习可在不交换数据前提下协同训练共享代理模型，但尚不清楚哪种联邦优化器能使模型最接近集中式（池化数据）训练的效果。
AI.method: 在DrivAerNet++上训练Transolver代理模型，设六个客户端各持一种车身类型数据。对比三种谱优化器（FedMuon及新提出的FedMARS-M、FedOLion，对每个权重矩阵更新做正交化）与三种非谱优化器（FedAvg、SCAFFOLD-Adam、FedLion），采用统一调参协议进行公平比较。
AI.result: FedMuon与FedMARS-M在每轮2–4个本地epoch下，阻力误差与集中式Muon训练相差在2%以内；非谱方法在16个本地epoch（测试最大值）时最佳，但阻力误差仍比FedMARS-M高17–37%。该差距与权重梯度的低稳定秩有关——在相同谱范数下，正交化步骤的一阶下降约为梯度步骤的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 谱（正交化）联邦优化器在减少本地训练轮次的同时更接近集中式性能，适合数据隐私受限的汽车气动代理建模；性能优势可由梯度低稳定秩特性解释。

title: Keystone: Judging Previews at Key Steps for Test-Time Search in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion and flow models yield a preview, their clean-image estimate, at every denoising step. When they miscount, drop or misplace objects, test-time search is in a bind: its verifiers are reward models built for finished images, so judging early misreads blurry previews, and judging late, as best-of-N does, pays to fully denoise doomed candidates. We find that the image is not the problem: the outcome is settled as denoising starts, by the seed or by a stochastic sampler's first steps, and already shows in early previews; what fails on them is the judge, as reward models read them near chance on several kinds of prompts. We introduce Keystone, a training-free judge of previews that compiles a prompt into typed questions about its objects, counts, colours and positions and has an off-the-shelf multimodal decision model answer them. Asked this way, the judge reads counts and positions from early previews better than reward models read them from finished images. Searching at these key steps on GenEval with SD3.5-Medium, Keystone's adaptive search and pruning significantly outperform best-of-8 with every other verifier at under half its generator compute, and as a drop-in verifier there, the Keystone score significantly improves best-of-N, progressive seed pruning and FK steering; without retuning, both searches stay significantly above the strongest other verifier's best-of-N on average over four base models and three benchmarks. Keystone thus moves test-time judgment to the key steps where the outcome already shows.

AI.tldr: Keystone：一种无需训练的"预览判别器"，把提示词编译为关于物体、数量、颜色、位置的结构化问题，由现成多模态决策模型回答，从而在去噪早期关键步即可完成可靠的测试时搜索与剪枝。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型的成败在去噪开始（种子或采样器最初几步）就已基本确定，并已体现在早期预览中；现有测试时搜索的验证器是为成品图训练的奖励模型，判定早期模糊预览时接近随机水平，而 best-of-N 式晚期判定又需对注定失败的候选做完整去噪，算力浪费严重。
AI.method: 提出 Keystone，无需训练的预览评判器：将提示词编译成关于物体、计数、颜色、位置的类型化问题，交由现成的多模态决策模型作答；在此基础上实施关键步的自适应搜索与剪枝，并可作为一种即插即用的验证器分数，用于 best-of-N、渐进式种子剪枝与 FK steering。
AI.result: 在 GenEval 上配 SD3.5-Medium，Keystone 的自适应搜索与剪枝以不到 best-of-8 一半的生成算力显著超越使用其他所有验证器的 best-of-8；作为替代验证器时显著提升 best-of-N、渐进式种子剪枝和 FK steering；无需重新调参，在四个基础模型、三个基准上平均仍显著优于最强其他验证器的 best-of-N。Keystone 从早期预览读取计数与位置的能力甚至强于奖励模型从成品图读取。
AI.conclusion: 测试时判断应前移到结果已显现的关键去噪步：用结构化问题式判别替代面向成品图的奖励模型，可在显著降低生成算力的同时提升文本到图像生成的语义正确性。

title: Zero to Four Views: Unified Panorama Generation and Preference RL for Unobserved Regions
summary: Panoramas can serve as shared scene backgrounds for multi-shot video generation, but most existing panorama generators take text alone or a single input image. We present a single model that generates a full equirectangular panorama from a text caption and K in {0,...,4} perspective conditioning views taken by a four-camera rig at one viewpoint. We fine-tune a pretrained text-to-image rectified-flow transformer in two stages. In the first stage, each conditioning view is appended to the token sequence together with the ID of its camera slot, and the number of views varies during training, so one set of weights serves every input setting. In the second stage, we improve the region not covered by any conditioning view. Supervised training computes its loss on noisy latents of the ground truth and never scores a panorama the model has generated and decoded, so we propose Uncovered-Region GRPO (UR-GRPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that rewards the candidates a vision-language model prefers in pairwise comparisons on crops around this region. Because the slot ID alone does not tell the model which way the rig points, we also offer an optional variant that writes each view's camera direction into its position encoding, which lets the user decide where each view appears in the output. With one conditioning view, our model outperforms the previous state of the art, 360Anything, trained on the same data and evaluated with the same code, on Laval Indoor and gives mixed results on an indoor subset of SUN360; the second stage improves the results for every number of conditioning views.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一模型，可从文本+K个（K∈0..4）透视条件视图生成完整等距柱状全景图，采用两阶段微调（变视角数训练+针对未覆盖区域的UR-GRPO强化学习），单视图设置下优于360Anything。
AI.motivation: 全景图可作为多镜头视频生成的共享背景，但现有全景生成器只接受纯文本或单张输入图像，缺乏灵活的可控条件输入与对未被条件视图覆盖区域的生成质量提升。
AI.method: 微调预训练文本到图像rectified-flow transformer，分两阶段：第一阶段将每个条件视图与其相机槽位ID一同拼入token序列，训练时视图数可变，一套权重适配所有输入设置；第二阶段提出Uncovered-Region GRPO（UR-GRPO），用视觉语言模型在未覆盖区域裁剪上的成对比较偏好作为奖励，弥补监督训练只对GT噪声潜变量计损失、从不评估生成解码结果的缺陷。另提供可选变体，将各视图相机方向写入位置编码。
AI.result: 单条件视图下在Laval Indoor上超过同数据训练、同代码评测的SOTA方法360Anything，在SUN360室内子集上结果喜忧参半；第二阶段对每种条件视图数量均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 统一的全景生成框架支持0-4个可变视图输入，结合监督微调与基于VLM偏好的强化学习，有效改善未覆盖区域质量并取得领先性能。

title: Rubric Semantics or Numerical Priors? Auditing Scale-Direction Bias in LLM Judges
summary: Recent benchmark evaluations increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) as automatic judges. This paradigm assumes LLMs evaluate based on the rubric's semantic meaning rather than its numeric scale. We question this assumption by introducing semantic faithfulness: the principle that semantically equivalent rubrics must yield consistent scores. To quantify this, we propose a scale-reversal probe that inverts score anchors without altering evaluation criteria. Furthermore, we introduce floor normalization to calibrate reversal disagreement against intrinsic model variability, enabling fair cross-model comparisons. Experiments across five meta-evaluation benchmarks with seven diverse LLM judges spanning open-weight and proprietary models reveal widespread violations of semantic faithfulness, showing that raw reversal agreement alone is misleading. Finally, we demonstrate that bidirectional anchor averaging reduces dependence on any single anchor direction without compromising alignment with human judgments. Our findings emphasize that trustworthy LLM judges must reliably follow rubric semantics, not just correlate with human ratings.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑"LLM作为自动评审只依据评分标准的语义而非数字刻度来打分"这一假设，提出语义忠实性概念与量表反转探针，并用下限归一化校准模型内在波动，发现七种LLM评审者普遍违反语义忠实性，而双向锚点平均可缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基准评测大量依赖LLM作为自动评审，默认其依据rubric语义而非数字刻度打分；作者质疑该假设，指出仅与人类评分相关并不足以说明评审可信。
AI.method: 提出"语义忠实性"原则（语义等价的评分标准须给出分值）与"量表反转探针"（反转分数锚点而保持评价标准不变）；再引入下限归一化，用模型内在波动校准反转不一致度，从而实现跨模型公平比较。
AI.result: 在5个元评测基准、7个开源与闭源LLM评审者上的实验显示，语义忠实性被广泛违反，且仅看原始反转一致率会产生误导；双向锚点平均能降低对单一锚点方向的依赖，同时不损害与人类判断的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 可信的LLM评审者必须可靠遵循rubric语义，而非仅仅与人类评分相关；作者建议采用双向锚点平均等策略提升评审稳健性。

title: SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning
summary: Split federated learning (SFL) distributes neural networks across clients and a server, coupling class-specific knowledge across their representations. This coupling complicates split federated unlearning (SFU), where class-wise forgetting must remove target knowledge while preserving retained utility under heterogeneous representation spaces and asymmetric update constraints. We propose SplitReAlign, a partition-aware representation realignment framework for class-wise SFU. It constructs endpoint-specific discriminative subspaces coordinated through a shared semantic anchor, selectively realigning forgotten representations while penalizing changes outside the active subspaces. To accommodate asymmetric update constraints, SplitReAlign leverages gradients through frozen servers for Client-only updates and fixed client-feature statistics for Server-only guidance, while Joint updates optimize both partitions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under heterogeneous client distributions demonstrate that SplitReAlign achieves the lowest average gap to retraining among all compared methods across six settings. Notably, Server-only achieves the closest agreement with retraining on both datasets, highlighting the effectiveness of partition-aware guidance under restricted updates.

AI.tldr: 提出SplitReAlign，一个面向拆分联邦学习类别级遗忘（SFU）的分区感知表征重对齐框架，在异构客户端分布下实现最低的重训练差距。
AI.motivation: 拆分联邦学习（SFL）将网络分布在客户端与服务器上，使类别知识在两侧表征中耦合，导致类别级遗忘（SFU）困难：需在异构表征空间与非对称更新约束下删除目标知识同时保留其余效用。现有方法难以处理这种耦合。
AI.method: SplitReAlign构建端点专属的判别子空间，通过共享语义锚进行协调，选择性重对齐被遗忘表征并惩罚活跃子空间外的改变。针对非对称更新约束：Client-only更新通过冻结服务器的梯度实现；Server-only更新利用固定的客户端特征统计进行引导；Joint更新同时优化两侧分区。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100的异构客户端分布下，六种设置中SplitReAlign取得与重训练最低的平均差距。特别是Server-only设置在两个数据集上均最接近重训练结果。
AI.conclusion: 分区感知的表征重对齐有效支撑类别级拆分联邦遗忘，且在受限更新条件下（Server-only）表现尤为突出，验证了按分区引导的有效性。

title: LM-based Personalized Travel Planner
summary: Effective travel planning requires handling multiple information sources, managing constraints, and tailoring recommendations to user preferences. While LLMs have introduced dynamic, context-aware decision-making, single-agent models often struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, constraint adherence, and modular execution. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent framework where a supervising chatbot agent coordinates specialized agents for schedule validation, user query formulation, real-time data retrieval, and constraint-aware itinerary generation. By integrating LLM reasoning, external APIs, and iterative refinement mechanisms based on a deterministic, multi-dimensional scoring framework, our approach ensures adaptability, efficiency, and personalization. Evaluations on the well-known TravelPlanner benchmark demonstrate improvements in Budget Constraint planning by 10\%, wider constraints set-based planning by 25\%, and personalized planning results by 45\%. compared to the ReAct baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/nimashaklaa/TravelPlanner_Research

AI.tldr: 提出分层多智能体框架，由监督型聊天机器人协调行程校验、查询构建、实时数据检索与约束感知行程生成等专用智能体，结合LLM推理、外部API与基于确定性多维评分框架的迭代优化，在TravelPlanner基准上相比ReAct基线显著提升。
AI.motivation: 有效的旅行规划需处理多信息源、管理约束并个性化推荐。LLM虽带来动态情境决策，但单智能体模型在多步推理、约束遵循与模块化执行上存在不足。
AI.method: 分层多智能体框架：监督型聊天机器人智能体协调多个专用智能体（行程校验、用户查询构建、实时数据检索、约束感知行程生成），整合LLM推理、外部API调用及基于确定性多维评分框架的迭代精炼机制。
AI.result: 在TravelPlanner基准上，相比ReAct基线，预算约束规划提升10%，更广约束集规划提升25%，个性化规划结果提升45%。
AI.conclusion: 分层多智能体+迭代评分优化的方案能提升旅行规划的适应性、效率与个性化水平，代码已开源。

title: HOPD: Historical On-Policy Distillation for SAR MLLM Continual Learning
summary: Continual SAR interpretation requires multimodal large language models to learn incoming sources while retaining earlier task abilities. This is difficult when acquisition and geographic shifts alter visual evidence, regionally concentrated categories bias answers, and historical images are scarce. We address this problem with Historical On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which reuses source-acquisition LoRA states as persistent teachers for one evolving student. Archiving each state before consolidation preserves a stable source reference. The teachers supervise student-generated prefixes, transferring historical behavior to the student's changing generation contexts. To enrich sparse replay, original-view teachers guide augmented historical student views while preserving spatial coordinates. This knowledge is consolidated into a single deployed adapter that requires no source identity. On SARVQA-CL, our source-incremental evaluation protocol, HOPD achieves the highest final mean score of 54.51 among the compared methods, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.96 points. It also improves the final source-macro score in every evaluated task over shared-memory Replay-SFT, with gains across source orders. These results support source-acquisition history as supervision for retaining earlier task performance during continual SAR adaptation. Code and data: https://github.com/zcablii/HOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出历史在线策略蒸馏（HOPD），把各源获取阶段的LoRA状态存档作为持久教师，监督不断演化的单一学生模型，实现持续SAR多模态大模型学习且不遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续SAR解译中，采集与地理漂移改变视觉证据、区域集中类别导致答案偏置、历史图像稀缺，使新知识学习与旧任务保持难以兼顾。
AI.method: 在每个源合并前存档源获取LoRA状态作为教师；教师监督学生自生成前缀，将历史行为迁移到学生变化的生成上下文；用原始视图教师指导增强后的历史学生视图并保留空间坐标，以丰富稀疏回放；最终整合为无需源标识的单一适配器。并构建源增量评测协议SARVQA-CL。
AI.result: SARVQA-CL上最终均分54.51，居对比方法之首，比最强基线高2.96分；最终源宏平均分数在各任务上均优于共享内存Replay-SFT，且跨源顺序均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 支持将源获取历史作为监督信号，用于持续SAR适应中保持早期任务性能；代码与数据已开源。

title: TRAC: Efficient Diffusion Language Models for Machine Translation via Length-Aware Decoding
summary: Machine translation with large language models requires both high translation quality and low generation latency. Accelerating translation while preserving quality is therefore essential for practical deployment. Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate tokens at arbitrary target positions through iterative denoising, offering a new paradigm for parallel translation beyond sequential autoregressive decoding. However, existing methods still incur redundant computation: fixed target generation lengths waste computation on unused positions, while confidence-only commitment delays medium-confidence tokens whose predictions have largely stabilized. To address these issues, we propose TRAC, a training-free adaptive decoding method for diffusion machine translation. TRAC adapts the target generation length using source length and translation direction, with a conservative fallback to the maximum length for empty or unusually short outputs. It preserves high-confidence commitment while identifying temporally stable medium-confidence tokens for early commitment using cross-step top-1 persistence and approximate Jensen-Shannon divergence over Top-$K$ distributions. On bidirectional Chinese-English translation across FLORES-200, WMT23, and NTREX-128, TRAC reduces model forward calls by 24.9% to 36.8% and achieves sentence-level generation speedups of 1.91 to 2.19 times over Fast-dLLM, with only a 0.02-point decrease in macro-average COMET. These results demonstrate that adaptive generation lengths and stability-aware token commitment improve the efficiency of diffusion machine translation.

AI.tldr: TRAC 是一种免训练的自适应解码方法，用于扩散机器翻译，通过自适应目标生成长度 + 基于跨步稳定性的中等置信度词元提前提交，减少前向调用次数并提速。
AI.motivation: dLLM 可并行生成任意位置词元，是超越自回归解码的新范式，但现有方法存在冗余计算：固定生成长度在无用位置上浪费算力；仅按置信度提交会延迟那些预测已基本稳定的中等置信度词元。
AI.method: 免训练的自适应解码：1）依据源句长度与翻译方向自适应确定目标生成长度，对空输出或异常短输出保守回退到最大长度；2）保留高置信度提交，同时用跨步 top-1 持续性和 Top-K 分布上的近似 Jensen-Shannon 散度识别时间上稳定的中等置信度词元并提前提交。
AI.result: 在中英双向翻译（FLORES-200、WMT23、NTREX-128）上，相比 Fast-dLLM 减少模型前向调用 24.9%–36.8%，句级生成提速 1.91–2.19 倍，宏观平均 COMET 仅下降 0.02 点。
AI.conclusion: 自适应生成长度与稳定性感知的词元提交能显著提升扩散机器翻译的效率，且几乎不损失翻译质量。

title: Prescribed Bayesian Efficiency under Lifetime Adjustment Costs
summary: A Bayesian learner may retain an issued action while updating its posterior, trading predictive loss against adjustment charges. We assume population curvature, boundary control, an order-$1/n$ lower bound on expected posterior uncertainty about the optimal action, and an observable unbiased gradient witness whose squared norms are uniformly integrable. Sample losses may be unbounded or nonconvex. Cumulative expected excess measures the loss increase relative to current predictive Bayes actions. For bounded nonnegative nondecreasing charges $c$ with $c(0)=0$ and nondecreasing profiles $G: \mathbb{N} \to [1,\infty)$ with $G(J)=o(J)$, we characterize joint attainability of cumulative expected excess $O(G(J))$ at horizons $T=2^J$ and finite expected lifetime charge. Here $J$ indexes logarithmic time. The criterion is finiteness of a prefix-constrained allocation of tracking-error allowances across action-distance scales, equivalently its decreasing-weight dual. Adaptive timing and private randomization do not enlarge the attainable region. For each feasible pair, a horizon-independent deterministic checkpoint policy attains the profile with lifetime-cost moments of every positive order. For excess $O((\log T)^r)$, $0<r<1$, every policy needs $Ω((\log T)^{2-r})$ revisions in expectation, and a charge-independent schedule achieves a matching pathwise upper bound for every feasible charge. We verify the assumptions for logistic decision models with nondegenerate covariates, finite second moments and a locally positive smooth prior density, including fixed-ridge models with unbounded parameter priors.

AI.tldr: 该文刻画了贝叶斯学习者在更新后验时保留动作、以预测损失换取调整代价的权衡：在若干正则假设下，给出累积期望超额与有限期望寿命代价联合可达的充要判据，并为对数时间下的若干超额率给出匹配的上下界。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯学习者每次更新后验时可选择沿用旧动作以节省调整代价，这种做法会带来预测损失上升。论文旨在统一刻画"累积期望超额（相对当前预测贝叶斯动作）"与"寿命调整代价"之间的联合可达区域，并厘清自适应时序与随机化能否扩大该区域，以及最小化超额所需的最少策略修正次数。
AI.method: 设定总体曲率、边界控制、关于最优动作的后验不确定性阶为 1/n 的期望下界，以及平方范数一致可积的无偏梯度见证；样本损失可无界、非凸。对满足 c(0)=0 的有界非负非减代价 c 与非减剖面 G（G(J)=o(J)），以 J 索引对数时间 T=2^J，把联合可达性归结为跨动作距离尺度的追踪误差额度前缀约束分配是否有限（等价于其递减权重对偶）。并构造与视界无关的确定性检查点策略，同时证明自适应时序与私有随机化不扩大可达区域，给出修正次数下界及与代价无关的匹配路径上界。最后在 logistic 决策模型（含固定岭、非有界参数先验）下验证假设。
AI.result: 联合可达性由前缀约束分配的有限性（或其对偶）完全刻画；自适应时序与私有随机化不能扩大可达区域；每个可行对可由一个视界无关的确定性检查点策略达到，且寿命代价的任意正阶矩有限；对超额 O((log T)^r)（0<r<1），任何策略期望上需要 Ω((log T)^{2-r}) 次修正，而一个与代价无关的调度达到匹配的路径上界；在非退化协变量、有限二阶矩与局部正光滑先验密度的 logistic 决策模型（含固定岭、无界参数先验）下假设成立。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了"保留动作换取调整节省"的贝叶斯学习问题的完整可达性刻画，表明可行性由追踪误差额度的前缀约束分配（或其递减权重对偶）决定；随机化与自适应时序无益；确定性检查点策略可达且具有任意正阶寿命矩，超额与修正次数之间存在 (log T)^r 与 (log T)^{2-r} 的匹配刻画。

title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
summary: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills.

AI.tldr: 论文研究模型在无反馈情况下反复重写专家技能文档（agent skills）自我演化会如何影响技能价值。实验发现技能会退化而非提升，30 轮后 SkillsBench 平均下降 15 分；原因是重写把技能拉向模型自身先验并丢弃先验之外的知识。据此提出 SkillDiff，在不改文本、无反馈条件下平均提升 4.8 分。
AI.motivation: 技能文档承载专家程序性知识，模型越来越多地在无任何任务、运行或判断反馈的情况下自行重写技能。这种自演化究竟让技能适配模型，还是侵蚀使其有价值的专家知识，此前未被研究。
AI.method: 让模型在无任务、无运行、无判断的条件下逐轮重写专家技能，再用重写后的技能驱动基于同一模型的 agent 进行评测；同时采样各模型仅凭主题自行生成的先验技能作对照，分析重写方向与知识流失；并提出 SkillDiff，在原位标记那些模型先验之外的知识。
AI.result: 所有被测模型在所有基准上表现均变差，30 轮后 SkillsBench 平均下降 15 分；重写将技能拉向模型先验，且优先丢弃先验之外的知识；把这些知识补回可恢复大部分损失的通过率；SkillDiff 在不改文本、无反馈条件下平均提升 4.8 分。
AI.conclusion: 专家技能的价值很大程度上在于模型自身不会写出的那部分知识，无反馈的自我重写会侵蚀它。识别并保留这类先验外知识是提升技能有效性、抵抗自演化退化的关键手段。

title: Decision Boundaries Matter: Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation for Cross-Domain Fake Image Detection
summary: Despite learning transferable features, fake image detectors may struggle on unseen domains due to mismatched decision boundaries. Our analysis shows that features extracted by the frozen forensic encoder remain discriminative, but the source-trained decision boundary does not fully exploit this information. However, correcting this boundary without source data or target labels remains challenging, as unreliable source predictions may lead to incorrect adaptation. To address this issue, we propose Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation (GraRA), which refines the source decision boundary using only unlabeled target data. To determine which classifier directions to update, GraRA constructs a compact residual subspace from uncertainty-weighted target features and keeps it orthogonal to the source classification direction. To guide these updates, it uses source-score anchors to generate soft labels through target-graph diffusion, while neighborhood consistency regularizes residual learning within the constrained subspace. The learned correction is merged into the source classifier, requiring only 32 optimized coefficients and no additional inference branches. On diverse unseen OpenMMSec domains, GraRA achieves 84.36\% accuracy and 91.34\% AUC, improving over the source detector by 4.33 and 3.50 percentage points, respectively. Further analysis shows that reliable source predictions and locally consistent neighborhoods help guide residual learning, allowing GraRA to correct ranking errors that a simple threshold shift cannot address. \textcolor{cvprblue}{Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GraRA用无标签目标数据构建残差子空间微调源决策边界，实现假图像检测的域自适应。
AI.motivation: 假图像检测器在未见域上因决策边界不匹配而性能下降；分析发现冻结取证编码器提取的特征仍有判别性，但源域训练的决策边界未充分利用这些信息，且无源数据/目标标签时校正边界易受不可靠源预测影响。
AI.method: 提出Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation (GraRA)：用不确定性加权的目标特征构建紧凑残差子空间并保持与源分类方向正交；用源分数锚点经目标图扩散生成软标签，邻域一致性正则化残差学习；校正并入源分类器，仅需32个优化系数、无额外推理分支。
AI.result: 在多样未见OpenMMSec域上达84.36%准确率和91.34% AUC，比源检测器分别提升4.33和3.50个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的源预测和局部一致的邻域有助于指导残差学习，GraRA能纠正简单阈值偏移无法解决的排序错误。

title: ColorRef: Calibrating Verbal Feedback for Color Revision
summary: People rarely specify an exact color when asking someone to revise a design: they might say \textit{a little darker} or \textit{more blue} after seeing a proposal. A language-model assistant must then infer not only which way to change the color, but how far. We study this distinction with \textsc{ColorRef}, a color reference game in which a model guesses a color from a description and a teacher, knowing a recorded target hidden from the guesser, supplies verbal corrections. On 1{,}000 crowd-sourced description--target pairs, three rounds of deterministic oracle feedback reduce mean target distance from 42.33 to 22.15 $ΔE_{76}$. However, those corrections provide additional information, and improvement alone does not establish well-calibrated feedback following. A controlled Qwen3-14B diagnostic reveals a more specific failure: following a requested direction and ordering graded phrases do not guarantee a suitable step size; strong modifiers can induce excessive changes. We therefore measure each receiver's typical response to \textit{a little}, \textit{somewhat}, and \textit{much} on separate colors and select wording matched to its observed steps. On 128 held-out starting colors, calibration reduces one-step mean error from 12.36 to 6.86 for Qwen3-14B and from 11.06 to 5.89 for Gemma 4 12B against a fixed graded-wording rule. The benefit is concentrated on large corrections, with many unchanged cases and no consistent increase in threshold success. Our findings show that following the direction of feedback is not the same as making an appropriately sized revision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ColorRef 颜色指代游戏，发现语言模型能遵循反馈方向但难以校准修改幅度，并给出基于个体响应校准的措辞选择方法使单步误差显著下降。
AI.motivation: 人类修改设计时常给出模糊的相对描述（如“更深一点”“更蓝”），模型不仅要推断方向还需推断幅度；而仅凭“有改进”无法证明模型真正良好地遵循了程度性反馈。
AI.method: 构建 ColorRef 游戏：1000 对众包描述-目标颜色，教师基于隐藏目标给出三轮确定性 oracle 反馈。通过受控 Qwen3-14B 诊断区分方向遵循与步长校准；再分别在独立颜色上测量每个接收模型对“a little / somewhat / much”等分级措辞的典型响应，为其选择匹配其观测步长的措辞。
AI.result: 三轮反馈使平均目标距离从 42.33 降至 22.15 ΔE76。校准在 128 个留出起始色上使单步平均误差从 12.36 降至 6.86（Qwen3-14B）、从 11.06 降至 5.89（Gemma 4 12B）。收益集中在大幅修正上，许多情况无变化，阈值成功率无一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 遵循反馈方向并不等同于做出合适大小的修改；程度性反馈的幅度校准是模型的一项独立且关键的失败模式，个体化措辞校准可部分缓解但收益不均。

title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
summary: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.

AI.tldr: 本文将残差强化学习的交互预算分配问题形式化为"完成增益"（completion gain），分解为到达该相位的概率×相位起始处的条件改善，并用配对回合估计，从而决定修正哪些动作分量及如何分配训练回合。实验显示最大增益相位往往并非失败最多相位，增益分配优于按失败计数或均匀分配。
AI.motivation: 残差RL的交互预算有限，需在多相位任务中分配；而基策略失败的相位不一定是最能通过修正提升整体完成率的相位，已有方法（如按失败计数分配）忽视这一区别。
AI.method: 定义完成增益：单相位内以状态反馈控制器替换基策略部分动作分量时全任务完成概率的变化；将其分解为到达该相位的概率与从该相位起点处的条件完成改善；用配对回合估计；正估计用于决定残差策略修正的动作分量及训练回合在相位间的分布。
AI.result: 随机点质量对接实验中，多数失败发生于最终对接相位，但最大完成增益出现在此前的通道相位；增益分配在总预算一半时优于按失败计数分配，并在更长接近变体中优于均匀分配。双臂装配仿真中仅插入与释放相位增益为正（尽管释放相位失败很少）；第二配置下释放相位训练的残差策略使留出起始状态的完成率提升16.9%。
AI.conclusion: 失败频率不等于修正价值，基于完成增益的相位选择与预算分配可显著提升残差RL的任务完成率。

title: COVERAGE-TRACE: Source-Side Counterfactual Tracing for Detecting Omissions in LLM Summaries
summary:
Omissions are difficult to verify because missing information leaves no output span
to inspect: a summary may be factually supported while still excluding a decision, qualification, quantity, or condition needed to preserve the source's meaning. We introduce COVERAGE-TRACE, a source-side counterfactual framework that evaluates omission as dependence on a designated atomic source fact. It replaces only the target fact with type-matched alternatives, holds the candidate summary fixed, and measures the resulting change in its teacher-forced, length-normalized likelihood. A summary covering the target should respond more strongly than one omitting it, while aggregation across multiple counterfactuals reduces sensitivity to replacement choice.
  We evaluate COVERAGE-TRACE on 80 matched covered--omitted QMSum pairs spanning several fact types and four open-weight models. Multi-CF achieves 0.764--0.825 AUROC, compared with 0.640 for the strongest evaluated text-only baseline. On Falcon-7B, targeted interventions achieve 0.779 AUROC, whereas shuffling counterfactual assignments reduces performance to 0.533; target deletion is effective while unrelated deletion is not. However, adjustment for meaning-preserving paraphrases reduces AUROC to 0.591--0.624.
  COVERAGE-TRACE therefore provides a practical, complementary signal of target-specific source--summary dependence, but not a wording-invariant semantic coverage probability. These results establish source-side intervention as a promising approach to omission detection while identifying semantic invariance as the central remaining challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出 COVERAGE-TRACE 源侧反事实框架，通过替换源文中的目标事实并测量摘要似然变化来检测摘要遗漏，AUROC 达 0.764–0.825，但语义不变性仍是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 摘要遗漏难以验证：缺失信息不留下可检查的输出片段，摘要可能事实正确却忽略了影响原意的决策、限定、数量或条件。现有文本侧方法难以捕捉这种目标特定的源—摘要依赖。
AI.method: 源侧干预框架：指定一个原子源事实，用类型匹配的替代项替换它，保持候选摘要固定，测量教师强制、长度归一化似然的变化。覆盖该事实的摘要应比遗漏它的摘要反应更强；对多个反事实进行聚合以降低对替代项选择的敏感性。
AI.result: 在 80 对匹配的 QMSum 覆盖—遗漏样本、多类事实和四个开放权重模型上：多反事实聚合 AUROC 0.764–0.825，最强纯文本基线仅 0.640；Falcon-7B 上定向干预达 0.779，打乱反事实分配降至 0.533（目标删除有效、无关删除无效）；但校正语义等价改写后 AUROC 降至 0.591–0.624。
AI.conclusion: 提供实用的目标特定源—摘要依赖互补信号，但并非措辞不变的语义覆盖概率。源侧干预是遗漏检测的有前景方向，语义不变性为核心待解挑战。

title: Watertight Mesh Optimization of Textured Objects
summary: When reconstructing high-quality 3D assets from images, existing approaches often excel at one objective while compromising another, and frequently overlook the intrinsic quality of the reconstructed surfaces. We present MODL, a framework that jointly optimizes geometry and view-dependent appearance directly on a watertight triangle mesh. Our approach combines Laplacian-preconditioned optimization for smooth vertex updates with curvature-adaptive remeshing to preserve fine details and well-shaped triangles. The triangle mesh is optimized subject to multi-view normalized cross-correlation constraints, but without segmentation, geometric supervision or alpha-blending. Evaluations on object reconstruction datasets demonstrate that MODL achieves competitive novel-view synthesis while producing geometrically accurate models with superior intrinsic mesh quality. Our results highlight the potential of direct mesh optimization to unify photorealistic rendering, geometric reconstruction, and practical 3D asset creation.

AI.tldr: MODL 是一个直接在封闭三角网格上联合优化几何与视角相关外观的框架，通过拉普拉斯预条件优化与曲率自适应重网格化，在无分割、无几何监督、无 alpha 混合条件下实现高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图像的三维重建方法往往只擅长某一目标（渲染真实感或几何精度）而牺牲其他目标，且普遍忽视重建表面本身的网格质量，不利于实际三维资产使用。
AI.method: 在 watertight 三角网格上直接优化几何和视角相关外观；采用拉普拉斯预条件优化实现平滑的顶点更新，配合曲率自适应重网格化以保留细节并维持三角形形状良好；优化以多视角归一化互相关（NCC）为约束，不使用分割、几何监督或 alpha 混合。
AI.result: 在物体重建数据集上，MODL 的新视角合成效果具有竞争力，同时生成几何精确且网格内在质量更优的模型。
AI.conclusion: 直接网格优化有潜力统一照片级渲染、几何重建与实用的三维资产生成。

title: FoodReact-AR: Learning Audience Reactions that Zero-Shot LLMs Miss in Arabic Food-Insecurity Discourse
summary: Facebook reactions record how an audience received a post, a signal absent from the post's text. We treat the six differentiated reactions on 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity posts from public Facebook pages (2020-2024) as compositions, apply a centered log-ratio transformation, and cluster them into four audience profiles: Solidarity (Love-dominant), Dismissal (Haha-dominant), Grief (Sad-dominant), and a flat Ambivalent profile. Dismissal peaks in 2022 (22.3%), the year of the wheat price shock, and grief in 2024 (14.0%), during the Gaza food emergency; a page-clustered GEE confirms both shifts (odds ratios 2.18 and 1.34), and they survive minimum-reaction filtering, alternative zero replacements and clustering methods, and bootstrap resampling. We then test whether the profiles can be predicted without reactions. A zero-shot Arabic LLM recovers Grief for 83.8% of posts but Dismissal for only 3.4%, and in a matched ablation, it shows the reaction percentages do not help. A simple classifier trained on the reaction-derived labels and tested on unseen pages recovers dismissal for 60.0% (macro-F1 0.56 against 0.43), mainly from mentions of officials and institutions. Derisive audience responses are thus learnable from text, yet a zero-shot LLM misses them. We release the corpus, LLM, and human annotation layers, and an evaluation protocol as FoodReact-AR.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Facebook六类reaction视为组成数据，用CLR变换聚类出四种受众画像（团结、嘲讽、悲伤、中立），发现2022年小麦价格冲击对应嘲讽激增、2024年加沙饥荒对应悲伤上升，并测试这些画像能否仅从文本预测。
AI.motivation: Facebook reactions记录了受众对帖子的反应，这是帖子文本本身无法体现的信号。作者希望从受众反应中刻画对食物不安全议题的态度结构，并检验这些态度能否脱离反应数据、仅靠文本被学习出来（尤其关注AI是否能识别嘲讽这类隐含态度）。
AI.method: 对74,241条阿拉伯语食物不安全Facebook帖子（2020–2024）的六类reaction做中心对数比（CLR）变换后聚类，得到四种画像；用页面聚类GEE检验时间趋势，并做最小reaction过滤、零值替换、替代聚类方法和bootstrap稳健性检验；再用零样本阿拉伯语LLM和有监督分类器（在反应衍生标签上训练、跨未见页面测试）做预测对比。
AI.result: 嘲讽（Haha主导）在2022年小麦价格冲击年达到峰值22.3%，悲伤在2024年加沙粮食紧急时达14.0%，GEE显示显著上升（OR=2.18与1.34）且通过多项稳健性检验。零样本LLM对Grief召回83.8%，但Dismissal仅3.4%，匹配消融显示加入反应百分比无帮助；简单分类器对嘲讽召回60.0%（macro-F1 0.56 vs 0.43），主要依赖对官员和机构的提及。
AI.conclusion: 受众的嘲讽性反应可以从文本中学习到，但零样本LLM明显漏检此类信号。作者以FoodReact-AR名义公开语料、LLM、人工标注层和评估协议。

title: Now You See Me Now You Don't: A Framework To Detect and Reduce Proxy Capacity
summary: In regulated domains such as lending, the two most salient fairness concepts are disparate impact and disparate treatment: disparate impact is generally defined by differential rates of adverse outcomes between demographic groups, while disparate treatment is generally defined by the use of demographic information or proxies to issue decisions. There already exist established methods to quantitatively detect and mitigate disparate impact; however, there has been less research on doing the same for disparate treatment. From a practitioner's perspective, the manner in which a conditional independence test is formulated and operationalized to identify proxies is nuanced and underexplored. As Machine Learning (ML) systems increase in scope and application in regulated domains, practitioners need a defensible framework to identify proxies at scale. Current disparate treatment frameworks typically rely upon some combination of quantitative and qualitative review of models' inputs to identify proxies. Features that are identified as proxies are then typically removed from the model in practice, and predictive performance degrades in favor of fairness through unawareness. Here, we propose a two-part framework that reduces the disparate treatment risk of a feature and keeps the predictive performance that removal of the feature loses. First, we propose a quantitative test for proxy capacity that identifies whether some of a feature's values reveal membership in a particular demographic group. Second, we propose a pre-processing methodology that adjusts those proxy features to reduce their proxy capacity. We show empirically on synthetic and public datasets that this framework identifies features that proxy for demographic information and reduces their proxy capacity while the adjusted feature retains task-relevant signal (i.e. improves predictive performance versus removal).

AI.tldr: 提出一个两部分框架：先用定量"代理能力"测试识别哪些特征取值泄露人群归属，再对代理特征做预处理调整以降低其代理能力，同时保留任务相关信号。
AI.motivation: 监管领域（如借贷）中，差别影响已有成熟的量化检测与缓解方法，但差别对待（用人口信息或其代理做决策）缺乏系统研究；条件独立性检验如何构造与操作化以识别代理尚不明晰；实践中通常直接删除代理特征，导致预测性能因"通过忽视实现公平"而下降，从业者需要一个可辩护的规模化代理识别框架。
AI.method: 两部分框架：1）提出定量检验特征"代理能力"（proxy capacity），判断某特征的某些取值是否揭示特定人群成员身份；2）提出预处理方法，调整这些代理特征以降低其代理能力，而非直接删除。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和公开数据集上的实证表明，该框架能识别出对人口信息起代理作用的特征，并在降低其代理能力的同时使调整后特征保留任务相关信号，预测性能优于直接删除该特征。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为差别对待风险提供了可辩护的量化代理识别与缓解手段，在公平性与预测性能之间取得比特征删除更优的权衡。

title: Efficient Multimodal Agents for Auditing 3D Worlds
summary: Multimodal agents can now build interactive 3D worlds and games, yet these worlds, like those built by people, often contain glitches such as floating objects, walls that can be walked through, or objects that change when no one is looking. An automatic auditor could check such worlds at scale and provide rewards for agents that build them, but only if it is both accurate and cheap. Auditing requires three abilities, namely navigating to the objects that may contain a glitch, triggering glitches that appear only after a specific behavior, and recognizing what is wrong. Current auditors are either accurate but slow and expensive or cheap but unreliable. We study how much of the audit small models can take on. A 4B vision language model fine-tuned end to end on verified trajectories of a frontier teacher guided by Bayesian search learns to navigate and trigger, and six such explorers together match a frontier model on both, but recognition stays far behind. We therefore build an auditor in which a swarm of small explorers navigates and triggers, and a frontier model reviews what they record and report. On WorldAuditBench, our auditor succeeds on 55.9% of 213 tasks in Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js worlds, 13.6 points above the strongest auditor reported, at less than a quarter of its cost. It matches the frontier reviewer exploring on its own at 4.6 times lower cost and about half the latency. Without further training, it also answers embodied questions about real-world scans, matching the frontier reviewer exploring on its own and surpassing four other frontier models by 6.4 to 16.6 points.

AI.tldr: 提出"小型探索器蜂群+前沿模型审查"的混合审计器，在WorldAuditBench上以不到四分之一成本超过最强审计器13.6个点。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体能构建交互式3D世界和游戏，但这些世界常含浮空物体、可穿墙、无人观察时变形等缺陷。自动审计可大规模检查世界并为构建者提供奖励，但要求审计器既准确又廉价。现有审计器要么准确但慢且贵，要么便宜但不可靠。
AI.method: 将审计拆为导航、触发、识别三项能力。用经贝叶斯搜索引导的前沿教师模型验证轨迹，端到端微调4B视觉语言模型学会导航与触发，六个探索器组成蜂群负责导航和触发，再由前沿模型审查其记录并报告。
AI.result: 6个小型探索器在导航与触发上可匹配前沿模型，但识别能力仍远落后。最终审计器在Unreal Engine 5和Three.js世界的213个任务上成功率达55.9%，比最强基线高13.6个点，成本不到其四分之一；与前沿审查者独立探索持平，成本低4.6倍、延迟约减半。未经额外训练即可回答真实扫描的具身问题，追平前沿审查者，并超过其他四个前沿模型6.4至16.6个点。
AI.conclusion: 小型模型可承担审计中的导航与触发，而识别仍需前沿模型，分工式混合架构兼具准确性与低成本，并具备向真实世界具身问答的泛化能力。

title: MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects
summary: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: MIR-Depth：针对透明物体单视图RGB-D可见表面深度恢复中的高光缺失与折射偏移问题，构建坐标感知多范围假设（全局逆深度体+深度轴过滤的局部体）并配合选择性循环细化与空间门控校正，在多个数据集上优于ReMake、DFNet、BP-Net、PSD，并支持真实机器人6-DoF抓取。
AI.motivation: 透明物体抓取需要准确的可见表面深度，但高光反射导致深度缺失，折射使非零深度混入背景深度，原始测量不可靠；在固定采样预算下，仅用单一搜索区间细化单视图预测，要么漏掉大幅折射偏移，要么牺牲局部精细分辨率。
AI.method: 1) 坐标感知多范围假设：由3D聚合的全局逆深度体，以及围绕先验引导初始深度的、沿深度轴过滤的逐像素局部体组成；2) 选择性循环细化：采用越界查找掩码与有效性掩码softmax融合，用多尺度ConvGRU从这些体中迭代更新逆深度；3) 空间门控校正：用学习到的逐像素空间门作用于全分辨率残差，保留准确初始几何且不把原始传感器读数作为硬约束。
AI.result: 在TransCG、TODD、TRansPose、ClearPose、HouseCat6D上误差低于ReMake、DFNet、BP-Net与PSD；真实机器人实验验证了其用于6-DoF抓取位姿预测的表面几何精度。
AI.conclusion: 多范围假设+循环细化+门控校正在固定采样预算下兼顾大范围折射偏移与局部精度，可有效恢复透明物体可见表面深度并服务机器人抓取。

title: From Geographic Memory to Spatial Generalization in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can associate places with geographic descriptions, but recovering an observed association does not establish an ability to generalize across geographic space. We distinguish geospatial memory, the recovery of location--description associations observed during training, from spatial generalization, the prediction of descriptions for locations in unobserved regions. We investigate whether continuous location representations improve this generalization and encourage geographic knowledge to become spatially organized within an LLM. We frame this organization as a latent spatial field: a learned mapping from locations to descriptions connected through spatial dependencies. Building on a continuous spatial encoder, we project location representations into the model's embedding space and supply them as spatial tokens. We evaluate the resulting models on two newly curated geo-text benchmarks for Los Angeles and London using two complementary assessments. Geospatial captioning tests both memory and spatial generalization by generating descriptions at observed locations and at locations beyond the spatial coverage of the training observations. A separate geospatial grounding model tests whether generated location--description pairs provide useful additional supervision for mapping text to geographic space. Across multiple LLM families, continuous location representations improve captioning at unobserved locations relative to textual coordinates, while their generated descriptions yield modest but consistent improvements in downstream grounding. Layer-wise probing and representation clustering provide additional evidence consistent with spatially organized geographic representations. Together, these findings show the value of evaluating spatial generalization separately from memory and of incorporating continuous spatial representations into language models.

AI.tldr: 论文区分"地理空间记忆"与"空间泛化"，通过连续位置编码将位置表示作为空间token注入LLM嵌入空间，并用新构建的洛杉矶和伦敦基准测试验证：连续位置表示能提升未观测区域的地理描述生成，且生成描述可下游提升地理定位性能。
AI.motivation: LLM能复述训练中见过的地点-描述关联，但复现关联不等于具备跨地理空间的泛化能力。现有评测混淆了"记忆"与"泛化"，且文本坐标形式可能限制地理知识在模型内形成空间组织。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为"潜在空间场"（位置到描述、含空间依赖的映射）。基于连续空间编码器，把位置表示投影到LLM嵌入空间并作为空间token输入。构建LA与London两个地理文本基准，用两类评测：(1)地理描述生成（观测点+训练覆盖范围外点）；(2)独立地理定位模型，检验生成的地点-描述对能否作为额外监督。辅以逐层探针与表示聚类分析。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族上，连续位置表示相比文本坐标显著提升未观测位置的描述生成；生成描述对下游地理定位带来小幅但一致的提升；逐层探针与表示聚类结果与"空间组织化的地理表示"一致。
AI.conclusion: 应将空间泛化与记忆分开评估，并将连续空间表示纳入语言模型，二者对构建具备地理泛化能力的LLM均有价值。

title: Class-Conditional Conformal Triage for ICAO Face-Image Compliance under Class Imbalance
summary: Automated ICAO/ISO face-image compliance analysers provide criterion-level pass/fail decisions, yet these verdicts do not quantify uncertainty when deciding whether to accept, reject, or retake a photograph. We investigate conformal prediction as a triage layer for BioGaze, evaluating 14 compliance criteria on the synthetic TONO benchmark. Without retraining the analyser, we fit per-criterion logistic classifiers and compare marginal and label-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction with conventional abstention rules using subject-disjoint splits. Marginal conformal prediction achieved approximately 0.90 overall coverage but substantially under-covered violations, with a ten-partition mean of 0.37 for one criterion. The corresponding Mondrian means ranged from 0.89 to 0.92 across criteria. However, most of the reduction in criterion-level false positives came from the logistic layer (0.145 to 0.048), while tuned abstention rules achieved lower false-positive rates than Mondrian at comparable retake rates. Bonferroni correction for joint coverage across 14 criteria required retaking nearly all images. These findings show that class-conditional conformal prediction can achieve near-target empirical coverage for minority violation classes and reveal trade-offs between statistical coverage, classification performance, and retake requirements in multi-criterion face-image compliance assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文将保形预测（conformal prediction）作为ICAO/ISO人脸图像合规分析器的分诊层，在TONO合成基准的14项合规标准上评估：边际保形虽达约0.90总覆盖率但严重低估违规类，Mondrian（标签条件）方法达0.89–0.92；然而假阳性下降主要来自逻辑回归层，且调优弃权规则在相同重采率下更优，Bonferroni联合覆盖几乎要求全部重拍。
AI.motivation: 现有自动合规分析器只给出每条标准的通过/不通过，未量化决策不确定性，难以在"接受、拒绝、重拍"之间做可靠分诊。
AI.method: 不重训分析器，在TONO合成基准上按14项标准分别拟合逻辑回归分类器，采用受试者不相交划分，比较边际保形预测与标签条件（Mondrian）保形预测，并与常规弃权规则对比。
AI.result: 边际保形总体覆盖率约0.90，但违规类覆盖不足（某标准十次划分均值仅0.37）；Mondrian均值0.89–0.92。假阳性从0.145降至0.048主要归因于逻辑回归层；调优弃权规则在相近重采率下假阳性率低于Mondrian；14项联合覆盖的Bonferroni校正需重拍几乎全部图像。
AI.conclusion: 类条件保形预测能为少数违规类实现接近目标的经验覆盖率，但多标准人脸合规评估中存在统计覆盖、分类性能与重拍成本之间的权衡。

title: Diagnosis is not a policy: a state-transition audit of caoability-conditioned test-time inference
summary: Test-time actions can satisfy retrieval, state-realization, program-consistency, or rendering objectives without correcting an answer. Test-time Error Response and Realizability Audit (TERRA) is an evaluation/auditing protocol, not a new inference algorithm. It uses a unified decomposition of intervention outcomes into applicability, target-state realization, endpoint translation, harm, and resource/inference cost. Paired comparisons fix the incoming state and evaluation conditions; cross-model analyses vary the receiving configuration. Executable financial reasoning experiments yield three findings: the same context expansion can harm one configuration and benefit another; sufficient evidence does not ensure correctness because configurations differ in evidence-to-answer translation; and diagnostic headroom---accuracy attainable with idealized diagnostic information over the measured baseline---plus local consistency does not ensure practical gains. Action value is $V(a\mid x,m)$, not diagnosis alone; diagnosis is not a deployable policy $π(a\mid x,m)$.

AI.tldr: TERRA是一种评估/审计协议（非推理算法），将测试时干预结果分解为适用性、目标状态实现、端点翻译、危害和资源成本五部分，用于判断测试时动作是否真正纠正答案。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时动作可能只满足检索、状态实现、程序一致性或渲染目标，却并未真正修正答案，缺乏统一评估框架。
AI.method: 提出TERRA协议：统一分解干预结果；采用配对比较固定输入状态与评估条件，并用跨模型分析改变接收配置；在可执行金融推理任务上实验。
AI.result: 三项发现：同一上下文扩展对不同配置有正负相反效果；充分证据不保证正确，因配置间证据到答案的翻译不同；诊断裕度加局部一致性也不保证实际收益。
AI.conclusion: 动作价值应视为V(a|x,m)而非仅诊断，诊断不是可部署策略π(a|x,m)；评估须关注实际答案纠正。

title: Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning for Mammography Vision--Language Models
summary: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) often need to identify small, subtle lesions within high-resolution images containing extensive normal anatomy and redundant visual information. Visual-token compression improves efficiency, but preserving salient regions alone can discard the context needed for diagnostic interpretation. This context can extend across images: in bilateral mammography, the opposite breast provides a patient-specific anatomical reference. Yet retaining such evidence does not ensure that the model uses it effectively. We propose Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR), which connects evidence preservation with comparative assessment through a bilateral-guided token selector and a bilateral reward. Under a shared token budget, the selector jointly prioritizes lesion appearance and its local and bilateral context, while the reward encourages assessments that benefit from the preserved comparison. Experiments on a bilateral dataset constructed from CBIS-DDSM and on VinDr-Mammo demonstrate improved evidence retention and diagnostic performance under constrained visual-token budgets. Inference benchmarking further shows reduced prefill latency.

AI.tldr: 提出BESR方法，通过双侧引导的token选择器与双侧奖励，在受限视觉token预算下保留并利用对侧乳腺影像作为诊断上下文，提升医学VLM的证据保留率与诊断性能并降低prefill延迟。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型需在高分辨率图像中定位细微病灶，而大量正常解剖信息冗余。视觉token压缩可提效，但仅保留显著区域会丢失诊断所需的上下文；在双侧乳腺摄影中，对侧乳腺提供患者特异性解剖参照，但仅保留证据不足以确保模型有效利用。
AI.method: BESR将证据保留与比较评估相连接：设计双侧引导的token选择器，在共享token预算下联合优先考虑病灶外观及其局部与双侧上下文；并引入双侧奖励，激励模型在评估中真正受益于所保留的对比信息。
AI.result: 在基于CBIS-DDSM构建的双侧数据集与VinDr-Mammo上，受限视觉token预算下证据保留与诊断性能均提升；推理基准测试显示prefill延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 将证据保留与比较推理耦合的设计可有效提升医学VLM在token受限下的诊断能力与推理效率，双侧上下文是关键可利用信息。

title: Drifting, Discriminating, and Directioning for Action Coordination in Higher-dimensional Action Space
summary: This paper proposes a lightweight policy model to mitigate the difficulty of handling higher-dimensional action spaces in reinforcement learning (RL), alongside an algorithm to effectively train it. To address this, we focus on drifting models, which can implicitly represent complex distributions and infer actions in a single forward pass. However, while drifting models can be straightforwardly trained via backpropagation of the Q-gradient, this alone cannot be expected to appropriately capture the desired action coordination. Therefore, this paper constructs a three-step learning algorithm to encourage the action coordination. First, the source distribution of the drifting model is co-optimized as a diagonal policy model. This conditions the drifting model to attach the coordination, which cannot be expressed by a diagonal distribution, as residuals. Second, a discriminator model before and after drifting is introduced with adversarial training for a regularization term. This actively promotes the extraction of the coordination that fundamentally separates the two distributions. Third, best-of-N sampling is applied for action selection during rollouts in order to give directionality toward/beyond the regions where the coordination is insufficiently extracted/sufficiently discovered. The proposed method consistently improves the sample efficiency and the final control performance over the conventional diagonal distribution modeling across three locomotion tasks with high-dimensional action spaces. Furthermore, the analysis indicates that this improvement is achieved by reducing variance in certain action dimensions, effectively coupling them with other actions as action coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级 drift 策略模型及三步学习算法，通过源分布协同优化、对抗判别正则与 best-of-N 采样来刻画高维动作空间中的动作协同，提升样本效率与控制性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在高维动作空间下难以有效处理，传统对角分布策略无法表达动作维度间的协同结构；仅用 Q 梯度反传训练 drift 模型虽可行，但难以自动学出理想的动作协同。
AI.method: 采用可单次前向推理隐式建模分布的 drift 模型作为轻量策略，构建三步训练算法：(1) 将 drift 模型源分布作为对角策略协同优化，使难以对角表达的动作协同以残差形式附加；(2) 引入 drift 前后判别器与对抗训练作为正则，主动促使协同被提取；(3) 在 rollout 中用 best-of-N 采样选择动作，为协同提取不足/已充分发现的区域提供方向性引导。
AI.result: 在三个高维动作空间的运动控制任务上，相较传统对角分布建模，方法一致提升样本效率与最终控制性能；分析表明改进源于降低某些动作维度的方差，并将其与其他动作有效耦合为动作协同。
AI.conclusion: drift 策略模型配合协同引导的三步学习算法能有效弥补对角策略的表达局限，在高维动作控制中实现更优的样本效率与性能。

title: AeroBelief: Budgeted First-Action Verification for Evidence-Guided Aerial Sensing
summary: Aerial sensing must combine uncertain overhead context with current observations while budgeting prediction, movement and image processing. AeroBelief uses the next executable action as the unit of verification against reference scores. It groups candidate views by first action, scans them with an inexpensive proposer, and selectively queries a structured world model (WM). Calibrated group bounds support strict commitment; a six-query controller connects selective prediction with belief updates, acceptance checks and scheduled sensing. Across four layout families, 40 worlds and 960 closed-loop executions, the AeroBelief controller completes 75.42% of tasks, compared with 73.33% for exhaustive WM scoring and 65.83% for line-of-sight geometry, using 91.81% fewer reference-candidate evaluations than exhaustive scoring. In fixed-reference replay with a six-query cap, proposer-scaled anchored bounds raised first-action certificate availability from 36.25% to 54.69% and reduced mean queries per state by 13.54% relative to unit-scale anchored bounds. A complete ground-hosted pipeline processes 2,685 self-collected 20-megapixel unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images from seven DJI Mavic 3M routes. Context-guided admission and feedback retain all eight independently supported target confirmations with 76.05% fewer processed images and 70.02% less accumulated active processing service than uncapped all-frame processing; feedback saves another 5.17% of images relative to static context. The studies connect budgeted action selection with evidence-driven processing of recorded flight imagery.

AI.tldr: AeroBelief 以“下一个可执行动作”为验证单元，在感知预算约束下结合不确定的俯视上下文、当前观测与世界模型，实现选择性预测、信念更新与调度感知，并在仿真闭环与真实无人机图像流水线上验证效率与精度优势。
AI.motivation: 空中感知需在预测、移动与图像处理的有限预算下，融合不确定的俯视上下文与当前观测；穷举式世界模型打分会消耗大量候选评估，纯几何视线方法精度不足，因此需要一种带预算约束的动作级验证机制。
AI.method: 方法分两层：\n1) 动作级验证框架：按第一个动作对候选视角分组，先用低成本 proposer 扫描，再有选择地查询结构化世界模型（WM）；用校准的分组界支持严格承诺；一个六查询控制器将选择性预测与信念更新、接受检查、计划感知连接起来。\n2) 真实图像流水线：地面托管完整管线，处理 7 条 DJI Mavic 3M 航线的 2,685 张 20MP UAV 图像；采用上下文引导的准入与反馈机制。
AI.result: 在 4 类布局、40 个世界、960 次闭环执行中，控制器完成 75.42% 任务（穷举 WM 打分为 73.33%，视线几何为 65.83%），且参考候选评估量比穷举少 91.81%。六查询上限的固定参考回放中，proposer 缩放的锚定界把首动作证书可得率从 36.25% 提升到 54.69%，每状态平均查询数比单位缩放锚定界减少 13.54%。图像流水线上，上下文引导准入与反馈保留全部 8 个独立支持的目标确认，处理图像减少 76.05%、累计主动处理服务减少 70.02%；反馈相较静态上下文再省 5.17% 图像。
AI.conclusion: 研究将预算约束下的动作选择与证据驱动的飞行影像处理连接起来：动作级选择性验证在显著降低评估开销的同时优于穷举与几何基线，上下文引导的准入/反馈亦在真实无人机图像上大幅节省处理量而不损失目标确认。

title: DiLE: Discrimination-Aware Latent-Space Learning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Multimodal large language models have greatly improved input understanding in universal multimodal embedding models. However, this understanding does not ensure that their embeddings preserve the evidence needed to distinguish relevant items from confusable alternatives. To preserve essential discriminative evidence in embeddings, this paper proposes DiLE, a discrimination-aware latent-space learning framework that combines task guidance with on-policy retrieval feedback. Specifically, a few learnable queries are used to encode task-relevant information in a compact latent space. Reasoning instructions and auxiliary answer-generation supervision shape these representations to support both task understanding and retrieval discrimination. To address task-specific discriminative needs, we design shared-private expert adaptation that integrates cross-task knowledge sharing with task-specific representation learning. Building on this, the on-policy hard-negative distillation is introduced: the student retrieves confusable candidates, and a reverse KL divergence objective aligns its embedding-based similarity distribution with the teacher's fine-grained relevance distribution over these candidates. Candidates are periodically refreshed using updated student snapshots, tying teacher supervision to the student's evolving retrieval behavior and confusions. Across four model configurations that span two backbone generations, DiLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMEB-v2, UVRB, and MRMR, demonstrating its effectiveness across modalities and tasks.

AI.tldr: DiLE 是一个判别感知的潜空间学习框架，通过任务引导与 on-policy 检索反馈，使多模态嵌入保留区分易混淆候选项的关键证据，在 MMEB-v2、UVRB、MRMR 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型虽提升了输入理解能力，但理解能力并不保证其嵌入保留区分相关项与易混淆替代项所需的证据，导致检索判别性不足。
AI.method: 用少量可学习 query 在紧凑潜空间编码任务相关信息，并以推理指令和辅助答案生成监督塑造表示；设计共享-私有专家适配实现跨任务知识共享与任务特定表示学习；提出 on-policy 难负例蒸馏，学生检索易混淆候选，用反向 KL 对齐其嵌入相似度分布与教师的细粒度相关性分布，并周期性用更新后的学生快照刷新候选项。
AI.result: 在跨两代骨干网络、四种模型配置下，DiLE 在 MMEB-v2、UVRB、MRMR 三个基准上均达到 SOTA，验证其跨模态、跨任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将判别性证据显式纳入潜空间学习，并结合随学生行为演化的检索反馈监督，是提升通用多模态嵌入检索判别力的有效途径。

title: VR-SparseQuant: Accurate FP4 Quantization with 2:4 Sparsity on Vera Rubin
summary: In recent years, GPUs have incorporated increasingly specialized support for low-precision computation, from Hopper's FP8 to Blackwell's FP4 Tensor Cores. Precision formats have evolved alongside this hardware, from MXFP4 and NVFP4 on Blackwell to E2M1 FP4 with direct UE5M3 block scaling on Vera Rubin, which we term as $\boldsymbol{VRFP4}$. These advances help serve larger language models at lower cost, but four-bit activation quantization can substantially degrade model quality. We introduce VR-SparseQuant, which uses Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 sparsity to recover accuracy while retaining native FP4 execution. By allowing two sparse streams to overlap, we use the same FP4 value budget as dense quantization to refine activations with larger errors. Offline scale-ratio calibration avoids runtime search, while a shared-weight GEMM accumulates both streams efficiently. On Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, VR-SparseQuant reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from $\boldsymbol{6.85}$ to $\boldsymbol{5.57}$ versus dense RTN W4A4. Including activation preparation, our native Rubin kernels for VRFP4 achieve up to $\boldsymbol{3.1\times}$ GEMM and $\boldsymbol{2.7\times}$ MoE speedup over BF16. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of adaptive activation quantization using Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 structured sparse FP4 instructions.
