AI.tldr: 提出 VR-SparseQuant，利用 Vera Rubin 的逐元素 2:4 稀疏 FP4 指令（VRFP4）以两条稀疏流重叠的方式做自适应激活量化，在相同 FP4 预算下挽回 4-bit 激活精度，并实现原生 FP4 加速。
AI.motivation: 低精度硬件（FP8/FP4、MXFP4/NVFP4/VRFP4）能降低大模型服务成本，但 4-bit 激活量化会显著损害模型质量，需要在保持原生 FP4 执行的前提下恢复精度。
AI.method: 利用 Vera Rubin 的逐元素 2:4 结构化稀疏能力，让两条稀疏流重叠，用与稠密量化相同的 FP4 数值预算去精化误差较大的激活；离线标定 scale ratio 避免运行时搜索；用共享权重的 GEMM 高效累加两条流。
AI.result: 在 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 上，WikiText-2 困惑度由稠密 RTN W4A4 的 6.85 降至 5.57；含激活准备在内，原生 Rubin kernel 相对 BF16 实现最高 3.1× GEMM 与 2.7× MoE 加速。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个基于 Vera Rubin 逐元素 2:4 稀疏 FP4 指令进行自适应激活量化的研究，兼顾了精度恢复与原生 FP4 效率。

title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TuringSpace——一个由125个交互式空间 CAPTCHA 组成的合成网页环境，要求模型像人一样在屏幕上点击/拖拽、观察结果并自我纠正，用以检验多模态大模型的空间智能；同时可作可扩展训练环境，微调后模型空间能力显著提升并可迁移到真实场景。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAPTCHA 基准大多已被解决且少有空间性，而空间基准又很少要求"行动"。人类通过"推断3D布局—预测动作后果—看到结果后纠正"的闭环解决视觉世界中的任务，但尚不清楚 MLLM 是否具备同样的能力，因此需要一个既空间化又需动作的测试基准。
AI.method: 构建 TuringSpace：125个交互式 CAPTCHA，覆盖五类空间能力，必须通过屏幕点击与拖拽解决。每个任务是一个程序，配有 checker 与 oracle，可自动生成新实例，从而构成可扩展的训练 gym。据此对多个 MLLM 评测，并在该 gym 上微调 Qwen3.5-9B，评估其分布外迁移能力。
AI.result: 人类成功率达94.1%；最强模型 GPT-6 Astra 仍失败25.9%，最强开源模型 Kimi K3 失败68.0%。分析显示失败多源于误读截图，且模型推理很少纠正错误信念，反而编造证据为其辩护。微调后 Qwen3.5-9B 成功率从1.6%升至33.1%（超过 Kimi K3），在全部七个分布外基准上均有提升，VSI-Bench 真实室内视频上提升9.9分。
AI.conclusion: 将空间智能锚定在屏幕动作上，能暴露 MLLM 的不足，并提供可扩展的教学途径，其收益可迁移至真实世界场景。作者将公开 TuringSpace 以支持后续研究。

title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online estimation. Specifically, DriftGuard first constructs causal supervision through repeated paired counterfactual replays, continuing the original and single-memory neutralized trajectory suffixes from a shared pre-action state. The resulting annotations are aggregated by component-wise majority voting into a memory drift score (MDS) that captures action change, attack removal, violation removal, and task recovery. Guided by this supervision, DriftGuard then learns an online risk model that estimates MDS from pre-action information and flags drift-inducing memories via its maximum component risk, without online counterfactual rollouts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriftGuard accurately identifies drift-inducing memories and enables efficient online defense. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DriftGuard-7F0B.

AI.tldr: 提出 DriftGuard 两阶段框架，将离线因果监督与在线估计解耦，实现无需在线反事实回放的记忆漂移检测。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体依赖持久记忆进行多步任务规划，存在记忆漂移风险（对抗或误导性记忆改变执行路径与结果），需要在服务时在线估计每条检索记忆对潜在漂移的因果贡献。现有方法面临两大挑战：内容级特征（困惑度、检索相关性）不足以做因果归因；反事实归因需为每条候选记忆重放下游执行，成本过高无法在线部署。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）离线阶段通过重复配对反事实回放构造因果监督——从共享的动作前状态续写原始轨迹后缀与单条记忆中和后的轨迹后缀，标注经分量式多数投票聚合为记忆漂移分数 MDS（涵盖动作改变、攻击移除、违规移除、任务恢复）；2）在线阶段学习风险模型，从动作前信息估计 MDS，并以最大分量风险标记致漂移记忆，无需在线反事实 rollout。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 DriftGuard 能准确识别致漂移记忆，并实现高效的在线防御。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将昂贵的因果归因转移到离线阶段、在线仅做轻量风险估计，DriftGuard 兼顾了因果忠实性与实时性，为 LLM 智能体记忆安全提供了可行方案。

title: Raptor: Rejection-aware Adaptive Tree based on Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-structured speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models (VLMs) by verifying multiple candidate continuations in parallel. However, long visual contexts increase the cost of speculative computation, making candidate coverage and redundant expansion important considerations beyond tree topology adaptation. We propose Raptor, a training-free framework that uses rejection feedback to jointly regulate candidate coverage and drafting effort. Our key insight is that acceptance length alone cannot distinguish insufficient candidate coverage from excessive deep expansion, and these conditions require different allocation decisions. Raptor therefore extracts complementary rejection-aware signals to characterize speculative progress, frontier coverage, and redundant expansion. These signals jointly guide bounded, momentum-smoothed updates of tree depth, branching width, and drafting budget, together with execution control that limits unnecessary drafting and progressively restores expansion when appropriate. Extensive experiments with two VLMs across seven multimodal benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Raptor, achieving up to 2.39x average speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: Raptor：一个免训练框架，利用拒绝反馈联合调控候选覆盖与草稿开销，用于加速视觉语言模型的树状推测解码。
AI.motivation: 长视觉上下文增加了推测计算成本，仅靠接受长度无法区分“候选覆盖不足”与“过度深度扩展”，二者需不同的资源分配策略。
AI.method: 提取拒绝感知的互补信号，刻画推测进度、前沿覆盖与冗余扩展；据此对有界、动量平滑的树深度、分支宽度与草稿预算进行联合更新，并配合执行控制，限制无效草稿、适时逐步恢复扩展。
AI.result: 在两个VLM和七个多模态基准上验证有效，相比自回归解码最高实现2.39倍平均加速。
AI.conclusion: 基于拒绝反馈的自适应调控可有效平衡候选覆盖与冗余扩展，提升VLM推测解码效率，且无需训练。

title: Verification Behavior Across Five Qwen2.5-Instruct Checkpoints
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Includes English translations of the experiment prompts and the behavioral rating rubric. AI language models were used for behavioral ratings and to assist manuscript preparation
summary: We evaluate five Qwen2.5-Instruct checkpoints (0.5B to 32B) under four prompting conditions using three fixed tasks per information condition and five generations per task. Two AI raters scored 600 trajectories. Under the coordinated instruction, both raters recorded strict declarations of insufficiency in 11/15 cases at 7B, 0/15 at 14B, and 5/15 at 32B. The runner sent a standard follow-up when a request detector fired. The three checkpoints received at least one follow-up in 15, 12, and 15 cases, respectively. On information-sufficient tasks at 3B through 32B, scored format markers appeared in 60/60 protocol trajectories and 0/60 baseline trajectories. After adjudication, 1/60 in each condition met the diagnostic-execution criterion (H3). Across all checkpoints and prompts, 7/300 information-sufficient trajectories met H3 after adjudication, all on the same task. The prespecified upward transition did not occur in this run. The results separate visible structure, diagnostic execution, and persistence after a request for evidence.

AI.tldr: 评估Qwen2.5-Instruct五个规模（0.5B–32B）在四种提示条件、三种信息条件下的行为，发现格式标记、诊断执行与追问后持续性三者可分离，预注册的"上升转变"未出现。
AI.motivation: 探究模型在信息不足时的"声明不足"、格式遵循、诊断执行与证据追问后持续行为是否一致，检验预注册的规模上升转变假设。
AI.method: 五个Qwen2.5-Instruct检查点（0.5B–32B）×四种提示条件，每信息条件三个固定任务、每任务五次生成；两名AI评审对600条轨迹打分；请求检测器触发时发送标准追问；条件含协议/基线对照，并进行裁决（adjudication）以判定H3诊断执行标准。
AI.result: 协调指令下严格声明不足：7B为11/15、14B为0/15、32B为5/15；三检查点获至少一次追问分别为15、12、15例。信息充分任务上格式标记出现60/60（协议）对0/60（基线）；裁决后每条件仅1/60满足H3，总计7/300且全在同一任务。预注册上升转变未发生。
AI.conclusion: 可见结构、诊断执行与追问后持续性三者相互分离，格式合规不等于实质诊断行为；规模并非单调改善来源，需分别度量。

title: Protein Functional Semantic Alignment via Representation Rectification
summary: Protein language models (PLMs) are commonly pretrained with likelihood-based objectives such as masked language modeling or denoising. These objectives capture sequence-level regularities, but can produce representations in which functional signals are entangled with non-functional variation (e.g., sequence identity, compositional bias, and frequent local motifs), creating a readout bottleneck for downstream function prediction. We introduce Functional Semantic Alignment via Representation Rectification (SAVR), a contrastive post-training method using Pfam family co-membership as a homology-guided discrete semantic signal to reshape PLM representations. SAVR reduces directional dominance and redistributes variance across embedding dimensions, decreasing variance concentration, and increasing effective dimensionality of the embedding covariance spectrum. Without observing any task-specific labels during post-training, SAVR achieves state-of-the-art results on Enzyme Commission (EC) benchmarks and competitive results on Gene Ontology (GO) benchmarks under frozen-backbone evaluation. These results suggest that homology-guided contrastive post-training can rectify PLM representation geometry and improve sequence-based protein function prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出SAVR，一种以Pfam家族共成员关系作为同源引导离散语义信号的对比式后训练方法，重塑蛋白语言模型表征几何，在冻结骨干设置下提升功能预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PLM预训练目标（掩码语言建模、去噪）只捕捉序列层面规律，表征中功能信号与非功能变异（序列同源性、组成偏好、高频局部基序）纠缠，形成下游功能预测的读出瓶颈。
AI.method: SAVR采用对比后训练，将Pfam家族共成员关系作为同源引导的离散语义标签；通过减少方向主导性、在嵌入维度间重新分配方差，降低方差集中度，提升嵌入协方差谱的有效维度。
AI.result: 后训练过程不使用任何任务特定标签；冻结骨干评估下在EC基准上取得SOTA，在GO基准上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.conclusion: 同源引导的对比后训练能够矫正PLM表征几何，从而提升基于序列的蛋白质功能预测。

title: Learning Networked Dynamical Systems via Neural ODE-based Graph Structure Inference
summary: Inferring the latent interaction graph from multivariate time series is fundamental to understanding complex dynamical systems in neuroscience, biology, and physics. Despite recent progress in neural relational inference, most methods rely on discrete-time modeling, which degrades under sparse and irregular observations and tends to entangle multi-hop dependencies into spurious direct edges. We show that a continuous-time formulation naturally decouples inference from any fixed observation schedule, allowing gradient signals to be integrated continuously between observations for both dynamics and structure learning. We propose NOGI (Neural ODE-based Graph Inference), a framework that couples a deterministic graph learner with an MPNN-based Neural ODE. The two modules are trained end-to-end via the adjoint method. Across four simulated dynamical systems at two scales, NOGI achieves the best structure recovery in 30 out of 32 evaluated cases with highly competitive forecasting performance, remaining robust under observation degradation. On the realistic Netsim fMRI benchmark, it attains an average AUPRC of 0.90 (AUROC 0.96). These results suggest that explicitly decoupling relational interactions from self-dynamics within a continuous-time vector field provides a powerful mechanism for graph structure learning under realistic observation conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NOGI框架，将确定性图学习器与基于MPNN的Neural ODE耦合，用连续时间向量场从多变量时间序列中推断潜在交互图，并通过伴随方法端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 现有多数神经关系推断方法采用离散时间建模，在稀疏、不规则观测下性能下降，且容易把多跳依赖误判为虚假的直接边，需要一种与观测时间表解耦的连续时间建模方式。
AI.method: NOGI由确定性图学习器与MPNN驱动的Neural ODE组成，将关系交互与自动力学在连续时间向量场中显式解耦；推断不依赖固定观测日程，梯度可在观测之间连续积分，两个模块通过伴随方法端到端联合训练。
AI.result: 在四个模拟动力系统、两个规模共32个评估情形中，NOGI在30个情形取得最佳结构恢复，预测性能极具竞争力，并在观测退化下保持稳健；在更真实的Netsim fMRI基准上平均AUPRC达0.90（AUROC 0.96）。
AI.conclusion: 在连续时间向量场中显式解耦关系交互与自动力学，是在真实观测条件下进行图结构学习的有效机制。

title: Wearable Logo, Silent Hijack: Stealthy Cross-Modal Semantic Attacks on Visible--Infrared Vision-Language Models
summary: Logos appear naturally on clothing and daily necessities, where their recognizable shapes and semantic associations make them familiar visual cues. This familiarity helps them blend into real-world environments and remain visually inconspicuous. We ask whether an existing logo can serve as a carrier for coordinated targeted semantic attacks on visible-infrared (VIS-IR) vision-language models (VLMs) without changing its original outline. This setting requires expressive adversarial variation within a fixed shape while accounting for different appearance characteristics and model responses across modalities. We propose Logo-guided Semantic Attack (LoSA), a score-based black-box framework that optimizes a logo's interior appearance and placement while preserving its silhouette. LoSA uses a contour field and low-frequency graph spectral modes to structure the interior color layout, a frozen appearance adapter to couple VIS and IR appearances, and particle swarm optimization to jointly optimize shared design parameters. Experiments across four datasets demonstrate that LoSA consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines in simultaneous Top-1 targeted success. Cross-architecture experiments, visual naturalness ratings, and captioning/VQA transfer analyses further characterize its effectiveness and limitations. These findings reveal that familiar visual symbols from real-world environments can serve as shape-preserving carriers for coordinated targeted semantic attacks across imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出Logo引导语义攻击LoSA，在不改变商标轮廓前提下，通过优化标志内部外观与放置位置，实现对可见光-红外视觉语言模型的协同目标语义攻击（黑盒）。
AI.motivation: 日常物品上的logo因形状可识别、语义关联强，天然熟悉而视觉上不显眼，是理想的攻击载体；但需在固定形状内产生足够强的对抗变化，且要兼顾两种模态的外观差异与模型响应差异。
AI.method: 基于分数的黑盒框架LoSA：用轮廓场与低频图谱模式结构化内部颜色布局，用冻结的外观适配器耦合VIS与IR外观，用粒子群优化联合优化共享设计参数（内部外观+放置位置），保持轮廓不变。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，LoSA在同时Top-1目标攻击成功率上稳定优于对比基线；跨架构实验、视觉自然度评分及captioning/VQA迁移分析进一步刻画了其有效性与局限。
AI.conclusion: 现实环境中熟悉的视觉符号可作为保形状载体，实现跨成像模态的协同目标语义攻击。

title: Closing Performance Gap for Diffusion Language Models under Low Inference Budgets
summary: Diffusion language models offer an architectural route to low-budget generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, which can reduce the number of sequential decoding steps relative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. However, realizing this advantage at low budgets is challenging, as generation quality often declines when the number of denoising and refinement steps is reduced. Editable diffusion models address this quality loss through post-draft refinement, but useful intermediate results may still be lost before final submission. We introduce CaRR (Commitment-aware Refinement and Recovery), a training-free framework which improves submission quality from a fixed editable checkpoint through updated-context refill and trajectory-based recovery within its existing forward schedule. Token Commitment Remasking (TCR) remasks selected native pure replacements and refills them on the next scheduled edit forward using the updated context. Submission Commitment Recovery (SCR) uses the resulting refinement trajectory to recover supported candidates when the final response does not satisfy task-specific output requirements. Both modules operate within the native mask/edit schedule without additional backbone forwards. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning show consistent gains in average accuracy over native ME-DLM across four inference budgets, with the largest gains under tight budgets. At one-eighth of the full scheduled forward budget, CaRR improves the six-metric average accuracy by 7.44 pp, including gains of 11.37 and 10.05 on MBPP and MBPP+.

AI.tldr: CaRR是一个免训练框架，通过在原生掩码/编辑调度内利用更新上下文回填与轨迹恢复，提升扩散语言模型在低预算下的提交质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型可并行更新多token以降低顺序解码步数，但低预算下减少去噪/细化步数会导致质量下降；现有多草稿可编辑扩散模型的中间结果可能在被最终提交前丢失。
AI.method: 在固定可编辑检查点上引入两个模块：Token Commitment Remasking（TCR）对选定的原生纯替换重新加掩码，并在下一次调度编辑前向中用更新后的上下文回填；Submission Commitment Recovery（SCR）利用细化轨迹，在最终响应不满足任务特定输出要求时恢复受支持的候选。二者均不增加额外骨干前向。
AI.result: 在代码生成与数学推理任务上，跨四个推理预算均优于原生ME-DLM，紧张预算下增益最大；在完整调度前向预算的1/8下，六指标平均准确率提升7.44个百分点，MBPP和MBPP+分别提升11.37和10.05。
AI.conclusion: CaRR证明无需额外训练或骨干前向，仅通过承诺感知的细化与恢复即可显著提升低预算下扩散语言模型的生成质量。

title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
summary: We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. In a cross-business transfer experiment, pretraining improves the target business metric by 34.5% over the same architecture trained from scratch. With only 25% of the training labels, the pretrained model outperforms the full-label scratch baseline in Average Precision (AP) and Recall@0.5% on different merchant domains. In a four-month online experiment on Ant International's billion-scale payment platform, the model reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% relative to XGB-Online.

AI.tldr: 提出约7B参数（每任务路由激活约1.7B）的Antom 3-in-1 Transformer支付基础模型，融合序列、表格与图表示用于支付风险检测；预训练在跨业务迁移中提升34.5%，仅用25%标签即超越全标签从头训练基线，线上四个月将整体损失率较XGB-Online降低37.88%。
AI.motivation: 支付风险检测需同时刻画用户行为序列、结构化特征的表格数据与实体间关系图，传统方法（如XGB-Online）难以统一建模并获得可迁移的通用表示；业务间标签稀缺，需要可跨域迁移的预训练基础模型。
AI.method: 基于蚂蚁国际内部支付数据，预训练一个约7B参数、每任务路由激活约1.7B的"三合一"Transformer，统一融合序列、表格与图三种表示，学习可复用的行为与关系表示，并支持下游业务迁移与标签高效微调。
AI.result: 跨业务迁移实验中，预训练使目标业务指标较同架构从头训练提升34.5%；仅用25%训练标签即在不同商户域的AP与Recall@0.5%上超过全标签从头训练基线；在十亿级支付平台四个月线上实验，整体损失率较XGB-Online降低37.88%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的序列-表格-图Transformer支付基础模型具备显著迁移性与标签效率，并在大规模真实线上系统中验证了风险防控收益，表明基础模型范式可有效落地支付风控场景。

title: Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models for Cyber Threat Intelligence: An Exploratory Study
comment: Accepted for publication in Computers and Electrical Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tasks, such as summarization and question answering. However, they may produce hallucinations, false or misleading content not grounded in the source text, which can mislead analysts and corrupt downstream security decisions. This paper presents an exploratory measurement study of hallucinations in LLM-based CTI. We introduce HalluVision, a reproducible framework that generates LLM outputs, extracts domain-specific entities using a fine-tuned named entity recognition model, and evaluates factual consistency using multiple similarity metrics. Using 4,940 real-world cybersecurity articles, we measure hallucinations in outputs from two commercial LLMs and one open-weight LLM. Measurements are validated against 100 human-annotated outputs and two established faithfulness detectors. Results show that semantic similarity aligns with human judgments, whereas entity-based metrics exhibit limited agreement. Differences between models are concentrated in question answering, while entity extraction quality limits what entity-level metrics can reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可复现框架 HalluVision，用微调 NER 抽取领域实体并结合多指标衡量 LLM 在 CTI 任务中的幻觉，发现语义相似度与人判一致、实体类指标一致性有限，模型差异集中于问答任务。
AI.motivation: LLM 已广泛用于网络威胁情报（CTI）的摘要与问答，但会产生无源文依据的幻觉内容，误导分析人员并影响下游安全决策。现有工作缺乏针对 CTI 领域的可复现幻觉测量方法。
AI.method: 构建 HalluVision 框架：生成 LLM 输出、用微调 NER 模型抽取领域实体、再用多种相似度指标评估事实一致性；在 4,940 篇真实网络安全文章上测量 2 个商业模型和 1 个开源模型的输出，并用 100 条人工标注及两个成熟忠实度检测器进行验证。
AI.result: 语义相似度指标与人工判断较为一致，而基于实体的指标一致性有限；模型间差异主要集中在问答任务；实体抽取质量限制了实体级指标可揭示的信息。
AI.conclusion: CTI 场景下的幻觉评估应优先采用语义相似度，实体级指标需依赖更高质量的实体抽取；HalluVision 提供了可复现的测量基线。

title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
summary: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VisualTalk-Bench 基准，用于评估"问题驱动的虚拟人主导视频讲解"任务，涵盖金融与中英文教育领域，包含 800 个参考视频与 100 个独立评测请求，从内容事实性、语音-视觉一致性、视觉质量、动作流畅性、虚拟人-内容指向性五个维度评估，并提出模块化智能体 Avatar-O Agent 进行探索。
AI.motivation: 视频生成与虚拟人合成技术使通过视觉讲解回答用户问题成为可能，但现有基准很少考察虚拟人是否真正指向其正在讲述的视觉内容，缺少对"指向准确性"这一关键能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建 VisualTalk-Bench（800 参考视频+100 评测请求，覆盖金融与中英文教育），设计五维评测体系；并提出 Avatar-O Agent，一个具备显式交互规划的模块化参考实现，与六个智能体进行对比实验，并开展 26 人用户研究（比较四个智能体）。
AI.result: 实验表明事实精确性与视觉质量并不能保证准确的指向性；端到端视频生成器难以将手势对齐到具体视觉目标；在 26 人研究中，Avatar-O Agent 在视觉引导、感知指向准确性和讲解有效性上获得最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 指向性（Avatar-Content Pointing）是虚拟人视频讲解中被忽视但重要的能力，显式交互规划的模块化方案优于端到端生成；基准与代码将公开，为后续研究提供评估基础。

title: Language models represent more about emphasis than they can tell you
summary: Prosodic prominence can largely be predicted from the words of a sentence, but part of it depends on how the speaker reads it. We study how much of prominence language models recover from text, whether they can report it when asked, and what the speech signal adds. On read English speech labelled for word-level prominence, we compare frozen and fine-tuned text models, prompted large language models (LLMs) and speech models on the same words. All text models end within about one point of each other, at best 68.8% on the 3-way task, and largely make the same errors. With the prompts we tested, LLMs do no better than a word-majority baseline, even with 500 examples. Linear probes find more in their representations. Speech models reach 84.7%. We argue that text determines only part of prominence, and that the rest has to be heard. LLMs encode what the text determines, but prompting does not bring it out: they represent more about where the emphasis falls than they tell you.

AI.tldr: 文本可比预测韵律显著度的上限约68.8%，语音模型达84.7%；LLM表征含相关信息但提示无法有效引出，其余部分只能"听"出来。
AI.motivation: 韵律显著度部分可由文本预测，部分取决于说话人朗读方式。作者想量化：语言模型能从文本中恢复多少显著度、能否被提示直接报告、语音信号又能额外带来什么。
AI.method: 在带词级显著度标注的英语朗读语音上，对同一批词比较冻结与微调文本模型、提示式LLM、语音模型；并辅以线性探针分析LLM表征，使用3分类任务与500示例的少样本设置。
AI.result: 所有文本模型差距约1个百分点内，最好68.8%，且错误高度一致；测试的提示下LLM不优于词多数类基线（即便给500示例），但线性探针显示其表征含更多信息；语音模型达84.7%。
AI.conclusion: 文本只能决定显著度的一部分，其余必须靠语音；LLM编码了文本可决定的部分，但提示不能将其引出——它们"表征的"多于"说出的"。

title: FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize small visual entities and understand their relationships. Scene graphs offer a natural way to represent this information, organizing visual entities as nodes and their relationships as edges. However, we identify two challenges: existing scene graph benchmarks provide insufficient coverage of fine-grained entities and the relationships among them, and existing methods for fine-grained visual understanding have yet to effectively leverage such graph-structured information in MLLMs. To address these challenges, we introduce Fine-Grained Multimodal Scene Graph Benchmark (FG-GraphBench) and FiGRA. FG-GraphBench is a benchmark comprising three complementary tasks: fine-grained visual question answering (FG-QA), image captioning (FG-Caption), and image description generation (FG-Description). We develop a two-stage construction pipeline that discovers and grounds fine-grained entities and establishes their relations to construct the fine-grained multimodal scene graphs (MSGs) in FG-GraphBench. Building on these MSGs, we propose FiGRA, a Fine-grained Graph Representation Augmentation method for MLLMs. FiGRA adopts a two-stage training strategy. It encodes multimodal entity and relation features as continuous graph tokens, and integrates them into the MLLM. Experiments show that FiGRA significantly outperforms strong baselines across three tasks of FG-GraphBench. Further analyses confirm the effectiveness of FG-GraphBench and highlight the importance of preserving fine-grained entity and relation information for visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出细粒度多模态场景图基准FG-GraphBench（含FG-QA、FG-Caption、FG-Description三任务）及FiGRA图表示增强方法，将实体与关系编码为连续图token注入MLLM，显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉理解要求MLLM识别小实体及其关系，场景图可自然表示此类信息。但现有场景图基准对细粒度实体及关系覆盖不足，且现有方法未能在MLLM中有效利用这种图结构信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建FG-GraphBench：三任务（FG-QA、FG-Caption、FG-Description），通过两阶段流水线发现并定位细粒度实体、建立关系，构建细粒度多模态场景图（MSG）；2) 提出FiGRA：将多模态实体与关系特征编码为连续图token并集成到MLLM中，采用两阶段训练策略。
AI.result: FiGRA在FG-GraphBench三个任务上显著超越强基线；进一步分析验证了基准的有效性，并表明保留细粒度实体与关系信息对视觉理解至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 显式的细粒度图结构表示可有效增强MLLM的细粒度视觉理解能力，配套基准为相关研究提供了评测基础。

title: Can an LLM Fix a Language Model Without Training It?
summary: Although an external language model can select and test repairs to another model's weights, behavior can also be recovered through fixed numerical edits. We assessed the value of interactive selection in a controlled study of Transformer repair. After inspecting predictions, activation summaries, and weight statistics, the editor selects projection recipes to apply to the target without gradient updates. We analyzed 20 recorded sessions involving five masked and causal language models, comparing the selected edits with fixed projections, scripted and matched-budget black-box search, and low-rank adaptation. Under the core two-layer fault, live selection matches black-box search on SmolLM2 and Qwen2.5. For Pythia, live selection achieves 65.62% completion accuracy, compared with 0% for black-box search and 66.15% for a fixed projection. Under a separate compound fault affecting attention and feed-forward weights, both scripted and LLM-guided selection increase the descriptive five-checkpoint mean from 24.89% to 71.25% using the same operator family. On unmodified checkpoints, scripted projection yields small gains or losses on a separate set of framed questions. The experiments identify cases in which feedback changes an edit decision, operator coverage accounts for recovery, or supervised adaptation performs better. Combined with measurements of parameter restoration and preservation, these comparisons establish the scope of controller-guided repair for the tested faults and completion tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过20次受控会话考察了"交互式修复选择"在Transformer权重修复中的价值，发现live选择在部分模型上匹配黑盒搜索或与固定投影相当（Pythia: 65.62% vs 0% / 66.15%），并在复合故障下将五检查点均值从24.89%提升至71.25%，但同时界定了反馈起作用、算子覆盖决定恢复效果以及监督式适配更优的具体条件。
AI.motivation: 外部语言模型可用来选择并测试对另一个模型权重的修复，但固定数值编辑同样能恢复行为。作者希望厘清"交互式选择"（live selection）本身究竟带来多少额外价值，而非恢复效果来自编辑算子本身的范围与覆盖。
AI.method: 在Transformer修复上做受控研究：编辑者检查预测、激活摘要与权重统计后，选择投影配方应用到目标模型，不使用梯度更新。共分析20次记录会话，涉及5个masked与causal语言模型，并将所选编辑与固定投影、脚本化及预算匹配的黑盒搜索、低秩适配进行对比；同时测量参数恢复与保持情况。测试包括核心两层故障和同时影响注意力与前馈权重的复合故障两类。
AI.result: 核心两层故障下，live选择在SmolLM2和Qwen2.5上匹配黑盒搜索；Pythia上live选择完成准确率65.62%，黑盒搜索为0%，固定投影为66.15%。复合故障下，脚本化与LLM引导选择使用同一算子族，将描述性五检查点均值从24.89%提升至71.25%。在未修改的检查点上，脚本化投影在一组独立的构题问题上带来小幅增益或损失。
AI.conclusion: 实验识别出反馈改变了编辑决策的情形、算子覆盖对恢复起决定作用的情形，以及监督式适配表现更优的情形。结合参数恢复与保持的测量，这些比较界定了控制器引导修复在所测故障与补全任务上的适用范围。

title: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
summary: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ApexFuse 提出一种超越"源图像相似度"约束的生成式图像融合范式：借助人-LMM 在环流程构建高质量融合参考分布，并用 FLUX 生成先验做目标分布引导的适配，实现高质量多模态融合与跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 图像融合缺乏真实（ground-truth）融合图像，现有深度方法只能通过要求融合结果同时逼近多张源图像来间接定义目标。但不同模态的成像特性差异会带来相互冲突的约束，限制互补信息的有效整合。作者希望摆脱源相似度约束，转向学习高质量场景表示的通用分布。
AI.method: 1) 设计 human-LMM-in-the-loop 流水线：利用大型多模态生成模型加迭代人工反馈，把抽象的融合目标转译为可靠的视觉参考，从而定义理想融合结果的目标分布；2) 基于目标分布引导的适配，将预训练 FLUX 的丰富生成先验迁移到图像融合，实现以多模态观测为条件的高质量场景重建。
AI.result: 实验表明 ApexFuse 能协调融合显著热目标、自然色彩与细节纹理，视觉质量优于源相似度方法，语义分割与目标检测性能也更佳；并展现出显著的跨任务泛化：从红外-可见光融合扩展到多曝光、多聚焦、可见光-深度融合，且无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: 通过以目标分布替代源相似度约束并迁移生成先验，ApexFuse 为图像融合提供了新的生成式范式，在质量、下游任务性能与跨任务泛化上均取得优势。

title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both large server-side setups (up to 3.1$\times$) and smaller models targeting memory-constrained on-device environments (up to 2.3$\times$ on H100 and up to 2.2$\times$ on a smartphone GPU). In addition, we present parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes for G-MTP that keep the drafter aligned with the backbone LLM under domain shift, requiring up to 1.83$\times$ fewer target forward passes than tuning only the backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出G-MTP：一种基于单共享草稿头的多Token预测架构，通过目标激活注入、零拷贝KV缓存交叉注意力和聚类词表投影三大优化，为推测解码提供轻量高精度的草稿器，在服务器与端侧均实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 推测解码依赖一个既轻量又准确的草稿器来逼近目标模型预测，但现有草稿器难以兼顾效率与质量，且需降低词表解码与内存开销，并在领域偏移下保持对齐。
AI.method: 将骨干LLM扩展为多Token预测架构，使用单一共享草稿头，并引入三项架构优化：目标激活注入以锚定语义规划；零拷贝KV缓存交叉注意力以绕过prefill计算并降低内存；高效聚类词表投影以降低全词表解码成本。同时给出参数高效微调方案以对齐领域偏移。
AI.result: 在Gemma 4系列上，G-MTP开箱即得加速：大型服务器场景最高3.1×，面向内存受限端侧的小模型在H100上最高2.3×、智能手机GPU上最高2.2×；微调配方比仅调骨干最多减少1.83×的目标前向次数。
AI.conclusion: G-MTP以单一共享草稿头结合三项架构优化，实现了高质量轻量草稿与跨服务器/端侧的高效加速，并提供领域偏移下的参数高效对齐微调方案。

title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
summary: Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls. Training the energy under the uncertainty-dependent temperature yields higher held-out recall@10 than training under a constant temperature of comparable magnitude. Under gene hold-out, recall@10 exceeds that of a trained DistMult embedding on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123); this difference is attributable mainly to three genes with many variants and is not established for all genes. These results establish an uncertainty-aware interface from genomic predictions to graph-supported phenotype hypotheses that combines interpretable probability allocation with held-out association recovery of explicitly stated scope.

AI.tldr: 提出"不确定度条件化路径能量"框架，将基因组基础模型的序列预测及其校准不确定度转化为基因–疾病–表型图上的显式假设概率分布，无需患者级表型监督，实现可解释、可溯源的多路径证据整合。
AI.motivation: 基因组基础模型虽能给出变异级证据，但把证据连接到表型假说需要在整个结构化推理中处理不确定度；现有方法缺少将预测不确定度显式传播到表型假设分布、且保持可解释与多路径可溯源的接口。
AI.method: 构建可学习的能量函数，对基因–疾病–表型可行路径打分；用查询不确定度控制目标温度，使证据质量决定假设的宽度（熵）；路径概率聚合为表型假说。对可枚举候选集做精确归一化作为参照，据此评估 Hastings 修正的学习型修订算子；并在不确定度依赖温度下训练能量函数，与恒定温度训练对比。
AI.result: AlzKB 与 Hetionet 上，表型级熵与上游不确定度的 Spearman 相关分别为 0.951 与 0.878；消融实验证实不确定度条件化的贡献；掩蔽边恢复任务中超过随机与度匹配的置换对照。不确定度依赖温度训练相比等幅恒定温度训练有更高的留出 recall@10。基因留出下，30 个图掩码中 24 个优于训练好的 DistMult（0.183 vs 0.123），但该差距主要来自三个变异丰富的基因，并非对所有基因成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从基因组预测到图支持表型假说的不确定度感知接口，兼具可解释的概率分配与明确适用范围的留出关联恢复能力；优势结论限于已声明条件，不宜泛化到全部基因。

title: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

AI.tldr: 提出LAQ，一种latent感知的4比特量化框架，专门保护世界动作模型（WAM）预测的未来latent保真度，在LIBERO-Plus上接近16比特模型精度并实现3.8倍压缩、1.66倍加速。
AI.motivation: WAM在机器人端侧部署需要W4A4KV4量化，但现有4比特量化器只按去噪步逐一估计敏感度并仅保护动作输出，忽略了动作误差主要经由"退化预测未来"这一通道传入，导致未来保真度下降。
AI.method: 提出LAQ框架，在预测未来的写入、存储、读取三处保护它：1）reader metric，以未来误差对动作的影响度量误差；2）read count，用读取该误差的去噪步数对舍入误差加权；二者结合给出激活与缓存精度分配的闭式解；3）gaze-guided refinement，在去噪循环与缓存中对动作关注的token做第二次4比特量化。权重全程4比特，无高精度分支，无需按任务重校准。
AI.result: LIBERO-Plus上Fast-WAM达76.4%、Cosmos-Policy达83.3%平均成功率，距16比特模型1.2个百分点以内，优于16比特KV缓存基线；模型压缩3.8倍、整策略峰值显存降2.3倍、比16比特快1.66倍。真实AgileX PiPER机械臂三任务平均47.0%，对比16比特的52.0%，较QuaRot高30.0%。
AI.conclusion: 保护预测未来latent的保真度是WAM量化的关键，LAQ以闭式精度分配与gaze引导二次量化在纯4比特设置下实现接近全精度性能并显著提升效率与真实部署可行性。

title: Lossless Latent Diffusion Models
summary: We study the problem of training image diffusion models while preserving pixel-exact reconstruction. Prior works typically address this problem by directly modeling images in pixel space, requiring modifications to the diffusion training objective or model architecture. In this work, we introduce a different paradigm: rather than modifying diffusion models, we construct a lossless transformation that maps pixels into a representation more amenable to diffusion modeling. We term our approach the Lossless Latent Diffusion Model (LLDM). We construct LLDM using residual latent transformation and uneven latent scaling, and explain its effectiveness through a proposed metric, semantic rank priority (SRP). Empirically, LLDM substantially outperforms prior pixel-space diffusion models in generation quality and even surpasses several widely used lossy VAEs. Furthermore, we show that SRP is strongly correlated with downstream generative performance.

AI.tldr: 提出无损潜在扩散模型（LLDM）：不改动扩散训练目标或架构，而是用残差潜在变换与不均匀潜在缩放构造像素的无损可逆映射，使表示更适合扩散建模，从而在保持像素级精确重建的同时提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 已有工作要实现像素精确重建的图像扩散模型，通常直接在像素空间建模，需修改扩散训练目标或模型架构；本文希望在不改动扩散模型本身的前提下达成同样目标。
AI.method: 构建像素到潜在表示的无损（可逆）变换：采用残差潜在变换（residual latent transformation）与不均匀潜在缩放（uneven latent scaling），并提出语义秩优先级（SRP）指标来解释其有效性。
AI.result: LLDM在生成质量上大幅优于以往的像素空间扩散模型，甚至超过若干常用的有损VAE；SRP与下游生成性能强相关。
AI.conclusion: 通过无损表示变换而非修改扩散模型，可同时实现像素精确重建与高质量生成；SRP可作为表征质量与生成性能的有效预测指标。

title: TableRoute: Capability-Aware Routing for Scalable Table Question Answering
summary: Table question answering with large language models remains difficult to scale: tables range from compact to million-token sizes, while questions require precise grounding of columns, values, and computations. Existing methods often specialize in a fixed inference strategy, which is brittle across different table scales and model capabilities. Full-table reading is efficient for compact inputs but suffers from irrelevant context. Table reduction helps long inputs but depends on reliable evidence localization, while execution is required when tables exceed the model context window and remains sensitive to schema and value grounding errors. We propose TableRoute, a capability-aware routing framework with evidence-conditioned inference for scalable TableQA. TableRoute first generates validated question--table evidence and identifies the required operations, then routes each instance among these three strategies according to serialized table length and calibrated estimates of how reliably the base model handles these operations. The validated evidence supports the selected route by grounding columns, values, and conditions. Across WikiTQ, WTQ-L, BirdQA, and TableBench, TableRoute consistently improves accuracy through complementary routing and evidence conditioning across table scales, while reducing online token cost. Code will be made available upon publication.

AI.tldr: TableRoute 是一个能力感知的路由框架，按序列化表长和对基座模型操作能力的校准估计，将每个 TableQA 实例在整表读取、表格缩减、执行三种策略间路由，并生成经校验的问答-表格证据来落地列、值与条件。
AI.motivation: 现有 TableQA 方法往往固定采用单一推理策略，在表格规模（从紧凑到百万 token）和模型能力差异下表现脆弱：整表读取对长表混入无关上下文，表格缩减依赖可靠的证据定位，执行则在超上下文窗口时必需但对模式与数值落地错误敏感。
AI.method: TableRoute 先为每个问题生成经校验的问答-表格证据并识别所需操作；再依据序列化表长与模型处理这些操作的可靠性校准估计，在整表读取、表格缩减、执行三种策略间路由；所选路线由已校验证据支撑列、值、条件的落地。
AI.result: 在 WikiTQ、WTQ-L、BirdQA、TableBench 上，TableRoute 通过互补路由与证据条件化，在不同表格规模下持续提升准确率，同时降低在线 token 成本。
AI.conclusion: 能力感知的策略路由结合证据条件化推理，可缓解单一推理策略的脆弱性，实现可扩展的表格问答；代码将在正式发表后公开。

title: Coordinate Basis Linear Bandits with Sublinear Regret over Low-Rank Clusters
summary: We study the problem of computational efficiency for linear bandits in high-dimensional settings with a finite arm set. In linear bandits, the increase in the dimension $d$ of the feature vectors leads to growing computational costs of $O(d^2)$ at each round of update. Traditional low-rank approximation methods such as SOFUL reduce computation via fixed-size matrix sketching, yet run the risk of incurring vacuous linear regret when the spectral tail of the data is heavy and the approximation rank is inadequately selected. To guarantee regret convergence and effectively reduce computational costs, we introduce a clustering mechanism and propose the Coordinate Basis Linear Bandit (CBL) algorithm. Our method preserves the full covariance information in each cluster by maintaining an exact orthonormal basis of the cluster's column space together with a low-dimensional coordinate representation, which guarantees robust sublinear regret without spectral-tail vulnerabilities. It performs cluster switching by assigning a sentinel for each cluster, and reduces per-round update computation to $O(\bar r^2)$ in the cluster's effective dimension $\bar r=\min(r,l)$, where $r$ is the intrinsic rank of the data and $l<d$ is a tunable rank bound.

AI.tldr: 提出坐标基线性bandit算法（CBL），通过聚类与精确正交基+低维坐标表示保留完整协方差信息，将每轮更新计算降至O(r̄²)，同时保证鲁棒次线性遗憾。
AI.motivation: 高维线性bandit中每轮更新成本O(d²)随维度增长昂贵；SOFUL等固定矩阵草图低秩近似在数据谱尾较重且近似秩选择不当时可能退化为线性遗憾。
AI.method: 引入聚类机制，每个簇维护其列空间的精确正交基及低维坐标表示以保留完整协方差信息；每个簇设置哨兵实现簇切换；有效维度r̄=min(r,l)，r为数据内在秩、l<d为可调秩上界。
AI.result: 每轮更新计算量降至O(r̄²)，并保证稳健的次线性遗憾，避免谱尾敏感性问题。
AI.conclusion: CBL在保持遗憾收敛保证的同时有效降低高维线性bandit的计算成本，优于存在谱尾风险的固定草图方法。

title: Cyber-Physical RSI for AI-RAN: A Case Study
summary: Learned models for radio access networks (RANs) are often developed using simulation, yet their predictions can shift when exposed to physical propagation conditions, protocol behavior, and equipment implementations. This paper presents a cyber-physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework for AI-RAN that connects a task-oriented student model, an experiment-planning coach agent, a calibratable virtual environment, and a physical host agent. Physical measurements are organized as evidence for both model adaptation and subsequent experiment planning. We examine an implementation of the physical-feedback pathway using ping-pong handover as a case study. The system completes 12 physical executions organized into six baseline--candidate pairs, updates the student from measured outcomes, and evaluates the revised model on reserved physical configurations. In the observed short-window tests, increasing the time-to-trigger from 320 to 1280\,ms changes the ping-pong count from three to zero. The updated student achieves a grouped-validation mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.673 round trips/min, while a common three-configuration physical evaluation yields MAEs of 1.240 and 1.601 round trips/min for the pre-feedback and post-feedback models, respectively. These results characterize both the operational feedback loop and the parameter-dependent generalization behavior revealed by new physical experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出面向AI-RAN的"信息物理递归自我改进(RSI)"框架，将任务型学生模型、实验规划教练智能体、可校准虚拟环境与物理宿主智能体闭环连接；以乒乓切换为案例验证物理反馈通路。
AI.motivation: RAN的机器学习模型多在仿真中开发，但面对真实传播条件、协议行为和设备实现时预测会偏移，缺少把物理测量持续回灌到模型与实验设计的闭环机制。
AI.method: 构建RSI框架：物理测量被组织为"证据"，同时用于学生模型自适应与后续实验规划；以乒乓切换为案例实现物理反馈路径，完成6组基线-候选共12次物理执行，用实测结果更新学生模型，并在预留物理配置上评估更新后的模型。
AI.result: 短窗口测试中，time-to-trigger从320ms增至1280ms使乒乓次数由3降为0；更新后学生模型的分组验证MAE为2.673往返/min；在常见三配置物理评估中，反馈前/后模型MAE分别为1.240与1.601往返/min。
AI.conclusion: 结果既刻画了可运行的操作反馈回路，也揭示了新物理实验所暴露的参数依赖泛化行为；注意后反馈模型在三配置评估上并未优于前反馈模型，说明泛化与验证协议仍需进一步研究。

title: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
summary: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/candor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CANDOR，一种基于「无条件/条件去噪误差对数比」的内在奖励，用来在 RL 后训练中替代需人工偏好标注的外部奖励模型，缓解 reward hacking。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图 RL 后训练依赖外部奖励模型（需标注偏好或辅助评估器），易被 reward hacking；而近期提出的「去噪准确率」类内在奖励在同提示词组内主要反映图像复杂度，对正确与错误样本的排序接近随机，无法衡量提示词保真度。
AI.method: 在共享噪声探针下，计算无条件去噪误差与条件去噪误差的对数比（log-ratio），衡量提示词对模型去噪自身样本的帮助程度，从而抵消与提示词无关、同比例放大两种误差的图像难度。
AI.result: 在同提示词样本对比较中，CANDOR 在组合生成与文字渲染上分别以 60% 和 63% 的概率把更优样本排在前。作为 Flow-GRPO 下 flow-matching 模型的唯一奖励，超过基线与先前的绝对自置信奖励，提升文字渲染、美学与人类偏好分数，且这些增益无法通过更强的 classifier-free guidance 复现；在已用外部奖励训练的公开 Flow-GRPO adapter 上还能进一步提升 PickScore 与 ImageReward。
AI.conclusion: 去噪误差的对比式对数比是更可靠的内在奖励信号，可作为独立奖励或与外部奖励互补，用于文生图模型的强化学习后训练。

title: HALTT: A HAte Lexicon Through Time
summary: Automated hate speech detection degrades over time as everyday vocabulary is weaponized into covert slurs while retaining original benign meanings (polysemy retention). Existing lexical semantic change detection (LSCD) frameworks struggle with this phenomenon due to a lack of standardized, sense-delineated diachronic resources. We propose a multi-stage framework to construct and validate a diachronic lexicon of semantically shifted hate speech terms. Filtering > 20,000 candidates, our pipeline combines historical (1770-1964) and modern (2001-2024) corpus frequency grounding, masked definition-level scoring to mitigate LLM temporal bias, and a dual-persona reasoning prompt paradigm. We release HALTT, a grounded lexicon of 19 polysemous terms with literal and derogatory senses, analyze shift typologies, and establish evaluation protocols for downstream diachronic benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多阶段框架构建并验证一个历时仇恨言论术语词典HALTT，收录19个兼具原义与贬义的多义术语，用于支撑仇恨言论检测的历时基准评测。
AI.motivation: 自动仇恨言论检测随时间退化：日常词汇被武器化为隐蔽侮辱语，同时保留原有良性含义（多义保留）。现有词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）框架因缺乏标准化、按义项切分的历时资源而难以应对该现象。
AI.method: 从超2万个候选中筛选，流程结合历史语料（1770-1964）与现代语料（2001-2024）的词频依据、掩码定义级评分以缓解LLM时间偏差，以及双人格推理提示范式。
AI.result: 发布HALTT：含字面义与贬义两个义项的19个多义术语依据化词典；分析语义转移类型学，并建立下游历时基准评测协议。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补了义项切分历时仇恨词汇资源的空白，为仇恨言论检测的时间漂移评测提供资源与规范。

title: Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models
comment: Submitted to a journal. The journal info will be confirmed once the paper is accepted
summary: Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. Under a single Loewner comparison between the base statistic and the task curvatures, this control converts into a ceiling on the interference functional, inversely proportional to the penalty coefficient, so that the curvature term of the bound is controlled during training. A first-order term, present because regularized solutions are not stationary for the task loss, is not reduced in the same way. Experiments on an exact non-quadratic model confirm the budget and the ceiling, show the first-order term dominating for strong penalties, and find the curvature-guided penalty slightly better than an isotropic one. In a three-seed transformer study the functional is rank-correlated with merging degradation, but no more strongly than the Euclidean displacement norm.

AI.tldr: 本文把"任务向量可组合性"形式化，证明合并模型的超额损失由交叉任务曲率重叠与更新符号对齐构成的干涉泛函控制；曲率正则化可把该干涉预算控制在罚系数设定的上限内。
AI.motivation: 将多个微调模型的任务向量相加/合并是多任务训练的常用替代方案，但合并何时有效、失效原因缺乏理论刻画，且需要一种能在训练中主动限制合并误差的手段。
AI.method: 定义任务向量集合的可组合性，推导超额损失界，其核心为干涉泛函（在二次情形下等于超额损失，衡量曲率度量而非欧氏度量下任务向量的夹角）。利用内存高效优化器本就维护的曲率统计构造曲率引导正则项，在标准 O(1/√T) 非凸收敛率下保证每步位移的曲率度量有上界；再借助基统计量与任务曲率间的一次 Loewner 比较，把控制转化为对干涉泛函的上界（与罚系数成反比）。
AI.result: 在精确非二次模型上的实验验证了位移预算与干涉上限；强惩罚下一阶项（因正则化解非任务损失驻点而存在）占主导；曲率引导惩罚略优于各向同性惩罚。三随机种子 Transformer 实验中，干涉泛函与合并退化程度呈秩相关，但不强于欧氏位移范数。
AI.conclusion: 干涉泛函给出合并误差的充要式判据（二次情形）与可训练阶段的曲率控制，但一阶项未被同步降低，且实证上其预测力并不超过简单的欧氏位移范数，说明该理论刻画的实际效用仍有限。

title: MambaLIFT: Reference-Based Mechanism-Aware Attribution for VMamba
summary: Attributing predictions of visual state-space models remains challenging because input-dependent selective dynamics couple feature selection, recurrent state propagation, and shared computational pathways. We introduce MambaLIFT, a reference-based, multiplier-first attribution framework for VMamba that propagates contributions through its computational graph using interaction-aware rules for selective-scan injection, recurrent memory, LayerNorm, and shared pathways. MambaLIFT decomposes the reference-relative class-logit difference, \(f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)\), by spatial position, VSS block, scan direction, and computational mechanism. Experiments on ImageNet-1K evaluate VMamba-T and VMamba-B, with hyperparameters selected on a calibration set and faithfulness assessed on a disjoint held-out evaluation set. MambaLIFT achieves numerical conservation to floating-point precision across audited attribution interfaces in both configurations. Under mean-colour pixel flipping, it achieves significantly higher mean faithfulness scores than MambaLRP on both configurations and the highest scores among the evaluated methods, including Integrated Gradients with matched references. Under blurred replacement, MambaLIFT is non-inferior to MambaLRP on VMamba-T and equivalent on VMamba-B, indicating that its advantage depends on the replacement protocol. Ablations on VMamba-T show that interaction allocation, temporal propagation, and pathway composition affect attribution maps. Mechanism-level analyses further show that exact relevance conservation does not imply additive effects under finite interventions: the mechanism decomposition accounts for the reference-relative logit difference but does not estimate intervention effects or establish causal validity.

AI.tldr: MambaLIFT：面向VMamba的参考基准、乘法优先的归因框架，可将类logit差分解到空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向与计算机制，并在浮点精度下守恒。
AI.motivation: 视觉状态空间模型（如VMamba）的预测难以归因，因为其输入依赖的选择性动态把特征选择、循环状态传播与共享计算通路耦合在一起，现有方法难以处理这种交互。
AI.method: 提出MambaLIFT：参考基准（reference-based）、乘法优先（multiplier-first）的归因框架，沿计算图传播贡献，针对选择性扫描注入、循环记忆、LayerNorm与共享通路采用交互感知规则；分解参考相对的类logit差f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)。在ImageNet-1K上对VMamba-T/B实验，超参在标定集选择，忠实度在独立留出集评估。
AI.result: 在两种配置下均可实现浮点精度的数值守恒。均值颜色像素翻转下忠实度显著高于MambaLRP且为所有对比方法（含匹配参考的IG）最高；模糊替换下VMamba-T不劣于MambaLRP、VMamba-B相当，说明优势依赖替换协议。消融显示交互分配、时序传播与通路组合影响归因图。机制级分析表明：精确相关性守恒不等于有限干预下的可加效应——机制分解能解释logit差，但不估计干预效果，也不具备因果有效性。
AI.conclusion: MambaLIFT为VMamba提供了守恒且可分解的归因工具，在颜色翻转协议下忠实度领先，但优势依赖替换协议；需注意其机制分解仅为解释性分解，非因果干预估计。

title: RemoteVLPG: How to Obtain a Specific VLM for Language-Guided Path Generation on Remote Sensing Images?
summary: We study how to obtain a task-specific Vision-Language Model (VLM) for language-guided path generation between start and end points on remote sensing images. We explore this question from three aspects. First, we implement three widely used architectural approaches and compare their performance. Second, we design a scalable method for constructing pre-training data and build an effective pre-training dataset with a degree of diversity. Methods trained on this dataset achieve promising zero-shot performance. Third, we construct three benchmarks that support stratified evaluation and design three metrics for path generation. We investigate this problem through extensive experiments. The results show that the zero-shot performance of methods trained on the constructed pre-training dataset can exceed that of some advanced commercial VLMs. Code and Dataset can be available at https://github.com/jzdang/RemoteVLPG

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何获得面向遥感图像上"语言引导起终点路径生成"任务的任务特定视觉语言模型(VLM),从架构对比、预训练数据构建、评测基准三方面展开。
AI.motivation: 通用商业VLM在遥感路径生成这一特定任务上能力不足,缺乏任务专用的模型、数据和标准化评测方案。
AI.method: 实现并比较三种主流架构方案;设计可扩展的预训练数据构建方法,构建具多样性的预训练数据集;构建三个支持分层评估的基准并设计三种路径生成指标。
AI.result: 在该预训练数据集上训练的方法具备有前景的零样本性能,可超过部分先进商业VLM。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定VLM可通过架构对比+自建多样化预训练数据+分层基准的系统性方案实现,并取得优于商业模型的零样本表现;代码与数据已开源。

title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
summary: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出临床大模型仅靠最终答案正确性评估存在严重缺陷，提出将智能体失败模式映射到符号化干预点的概念框架，并主张认证应同时审计推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有临床大模型评估只看最终答案是否正确，而模型可能通过无效推理、自信幻觉、因果无效推断或虚假人口学捷径给出流畅可信的输出，静态基准无法检测；同时现行监管强调性能指标而不要求验证推理步骤。
AI.method: 批判性综述，依次讨论四种范式：(1) 临床幻觉的成因及静态指标为何漏检；(2) 智能体幻觉级联——多智能体与工具增强系统如何传播和放大早期推理错误；(3) 过程奖励建模作为步骤级监督；(4) 神经符号接地——形式逻辑引擎、本体推理机和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证约束。并提出将各智能体失败模式映射到符号干预点的概念框架。
AI.result: 带符号否决层的系统在其编码知识域内可提供相对该知识的保证，并在所用安全指标上报告了较大提升；但这些结果来自单一研究，多为模拟或小样本设置，与神经基线不可直接比较。过程奖励模型仍受训练数据统计分布的限制。
AI.conclusion: 临床AI安全在很大程度上取决于系统架构；负责任的认证除静态基准准确率外，还应审计推理轨迹，而非仅依赖现行以性能为中心的监管要求。

title: Inverse ECG Reconstruction via a Preconditioned Variational Quantum Linear Solver
summary: Inverse electrocardiography (ECG) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface measurements, enabling noninvasive mapping of cardiac electrical activity. However, the reconstruction requires solving dense and ill-conditioned linear systems, whose computational cost grows rapidly with the refined heart mesh. Quantum computing offers new opportunities for solving such systems. This paper presents a hybrid quantum-classical framework for inverse ECG reconstruction, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to apply a quantum linear solver to this problem. We first propose a Laplacian-regularized pre-encoding procedure to reduce the dimension of the system while improving its conditioning. Second, the resulting reduced system is encoded and solved using a coherent variational quantum linear solver (VQLS). Finally, we provide a rigorous theoretical proof establishing that the proposed framework preserves the exact solution of the original reconstruction problem throughout all stages of the computational process. Experimental results on a realistic heart-torso geometry demonstrate that our approach holds significant ability for accurate inverse ECG reconstruction. These findings highlight the potential of quantum solvers for noninvasive cardiac imaging, providing a foundation for further research into quantum-enhanced cardiac assessment and other healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: 首个将量子线性求解器用于逆心电重建的混合量子-经典框架，先降维正则化，再用VQLS求解，并证明解保持精确。
AI.motivation: 逆心电重建需解稠密、病态的线性系统，随心脏网格细化计算成本急剧上升；量子计算为解决此类系统提供新途径，但此前尚无工作将量子线性求解器用于逆心电问题。
AI.method: 提出Laplacian正则化的预编码流程降低系统维度并改善条件数；再用相干变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）编码并求解降维系统；并从理论上严格证明框架在各计算阶段均保持原重建问题的精确解。
AI.result: 在真实心脏-躯干几何上实验，表明该方法具有准确进行逆心电重建的显著能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果突显量子求解器在无创心脏成像中的潜力，为量子增强心脏评估及其他医疗应用的研究奠定基础。

title: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
summary: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.

AI.tldr: MatVerse是基于Intern-S2-Preview、经大规模材料领域后训练得到的材料科学多模态基础模型，在OmniMatBench、MatSciBench、MaCBench三个基准上均优于基座模型。
AI.motivation: 材料科学信息高度异质（文本知识、分子/晶体结构、表征数据、显微图像、构效关系），现有模型难以统一理解与推理，缺乏通用材料基础模型。
AI.method: 构建覆盖材料知识、科学推理、定量解题、结构理解与多模态科学解读的大规模多模态语料；设计统一数据构建流水线：教师引导的推理蒸馏、科学问题合成、一致性过滤、检索式多模态数据构建；在Intern-S2-Preview上进行领域后训练。
AI.result: 在自建人工校准的OmniMatBench及MatSciBench、MaCBench三个基准上，经材料后训练后性能一致提升，计算密集题目的推理效率亦改善。
AI.conclusion: 针对性领域后训练可有效增强基础模型的科学推理、材料知识理解与多模态能力；MatVerse提供统一语言-视觉接口，可作为AI辅助材料研究工作流的基础。

title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role.
  However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full
  history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past
  experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that
  decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native
  video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this
  inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets
  the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation
  across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena,
  surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared
  methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above
  the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem and
  https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem.

AI.tldr: ActMem 提出一种上下文记忆框架，将"记忆推理"与"感知定位"在同一 VLM 主干内解耦：先用时间戳交互历史推断当前子任务，将其隐藏状态作为 Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought 条件化流匹配动作专家，并通过 Perception Attention 让动作专家直接看当前视图。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强 VLA 要么只检索历史观测而不推理其含义，要么在共享上下文中推理完整历史，导致历史挤占当前感知。认知科学将记忆（重建过去经验以决定做什么）与感知（指导如何行动）视为不同系统，本文据此提出解耦设计。
AI.method: 基于具备原生视频理解能力的 VLM；从带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，保留推理过程中的隐藏状态形成 Latent Memory CoT，用于条件化 flow-matching 动作专家；Perception Attention 使动作专家直接关注当前视图；Efficient Memory CoT Inference 在连续决策间复用计算且不改变输出，以加速长历史推理。
AI.result: RoboMemArena 上任务成功率 71.1%、完成成功率 80.8%，比最强基线高 7.5 与 8.7 个百分点；MIKASA-Robo 上平均成功率 73.8%，为对比方法中最佳；真实世界在外生、内生与无痕记忆任务上平均成功率 68.8%，高于最强记忆增强 VLA 10.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过在单一 VLM 主干内解耦记忆推理与感知定位，并以 Latent Memory CoT 连接动作专家，ActMem 在仿真与真实长程记忆操纵任务上均显著超越现有方法，同时借助高效推理保持速度。代码与权重将开源。

title: The Linguistic Structure of Dependency-Conditioned Embeddings
summary: Dependency-based distributional models capture syntactically informed lexical similarities, but the geometric organisation of dependency-conditioned lexical representations remains underexplored. We investigate the global and local geometry of lemma-dependency relation embeddings using four representations trained on WikiText-103: two count-based PPMI configurations and two Skip-Gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) configurations. At the global level, we analyse dependency-relation centroids, control for lexical identity through within-lemma centring, and examine their alignment with part-of-speech (POS) distributions. At the local level, we evaluate cross-relation geometric consistency, cross-method agreement, lexical similarity, and polysemous usages. Results show that global geometry is structured strongly by context POS across all representations. Locally, broader lexical similarity structures are partially preserved across dependency relations, while immediate neighbourhoods vary substantially, highlighting different usages. PPMI-based representations exhibit greater cross-relation consistency than SGNS-based representations, with cross-method agreement varying by relation. These findings reveal systematic linguistic organisation at multiple geometric scales and its sensitivity to representation choices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究依存条件词嵌入（lemma-依存关系表示）的全局与局部几何结构，发现全局几何受上下文词性（POS）强烈驱动，局部上词汇相似结构部分保留但近邻变化大，且PPMI表示比SGNS有更高的一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于依存的分布式模型能捕捉句法相关的词汇相似性，但依存条件表示在几何空间中的组织方式（全局与局部结构）尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在WikiText-103上训练四种表示（两种基于计数的PPMI配置、两种SGNS配置）。全局层面分析依存关系质心，用lemma内中心化控制词汇同一性，并考察其与POS分布的对齐；局部层面评估跨关系几何一致性、跨方法一致性、词汇相似性和多义用法。
AI.result: 全局几何在四种表示中均由上下文POS强烈结构化；局部上，较宽泛的词汇相似结构在跨依存关系中部分保留，但近邻显著变化，体现不同用法；PPMI表示跨关系一致性高于SGNS，跨方法一致性随关系而异。
AI.conclusion: 依存条件词表示在多个几何尺度上呈现系统性的语言学组织，且该组织对表示方法的选择敏感。

title: FamilySpace: From Emergent Chemical Semantics to Controllable Crystal Generation
summary: Latent crystal generative models typically combine a variational autoencoder (VAE) for learning atom-wise representations with a flow model that transports a simple source distribution to the learned latent distribution. However, previous studies have mainly focused on the quality of generated crystals, leaving the structure and generative utility of the atom-wise latent space largely unexplored. In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space. We term this phenomenon emergent chemical semantics. This structure suggests that sampling from a family-specific latent region can bias the decoder toward atoms from the corresponding elemental family. Building on this insight, we propose FamilySpace, a framework for controlling the elemental-family composition of generated crystals. FamilySpace assigns each elemental family a distinct source component, forming a family-indexed multi-source distribution, and trains a flow model using source-target pairs matched by family. In inference, a user-specified family template selects the source component for each atom-wise representation, enabling direct control over the family composition of generated crystals. Experiments on MP-20 and MPTS-52 show that FamilySpace achieves competitive crystal-generation performance while matching prescribed elemental-family compositions. Moreover, selected family templates increase the fraction of generated crystals predicted to be stable or metastable, demonstrating that latent-space composition control can support targeted exploration of promising chemical regions without additional optimization techniques such as reinforcement learning. Code is available at https://github.com/hhw11/FamilySpace

AI.tldr: Latent crystal generative models自组织出元素族语义结构，据此提出FamilySpace实现元素族组成可控的晶体生成。
AI.motivation: 以往研究只关注生成晶体的质量，忽视了原子级潜空间的结构与生成效用，需要探究其潜在组织规律并加以利用。
AI.method: 发现vanilla VAE按元素族分离潜表示（emergent chemical semantics）；据此为每个元素族分配独立源分量构成族索引多源分布，用族匹配的源-目标对训练flow模型；推理时由用户指定族模板选择各原子的源分量，从而直接控制元素族组成。
AI.result: 在MP-20与MPTS-52上取得有竞争力的生成性能，同时精确匹配规定的元素族组成；部分族模板还提高了生成晶体被预测为稳定/亚稳的比例。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间组成控制可在无需强化学习等额外优化的情况下支持对潜在化学区域的有针对性探索。

title: Multiple Criteria Decision Making Under XORness
summary: How should we make decisions under XORness? XORness is a class of uncertainty arising from indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy. We develop a multiple criteria decision making framework that preserves XORness throughout the decision process. We define XOR numbers and prove their fundamental arithmetic and algebraic properties. Building on these results, we extend the deterministic decision matrix to an XOR decision matrix and introduce a compatible normalization procedure. Further, we propose an additive XOR aggregation operator, which preserves indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy inherent in evaluations. In addition, we introduce an axiomatic XORness measure that quantifies the degree of uncertainty associated with global performance scores and develop a performance--XORness index to rank alternatives. We prove that this index induces a total preorder over the set of alternatives and identify the conditions for preserving dominance. The applicability of the developed framework is demonstrated through the risk assessment of cyberthreat scenarios in energy systems, and recommendations are derived using the XOR--weighted sum method.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在"XORness"（由不确定性、互斥性和迟疑性构成的一类不确定性）下的多准则决策框架，全程保持XORness，并以能源系统网络威胁风险评估为例验证。
AI.motivation: 传统决策方法在处理评价中的不确定性、互斥性与迟疑性时难以在整个决策过程中保持一致，作者希望发展一种能在决策全流程中保留XORness的框架。
AI.method: 定义XOR数并证明其算术与代数性质；将确定性决策矩阵扩展为XOR决策矩阵并引入兼容的归一化；提出加性XOR聚合算子；建立公理化XORness测度以量化全局得分的总体不确定性，并构建performance–XORness指数用于排序，证明其诱导全预序并给出保持支配性的条件。
AI.result: 证明了XOR数的基本性质与XORness测度的公理体系；performance–XORness指数在备选集上诱导全预序，并识别了保持支配关系的条件；在能源系统网络威胁情景风险评估中展示了框架的适用性，并用XOR加权和法给出建议。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在多准则决策全过程中保持XORness，具备理论性质（全预序、支配保持）与实践可行性，可用于风险评估类决策问题。

title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
summary: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion and from 95% to 100% for task manipulation. We also explore cross-view consistency checks as a mitigation. These findings expose a gap in visual trust: securing what a machine reads does not secure what a user sees. A demo is available at https://qshen0629.github.io/DRJanus/

AI.tldr: DRJanus 是一种视觉伪装攻击，利用 SDR 处理与 HDR 显示之间的差异，在单张 JPEG 中嵌入两幅独立图像：审核系统看到的是无害的 SDR 基础层，人类在 HDR 设备上看到的却是有害内容；在对 100 张性内容图片的测试中，它绕过了全部 6 家商业审核服务和 9 个视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 图像审核通常是机器读 SDR 基础层，而 HDR 显示会用增益图重建出另一幅画面，这一"机看"与"人看"的差距可被恶意利用，导致自动化安全检查通过但用户仍看到有害内容。
AI.method: 提出 DRJanus：将 HDR 的增益图重建过程反向求解，在单个 JPEG 中嵌入两幅自选彩色图像。它精确保留指定的 SDR 基础层（对审核系统而言与目标无关、无需查询或针对模型优化），同时让 HDR 端重建出另一目标图像。
AI.result: SDR 基础层完美保留，HDR 目标在 400 张图片上平均 PSNR 为 43.03 dB；100 张性内容基准上绕过全部 6 家商业审核服务和 9 个视觉语言模型；5 个智能体各 120 个任务案例中，审核规避成功率 31.67%–100%，任务操纵成功率 95%–100%。另探讨了跨视图一致性检查作为缓解手段。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示"视觉信任"缺口：保护机器所读不等于保护用户所见，现有审核机制在 HDR 场景下存在盲区，需引入跨视图一致性等防御手段。

title: Many Solutions, One Answer: Search Order Shapes the Default Solutions of Language Models
summary: When a constraint puzzle has several correct answers, language models tend to give the same one.We study four open-weight models from three families on symbolic puzzles and multi-solution ZebraLogic variants with exactly known solution sets.Repeated samples concentrate on one default solution far beyond uniform sampling, and different models often share it.Yet models usually produce even rarely sampled solutions when added clues uniquely identify them.On held-out symbolic puzzles, we compare visiting entities in name order with visiting those with the fewest initial candidates first. Both searches try values in the stated order. Where their pre-specified predictions differ, the latter matches a larger share of responses in all four models, by 26 to 40 percentage points.Reversing the stated value order or specifying a search order shifts responses towards the solution that the new order favours, on both testbeds. Randomising the presentation or supplying a random search order raises breadth (the effective share of solutions in use) by 26 to 42 percentage points on the symbolic task and 11 to 26 on ZebraLogic. The largest observed validity losses are 3 and 4 percentage points, respectively. Randomised presentation broadens answers more than a random-choice instruction in each of the three main models.

AI.tldr: Language models answering constraints puzzles with multiple solutions concentrate on a single default solution, but this behavior is explained by models following a specific search heuristic; randomizing presentation or search order substantially broadens the diversity of solutions used at minimal cost to validity.
AI.motivation: When a constraint puzzle admits several correct answers, models tend to return the same one, which is problematic. The paper aims to understand why this concentration occurs—whether it reflects an inherent narrowness or a systematic search heuristic—and to find interventions that increase answer diversity.
AI.method: Studying four open-weight models from three families on symbolic puzzles and multi-solution ZebraLogic variants with exactly known solution sets. Comparing two search heuristics (name order vs. fewest-initial-candidates-first) where their predictions diverge, and testing manipulations of value order, presentation randomization, and random search-order instructions.
AI.result: Repeated samples concentrate on one default solution far beyond uniform sampling, often shared across models; yet models can produce rare solutions when clues uniquely identify them. Fewest-candidates-first matches responses 26–40 points more where predictions differ. Reversing value order shifts answers toward the favored solution. Randomizing presentation/search order raises breadth by 26–42 points (symbolic) and 11–26 points (ZebraLogic), with validity losses of at most 3–4 points. Randomized presentation broadens answers more than a random-choice instruction.
AI.conclusion: Model concentration on a single solution is driven by a systematic search heuristic rather than an inability to produce diverse answers. Manipulating presentation and search order cheaply increases solution diversity with minimal accuracy loss, offering a practical route to more varied outputs.

title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
comment: Submitted to a journal and details will be confirmed once paper accepted
summary: Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $β_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-β_1)\|G_t\|_F + γ\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order $p^2/r^2$ by one of order $1$, against $Θ(p/r)$ for the sharpest contraction-based bounds. Transferring the full rate costs a leakage term, which we bound by the step-weighted gradient mass $\sum_{u\le t}η_u\|G_u\|_F$ and show tight up to a factor $\sqrt{2}$; the price is an additive $O(\log^2 T)$ floor, not a slower rate. On BERT fine-tuning at rank ratio $32/768$ the feedback decay costs under $0.008$ validation $F_1$.

AI.tldr: 该文证明误差反馈界不必包含压缩器的收缩常数 r/p，当压缩动量被重新注入压缩前累加器时，缓冲区误差仅满足与维度 m,n 及秩 r 无关的递推界。
AI.motivation: 现有误差反馈分析通过压缩器收缩常数（最优秩-r 逼近的 r/p）界定内存缓冲区，该常数会进入收敛速率，导致分析受维度和秩约束。
AI.method: 利用压缩器仅为到闭锥的度量投影这一性质，将上一时刻压缩动量 β₁M_{t-1} 视为投影中的可行竞争项，推导 ‖E_t‖_F ≤ (1-β₁)‖G_t‖_F + γ‖E_{t-1}‖_F；证明覆盖 top-k 选择与截断 SVD，且对投影集任意选择、无奇异值交叉条件成立，轨迹跟踪形式对梯度无假设。
AI.result: 在标准分析的两阶段模板中，将 Stage-2 的 O(p²/r²) 常数替换为 O(1)，优于收缩法最锐界 Θ(p/r)；完整速率转移带来泄漏项，用步长加权的梯度质量 ∑η_u‖G_u‖_F 界定并证明其紧至 √2 因子，代价是 O(log²T) 加性下界而非更慢速率。BERT 微调在秩比 32/768 下反馈衰减使验证 F₁ 损失小于 0.008。
AI.conclusion: 收缩常数在误差反馈分析中是人为产物；动量重注入给出维度与秩无关的紧致误差界，实验验证其实际代价可忽略。

title: SiliconGym: A Versatile Reinforcement Learning Environment for Agentic EDA
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with electronic design automation (EDA) feedback is advancing large language models for hardware design and verification. Extending these gains to hardware-engineering agents requires environments that span tasks, preserve state across tool calls, and support large hierarchies alongside parallel rollouts. We present SiliconGym, the first versatile, cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification. By decoupling versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, SiliconGym scales from module-level RTL, testbench, and PPA tasks to multi-round repository repair and full-hierarchy SoC flows. Streaming dispatch overlaps tool checks with generation, finishing a 256-answer RL batch 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek. Using interchangeable open-source and commercial backends, we show that open-source-trained functional correctness transfers cleanly to commercial simulation, while paired netlist evaluation reveals when open-source PPA gains survive commercial synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出 SiliconGym——首个跨任务、跨工具链的硬件设计与验证强化学习环境，通过版本化工作区、预算化执行与验收门控评分支持从模块级 RTL 到全 SoC 流程，并验证开源训练成果可迁移至商业仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 EDA 反馈的 RL 主要针对单一任务，缺乏跨任务、可保持工具调用状态、支持大规模层次结构与并行 rollout 的环境，限制了 LLM 硬件工程智能体的能力扩展。
AI.method: 解耦三项机制：版本化工作区（跨工具调用保留状态）、预算化执行、验收门控评分；并采用流式调度，将工具检查与生成重叠进行，后端可在开源与商业工具链间互换。
AI.result: 覆盖模块级 RTL、testbench、PPA 任务及多轮仓库修复与全层次 SoC 流程；256 条答案的 RL 批处理比原生 ChipSeek 快 21.9%；开源训练得到的功能正确性可干净迁移到商业仿真，配对网表评估揭示开源 PPA 收益何时能在商业综合中保留。
AI.conclusion: SiliconGym 为硬件设计验证提供了可扩展、跨工具链的 RL 训练环境，并表明开源工具链训练的智能体具备向商业工具链迁移的实用价值。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation.
