AI.method: 在5,439例公共麻醉记录上开发因果信号调理流程：流式滤波剔除10.13 min、64 Hz阻抗检查，去凹口后不裁剪调理，分离63 s抑制比时滞，三通道区分袖带充气与脱落；去阻抗后的皮层树集成与深度序列模型对比，并配合患者聚类子群协变量加权保形风险控制（CRC）和滞后缓冲在线保形PID跟踪。
AI.result: 预滤波剔除消除97.90%/97.60%假平线冲突同时保留99.23%/98.96%深度抑制；TIVA（N=525）AUPRC 0.3135（1.94%流行率）与0.1627（0.82%无滞后），与深度编码器无显著差异（p≥0.36），血压预测无皮层增益（p=0.784）；零再训练挥发性麻醉迁移与呼气末气体oracle无差异（p=0.472）；CRC在66.32 ms/30 s时段内将所有70个移位单元限制在≤4.38%（alpha=5%）。
AI.conclusion: 因果伪迹解耦与偏移感知保形校准可在明确的生理可观测性极限内提供可靠的实时术中风险上界。

title: Explainable AI for Solar PV Power Forecasting: From Model Selection to Trustworthy, Reproducible Deployment
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code and results available from the corresponding author on request
summary: Machine learning (ML) is now a standard tool for forecasting the output of solar photovoltaic (PV) plants, yet published accuracy figures are often hard to compare and harder to trust. Many studies validate with random splits, report no reference forecast, and present feature attributions without saying what they can and cannot show. This paper reviews the main families of ML methods for PV power forecasting and resource assessment, from tree ensembles to deep and foundation models, and sets out a reproducible workflow that combines automated model search with explainable AI. The workflow is then tested on an openly available dataset: a 16.32 kWp plant in Porto, Portugal, forecast one day ahead from a 4 km numerical weather prediction grid. Over a full test year, the best models reach a normalised root mean square error (nRMSE) of 11.6% of installed capacity, about half the error of smart persistence. The choice of input features changed accuracy far more than the choice among strong algorithms, and shuffled cross-validation was mildly optimistic. After conformal calibration, the nominal 80% prediction intervals covered 81.7% of observations, against 64.5% before. SHAP rankings stayed stable when the model was retrained on different periods but shifted when correlated inputs were removed, so attributions should be read as properties of a model rather than of the plant. The paper closes with practical lessons and open problems, including deployment on edge hardware and the effect of a changing climate.

AI.tldr: 本文综述光伏功率预测的机器学习方法，提出"自动化模型搜索+可解释AI"的可复现工作流，并在葡萄牙波尔图16.32 kWp电站数据上验证，最佳模型nRMSE为11.6%，约为智能持续性的一半。
AI.motivation: 现有ML光伏预测文献的精度指标难以比较、可信度不足：多用随机划分验证、缺少参照基准、特征归因未说明其可解释边界。作者希望建立更可复现、可比较的评估范式。
AI.method: 综述从树集成到深度与基础模型的各类ML方法；构建结合自动化模型搜索与可解释AI的可复现工作流；在公开数据（波尔图16.32 kWp电站，基于4 km数值天气预报网格做提前一天预测）上测试，并考察验证方式、输入特征、共形校准与SHAP归因的稳定性。
AI.result: 整个测试年最佳模型nRMSE为11.6%（占装机容量），约为智能持续性误差的一半；输入特征选择对精度的影响远大于强算法之间的选择；打乱交叉验证略偏乐观；共形校准后名义80%预测区间覆盖81.7%（校准前64.5%）；SHAP排序在不同时期重训练下稳定，但去除相关输入后发生偏移。
AI.conclusion: 归因应理解为模型属性而非电站属性；论文总结实践教训与开放问题，包括边缘硬件部署与气候变化影响。强调需以参照基准、合理验证与校准区间提升ML光伏预测结果的可比性与可信度。

title: DAWN: Robust Neural Blind Deconvolution via Alternating Wiener Guidance
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to jointly recover a sharp image and blur kernel from a single degraded observation. Under nontrivial and high noise, which is common in photography and scientific imaging such as microscopy, BID remains particularly challenging, as existing methods suffer from noise overfitting and inaccurate kernel estimation. Existing training-data-free learning methods for BID, such as those based on the deep image prior (DIP), often utilize external guidance by including model-based estimates as additional loss terms, which underexploits the information these estimates carry especially under nontrivial noise. To address these challenges, we propose DAWN, a training-data-free DIP framework that alternates between injecting model-based estimates directly into the model input and refining this imperfect estimate with the network's own prior. To provide more reliable kernel estimates for these injections, we apply autoencoding regularization to both the image and kernel networks. On natural and scientific images under varying levels of Gaussian and Poisson noise, DAWN outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both image and kernel quality (achieving up to +4.5 dB over the next best baseline on the Levin dataset at $σ= 0.1$). Without any training images, DAWN remains highly competitive with a state-of-the-art diffusion model on FFHQ, despite the latter being trained on a massive number of in-distribution images.

AI.tldr: DAWN：一种无需训练数据的DIP框架，通过将模型估计直接注入网络输入并与网络先验交替优化，配合图像与核网络的自编码正则，显著提升高噪声盲去卷积性能。
AI.motivation: 盲图像去卷积在非平凡高噪声下极难，现有方法存在噪声过拟合和核估计不准问题；基于DIP的无训练方法仅将模型估计作为额外损失项，未能充分利用其信息。
AI.method: 提出DAWN框架：在模型输入中直接注入基于模型的估计，并与网络自身先验交替精化该估计；同时对图像网络和模糊核网络施加自编码正则，以获得更可靠的核估计用于注入。
AI.result: 在自然图像与科学图像、不同强度高斯与泊松噪声下，图像与核质量均优于SOTA；Levin数据集σ=0.1时比次优基线最高提升4.5 dB；无训练图像条件下在FFHQ上仍可媲美大规模同分布训练的扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 直接注入模型估计而非仅作损失项，结合自编码正则，是无训练盲去卷积在强噪声下的有效方案。

title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
summary: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. For judgments of whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average ($Δd' = -0.34$ across model families; -0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: Base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning, model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. Our corpora cannot be shared, so we add a case reproducible from public data, the truth of negated statements. Here, post-training acted in the opposite direction: Probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement; below it, the representation of the statement contributed, strongly in one of four models. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved the answers on our newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on the chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction.

AI.tldr: 后训练（post-training）主要改变的是模型如何"读出"已有表征，而非改变表征本身。作者用线性探针与模型自身回答做信号检测论对比，发现探针能区分人/AI作者与否定陈述真值，但后训练显著改变读出方式（如降低作者判断敏感度、反转否定真值利用方向），且改变发生在监督微调阶段、始于早期层、主要通过文本后位置传递，少量训练信号即可设定读出方向。
AI.motivation: 核心问题：后训练究竟改变了模型"表征什么"，还是改变了"如何将表征读成答案"？这一问题对于理解对齐/微调的作用机制至关重要，但缺乏系统性实证区分。
AI.method: 在六个开源基座模型及其后训练版本上，对比线性探针与模型自身回答，并用信号检测论（d'、基础率偏移）量化敏感度与先验使用；设计两个任务：德国文本人/AI作者判断、否定陈述真值。利用分期检查点、模型缝合（model stitching）、以及仅添加2,000条标注作者判断的训练实验来定位改变发生的阶段与层级。
AI.result: 作者判断任务：探针与n-gram分类器区分良好，但回答敏感度低甚至顺序反转；后训练平均降低回答敏感度（跨家族Δd'=-0.34，跨提示-0.29），并增强对设定基础率的响应。改变发生在监督微调阶段，缝合指向早期层，中深层后文本位置承载迁移。否定真值任务：后训练方向相反——探针接近天花板，部分基座回答未利用真值，后训练修复之，修复位于中深层的后文本位置。加入2,000条正确标注的作者判断可改善报纸/教科书语料回答，却在聊天语料上反转并追随基座的新训练探针。
AI.conclusion: 后训练改变的是判断从表征中被读出的方式，而非表征本身；且小的训练信号即可设定读出方向。这对模型对齐、评估与探针应用有重要含义——仅凭探针难以预测模型行为。

title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). Second, replacing router logits across all routed layers changes the judgment in all nine checkpoints, and by more than a norm-matched random replacement. Third, this change rarely depends on whether the source step is correct. At one layer, routing from erroneous steps and from correct steps produces indistinguishable margins in all nine checkpoints. Under all-layer routing, their difference is resolved and positive in only one. Fourth, the same difference is positive for local residual replacements in eight of nine checkpoints, so the measure does detect such dependence where it exists. Correctness is therefore readable from routing, and routing replacements move the judgment, but the movement rarely follows correctness.

AI.tldr: 通过 RouteVerify 干预实验发现：MoE 路由状态能区分正确/错误推理步，替换路由也会改变验证判断，但判断变化很少依赖来源步骤的正确性——路由"可读"正确性，却不"携带"其因果作用。
AI.motivation: 已有证据表明 MoE 模型的路由状态可区分正确与错误推理步，且改变路由会改变步级验证判断。看似可推出"判断跟随路由所编码的信息"。作者要检验这一因果推断是否成立。
AI.method: RouteVerify 控制干预研究：保持被测输入不变，用另一条解迹的激活替换选定内部激活。跨九个 MoE checkpoint，比较三种干预接口（router logits、MoE 输出、MoE 后残差），并变化替换所在的层与 token 位置；度量验证 margin（模型对错误答案相对正确答案的偏好）的变化，并对比来自正确步 vs 错误步的激活，检验判断是否依赖来源步正确性；另设 norm-matched 随机替换作为对照。
AI.result: 四项关联结果：(1) router logits 探针在 8 个 checkpoint 上可区分正确/错误步（AUROC 0.80–0.88）；(2) 全路由层替换 router logits 在全部 9 个 checkpoint 改变判断，且强于等范数随机替换；(3) 该变化极少依赖来源步正确性——单层时错误步与正确步来源的 margin 在 9 个 checkpoint 中均不可区分，全层时仅 1 个呈显著正差异；(4) 而局部残差替换在 9 个中 8 个出现正差异，说明该度量在依赖存在时确能检出。
AI.conclusion: 正确性可以从路由中读出，路由替换也会移动验证判断，但这种移动很少跟随正确性；即路由编码与步级验证判断之间存在因果解耦，不能由可解码性或干预敏感性推出路由承载了验证功能。

title: One Schedule Does Not Fit All: Adaptive Inference Schedules for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models typically use a fixed denoising schedule across workloads. We show that the cheapest schedule that preserves quality depends on the task, model, and sampler. We propose Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation (TCDA), a deployment rule with an explicit error guarantee. Given candidate samplers, paired calibration data, a utility tolerance, and guardrails against degeneration, TCDA uses simultaneous one-sided bootstrap bounds to certify which candidates meet both the utility and guardrail criteria. It deploys the cheapest certified candidate or falls back to the full schedule. The probability of deploying an infeasible schedule is asymptotically at most alpha. Candidates include early prefix decoding, state-reusing continuation, reduced time grids, and confidence-threshold decoding. Across seven datasets and two model families, TCDA certifies reductions in denoiser evaluations by factors of 3.4 on XSum and 2.0 on WMT14 for ELF-B; 8.0 on WMT14 and 4.1 on GSM8K for LLaDA-8B; and 1.33 on OpenWebText for both ELF-M and ELF-L. A validation protocol fixed before generation confirmed every selection on fresh seeds. Across 500 calibration splits, false certification remained below 2% in every setting at a nominal level of 5%. Certified schedules vary across tasks and model scales. Trajectory measurements suggest that when decoded tokens commit is more informative for schedule selection than the remaining latent discretization error. We also find that the ELF reference sampler draws its time grid at random, so reproducible schedule comparisons for unconditional generation require fixing the grid.

AI.tldr: 提出任务校准去噪分配（TCDA），用单侧 bootstrap 同时置信界认证最便宜且满足效用与防退化约束的去噪调度，实现扩散语言模型的按任务自适应加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通常对所有负载使用固定的去噪调度，但保持质量所需的最省调度实际上依赖任务、模型与采样器，因此需要一种带显式错误保证的部署规则来自动选择。
AI.method: 给定候选采样器（早期前缀解码、状态复用续算、缩减时间网格、置信度阈值解码）、配对校准数据、效用容忍度和防退化护栏，用同时单侧 bootstrap 置信界认证哪些候选同时满足效用与护栏标准，部署最便宜的被认证候选，否则回退到完整调度；不可行调度被部署的概率渐近不超过 alpha。
AI.result: 七个数据集、两个模型族上认证了去噪评估次数的大幅削减：ELF-B 在 XSum 3.4×、WMT14 2.0×；LLaDA-8B 在 WMT14 8.0×、GSM8K 4.1×；ELF-M/L 在 OpenWebText 均为 1.33×。新种子验证全部确认选择；500 次校准划分中名义水平 5% 下各设定错误认证率均低于 2%。
AI.conclusion: 认证调度随任务与模型规模变化；轨迹测量表明"已解码 token 的确定性"比剩余潜变量离散化误差更能指导调度选择；此外 ELF 参考采样器随机抽取时间网格，无条件生成的可复现调度比较需固定网格。

title: Physical Laws without Physics Loss? Probing Learned Dynamics in Video World Models through Forced Response
summary: Do video world models learn physical laws without a physics loss, or merely imitate motion? Overall motion and appearance scores cannot settle it. We investigate this through nonlinear forced response: an excitation shakes the support of a suspended object. We introduce dual visual-numeric conditioning and adapt six image-to-video backbones to predict this motion using only the flow-matching loss. Wan predicts motion accurately and generalizes to unseen excitations, objects, poses, and scenes. Counterfactual tests suggest capabilities beyond replaying training videos. But what laws have they learned? We design three tiers of tests using Taylor expansions of the dynamics and geometry. All six reproduce the linear response, including resonance; five capture higher-order dynamics, including nonlinear softening. Remarkably, softening is barely present in training: only 0.74% of the swing's squared displacement. Extensions to a double pendulum and a rocking block show sustained dynamics are learned more faithfully than brief impacts. Yet learned dynamics may fail to appear when state estimation or propagation goes wrong. We turn these tests and findings into strategies to improve video training and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"非线性受迫响应"实验（震荡激励悬挂物体的支撑）检验视频世界模型是否真正习得物理规律。作者提出双视觉-数值条件，仅用flow-matching损失微调6个image-to-video骨干。结果显示Wan能准确预测并泛化到未见激励、物体、姿态与场景；全部6个模型重现线性响应与共振，5个捕捉高阶非线性"软化"（训练数据中仅占0.74%）。双摆与摇摆块显示持续动力学比瞬时碰撞学得更忠实，但状态估计或传播失败时学到的动力学可能不显现。作者据此提出改进视频训练与生成的策略。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型仅凭整体运动与外观分数无法判断其是"学会物理定律"还是"模仿运动"。论文希望通过受控的物理实验（非线性受迫响应）区分二者，并系统刻画模型究竟学到了哪一层物理规律（线性、高阶非线性），而非停留在整体逼真度评估。
AI.method: 1) 任务：设计"支撑受激振动、悬挂物体摆动"的非线性受迫响应场景；2) 建模：引入双视觉-数值条件（visual-numeric conditioning），仅用flow-matching损失适配6个image-to-video骨干网络；3) 评估：基于动力学与几何的Taylor展开设计三个层级的测试，逐层考察线性响应、共振与高阶非线性；4) 泛化与反事实测试，并扩展到双摆、摇摆块等系统，分析状态估计/传播对结果的影响。
AI.result: Wan能准确预测该运动并泛化到未见激励、物体、姿态与场景，反事实测试表明其能力超出"回放训练视频"；全部6个模型再现线性响应（含共振），5个捕捉到高阶动力学（含非线性软化），而软化在训练数据中几乎不存在（仅占摆动平方位移的0.74%）。双摆与摇摆块上，持续动力学比短暂碰撞学得更忠实；但状态估计或传播出错时，已学动力学可能不显现。
AI.conclusion: 视频世界模型可在无显式物理损失下学到超出训练分布的物理规律（含微弱高阶非线性），但学习效果依赖状态估计与传播正确性、且持续性动力学优于瞬时冲击。论文据此将这些测试与发现转化为改进视频训练与生成的策略，并提供了诊断世界模型物理能力的可复现评估框架。

title: How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?
summary: Organizations monitor their workers' activity for insider threats, in which workers misuse their legitimate access, by copying confidential files before leaving. Detectors score how unusual each day of activity is, flagging the most unusual for an analyst to review. Prominent current approaches use opaque neural networks, so explanations of a flag point to internal features: patterns of neuron activity most active on days of misuse. We audit such explanations for language-model detectors trained on CERT's simulated workplace logs. To test an explanation, we see what happens to the detector's score when we remove its features inside the model. We compare this to a control: a change that is as similar as possible to the removal, but without actually removing the features. Because defining "similar" requires choosing a metric, our central contribution is the tipping radius: a first-order prediction of how far that metric must move before the difference between removal and control disappears, a measure of how fragile the result is to that choice. In 33 of 34 runs of seven language models, the tipping radius is at most 18% of the distance between two standard choices of metric. Moving that far removes at least 58% of the difference or reverses it, while random moves of the same size leave it largely intact. The result replicates in thirteen of fourteen pre-declared primary runs on openly released models, though on our trained detectors the difference is often too small to measure. We also find that a flag's score partly reflects who the worker is, not what they did, and that the features named depend on whom they are compared against. Audits should therefore fix the control's metric in advance, report its tipping radius, and disclose that comparison.

AI.tldr: 论文审计语言模型内部威胁检测器的解释，提出"倾覆半径"度量解释结果对控制度量选择的脆弱性，发现多数情况下解释差异在度量微小变动下即消失。
AI.motivation: 组织用不透明的神经检测器监控内部威胁，其"神经元特征解释"是否可靠缺乏审计，解释结论又依赖于比较时选用的度量。
AI.method: 在CERT模拟工位日志上训练语言模型检测器；通过在模型内移除解释所指特征并对照"相似但不移除"的控制，提出倾覆半径（一阶预测差异消失所需度量移动距离）。
AI.result: 34次运行中33次倾覆半径≤两种标准度量距离的18%，移动该距离可消除至少58%差异或使其反转，而同样大小的随机移动基本无影响；14个预测先登记运行中13个复现；标记得分部分反映"是谁"而非"做了什么"，特征依赖比较对象。
AI.conclusion: 解释审计应预先固定控制度量、报告倾覆半径并披露比较对象。

title: RelGeo: Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration for Frozen Diffusion Correspondence
summary: Frozen diffusion descriptors retrieve strong semantic correspondence candidates, yet cosine nearest-neighbor matching can select incorrect locations despite valid high-ranking alternatives. Across DIFT-SD2.1 and DiTF-FLUX on SPair-71k, AP-10K, and SOCO (CC, SOC, Cross-SOC), 41-69% of Top-1 errors retain a PCK@0.10-valid match among the original Top-5 spatial peaks, revealing a persistent candidate-selection bottleneck. We find that descriptor rankings and current-pair relational evidence can favor different candidates: reciprocal diffusion Query/Key associations and pretrained RoMa transport exhibit distinct, partly complementary preferences. To incorporate this evidence into matching decisions, we introduce RelGeo, a Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration framework expressing heterogeneous relations as shared source-target coordinates. Spectral Relational Coordinates (SRC) encode reciprocal diffusion affinities, while Warp Identity Coordinates (WIC) encode reliability-weighted bidirectional transport endpoints. Their inner products augment frozen descriptor similarity while preserving full-domain cosine nearest-neighbor matching without additional semantic-correspondence training. RelGeo improves all ten evaluations by an average of 5.51 PCK@0.10 points; fixed-candidate reranking and pair-misalignment controls corroborate improved selection and dependence on current-pair relational alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出 RelGeo 框架，用成对关系校准修正冻结扩散描述子的候选选择错误，在十个评测上平均提升 5.51 PCK@0.10 点。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散描述子虽能召回强语义对应候选，但余弦最近邻匹配常挑错位置。实验显示 Top-1 错误中 41-69% 在原始 Top-5 空间峰内仍存在 PCK@0.10 有效匹配，说明瓶颈在候选选择而非候选质量；且描述子排序与当前成对关系证据偏好不同候选。
AI.method: RelGeo：成对条件关系校准框架，将异质关系表示为共享的源-目标坐标。谱关系坐标 SRC 编码互惠扩散亲和度；Warp 恒等坐标 WIC 编码按可靠性加权的双向传输端点；二者内积用于增强冻结描述子相似度，保持全域余弦最近邻匹配且无需额外语义对应训练。
AI.result: 在 DIFT-SD2.1、DiTF-FLUX 上的 SPair-71k、AP-10K、SOCO（CC、SOC、Cross-SOC）共十项评测全部提升，平均 +5.51 PCK@0.10；固定候选重排序与成对错配控制实验证实提升来自更好的候选选择且依赖当前成对关系对齐。
AI.conclusion: 候选选择是冻结扩散对应方法的主要瓶颈，引入成对关系证据进行校准可即插即用地显著提升性能，且无需训练语义对应模型。

title: A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Low-rank plus sparse decompositions, such as robust PCA, typically model the low-rank component as dense and the sparse component as corruption. This viewpoint is poorly suited to graph adjacency matrices, where sparsity is structural and dense low-rank factors destroy the combinatorial and computational properties of the graph. We propose signed biclique decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that represents the structured component as a sum of sparse signed binary rank-one factors, together with a sparse signed residual. The resulting representation remains discrete, interpretable, sparse, and compatible with standard linear algebra. We formulate fixed-rank and greedy SBD objectives and derive a gain-based greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, SBD recovers block structure in noisy graphs, while its factorized representation enables efficient sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM). On real graphs with strong shared-neighborhood structure, SBD achieves compression factors above $10$ and SpMM speedups up to $6\times$ over cuSPARSE, suggesting a practical alternative to dense low-rank decompositions for graphs. Code is available at https://github.com/IAntoineV/sbd.

AI.tldr: 提出符号双团分解（SBD），将图邻接矩阵分解为稀疏符号二元秩一因子之和加稀疏残差，保持离散、可解释与稀疏性，并支持高效SpMM。
AI.motivation: 传统低秩+稀疏分解（如鲁棒PCA）将低秩部分视为稠密、稀疏部分视为噪声，不适配图邻接矩阵：图中稀疏是结构性的，稠密低秩因子会破坏组合与计算性质。
AI.method: 针对整数权重图，将结构化分量表示为稀疏符号二元秩一因子之和，外加稀疏符号残差；提出固定秩与贪心SBD目标，并设计基于增益的贪心算法及理论保证。
AI.result: 在含噪图中成功恢复块结构；因子化表示支持高效稀疏矩阵乘法。在具有强共享邻域结构的真实图上实现超过10倍压缩，SpMM较cuSPARSE最高6倍加速。
AI.conclusion: SBD为图提供了一种保持稀疏性与可解释性的稀疏低秩分解，作为稠密低秩分解的实用替代方案。

title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
summary: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. Given a target query, RubricDuo first combines concepts relevant to the target query with retrieved historical cases to draft a rubric with broad coverage. It then revisits each draft criterion, retrieves concept-linked historical criteria and their source queries, and adapts applicable evidence to refine the criterion. Experiments on RubricBench and HealthBench demonstrate that RubricDuo achieves the overall best performance among the evaluated automatic methods in both alignment with human-authored rubrics and downstream LLM judging.

AI.tldr: RubricDuo 将历史查询-评分标准对组织成评分标准知识图谱，通过“先草案后逐条精炼”的两阶段流程生成高质量查询专属评分标准。
AI.motivation: 查询专属评分标准可让 LLM 评估更细粒度和透明，但生成高质量标准需识别评估范围并给出具体检查项。现有复用历史经验的方法要么整体复用查询-标准案例（带入无关任务细节），要么只聚合准则与维度（丢失整体结构），未将反复出现的评估需求与其准则级证据、来源查询语境显式关联。
AI.method: 构建 Rubric Knowledge Graph，链接评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则与查询，以共享概念抽象跨查询的可复用评估需求。给定目标查询，先结合相关概念与检索到的历史案例起草覆盖广泛的评分标准；再逐条回访草案准则，检索概念关联的历史准则及其来源查询，将适用证据适配以精炼该准则。
AI.result: 在 RubricBench 与 HealthBench 上，RubricDuo 在与人工评分标准的一致性以及下游 LLM 评判两方面，均取得所比较自动方法中的整体最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 以知识图谱显式连接概念、准则证据与来源查询语境，并通过起草-精炼两阶段复用历史评估经验，能有效提升自动评分标准生成质量。

title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
summary: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有视频世界模型评测（Physics-IQ）将生成视频与单一真实录制对比，存在"向中间预测"悖论：减少去噪步数反而提高物理分数。作者提出 Kernel Physics-IQ，用核方法在期望上消除该激励，只需每条件两个独立样本。
AI.motivation: 一个场景可能存在多个合理未来，仅与单条录制对比打分，会奖励生成未来之间变化度的减小（分布坍缩），即使分布本身更不准确。这使评测误导模型优化方向。
AI.method: 给出分数的精确分解，揭示其可奖励生成未来间变化减少的问题；提出 Kernel Physics-IQ，基于核方法度量生成分布与真实可能结果的匹配，期望上消除该偏差，每条件仅需两个独立样本。
AI.result: 两步采样在全部五个图生视频模型上降低 Kernel Physics-IQ。CogVideoX 官方分数上升 0.055 而新指标下降 0.131；改变采样调度也揭示官方分数遗漏的差异。在已知结果概率的受控物理系统中，新指标偏好真实分布而非坍缩预测。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型不应只看单个视频与已发生情况的吻合度，还应评估其预测对未来可能性的表征是否忠实。

title: Beyond Alignment: Whitening Geometry, Profile Synthesis, and Heterogeneous Ensembles for Cross-Environment WiFi Action Recognition
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of a manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Cross-environment deployment is the central obstacle to practical WiFi sensing: a pipeline reaching 0.89+ top-1 in its training environments collapses to 0.408 under Leave-One-Domain-Out (LODO) evaluation with only K-shot labels. A ceiling analysis shows the collapse is not an alignment problem: the action signal is strong across seen environments (about 0.89 K10), environment identity is decodable from the encoder (0.965), and the failure concentrates in the encoder's extrapolation to the novel environment. A pre-registered falsification chain confirms that "align the domains" methods--training-time alignment, readout-level prototype alignment, adversarial confusion, and covariance/subspace alignment (CORAL -3.8pp, subspace -8.3pp)--degrade performance, and that source-domain statistics anti-correlate with cross-environment contribution. The effective levers lie elsewhere; we combine them into Dec-H: (i) closed-form source within-class whitening, provably re-geometrizing the readout's L2 regularization (+8.6pp, zero cost); (ii) profile-mixing augmentation (+1.0pp); (iii) few-shot adaptation with alternating whitening refit (+1.5pp; fixed preconditioners are 20/20 negative); (iv) heterogeneous decision ensembles (+1.7pp); homogeneous scaling and source-weighted stacking are saturated or harmful. Dec-H reaches 0.560 K10 (0.812 K40), +15.2pp over the baseline, consistent across all four environments and seeds; all thirteen configurations were pre-registered with frozen criteria.

AI.tldr: WiFi感知的跨环境部署难题并非域对齐问题，而是编码器外推失败；提出Dec-H组合四个有效杠杆，在LODO下K10达0.560（+15.2pp）。
AI.motivation: WiFi感知在训练环境top-1可达0.89+，但在Leave-One-Domain-Out且仅少量K-shot标签时骤降至0.408。作者想厘清这一崩塌的真正原因，并验证流行的"域对齐"思路是否有效。
AI.method: 通过上限分析（动作信号在已见环境强约0.89 K10、环境身份可从编码器解码0.965）定位问题在编码器外推；用预注册的否证链检验各类域对齐方法（训练期对齐、readout原型对齐、对抗混淆、CORAL/子空间对齐）均失败。据此提出Dec-H：(i)闭式源域类内白化，等价重几何化readout的L2正则；(ii)profile-mixing增强；(iii)交替白化重拟合的少样本自适应；(iv)异构决策集成。
AI.result: 域对齐方法普遍退化（CORAL -3.8pp、子空间 -8.3pp），源域统计与跨环境贡献反相关。Dec-H各组件分别+8.6/+1.0/+1.5/+1.7pp；固定预条件器20/20为负，同质化扩展与源域加权堆叠饱和或有害。整体K10达0.560（K40为0.812），较基线+15.2pp，四个环境与随机种子一致。
AI.conclusion: 跨环境WiFi感知的关键在编码器外推与readout几何，而非域对齐；Dec-H以低成本可证明的组件组合稳定提升，且全部13个配置均预注册并冻结标准，保证结论可信。

title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
summary: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向智能体 LLM 服务的端到端评测流水线，验证"重放录制轨迹"能稳定复现每会话 token 负载，并指出实测/重放/合成负载在 vLLM 代码覆盖上互补；MoE 模型上线案例显示捕获工作负载仅达约一半最优并发与约 60% 吞吐。
AI.motivation: 企业正将智能体工作负载从闭源 API 迁移到自建开放权重模型部署，需要覆盖从小规模测试、容量规划、预生产到生产的全生命周期验证；但现有 rollout 评估多用临时工具，其准确性很少被检验。
AI.method: 构建端到端评测流水线，并以实验对流水线各阶段间的设计选择做经验性验证：对比轨迹重放与实时重跑的每会话负载稳定性；对 vLLM 做代码覆盖分析以比较实测、重放、合成三类工作负载；在 llm-d 上对四个大型 MoE 模型做上线案例研究，比较捕获工作负载与公开轨迹的表现。
AI.result: 重放在 95 分位处输入 token 为记录的 1.18x，而实时重跑达 4.98x，说明少量录制会话即可产生可重复的每会话 token 负载；三类工作负载各自触达其余两者未覆盖的 Python 服务路径，具有互补性；目标模型在捕获工作负载上仅达到约一半最优并发、约 60% 吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹重放是可靠且可重复的负载复现手段，且应与实测、合成负载组合使用以覆盖更多服务路径；仅依赖公开轨迹会高估部署性能，需按真实捕获负载做容量规划。作者开源相关工具并发布轨迹数据集。

title: AesDistill: Distilling Generative Aesthetics for Image Color Enhancement
summary: Image color enhancement aims to improve visual appeal, but previous methods often learn to reproduce ground-truth expert targets. These targets reflect the preferences of a few experts and cover a limited range of aesthetic choices. Matching them does not ensure stronger aesthetic quality across different tastes and scenes. By contrast, large generative models learn rich visual knowledge from large image collections and often produce vivid, appealing image edits. However, direct generation can change the source image's semantic structure along with its colors. In this paper, we introduce AesDistill, a framework for distilling generative aesthetics into image color enhancement. We use 4 leading open-source large generative models to produce 64,644 edited images as teacher targets at a cost of about 3,360 H100 GPU-hours, forming the AesDistill Dataset. AesDistill also includes AesDistill Student, a 1.13M-parameter model that learns teacher color changes through confidence-weighted supervision while preserving the source image's semantic structure. We evaluate AesDistill with 12 aesthetic and 4 image-quality assessment models. Every teacher's targets rank above the FiveK and PPR10K expert target means in the joint assessment. Across both datasets, AesDistill Student outperforms all 20 baseline methods and ranks directly behind the 4 teachers. These results demonstrate that distilling aesthetics from generative models enables a compact student to outperform methods trained on expert targets.

AI.tldr: AesDistill 将大型生成模型的美学能力蒸馏为紧凑的图像色彩增强模型，用 4 个开源生成模型产出约 6.5 万张教师图像构成数据集，并用 1.13M 参数的学生模型在保留语义结构的前提下学习教师的色彩编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有色彩增强方法以少数专家的 ground-truth 目标为监督，这些目标只反映少数专家的偏好，美学选择范围有限；而直接调用大生成模型虽能产生鲜艳的编辑效果，却会改变源图的语义结构。
AI.method: 用 4 个领先开源大生成模型生成 64,644 张编辑图作为教师目标（约 3,360 H100 GPU 小时），构建 AesDistill Dataset；提出 AesDistill Student（1.13M 参数），通过置信度加权监督学习教师的色彩变化，同时保持源图语义结构。
AI.result: 用 12 个美学模型和 4 个图像质量模型评估：所有教师目标在联合评估中均高于 FiveK 与 PPR10K 的专家目标均值；AesDistill Student 在两个数据集上均优于全部 20 个基线方法，仅次于 4 个教师模型。
AI.conclusion: 从生成模型蒸馏美学知识，可使紧凑的学生模型超越基于专家目标训练的方法，为色彩增强提供更具泛化美学质量的新范式。

title: Interpretable Prototype-Conditioned Adaptation for Weather Forecasting
comment: 38 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://zhixuanli.github.io/projects/li2026protocast
summary: Data-driven weather forecasting requires distinguishing local states and their temporal evolution. However, learned patterns remain implicit in neural forecasters, making their influence difficult to interpret. Failing to distinguish local evolution can lead to similar forecasts for locations that develop differently, increasing prediction error. This motivates explicit references for distinguishing and interpreting local patterns. Prototypes provide explicit pattern references, but sample- or task-level conditioning leaves open how to adapt to distinct locations and variable groups. To deal with this problem, we design ProtoCast, which uses group-specific prototype banks to adapt local features while accounting for cross-variable dependencies. Specifically, (1) we combine each group's historical features and temporal change with forecast context from cross-variable attention for evolution-aware prototype matching. (2) Sparse mixtures of prototype-specific low-rank operators tailor corrections to each group and location. A gated attention block then exchanges the corrected features across groups before prediction. Each group's correction decomposes into explicit prototype contributions before this fusion. (3) We jointly train the forecasting network and operators from scratch and refit each group's prototypes before every training epoch. Slot tracking preserves prototype-operator associations, making each prototype's contribution to local corrections more interpretable. Experiments on GlobalForecast and TyphoonTracking show improved forecasting accuracy, while prototype deletion links local feature contributions to changes in prediction error. This work advances the development of more accurate and interpretable data-driven weather forecasting models. Project page: https://zhixuanli.github.io/projects/li2026protocast

AI.tldr: ProtoCast：用分组原型库显式区分和解释局地气象模式，提升数据驱动天气预报的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 神经预报器中学习到的模式是隐式的，无法区分对局地状态及其时间演变的刻画，容易对不同演变趋势的地区给出相似预测从而增大误差，因此需要显式的模式参照（原型），但样本级/任务级条件化难以适配不同位置与变量组。
AI.method: 采用组特定的原型库适配局地特征并考虑跨变量依赖：(1) 将各组历史特征与时间变化同跨变量注意力的预报上下文结合，做演变感知的原型匹配；(2) 用原型特定低秩算子的稀疏混合，为每组和位置定制修正，再用门控注意力块在组间交换修正特征，且修正可分解为显式原型贡献；(3) 从头联合训练预报网络与算子，每个 epoch 前重拟合各组原型，并通过槽位跟踪保持原型-算子关联。
AI.result: 在 GlobalForecast 和 TyphoonTracking 上预报精度提升；原型删除实验将局地特征贡献与预测误差变化建立联系。
AI.conclusion: 显式原型机制可同时提升数据驱动天气预报的准确性和可解释性，为更准确、可解释的预报模型提供思路。

title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.

AI.tldr: 提出 ROAM-GRPO，在 GRPO 训练中将已熟练掌握的题目转入"off-mode"轨道，用 LLM 评判器筛选逻辑有效且互异的解题策略并自蒸馏回策略，从而缓解 SFT+RLVR 导致的输出多样性塌缩，提升 pass@k。
AI.motivation: SFT 配合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）虽已成复杂推理后训练的主流配方，但会使策略塌缩到低多样性模式：重复采样输出近乎相同，pass@k 随 k 增大收敛甚至下降。
AI.method: ROAM-GRPO 检测训练中已被良好解决的题目，将其转移到 off-mode 轨道；提示模型为这些题生成不同的解题策略，由 LLM judge 校验其逻辑有效性与差异性，再将合格策略自蒸馏进策略模型。
AI.result: 在 MATH level 5 的 1000 题子集上训练 Qwen3.5-2b，peak pass@16 提升 4.7%；在困难评测集上，正确输出的嵌入余弦距离提高到约 1.5–2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过在已掌握问题上鼓励"离模"探索并自蒸馏，ROAM-GRPO 在不牺牲正确性的前提下显著提升推理策略多样性，是 GRPO 的一项轻量增强。

title: LG-FiLM: Local-Global Mixture-of-Experts Modulation for RAW-to-RGB Reconstruction
summary: An image signal processor does more than reconstruct an image. It also has to decide how strongly to denoise, how to balance color, and which tone curve maps the scene onto the display, and these settings depend on the scene itself, the curve that suits a backlit sky is not the one that suits an indoor portrait. Most neural ISPs learn a single fixed transformation and apply it to every scene. We instead make the adaptation an explicit part of the network. Our model, LG FiLM, keeps one shared encoder decoder and places a small mixture of affine experts at its bottleneck; the experts scales, shifts, and mixing weights are predicted from local neighborhood evidence together with a global scene descriptor. Reconstruction stays in a single shared pathway and only the processing mode is switched. We evaluate LG FiLM on three datasets, Fujifilm UltraISP, Zurich RAW to RGB, and a COCO derived benchmark built with an inverse ISP. The model reaches the best reconstruction fidelity of the compared entries on the primary benchmark and transfers to the other two.

AI.tldr: LG FiLM 在共享编解码器瓶颈处放置小型仿射专家混合，用局部邻域证据与全局场景描述符预测缩放、偏移和混合权重，实现逐场景显式自适应的图像信号处理，在三个数据集上取得最佳或可迁移的重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有神经 ISP 大多学习单一固定变换并应用于所有场景，但去噪强度、色彩平衡、色调曲线等设置应随场景变化（如逆光天空与室内人像适配不同曲线），因此需要把场景自适应显式地引入网络。
AI.method: 提出 LG FiLM：保留单一共享的编码器-解码器，仅在瓶颈处放置一个小型仿射专家混合（mixture of affine experts）；专家参数（缩放、偏移）与混合权重由局部邻域证据和全局场景描述符共同预测。重建始终在单一共享路径中完成，仅切换处理模式。
AI.result: 在 Fujifilm UltraISP、Zurich RAW to RGB 以及用逆 ISP 构建的 COCO 衍生基准三个数据集上评估；在主要基准上取得对比方法中最佳的重建保真度，并能迁移到另外两个数据集。
AI.conclusion: 将自适应作为网络的显式组成部分（瓶颈处的 FiLM 式专家混合）是一种有效且轻量的方案，可在保持单一路径重建的同时实现场景相关的处理模式切换，并获得良好保真度与跨数据集迁移性。

title: X Hedging: towards an eXplainable artificial intelligence option Hedging framework
summary: We propose X Hedging, an alternative to the Deep Hedging framework that addresses computational and explainability limitations of neural-network-based hedging strategies. Deep Hedging leverages neural networks to learn flexible hedging policies but relies on opaque models and typically requires large training datasets, which can complicate interpretation and limit its effectiveness in data-constrained settings. X Hedging takes a step toward addressing these limitations by replacing neural networks with tree ensemble methods, specifically LightGBM, to estimate hedging strategies. This design provides a computationally efficient alternative while preserving strong hedging performance and moving toward more user-centered explainability. To integrate LightGBM into a reinforcement-learning-style hedging framework, we introduce an optimization approach that sequentially trains tree-ensemble models while introducing stochasticity through random training orders. In controlled experiments, X Hedging achieves performance comparable to Deep Hedging while offering greater user-centered explainability, improved computational efficiency, and substantially higher robustness when training data are limited. The numerical results demonstrate that tree-ensemble methods provide an effective computational alternative to neural networks for data-driven dynamic hedging.

AI.tldr: 提出X Hedging，用LightGBM树集成替代神经网络实现深度对冲（Deep Hedging），在保持对冲性能的同时提升可解释性、计算效率与少数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Deep Hedging用神经网络学习灵活的对冲策略，但模型不透明、难以解释，且通常需要大量训练数据，在数据受限场景下效果受限。论文希望解决其计算与可解释性方面的局限。
AI.method: 用树集成方法（LightGBM）替代神经网络来估计对冲策略；为把LightGBM嵌入强化学习式对冲框架，提出一种顺序训练树集成模型的优化方法，并通过随机训练顺序引入随机性。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，X Hedging的对冲表现与Deep Hedging相当，同时具有更好的用户中心可解释性、更高的计算效率，以及在训练数据有限时显著更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果表明，树集成方法可作为神经网络在数据驱动动态对冲中的有效计算替代方案。

title: GaussTrans: A Gaussian Interface Framework for Multi-Layer Refractive Transport
summary: We investigate surface modeling of multi-transparent interfaces to achieve accurate light transmission. The interplay of errors in geometric structure, light paths, and observation results during the reconstruction of transparent media with a high number of layers makes this a challenging problem. Some existing techniques address the reconstruction of transparent scenes by reducing the number of layers or simplifying light paths; however, this limits their direct applicability to high-order transparent scenes. We propose GaussTrans, a compact framework for light transport in high-order transparent scenes, consisting of three components: Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces, Transport-Coupled Refinement, and Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection. Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces use a hybrid approach combining Gauss surfaces and fields to reconstruct different interfaces. Transport-Coupled Refinement reduces coupling errors by evaluating the entire light path. Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection combines primitive support regions to reduce errors in the intersection of interfaces and rays. In experiments on datasets such as RefRef, GaussTrans achieves significantly higher accuracy with relatively low spatial storage requirements.

AI.tldr: GaussTrans 提出一种面向高阶多层透明界面的紧凑光传输建模框架，通过高斯-场混合表面、传输耦合精化与基元引导隐式求交三个组件，实现高精度透明界面重建，在 RefRef 等数据集上精度显著提升且存储需求较低。
AI.motivation: 多层透明介质重建中，几何结构、光路与观测结果三者的误差相互耦合放大，层数越多问题越困难。现有方法通过减少层数或简化光路来回避这一问题，因而难以直接适用于高阶（多层）透明场景。作者希望在不简化光路的前提下实现高阶透明界面的精确光传输建模。
AI.method: GaussTrans 由三个组件构成：(1) Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces——将高斯表面与场表示混合，用于重建不同特性的透明界面；(2) Transport-Coupled Refinement——基于整条光路的整体评估来降低误差耦合；(3) Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection——结合基元支撑区域，减小界面与光线求交时的误差。另根据摘要推断，框架整体以紧凑（低存储）方式组织高斯基元。
AI.result: 在 RefRef 等数据集上，GaussTrans 相比现有方法取得显著更高的重建精度，同时空间存储需求相对较低，体现了精度与紧凑性之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: GaussTrans 表明，通过混合表面表示、全光路耦合精化与基元引导求交的组合，可以在不简化光路与层数的前提下有效建模高阶透明场景，为多层透明介质重建提供了一种高精度、低存储的解决方案。

title: TRACE: Attribute Execution for Sequential Image Editing
summary: Given an image and successive user instructions, sequential image editing should return an updated image that satisfies each new request and preserves earlier requirements that remain active. This lets users develop a result without repeatedly restating or repairing their decisions. The difficulty is that a retrieved image can contain a valid color on an obsolete surface, while the current image may lack the newly requested material. Neither reference selection nor a precise object mask alone specifies how to reconcile attributes occupying the same region. We present TRACE, which separates the continuing attribute from its visual carrier and prioritizes local appearance operations under complete-request checks. Active-goal binding identifies what should persist, carrier selection supplies suitable current or newly generated pixels, and tonal calibration reduces tinting near highlights and shadows. Experiments across frozen editors, independent visual readers, new source images, and complete sequential benchmarks support joint color-material recovery and show how local execution preserves the surrounding scene.

AI.tldr: TRACE 提出一种顺序图像编辑方法，将"持续属性"与其"视觉载体"分离，并通过局部外观操作在完整请求校验下实现颜色-材质联合恢复。
AI.motivation: 顺序编辑需同时满足新指令并保留仍然有效的旧要求。难点在于：检索图像中可能在过时表面上存在有效颜色，而当前图像又缺少新请求的材质；仅靠参考选择或精确物体掩码都无法说明如何调和占据同一区域的属性冲突。
AI.method: TRACE 包含三部分：(1) 主动目标绑定，识别哪些属性应持续保留；(2) 载体选择，从当前图像或新生成像素中提供合适的视觉载体；(3) 色调校准，减少高光与阴影附近的染色偏色。整体以局部外观操作为优先，并辅以完整请求检查。
AI.result: 在冻结编辑器、独立视觉阅读器、新源图像以及完整顺序基准上的实验，支持颜色-材质联合恢复，并显示局部执行能够保持周围场景不被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离属性与载体、优先局部操作并做完整请求校验，可在顺序编辑中兼顾新请求与历史有效要求。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Self-supervised Vision Backbones Survives Distribution Shift in Radar Micro-Doppler HAR
summary: Micro-Doppler radar enables contactless, privacy-preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but deployment robustness remains underexplored. We compared full fine-tuning, frozen probing, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using subject-disjoint in-distribution cross-validation and few-shot cross-age, cross-orientation, and cross-dataset transfer. Full fine-tuning suffered negative cross-dataset transfer, while frozen features under-adapted on cross-orientation. Only PEFT avoided both failures. We paired DINOv3 with all-layer principal-singular-direction adaptation (PiSSA), to our knowledge the first application of a self-supervised image foundation backbone to radar micro-Doppler HAR. DINOv3-PiSSA ranked first among PEFT methods in every evaluated setting. Under our protocol, its Small variant matched the in-distribution accuracy of the prior Base-size PEFT state of the art using 4.5x fewer total parameters, with only 3% trainable. It surpassed a size-matched variant of that baseline in every evaluated setting, with transfer gains increasing with shift severity: 2.1, 6.6, and 8.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations attributed improvements to both pretraining and adapter recipe, with the pretraining contributing most under compound shift. Code and protocol are available at https://github.com/KeryanChelouche/udoppler-ssl.

AI.tldr: 首次将自监督图像基础骨干DINOv3结合全层主奇异方向适配(PiSSA)用于雷达微多普勒人体活动识别，证明其在跨年龄、跨朝向、跨数据集等偏移场景下兼顾泛化与自适应。
AI.motivation: 微多普勒雷达HAR虽具非接触、隐私友好优势，但部署鲁棒性（分布外/少样本迁移）研究不足；全微调在跨数据集迁移上表现负迁移，冻结探测在跨朝向时欠适配。
AI.method: 在主体不交叉的分布内交叉验证及跨年龄、跨朝向、跨数据集的少样本迁移设定下，对比全微调、冻结探测与PEFT；提出DINOv3 + PiSSA（全层主奇异方向适配）；辅以消融分离预训练与适配器贡献。
AI.result: 仅PEFT同时避免两类失效；DINOv3-PiSSA在所有设定中位列PEFT第一。Small变体以4.5倍更少总参数(仅3%可训练)达到此前Base级SOTA的分布内精度；相对同尺寸基线在三种迁移中分别提升2.1、6.6、8.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DINOv3-PiSSA是鲁棒、参数高效的雷达HAR方案，提升随偏移加剧而增大；消融显示预训练与适配配方均有贡献，复合偏移下预训练贡献最大。

title: From AI Surrogate to Engineering Tool: Toward Production Use of Fiber-Orientation Prediction in Crash CAE
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027), with technical appendices. 10 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables
summary: Crash simulations of glass-fiber-reinforced plastic parts are highly sensitive to the fiber-orientation field supplied to the material model. In conventional workflows, that field comes from resin-flow analysis, which requires molding-specialist support and takes about 25 hours of work per part. We previously proposed a surrogate model that addresses this bottleneck by predicting the orientation field in about 3 minutes. This paper reports the implementation, validation, and operational design that turned the model into an engineering tool for Honda design workflows. We present staged validation from 2D plates to production parts, evaluation against a predefined engineering angular-error criterion, and the expert review that approved design use in March 2025; the system has since been transferred to the crash-safety group and is in initial, limited use in directed fracture-prediction scenarios. The developed system combines injection-gate setting support for cases in which gates are unknown (90% gate-count accuracy, mean position error 11% of flow length), voxelization, surrogate inference, automatic mapping to the crash CAE model, and report generation in a single GUI. The complete orientation-preparation workflow takes about 0.1 hours, a 99.6% reduction from the conventional 25-hour flow-analysis route, and can be run directly by crash CAE engineers without molding-specialist support. As evidence of practical impact, component-level crash analysis using the predicted orientation field reduced the absolute peak-force error from 19.0% with an isotropic baseline to 11.4%, while confining predicted fracture to the test-observed region. The deployment lesson is that a surrogate model alone is not enough for practical adoption: gate-setting support, automatic data conversion, and shareable reporting are what make the model usable as a design tool.

AI.tldr: 将预测玻纤增强塑料纤维取向场的代理模型工程化为本田碰撞设计工具，取向准备时间从25小时降至约0.1小时（降99.6%），峰值力误差由19.0%降至11.4%。
AI.motivation: 碰撞仿真对材料模型所需的纤维取向场高度敏感，传统依赖树脂流动分析，需成型专家支持且每件约25小时，是设计流程的瓶颈；作者虽已有约3分钟出结果的代理模型，但单纯模型不足以被实际采用。
AI.method: 面向工程落地的系统实现与验证：集成浇口设定辅助（浇口未知时，浇口数量准确率90%，平均位置误差为流动长度的11%）、体素化、代理模型推理、自动映射到碰撞CAE模型及报告生成的单一GUI；开展从2D平板到量产件的分级验证，对照预定义工程角度误差判据评估，并经专家评审于2025年3月批准设计使用。
AI.result: 完整取向准备流程约0.1小时，较传统25小时降99.6%，碰撞CAE工程师无需成型专家即可直接使用；系统已移交碰撞安全组并有限用于定向断裂预测场景；使用预测取向场的部件级碰撞分析将绝对峰值力误差从各向同性基线的19.0%降至11.4%，且预测断裂局限于试验观测区域。
AI.conclusion: 代理模型本身不足以促成实际采用，浇口设定支持、自动数据转换与可共享报告才是使其成为可用设计工具的关键；该工作展示了从代理模型到工程化部署的完整路径。

title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.

AI.tldr: SEAF是一个双分支框架，用于多图多模态讽刺检测，将MLLM生成内容分工使用：实体背景增强语义、图像描述提供对齐统计，并通过文本锚定平滑聚合融合视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 多图多模态讽刺检测需要文本、视觉和上下文证据，但MLLM生成的辅助信息常混入有用背景知识与冗余视觉描述，需对生成内容进行选择性利用。
AI.method: 提出SEAF双分支框架：语义分支结合原文、冻结MLLM生成的背景和OCR文本；对齐视觉分支融合全局/局部视觉特征与跨模态、跨图相似度统计；采用TASA按图像与原文相似度加权，同时保留低字面相似图像的贡献；最后分支分数相加。
AI.result: 在MMSD3.0多图基准上，SEAF优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM生成字段按角色分工并配合相似度感知的图像聚合，可有效整合上下文语义与视觉证据，提升多图讽刺检测性能。

title: LIFT: Latent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Cell Fate Dynamics with Single Cell Snapshots
summary: Lineage tracing links cell states through clonal ancestry, but does not generally identify unique source-descendant pairings. Learning from such data therefore requires a model of conditional outcomes, rather than only the terminal population distribution. We introduce LIFT, a latent flow framework for probabilistic cell-state generation from lineage-informed couplings. Variational inference encodes alternative outcomes in a latent space, while a conditional prior enables sampling from the initial state alone. A Mean Flow decoder predicts future cell state directly, requiring one decoder evaluation per sampling, which makes it convenient to predict cell fate through large scale Monte-Carlo sampling. This construction combines a representation of one-to-many relationships with efficient sampling and an analysis of conditional prediction error. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate LIFT's ability to recover both population distribution and cell fate probabilities.

AI.tldr: LIFT 是一个潜变量流（latent flow）框架，从谱系信息提供的耦合关系中学习细胞状态的生成模型，只需一次解码器评估即可高效采样，从而同时恢复群体分布与细胞命运概率。
AI.motivation: 谱系追踪能把细胞状态通过克隆祖先联系起来，但一般无法确定唯一的"源—后代"配对。因此从这类数据学习不能只建模终末群体分布，而需要建模条件结果（一对多关系）。
AI.method: 提出 LIFT：用变分推断把多种可能结果编码到潜空间；用条件先验实现仅从初始状态出发采样；用 Mean Flow 解码器直接预测未来细胞状态，每次采样只需一次解码器评估，便于大规模蒙特卡洛采样预测细胞命运；并给出条件预测误差分析。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，LIFT 能同时恢复群体分布和细胞命运（fate）概率。
AI.conclusion: LIFT 将一对多关系表示、高效采样与误差分析结合，为谱系信息下的概率性细胞状态生成与命运预测提供了有效方案。

title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
summary: Simulation-driven design of real engineering components has to meet three conditions at once. It runs on few solves, since a nonlinear finite-element simulation of a 3D part takes hours; its design space has many values, the hundreds to thousands of values of the part's CAD model; and a better design often needs a redesign, coordinated changes of the part's proportions rather than local polishing of its surface. Automated optimisers meet at most two of these conditions. Classical optimisers, Bayesian or derivative-free, need a person to cut the design down to a few parameters, and on all the values they need far more solves; industrial shape optimisers move every surface node of the mesh in one solve per cycle, but only in small steps that polish rather than redesign. We ask whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can meet all three by joining what it knows with what the simulation shows. GPT-6 Astra edits a magnesium stent through a CAD geometry parametrisation of about 1,650 values, with a budget of 15 simulations; every proposal is built in CAD, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact, and the LLM reads the full results of every solve. Within that budget it lowered the objective, a high percentile of the strains in the stent's bends, by 32%; on the same budget, the industrial shape optimiser Tosca improved the original design by a tenth and then stopped improving. An earlier GPT-6 Astra design, 25% lower in the same objective, was checked in an independent, higher-fidelity model of the full deployment with crimping and damage: it was 14% less strained than the original after the full chain, and its most damaged spot began to fail later and carried 63% less damage at full expansion. LLMs can thus join their learned knowledge with simulation data to adjust more than a thousand design values and reach valid designs with real improvements.

AI.tldr: 用一个通用LLM（GPT-6 Astra）在仅15次仿真的预算下，对约1650个CAD参数驱动的镁合金支架进行整体改型设计，目标（弯角应变的百分位）下降32%，远超工业形状优化器Tosca（约10%即停滞）；另一设计在含压握与损伤的高保真全流程模型中应变降低14%、最大损伤点延后失效且满膨胀时损伤少63%。
AI.motivation: 仿真驱动的真实零件设计需同时满足三个条件：仿真次数极少（非线性有限元一次需数小时）、设计空间维度高（CAD模型数百至数千个值）、改进需要"重新设计"（成比例地协调改变）而非局部表面打磨。现有自动优化器最多满足其中两条：经典贝叶斯/无导数优化器需人工降到少量参数且所需仿真次数多；工业形状优化器每次一个求解只做小步的表面打磨。作者因此追问通用LLM能否结合自身知识与仿真反馈同时满足三点。
AI.method: 以镁合金支架为对象，基于约1650个值的CAD几何参数化，预算限定为15次仿真；每个LLM提案都被构建为CAD、划分网格，并做含大变形塑性与接触的非线性有限元仿真，LLM可读取每次求解的完整结果，据此迭代提出整体协调的改型方案。另将较早版本设计放入独立的更高保真模型（含压握与损伤的全流程展开）中做交叉验证。
AI.result: 在15次仿真预算内，目标函数（支架弯角处应变的高百分位）降低32%；同样预算下Tosca仅改善约十分之一随后停止改进。早期Astra设计（同指标低25%）在独立高保真全流程模型中被验证：完整压握-展开链条后应变比原设计低14%，最易损伤部位失效起始更晚，满膨胀时承受的损伤少63%。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够把学到的先验知识与仿真数据结合，在高维（上千个）设计变量上实现协调的重新设计，而非局部打磨，并在严苛仿真预算下得到真实有效且经独立模型验证的改进设计；为少求解、高维、需改型的仿真驱动设计提供了新范式。

title: Minimal Memory for Correctable Visual Continuation
summary: Given past images and known actions, visual continuation generates future frames from one evolving scene state. Keeping this state revisable matters when an object reappears or a later view changes an earlier interpretation. Once past images cannot be replayed, a summary sufficient for current rendering can lose candidates needed after correction. We establish matching sparse and dense bounds on the bits needed for later correction under stable observations and bounded disagreement. For static streams at the stated smoothness and margin scales, correction incurs at least logarithmic overhead in one dimension and polynomial overhead in higher dimensions. Coherent Archive Memory (CAM) stores geometric summaries with exact updates under clipped expansion and coordinate assignments, then uses historical existence constraints to select one state for all requested frames. Exhaustive photographic tests show strict worst-truth image-risk gains from joint witnesses, while controlled neural continuations recover positions hidden in the current view.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉延续中可修正的场景状态记忆问题，提出稀疏与稠密匹配的比特界，证明纠正需对数/多项式开销，并提出Coherent Archive Memory(CAM)方法。
AI.motivation: 给定过去图像和已知动作生成未来帧时，当物体重现或后续视角改变早期解释，场景状态需保持可修正性；一旦过去图像无法回放，仅够当前渲染的摘要会丢失纠正所需的候选信息。
AI.method: 建立稳定观测与有界分歧下纠正所需比特的匹配稀疏与稠密界；提出CAM，用裁剪扩展与坐标分配进行几何摘要的精确更新，并利用历史存在性约束为所有请求帧选择单一状态。
AI.result: 静态流在给定平滑度与间隔尺度下，纠正至少带来一维对数开销、高维多项式开销；摄影测试显示联合见证带来严格的最坏真值图像风险收益，受控神经延续可恢复当前视角中隐藏的位置。
AI.conclusion: 可修正记忆存在理论比特代价下界，CAM以几何摘要与精确更新实现有效纠正，在图像与神经延续任务上验证了优越性。

title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
summary: Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. This low-frequency estimation parameterizes a static milling force model that reconstructs the force behavior over one spindle revolution. Although the static model does not reproduce all dynamic effects, it captures the force distribution, load levels, and angular regions of highest tool engagement. The approach is evaluated on one milling machine across varying process parameters, engagement conditions, cutting tools, and two workpiece materials. Dynamometer measurements are required only for development and validation. Ridge regression achieves an $R^2$ of $0.984$ and $0.991$ for average-force prediction on the test data ($\bar{F}_x$ and $\bar{F}_y$). The reconstructed force behavior over one spindle revolution achieves an $R^2$ of $0.962$ and $0.982$ ($F_x$ and $F_y$) compared with the reconstruction based on measured force features. The method provides a cost and computationally efficient basis for process monitoring, tool condition assessment, and process optimization on existing machines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需外加传感器的混合方法：用机床内部信号和加工元数据通过岭回归预测平均铣削力，再参数化静态铣削力模型重构一个主轴回转内的力行为，R²达0.96以上。
AI.motivation: 基于铣削力的数据驱动监测可支撑工艺优化与状态监测，但工业落地受限于昂贵且侵入式的硬件和大量训练数据需求，希望在不改造既有（brownfield）机床、不增加传感器的条件下实现力监测。
AI.method: 利用采样率较低的机床内部信号与加工参数特征，训练监督学习模型（岭回归）仅预测平均铣削力；再用该低频估计值参数化一个静态铣削力模型，重构一个主轴回转周期内的力变化，替代直接学习完整高频力信号。
AI.result: 在单台铣床上跨不同工艺参数、啮合条件、刀具和两种工件材料评估；测力仪仅用于开发与验证。平均力预测测试集R²为0.984（F̄x）和0.991（F̄y）；单转力重构相对基于实测力特征的基准，R²为0.962（Fx）和0.982（Fy）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为现有机床的工艺监测、刀具状态评估与工艺优化提供了低成本、计算高效的基础；虽未复现全部动态效应，但能捕捉力分布、载荷水平与最大刀具啮合的角度区间。

title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
summary: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出System-One RSI框架，用在线OODA快决策内循环+离线多推理智能体递归改进外循环，在少量真实episode下实现亚秒级游戏控制并显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 推理模型多模态理解强但延迟高，难以满足亚秒级控制；快决策模型响应快，却缺乏新任务所需的细粒度经验，prompt与few-shot难以弥补。
AI.method: 受教练式运动学习启发，构建双循环：内循环为OODA高频在线环，决策模型将视觉观测与任务问题映射为结构化判断，再由决策树转化为定时动作，不调用推理模型；外循环由一组推理智能体离线完成递归改进——修订决策模型prompt与决策树、记录交互、从记录中导出监督信号、训练或部署更新参数，改进后系统回到环境生成下一轮经验。
AI.result: 在Snake、Zenless Zone Zero、Black Myth: Wukong中，用27B决策模型：Snake平均分从1.30提升至7.35；Zenless Zone Zero某评估场景完成时间中位数下降8.4%；Black Myth: Wukong中闪避策略平均存活时间为静止基线的11倍，进攻策略胜率从0%升至66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 仅需少量真实episode，无需专家示范、环境修改、沙箱或并行仿真，即可把学习到的区分固化为"外部肌肉记忆"，兼顾低延迟与持续自我提升。

title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
summary: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/VC-VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出VC-VQA，一个面向视觉中心知识推理的大规模基准，系统评测MLLM在细粒度视觉知识获取与多阶段推理上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多把视觉信息仅当作实体识别，依赖文本外部知识，未显式建模视觉信息在知识推理中的来源（内部/外部图像）与参与阶段（检索前/检索后）。
AI.method: 按视觉信息来源与参与阶段设计任务，要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索、并对检索知识与内部图像进行定位/验证/匹配；构建带可追溯文本与视觉证据的受控多模态知识库；在四种设置（无外部知识、给定证据、知识库检索、开放网络搜索）下评测21个代表性MLLM。
AI.result: 三点发现：模型在视觉中心知识推理上仍表现不佳；细粒度视觉知识获取是主要瓶颈；智能体式检索凸显多步规划与跨模态知识整合的价值。
AI.conclusion: VC-VQA为评估MLLM的视觉中心知识推理提供了更具挑战性的基准，代码与数据已开源。

title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at DATE 2027. Emre Uğur and Jiawen Qi contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10 percentage points of full attention, with RULER evaluated up to 128K tokens. At 128K tokens, DTS reduces measured scoring-pipeline latency by 38% compared with XAttention. On four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it achieves a 3.3$\times$ prefill speedup over a PyTorch full-attention baseline using FlashAttention-2 at 512K tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS)，通过锚点选块与并行打包加速长上下文块稀疏注意力预填充，保持精度同时显著提速。
AI.motivation: 长文档与代码库处理使长上下文注意力成为预填充瓶颈；块稀疏注意力虽能跳过不重要块，但准确给块打分的开销本身很大。
AI.method: DTS为免训练、内容自适应的瓦片打分方法：依据局部向量变化选择query/key锚点，冗余区少用代表、异质区保留细节；并行delta打包将序列切为tile对齐块并并发做有界局部扫描以加速锚点选择；最终用原始Q/K/V计算被选中的瓦片。
AI.result: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct上RULER(至128K)与LongBench平均分与全注意力差距在0.10个百分点内；128K时打分流水线延迟比XAttention降低38%；4块H100上512K token预填充较PyTorch+FlashAttention-2全注意力基线提速3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: DTS在几乎不损失长上下文质量的前提下，有效降低块打分开销并大幅提升长上下文预填充效率。

title: When Agents Play Differently: Localizing Human--Agent Behavioral Divergence with Conditional Distributional Testing
summary: Evaluating whether artificial agents behave like humans requires comparing not just average outcomes but entire behavioral distributions across diverse contexts. We propose a stratified framework that computes nonparametric discrepancy statistics within contextual cells, and discovers subgroup rules identifying where agent behavior departs from human play. We show that session-level metrics dominated by win/loss outcomes offer little signal beyond mean comparisons, whereas process-level metrics such as move efficiency reveal genuine behavioral differences. Applied to a commercial match-3 game, it uncovers patterns invisible to aggregate metrics: a playtesting bot is diverging substantially from humans in certain game modes, while showing no detectable divergence in others. We release our implementation as open source to support reproducibility and adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出一个分层框架，在情境单元内计算非参数差异统计，并用子群规则发现智能体行为偏离人类的具体情境。应用于一款商业三消游戏。
AI.motivation: 评估人工智能体是否"像人"不能只看平均结果，而需比较多样情境下的完整行为分布。
AI.method: 分层框架：在情境单元(contextual cells)内计算非参数差异统计量，并发现能识别智能体偏离人类行为的子群规则；区分会话级(胜负结果主导)与过程级(如步数效率)两类指标。
AI.result: 会话级指标除均值比较外几乎无额外信号，过程级指标能揭示真实行为差异；在三消游戏中发现某个游戏模式里测试机器人显著偏离人类，而其他模式无可检测偏差——这些是聚合指标看不见的。
AI.conclusion: 分层+过程级指标是评估智能体类人性的有效方法；开源实现以支持复现与采用。

title: D3-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images and videos, but every sampling step requires a full network evaluation. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing or forecasting network outputs across steps, but common approaches use per-model calibrated skip criteria or maintain per-layer prediction histories. We present D3-Cache, which applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to Diffusion sampling: it fits DMD to a short history of exact velocities and forecasts only the velocity that the scheduler consumes. A horizon-aware gate decides when to skip: whenever the network is evaluated, its output is compared with the forecast for that step, and the larger the error, the sooner the network is evaluated again, up to a cap on consecutive skipped steps. D3-Cache requires no training or per-model offline calibration curve and adds negligible memory. It shares one history length and risk tolerance across the four evaluated models. On four state-of-the-art image and video models, D3-Cache achieves speedups of 2.6-3.8x with high fidelity to the base model output.

AI.tldr: D3-Cache 将动态模态分解（DMD）用于扩散采样，对近期精确速度序列建模，仅预测调度器所需的速度，并用"预测误差越大、下次评估越早"的门控动态决定跳过步数，实现无需训练、无需逐模型校准、内存开销可忽略的加速。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers 生成质量高，但每个采样步都需完整网络前向，代价高。现有免训练缓存方法依赖逐模型校准的跳过准则，或需维护逐层预测历史，泛化性与开销不佳。
AI.method: 对精确速度的短历史拟合 DMD 做速度预测；引入 horizon-aware 门控：每次真实评估时将输出与该步预测比较，误差越大则越早再次评估，并设连续跳过步数上限。无需训练、无需离线校准曲线，仅少量额外内存，四个模型共享同一历史长度与风险容差。
AI.result: 在四个 SOTA 图像与视频模型上取得 2.6–3.8 倍加速，且与基础模型输出保持高保真度。
AI.conclusion: D3-Cache 以极简、免校准的方式把预测式缓存应用于扩散 Transformer 采样，兼顾通用性、低开销与显著提速，为免训练采样加速提供了可跨模型复用的方案。

title: Gradient Boosting with Kolmogorov-Arnold Units for Interpretable Regression beyond Pairwise Interactions
summary: Interpretable models for tabular regression, such as the explainable boosting machine (EBM), restrict a prediction to main effects and pairwise interactions so that every part of it can be plotted. When the target depends on three or more inputs jointly, this restriction costs accuracy, and a black-box model with post hoc explanations becomes the usual fallback. Here we present MJBoost, a gradient boosting method whose weak learner is a single Kolmogorov-Arnold unit $g(\sum_p φ_p(x_p))$ with penalized spline inner and outer functions. Each unit is fitted in closed form by alternating penalized least squares, starting from principal Hessian directions of the residual, and categorical and missing inputs enter the units directly. Because a unit depends on each input only through one inner function, the fitted model has an exact functional ANOVA decomposition into main effects, pair effects and a higher-order remainder, which one-dimensional convolutions compute. On synthetic targets of interaction order three to six, the test error of MJBoost is up to 13 times lower than that of EBM, and its decomposition recovers the true variance share of every order to within 0.04. On the 35 regression tasks of the OpenML-CTR23 benchmark, it has a lower test RMSE than EBM on 21 tasks and a higher one on 2 (geometric-mean RMSE -29.1%). On these tasks the main and pair effects of the fitted model explain a median 0.992 of its variance, so the model reads as plots where the data allow, and the decomposition measures the higher-order part where they do not. With Newton steps the same algorithm classifies: on 32 binary tasks of OpenML-CC18 its test log-loss is on par with that of EBM, and on 11 multiclass tasks its mean log-loss is lower than that of EBM on 8 and than that of tuned LightGBM on 7.

AI.tldr: 提出MJBoost：以单个Kolmogorov-Arnold单元为基础的梯度提升方法，在保持可解释分解的同时克服EBM仅限主效应与成对交互的精度损失。
AI.motivation: EBM等可解释模型将预测限制在主效应和成对交互，当目标依赖三个及以上输入的联合作用时精度下降，只能退回到黑箱模型加事后解释，缺乏可解释与精度兼顾的方案。
AI.method: MJBoost的弱学习器为单个Kolmogorov-Arnold单元 g(∑_p φ_p(x_p))，内外函数用惩罚样条；每个单元以交替惩罚最小二乘闭式拟合，初始化采用残差的主Hessian方向；类别与缺失输入直接进入单元。因每个输入仅经过一个内函数，模型具有精确的函数ANOVA分解（主效应、成对效应与高阶余项），可由一维卷积计算。
AI.result: 合成数据上（交互阶3-6），测试误差比EBM低至13倍，分解对各阶真实方差占比恢复误差在0.04内；OpenML-CTR23的35个回归任务中21个RMSE更优、2个更差（几何平均RMSE -29.1%），预测方差中位数0.992由主效应与成对效应解释；OpenML-CC18的32个二分类任务log-loss与EBM相当，11个多分类任务中8个优于EBM、7个优于调优LightGBM。
AI.conclusion: MJBoost在保持可解释分解的同时显著提升高阶交互目标的精度，数据允许时可读作图表，不允许时用分解量化高阶部分，回归与分类任务上均与或优于EBM。

title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek

AI.tldr: ForeSeek 将长视频推理从"反应式检索"转为"预测式探索"：先对未观测时间段形成视觉锚定的预期，再定向验证并根据新证据持续修正，失败预期可作为回溯信号；配合两阶段训练，在五个基准上以少 2.5–4.4 倍帧数达到相当或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的长视频智能体本质上是检索驱动，只能依据局部显著性被动抓取片段，缺乏全局时间规划，导致效率与准确率的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 ForeSeek 前瞻驱动视频智能体：对未见时间区域生成视觉锚定的预期，通过定向观测验证，并基于浮现证据迭代修正搜索，失败预期转为有原则回溯的信号；另设两阶段训练框架，为 MLLM 注入前瞻引导推理与高效决策能力。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准上，ForeSeek 稳定改善效率—精度权衡，相比最强的搜索式智能体观测帧数减少 2.5–4.4 倍，同时精度相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 将预测式探索引入长视频智能体可有效突破检索驱动的瓶颈，实现更高效且准确的长视频理解。

title: LIFT: Lifting Language-Controlled Image Fusion to Free-Viewpoint 3D Scenes
summary: Multimodal image fusion traditionally generates a single fused image from paired observations at a specific viewpoint, limiting comprehensive scene perception and adaptability to diverse perceptual objectives. To overcome these limitations, we present LIFT, a novel framework for our proposed language-controlled 3D image fusion (L3D-IF) paradigm that extends multimodal image fusion from 2D images to free-viewpoint 3D scenes, enabling language-guided fusion tailored to diverse perceptual objectives. First, LIFT formulates Semantic Modality Binding (SMB), which interprets language instructions to identify semantic targets and their associated modality preferences and grounds these targets in corresponding regions of a shared Gaussian scene, establishing persistent semantic-to-spatial correspondences for consistent fusion control across viewpoints. Second, Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance (LCGA) is developed to achieve scene-wide multimodal appearance modeling by combining adaptive multimodal blending with language- and viewpoint-conditioned appearance refinement, enabling spatially adaptive realization of diverse fusion appearances while preserving source fidelity at pure-modality endpoints. Finally, we construct a Multi-View Language-Supervision (MVLS) dataset that associates language instructions and calibrated viewpoints with modulated fused images, providing effective supervision for learning instruction-dependent fusion from finite multi-view observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIFT achieves coherent multimodal fusion across continuous viewpoints, accurate semantic target localization, and consistent regional fusion control under diverse language instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出LIFT框架，将多模态图像融合从2D固定视角扩展到语言控制的可自由视角3D场景融合（L3D-IF范式）。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态融合仅从特定视角的配对观测生成单张融合图像，难以全面感知场景，也无法适应多样化的感知目标。
AI.method: 包含三部分：1）语义模态绑定（SMB），解析语言指令识别语义目标及其模态偏好，并绑定到共享高斯场景对应区域，建立跨视角持续一致的语义-空间对应；2）语言条件高斯外观（LCGA），结合自适应多模态混合与语言/视角条件外观精修，实现场景级外观建模与区域自适应融合，同时保持纯模态端点的源保真；3）构建多视图语言监督（MVLS）数据集，将语言指令、标定视角与调制融合图像关联，为有限多视图观测下的指令依赖融合提供监督。
AI.result: 实验表明LIFT可在连续视角下实现连贯的多模态融合、准确的语义目标定位，并在多样语言指令下保持一致的区域融合控制。
AI.conclusion: LIFT成功将多模态融合推广至语言引导的自由视角3D场景，实现语义可控、视角一致的融合感知。

title: Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Transportation Electrification
summary: In power setpoint tracking (PST), an operator follows a purchased charging profile without overloading shared transformers or undercharging vehicles. PST is cast as a constrained Markov decision process that minimizes tracking error subject to overload and mean user-satisfaction constraints. Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning (TC-CPL) extends soft actor-critic with proportional-integral Lagrange-multiplier updates from measured violations, a residual on the incumbent dispatcher that is warm-started from its demonstrations, and a transformer-aware encoder shared by all ports. It observes no departure times or states of charge. Simulations (five seeds, 100 paired days) compare it with the incumbent, Round-Robin. On a 600-port, 122-substation district, raw overload falls from 3.59 to 0.0017 kWh/day (overloaded seed-days from 77% to 0.4%), and absolute tracking error falls by 27%. Delivered energy rises by 16%, and satisfaction rises from 0.959 to 0.989. On a 42-kW transformer with household load, overload falls from 1.86 to 0.0014 kWh/day and satisfaction rises from 0.974 to 0.985, but absolute tracking error is 22% higher. Against hand-set fixed multipliers, self-tuning is statistically indistinguishable on the district. On the single transformer, it raises satisfaction by 0.011 at similar overload, but a short sweep found a better-serving fixed pair. The overload multipliers stay below their cap.

AI.tldr: 提出TC-CPL：将功率设定点跟踪建模为约束MDP，用PI拉格朗日乘子自整定的软演员-评论家学习充电策略，可显著降低变压器过载并提升跟踪精度与用户满意度。
AI.motivation: 运营商需按购买的充电曲线跟踪功率设定点，同时不能过载共享变压器、也不能让车辆充电不足，需在无出发时间和荷电状态信息下满足过载与平均满意度约束。
AI.method: 将PST建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，最小化跟踪误差并受过载与平均用户满意度约束。TC-CPL在软演员-评论家中加入基于实测违约量的PI型拉格朗日乘子更新；在现有调度器上学习残差并以演示数据热启动；使用所有端口共享的变压器感知编码器；不观测出发时间与SOC。
AI.result: 600端口、122变电站区域：过载从3.59降至0.0017 kWh/天（过载种子日77%→0.4%），绝对跟踪误差降27%，交付电量增16%，满意度0.959→0.989。42kW含家庭负荷变压器：过载1.86→0.0014 kWh/天，满意度0.974→0.985，但绝对跟踪误差高22%。固定乘子对比：区域上统计无差别；单变压器上满意度+0.011、过载相当，但短扫描找到更优固定乘子对；过载乘子始终低于上限。
AI.conclusion: TC-CPL能在不观测出发时间与SOC的条件下同时大幅抑制过载并改善跟踪与满意度，自整定乘子与手工固定乘子相当且不触上限；但单变压器场景跟踪误差偏高，且固定乘子细调仍可能优于自整定，说明收益具场景依赖性。

title: Serialization Tax in Shared-Latent Exchangeable Decisions
summary: Accurate item probabilities can produce inaccurate group-level decisions. A system may score each item separately, yet act on whether enough hidden items succeed: show a slate, defer a panel decision, or inspect a batch. When items share an uncertain latent state, independent marginalization preserves means but removes dependence from the aggregate posterior. We call this error the serialization tax. For binary items sharing one success rate, classical convex-order comparisons give a more dispersed exact count law than any independent completion with the same total mean. We quantify variance and total-variation gaps, derive threshold separation under margin conditions, and connect posterior approximation to decision regret. Separate results cover non-binary outcomes, heterogeneous items, and sufficient posterior resolution. TaxScore identifies large hidden blocks with unresolved uncertainty near a decision boundary for routing to richer posterior heads. On pre-specified, hidden-target-free MovieLens 1M/10M audits, existing shared-latent heads improve high-score negative log-likelihood (NLL)/utility from 0.673/0.696 to 0.629/0.723 and from 0.670/0.691 to 0.639/0.715. Routing gives 0.006--0.012 full-population utility gains, with matched controls identifying their sources. Our code is available at https://github.com/SiminChang/Serialization-Tax-in-Shared-Latent-Exchangeable-Decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"串行化税"(serialization tax)：当条目共享不确定潜在状态时，对每个条目独立边缘化虽保留均值，却丢失聚合后验中的相关依赖，导致组级决策失准。作者用凸序比较理论量化该误差，并提出TaxScore路由方法。
AI.motivation: 实际系统常对每个条目单独打分，但决策依赖"有多少隐藏条目成功"（如展示列表、面板决策、批量检查）。独立边缘化会保留均值但破坏条目间依赖关系，使聚合后验失真，进而造成决策偏差。
AI.method: 将该误差定义为serialization tax。对共享同一成功率的二值条目，利用经典凸序比较证明：相同总均值下，真实计数分布比任何独立近似更分散。据此量化方差与全变差差距，在边际条件下推导阈值分离，并将后验近似误差与决策后悔联系起来；扩展到非二值结果、异质条目与充分后验分辨率。提出TaxScore，识别决策边界附近未解不确定性的隐藏块并路由到更丰富的后验头。
AI.result: 在无隐藏目标、预注册的MovieLens 1M/10M审计中，共享潜在头将高分数NLL/效用从0.673/0.696提升至0.629/0.723，及从0.670/0.691提升至0.639/0.715；路由带来0.006–0.012的全人群效用增益，并用匹配对照确认增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 对共享潜在状态的条目独立边缘化会产生系统性决策误差（serialization tax）。理论刻画其分布差距与后悔，TaxScore路由是可落地的缓解方案，实验验证了显著且可归因的效用提升。

title: Slide2PPT: Native PowerPoint Reconstruction with Localization-Guided Refinement
summary: Image-to-slide reconstruction must recover both visual appearance and native object structure for subsequent editing. Yet visually faithful charts and tables may lack editable series and cells, and direct code generation couples content prediction to rendering implementation. We present Slide2PPT, a model-agnostic, training-free framework that equips both open- and closed-source vision-language models with native PowerPoint reconstruction capabilities.
