Through a unified typed interface, the model predicts object records while a fixed renderer materializes their native properties, enabling integration with different backbones without task-specific training or architectural changes. Localization-guided refinement then connects visual discrepancies to object records for correction. Regional updates preserve unselected records, while whole-slide updates address cross-region relationships. Record refinement and targeted object editing support structural and attribute-level changes, with rendered feedback governing iterative acceptance. To evaluate this framework across diverse reconstruction demands, we introduce Slide2PPT-Bench, covering controlled elements, real slides, and scientific figures. Evaluation separately measures file production, rendered agreement, and native-object availability. Experiments across open- and closed-source backbones demonstrate substantially more reliable PPTX generation than direct code generation, improved layout and text recovery on scientific figures, and native chart and table interfaces beyond geometric primitives.

AI.tldr: 提出Slide2PPT，一个模型无关、免训练的框架，让开源/闭源视觉语言模型通过统一的类型化接口预测对象记录，再由固定渲染器生成可原生编辑的PPTX；并构建Slide2PPT-Bench分维度评测。实验显示其PPTX生成可靠性、科学图表布局与文本恢复、原生图表/表格接口均优于直接代码生成。
AI.motivation: 图像到幻灯片重建需同时恢复视觉外观与原生对象结构以支持后续编辑。但现有方法中，视觉上逼真的图表和表格可能缺少可编辑的数据系列和单元格；而直接生成代码又把内容预测与渲染实现耦合在一起，难以迁移与编辑。
AI.method: 模型无关、免训练框架：通过统一类型化接口，由VLM预测对象记录（object records），固定渲染器将其物化为原生属性，无需任务特定训练或架构改动即可适配不同骨干。采用定位引导的细化，将视觉差异映射回对象记录进行修正；支持保留未选中记录的局部更新与处理跨区域关系的整页更新；记录细化与定向对象编辑支持结构与属性级修改，并以渲染反馈驱动迭代接受。同时构建Slide2PPT-Bench，覆盖受控元素、真实幻灯片与科学图表，分别评测文件产出、渲染一致性、原生对象可用性。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源骨干上的实验表明：PPTX生成可靠性显著优于直接代码生成；科学图表的布局与文本恢复更好；并提供超越几何图元（geometric primitives）的原生图表与表格接口。
AI.conclusion: 解耦"内容预测"与"渲染实现"的类型化接口+固定渲染器范式，是提升幻灯片可编辑重建质量的有效路径，且具备良好的骨干通用性；配套基准为多维度评估提供了规范。

title: Seeing Beyond the Obvious: Complementary Semantic Guidance for Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning
summary: Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SalSPML) assigns each image its most salient positive label, leaving other classes unlabeled. Existing methods construct class-level Salient Prototypes from observed positives to guide the recognition of unobserved classes. However, since salient annotations favor visually prominent instances, these prototypes may not fully capture the visual diversity of hidden positives, resulting in insufficient positive supervision. To address this limitation, we propose CoST, a Coverage-guided Complementary Soft-Target Refinement framework that supplements Salient Prototypes with complementary class-semantic information. Specifically, CoST identifies semantically relevant candidates from unknown classes by leveraging task-learned category information and image-text semantic correspondence. The selected candidates are then aggregated into class-wise Coverage Prototypes to complement the semantic representations provided by Salient Prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce a ranking-based selective refinement strategy that identifies classes receiving stronger semantic support from Coverage Prototypes and selectively enhances their soft targets while preserving the base soft targets for the rest. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CoST, with strong performance gains over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CoST框架，用Coverage Prototypes补充Salient Prototypes的语义信息，并通过基于排序的选择性软目标修正，缓解显著单正多标签学习中正类监督不足的问题。
AI.motivation: SalSPML只给每张图标注最显著的一个正类，其余类未标注。现有方法用观察到的正类构建类级Salient Prototypes来识别未观察类，但显著标注偏向视觉上突出的实例，原型难以覆盖隐藏正类的视觉多样性，导致正类监督不足。
AI.method: CoST在Salient Prototypes之外补充类语义信息：1) 利用任务学到的类别信息和图文语义对应关系，从未知类中识别语义相关的候选类；2) 将候选聚合为类级Coverage Prototypes，补充语义表示；3) 引入基于排序的选择性修正策略，对从Coverage Prototypes获得更强语义支持的类选择性增强软目标，其余类保留基础软目标。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上验证了CoST的有效性，相较现有基线取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 用互补的覆盖原型和选择性软目标修正可有效弥补显著标注的覆盖偏差，是提升SalSPML性能的有效途径。

title: SEOYUN: Refusal-Inducing Exam Documents for AI-Glasses Pipelines
comment: 10 pages; research framework and analytical limits; no empirical efficacy results. Includes an author reflection in Korean in Appendix C
summary: Camera-equipped glasses can convert an examination page into a query to a vision-language model (VLM). Device detection addresses possession; a complementary question is whether an examination document can reduce the usefulness of an unauthorized capture. We present SEOYUN, an application-specific framework for refusal-inducing exam documents, with optical and encoder-level interventions as extensions. We use reverse jailbreaking to describe the direction of the objective: inducing abstention rather than bypassing refusal. Refusal induction and defensive visual prompt injection already have precedents; our contribution is a threat model, analytical limits, and an evaluation protocol for examination use. We distinguish refusal from correct-answer leakage, show why removing an added dummy option is not itself a reduction in the original answer space, and derive a sampling comparison under explicitly stated camera assumptions. The protocol separates digital, simulated, and physical inputs and requires held-out evaluation after subject-specific selection. A local CSAT candidate corpus and rendering harness have been prepared, but this version reports no model-performance measurements, physical validation, or human-subject results. Accordingly, SEOYUN is a research framework, not a validated defense or a basis for allegations against individuals.

AI.tldr: SEOYUN 是一个面向考试的"拒绝诱导"文档框架，用逆向越狱思路让拍照提问的视觉语言模型倾向于拒答，但本文只给出威胁模型、分析界限与评测协议，尚无实测结果。
AI.motivation: 相机眼镜可把试卷变成 VLM 查询；现有设备检测只解决"谁持有设备"，而作者追问补充问题：能否让试卷本身降低未授权拍摄的可用性。
AI.method: 提出 SEOYUN 应用专用框架：以光学层与编码器层干预作为扩展手段实现拒绝诱导；区分"拒绝作答"与"正确答案泄漏"；论证删除新增干扰选项并不等价于缩小原始答案空间；在明确相机假设下推导采样比较；协议区分数字/模拟/物理输入，并要求按科目筛选后做留出评测；构建本地 CSAT 候选语料与渲染管线。
AI.result: 本版本未报告任何模型性能测量、物理验证或人类被试结果；仅准备了语料与渲染工具。
AI.conclusion: SEOYUN 定位为研究框架，而非经验证的防御手段，也不能作为指控个人的依据。

title: Calibrate in Context: Efficient Data-Free Quantization from Small Synthetic Pools
comment: 21 pages, 5 main figures. Supplementary material included
summary: We enable accurate low-bit recovery from small synthetic pools by improving both image synthesis and student preparation. A grid with lower local response error can incur greater error in the student's block context. Functional Grid Calibration (FGC) selects activation scales and integer offsets against full-precision responses constructed from the student's current block input. With weights fixed during calibration, FGC evaluates candidates only at their consuming operators, bringing block context to calibration at nearly local-scoring cost. For DeiT and ViT, progressive inversion updates the same images through increasingly deep teacher prefixes. With 1,000 images, the complete pipeline exceeds MimiQ's reported accuracy in all 18 W4A4/W5A5 settings across nine backbones. With 256 images, DeiT-S and ViT-S reach 68.20% and 66.90% ImageNet top-1 accuracy at W4A4 in 26-27 minutes on one RTX 5090. The pipeline outperforms strengthened 1K-image MimiQ by 13.03 and 24.36 percentage points at lower preparation cost and the same recovery-update count. The same low-budget checkpoints retain their advantage on ImageNetV2.

AI.tldr: 提出改进图像合成与学生网络准备的低比特恢复流程，在少量合成图像（1000/256张）下实现高精度W4A4/W5A5量化恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如MimiQ）依赖小型合成图像池做低比特恢复，图像质量和学生准备不足导致精度受限；且局部响应误差低的网格反而可能给学生块的上下文带来更大误差。
AI.method: 两方面改进：(1) Functional Grid Calibration (FGC)——以学生当前块输入构造的全精度响应为目标，选择激活尺度与整型偏移，权重固定、仅在消费者算子处评估候选，以近局部打分成本引入块上下文；(2) 渐进式反转（progressive inversion）——用逐渐加深的教师前缀反复更新同一批图像。
AI.result: 1000张图下全部18个W4A4/W5A5设置（9个骨干）均超过MimiQ报告精度；256张图下DeiT-S/ViT-S在W4A4达68.20%/66.90% ImageNet top-1，单张RTX 5090耗时26-27分钟，比强化版1K图MimiQ高13.03/24.36个百分点，且准备成本更低、恢复更新次数相同；在ImageNetV2上优势保持。
AI.conclusion: 合成图像质量与校准学生准备相结合可显著提升低比特量化恢复精度，且在小图像预算下高效可行，具备泛化性。

title: Policy Improvement-Guided Replay for Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. Our analysis links correct-response likelihood gains to reference-policy advantages under an idealized KL-regularized optimal update and provides an endogenous-reward interpretation for general policy updates. CoLiR estimates scores from finite training rollouts and cached log-likelihoods, selects prompts at task boundaries, and replays them uniformly during subsequent training, with KL regularization restricted to replayed prompts. Memory construction only requires a small amount of additional cross-policy scoring but no additional response generation. Across three Qwen3-VL model sizes on MRCL, CoLiR achieves the highest mean final accuracy and mean task accuracy among the compared methods while maintaining competitive new-task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR)，从策略改进视角重访视觉-语言模型的持续强化学习，通过对比似然分数选择历史prompt回放，在MRCL上取得最高平均最终准确率与平均任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习以稳定性为导向，强调知识保留与干扰抑制；本文补充策略改进（RL基本原理）视角，关注如何保留已获得的性能增益，并用性能差异引理刻画历史性能变化，从而指导历史任务分布上的回放。
AI.method: 用性能差异引理将历史性能变化表述为当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势。为分配有限回放内存，提出CoLiR：对比最终任务策略在正确回答上的似然增益与初始策略在错误回答上的似然下降。理论分析将该增益联系到KL正则化最优更新下的参考策略优势，并给出内生奖励解释。CoLiR由有限训练rollout与缓存对数似然估计分数，在任务边界选择prompt，后续训练中均匀回放，KL正则仅作用于回放prompt；内存构造仅需少量额外跨策略打分，无需额外生成回答。
AI.result: 在MRCL基准上，跨三种Qwen3-VL模型规模，CoLiR在对比方法中取得最高平均最终准确率与最高平均任务准确率，同时新任务性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 策略改进视角为视觉-语言模型CRL提供了与稳定性视角互补的回放设计原则，CoLiR以低额外成本实现有效的历史prompt选择与回放，兼顾旧任务保留与新任务学习。

title: Studying AI Act Mentions: A first look at the impact of the European Union's AI regulation on Hugging Face
summary: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) entered into force in August 2024, and its obligations apply in stages. Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models have applied since August 2025, and transparency rules since August 2026. These obligations affect developers who share and deploy models and applications on public platforms such as Hugging Face (HF), the largest platform for distributing AI artifacts. However, little is known about how practitioners respond to the regulation in practice. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical study of explicit references to the AI Act on HF. We collected over five million records, including repository cards, discussions, and commits from Models, Datasets, and Spaces, and identified over 1,500 records that explicitly mention the Act. Two coders manually labeled these records using a primarily closed coding approach, and we analyzed the resulting categories per source. We find that explicit references to the AI Act remain rare across all repository types. Repository cards mainly contain claims of compliance and responsibility, like ensuring compliance or assigning responsibility to downstream users, and some claim that the Act does not apply because the model is not a general-purpose AI model. Discussions are used to report alleged violations of the Act, while commits mainly update artifacts that support compliance. Overall, compliance statements focus on who is responsible rather than how compliance is achieved. We believe that this calls for direct platform support, e.g., automated checks and documentation templates, as well as clearer guidance on the scope of the AI Act.

AI.tldr: 一项对 Hugging Face 上超500万条记录的实证研究，发现对欧盟《人工智能法案》(AI Act)的显式引用仍然罕见（仅1500余条），且合规声明多聚焦"谁负责"而非"如何合规"。
AI.motivation: 欧盟 AI Act 已分阶段生效（通用AI模型义务2025年8月、透明度规则2026年8月），影响在 Hugging Face 等公共平台分享与部署模型的开发者。但实践者如何实际响应该法规尚不清楚，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 对 Hugging Face 开展实证研究：收集模型、数据集与Spaces的仓库卡片、讨论和提交共超500万条记录，识别出1500余条显式提及AI Act的记录；由两名标注者采用以封闭式为主的编码方式人工标注，并按来源分别分析类别。
AI.result: 各仓库类型中对AI Act的显式引用均稀少。仓库卡片主要包含合规与责任声明（如确保合规或将责任转嫁给下游用户），部分声称因模型不属通用AI模型而法规不适用；讨论区用于举报涉嫌违规；提交则主要更新支持合规的工件。整体上门合规声明聚焦责任归属而非合规实现方式。
AI.conclusion: 合规实践停留在责任声明层面，缺乏具体落实。呼吁平台提供直接支持（如自动检查与文档模板），并就需要监管方对AI Act适用范围给出更清晰指引。

title: SkillLens: Action-Guided Dense Visual Dynamics for Proficiency Estimation
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, Project page: https://skill-lens.net/
summary: Human proficiency estimation is challenging because skill is a high-level and often subjective property that is not captured by action identity alone. Existing approaches leverage multimodal observations such as ego-exo video, gaze, pose, and inertial signals, but the gap between sensor-level evidence and abstract proficiency labels remains difficult to bridge. We present SkillLens, a proficiency estimation framework that uses atomic action descriptions as temporal guidance, rather than direct semantic supervision, to localize proficiency-relevant windows for dense visual-dynamics extraction. Each window is summarized into an action-dynamics feature and scored by a high-low prototype margin against higher- and lower-proficiency executions from the same activity-action category. Fusing these ego/exo PDM cues with a global ego-exo-gaze baseline through CORAL ordinal calibration, our method achieves 0.542 accuracy on Ego-Exo4D. Our project page is available at https://skill-lens.net/

AI.tldr: SkillLens 以原子动作描述作为时间引导定位技能相关窗口，提取稠密视觉动力学特征，并用高-低原型边距打分，经 CORAL 序数校准融合 ego/exo 线索，在 Ego-Exo4D 上取得 0.542 准确率。
AI.motivation: 技能水平是高层次、主观的属性，仅凭动作类别无法刻画；现有基于第一/第三人称视频、注视、姿态、惯性等多模态方法难以弥合传感器级证据与抽象熟练度标签之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 SkillLens：1) 用原子动作描述作为时间引导（而非直接语义监督）定位与熟练度相关的窗口；2) 对每个窗口提取稠密视觉动力学并汇总为动作动力学特征（PDM）；3) 在同一活动-动作类别内，用高/低熟练度样本的原型边距对特征打分；4) 将 ego/exo 的 PDM 线索与全局 ego-exo-gaze 基线通过 CORAL 序数校准融合。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上取得 0.542 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以原子动作为时间引导、结合原型对比与序数校准融合，可有效桥接底层感知证据与抽象熟练度标签，为细粒度技能水平估计提供了可行框架。

title: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching
summary: Few-step diffusion models are widely deployed for their efficiency. However, reinforcing them with black-box rewards, as is routine for multi-step models, faces two structural challenges. First, a few-step generator is a sampler rather than a score model, so its velocity is not the forward velocity of the generated distribution. Second, it must be anchored to the undistilled teacher, which shares no transitions with it. Existing few-step RL methods handle the latter with a marginal KL to the teacher, but each pays for the former in its reward credit. We propose Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples into shadow inputs and obtains the credit from their shadow posterior. From the KL-regularized reward objective, we derive a regression loss that turns reward values into a reward direction while anchoring the generator's outputs to the teacher and aligning the shadow inputs with the deployed inputs. Applied to 4-step generators, SPM achieves higher rewards with less reward hacking than prior few-step RL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM)，通过将少步生成样本重新加噪为"影子输入"并利用其影子后验获取奖励信用，将KL正则化奖励目标转化为回归损失，使奖励值变为奖励方向，从而在少步扩散模型上实现黑盒奖励强化。
AI.motivation: 少步扩散模型被广泛部署，但用黑盒奖励强化它们面临两个结构性难题：(1) 少步生成器是采样器而非分数模型，其速度场不是生成分布的前向速度；(2) 它必须锚定到与其不共享转移的未蒸馏教师模型。现有少步RL方法用边际KL锚定教师，但都在奖励信用上为第一个难题付出代价。
AI.method: 提出Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM)：将生成样本重新加噪为影子输入，从影子后验中获取信用；从KL正则化奖励目标推导出一个回归损失，把奖励值转化为奖励方向，同时将生成器输出锚定到教师，并使影子输入与部署输入对齐。
AI.result: 应用于4步生成器时，SPM相比现有少步RL方法获得更高奖励，且奖励黑客现象更少。
AI.conclusion: SPM通过影子后验匹配有效解决了少步扩散模型黑盒奖励强化中的信用分配与教师锚定难题，在提升奖励的同时减少奖励黑客，为少步生成器的RL微调提供了有效方案。

title: Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network
summary: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究脉冲神经网络（SNN）能否在学习人形机器人行走的同时保持生物合理性与鲁棒性，比较固定储备池、e-prop、奖励调制STDP与BPTT四种训练方案在Unitree H1-2上的表现。
AI.motivation: SNN在模拟生物神经培养物方面表现出色，但尚无定论：能否在保持生物合理性的同时通过训练实现人形机器人行走并维持鲁棒性能。论文希望厘清不同"生物忠实度"的学习规则在真实机器人控制任务中能达到什么水平，以及真实神经培养物目前能够和不能够产生的活动趋势。
AI.method: 提出一个生物启发的脉冲网络，在Unitree H1-2人形机器人上测试，并以强化学习专家策略+数据集聚合的蒸馏方式训练。按生物忠实度从高到低比较四种方案：（1）固定储备池（循环权重冻结，仅训练线性读出）；（2）同一网络但突触用奖励调制的STDP训练；（3）eligibility propagation（e-prop）训练；（4）循环权重用时间的反向传播（BPTT）作为非生物基线。
AI.result: e-prop达到100%存活率，与BPTT持平；固定储备池和奖励调制STDP虽然最接近生物培养物，但性能明显更低，存活率分别约为43.7%和11%。论文还进一步分析了真实神经培养物迄今能够与不能够复现的趋势。
AI.conclusion: e-prop这类带局部eligibility轨迹的在线学习规则可在生物合理性与性能之间取得良好折衷，实现与BPTT相当的人形行走控制；而更"纯粹"生物的方案（固定储备池、R-STDP）目前性能受限。最终在全身人形机器人H1-2上演示了短暂的双足行走。

title: Interpreting DeepStack-Style Vision-Language Models: Do Input or Deeper-Layer Visual Tokens Drive Answers?
comment: Includes the supplementary material. Code and numerical results: https://github.com/yucheng-du/interpreting-deepstack-style-vlms
summary: DeepStack-style vision-language models feed visual tokens to the language model at its input, and again at deeper layers. We call these the main entry and the later entries. What do the later entries add when the model already has the image? We give the entries versions that differ in one object's color and see which one the answer follows. On photographs, the original DeepStack follows the later entries, while Qwen3-VL-8B/32B follow the main entry. Does weakening the main entry give the later features more influence? On synthetic images, we keep this conflict and reduce color saturation at the main entry only. The unchanged later features gain a stronger effect on the relative scores of the two colors, in all four models, including Granite Vision. This holds even under mild desaturation, when accuracy without the conflict stays at 100%. To test whether later features can also correct errors, we degrade both entries and restore only the later ones. The same blur costs both Qwen models 50 percentage points of accuracy on stripe orientation. The 32B model recovers 48 points and the 8B model only 8. Accuracy with one clean entry predicted which entry each model can lose, and five of six tested predictions held on new GQA attribute questions. With the other entry zeroed, Qwen3-VL-8B loses only 0.3 points on its main entry alone, and DeepStack at most 3.45 points on either entry alone. In split inference on these questions, DeepStack can then send only its main-entry features at higher precision. This takes 49% fewer bytes than all entries at a shared precision, at similar accuracy.

AI.tldr: 研究DeepStack式视觉语言模型中"后续注入"（later entries）视觉特征的作用：它们不仅冗余，还携带对答案有实际影响且可纠错的信息。
AI.motivation: 模型在输入端已有图像token，后续层再次注入视觉token是冗余还是有用？论文追问later entries到底增加了什么、能否在主入口弱化或损坏时提供影响力甚至纠错。
AI.method: 构造同一物体颜色冲突的两个视觉入口版本，观测答案跟随哪个入口；合成图像中仅降低主入口色彩饱和度；双边退化后仅恢复later特征；并比较单入口干净时的准确率来预测各模型可丢失哪个入口；最后做分裂推理实验。
AI.result: 照片上DeepStack跟随later entries，Qwen3-VL-8B/32B跟随主入口；主入口弱化后later特征在全部四个模型（含Granite Vision）中对相对分数影响增强，且在饱和度轻度降低、无冲突准确率仍为100%时也成立。条纹方向任务双边模糊使Qwen两模型各掉50点，32B恢复48点、8B仅8点。单入口干净预测能力在六个预测中五个于新GQA属性题上成立；单独主入口时8B仅掉0.3点，DeepStack任一口最多掉3.45点。分裂推理中DeepStack可仅以高精度传主入口特征，字节减少49%而准确率相近。
AI.conclusion: later entries并非多余：它们能主导答案、在主入口弱化时影响力上升，并可纠错；入口重要性可预测，且可支撑更省带宽的分裂推理。

title: Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model
summary: Global Workspace Theory (GWT), a leading theory of consciousness, holds that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast to specialized processes that use it. Building a workspace into a network does not reveal what the trained network computes with it: a module that reports an answer may have combined a broadcast message with its own knowledge, or merely forwarded an answer computed elsewhere, and task accuracy and ablation cannot tell these apart. We introduce a causal protocol that identifies who computes when modules communicate. Its central test transplants a message from another input, chosen so that ignoring, relaying and recombining it predict three different answers. On networks built to relay or to recombine, the test assigns the right computation in every case. Among trained workspace models it finds all three outcomes: one leaves its broadcast nearly unused, and of two models that differ only in their training data, one relays and the other recombines. In AFGW, a language model whose modules communicate only through a learned workspace, a transplanted message yields the answer that recombination predicts in 97% of cases, and its content acts by redirecting what the receiver retrieves from its own memory. The tests carry over to other communication designs and to a known interface of a pretrained Transformer, turning GWT's central claim into a testable property of trained models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种因果协议，通过"移植消息"测试来区分模块通信时的三种计算情形（忽略、中继、重组），使全局工作空间理论的核心主张成为可检验性质。
AI.motivation: GWT认为信息被广播给专用进程即为意识，但把工作空间嵌入网络后，无法确定网络究竟用它计算了什么：报告答案的模块可能是结合广播信息与自身知识，也可能只是转发别处算出的答案，而任务准确率与消融实验都无法区分。
AI.method: 设计因果协议，核心测试是从另一输入移植消息，使得忽略、中继、重组三种情形分别预测三种不同答案；在刻意构建为中继或重组的网络上验证测试有效性，再应用于多个训练好的工作空间模型，包括仅通过学习到的workspace通信的语言模型AFGW，并推广到其他通信设计和预训练Transformer的已知接口。
AI.result: 在构建网络上测试100%给出正确计算判定；训练模型中三种结果均出现：一个模型几乎不使用其广播内容，两个仅训练数据不同的模型中一个中继、一个重组。AFGW中移植消息有97%情况给出重组预测的答案，且其内容通过重定向接收方从自身记忆检索的信息起作用。
AI.conclusion: 该测试可推广到其他通信设计与预训练Transformer接口，将GWT的核心主张转化为可检验的模型性质。

title: SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. Under the standard attack, restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted effect in the five models whose action experts attend to them. When the attack is constrained to keep the predicted future close to the clean prediction, the targeted effect can become more dependent on current-frame tokens. In three of these five models, restoring current-frame tokens removes 87-99% of the effect, compared with 9-15% for future tokens. In six models, restoring just 0.36% of the FFN neurons in layers 10-29 of the video expert removes 72-96% of the targeted effect. Residual directions 2-16 hold only 11-18% of the shift energy, yet removing them cancels most of the targeted effect.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SteerTrace，一种针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的通用定向攻击，并追踪其内部因果机制。
AI.motivation: WAMs 用单一骨干同时预测未来视频与动作，其"想象未来"常被视为安全信号；但这种可解释性/安全假设是否可靠尚缺乏针对性攻击与内部机制检验。
AI.method: 为每个模型学习一个 ℓ∞=4/255 的扰动，跨帧、任务、相机视角共享，将执行动作推向攻击者指定目标；在四个家族八种 WAM（FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM、LingBot-VA）与 LIBERO/RoboTwin 上评估；用有符号定向效应量化各干预（恢复未来 token、当前帧 token、FFN 神经元、残差方向）对攻击效果的消除或复现比例。
AI.result: 攻击使任务成功率接近 0 并显著推动动作偏向目标；同预算噪声与 BadWAM 几乎无定向偏移。标准攻击下，恢复未来 token 消除 61–94% 定向效应；约束预测未来接近干净预测时，攻击更依赖当前帧 token，三个模型中恢复当前帧 token 消除 87–99%（未来 token 仅 9–15%）；恢复视频专家 10–29 层仅 0.36% FFN 神经元即消除 72–96%；残差方向 2–16 仅含 11–18% 位移能量，移除却抵消大部分定向效应。
AI.conclusion: WAMs 的"想象未来"安全信号可被微小通用扰动绕过；攻击效果可定位到稀疏的关键子结构（当前帧 token、少量 FFN 神经元、低能量残差方向），为 WAM 鲁棒性与可解释性提供机制层面证据。

title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
summary: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On our own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO (2 of 4 training designs). At matched recall, the base model plus the probe beats truncation for 8 of 9 LLaVA-1.5 systems on COCO and 9 of 9 on AMBER, on the two newer backbones, and when realized as actual sentence deletion. The same measure prices training signals: DPO on the model's own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL (the probe 0.73 on InternVL2.5), both beat length-matched random labels, and CLIP labels buy more than probe labels on COCO. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator's precision falls below our pre-set bar, which we report as a limitation.

AI.tldr: 该文追问偏好训练降低物体幻觉的收益究竟由什么构成，并用冻结的十一特征事后探针做对照核算，发现大部分"超越少说"的增益可被简单探针复现。
AI.motivation: 降低 VLM 幻觉的偏好训练方法多以更低 CHAIR 分数自证有效，但分数下降可能主要来自"说得更少"，且缺乏独立、预先冻结的核算标准来判定真正的方法性增益。
AI.method: 将每个训练模型与"截断到相同物体召回率的基座模型"比较以扣除简洁性收益；剩余增益再与弱冻结探针（500张标注图像拟合的十一特征事后分类器）能复现的部分对照；所有标准在见到输出前写进分析代码并冻结；覆盖8个公开方法、SENTINEL、自研DPO检查点（Qwen2.5-VL/InternVL2.5），并做匹配召回率、实际删句、训练信号定价与人评。
AI.result: 探针在7/8(COCO)、8/8(AMBER)、6/6(Object HalBench)方法上复现≥2/3超越少说的增益，RLAIF-V为一致例外；SENTINEL在两种骨干上达标；自研DPO在Qwen2.5-VL成立、InternVL2.5在COCO部分失败(2/4)；匹配召回下基座+探针在8/9与9/9系统上优于截断；探针/CLIP标签DPO分别回收0.70/0.87的地面真值DPO增益；人评显示探针删句错误率更高，但CHAIR评估器精度低于预设门槛，作为局限报告。
AI.conclusion: 偏好训练相对简洁性之外的去幻觉增益，大部分可被一个弱事后探针解释，说明现有方法的"进步"被高估；探针本身可作为廉价后处理与标签来源，但CHAIR指标可靠性存疑。

title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
comment: 15 pages (12 pages main text + references), 12 figures, 4 tables
summary:
Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load.
  We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. While the forward pass runs uncut, FrontierReplay logs a short window of recurrent-layer inputs and invokes a cross-layer, state-only replay kernel to build the target state 6-37x cheaper per token than full recomputation without host synchronization. A frontier-aware retention policy prioritizes active anchors and proven branches while lending dead checkpoint slots to the attention KV cache.
  Across diverse hybrid architectures, model scales, and workloads, FrontierReplay delivers clear gains over existing exact caches, lowering median time to first token (TTFT) by 16-89% (up to 8.9x), raising 80% service-level objective (SLO) capacity by up to 1.73x, and improving goodput by up to 4.26x (3.67x at larger scales). Compared with approximate replay methods, FrontierReplay delivers up to 1.54x higher goodput while preserving exact task accuracy, avoiding the up to 17% accuracy drop suffered by approximation on long contexts.

AI.tldr: FrontierReplay 是一种面向混合语言模型的精确前缀缓存系统，它在可预测的结构边界（如轮次结束、分支点）物化检查点，通过不切分 prefill 前向、并使用跨层仅状态的 replay kernel 重建循环层状态，实现低成本精确缓存复用，显著降低 TTFT 并提升吞吐与容量。
AI.motivation: 混合模型（自注意力+循环层）的循环层原地状态更新使得前缀复用只能落在精确保存的位置。粗粒度保存浪费可复用前缀，而细粒度精确缓存需在 prefill 中每个检查点处切断前向，引入调度开销，在负载下得不偿失。同时观察到前缀复用几乎总终结于可事先预测的结构边界。
AI.method: 1) 在不切断 prefill 的情况下，于结构边界物化精确检查点；2) 前向不中断运行的同时，记录短窗口的循环层输入，并调用跨层、仅状态的 replay kernel 构建目标状态，无需主机同步；3) 采用 frontier-aware 保留策略，优先保留活跃锚点与已验证分支，并将失效检查点槽位借予注意力 KV cache。
AI.result: 在多种混合架构、模型规模和负载下，较现有精确缓存将 TTFT 中位数降低 16-89%（最高 8.9x），80% SLO 容量最高提升 1.73x，goodput 最高提升 4.26x（大规模下 3.67x）；比重放开销较全量重算低 6-37x/token。相比近似 replay 方法，goodput 高至 1.54x 且保持精确任务精度，避免长上下文下最多 17% 的精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 在可预测结构边界物化精确检查点并配合高效状态重放与前沿感知的保留策略，可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅提升混合模型的服务性能，优于精确缓存与近似 replay 两类现有方案。

title: SenseAlign: Learning Decision-Aligned Predictive Representations for Active Urban Sensing with UAVs
summary: Active urban sensing orchestrates a mobile sensor fleet to proactively inspect a dynamic road network and gather critical information for system management. This problem simultaneously requires understanding the complex spatio-temporal evolution and making decisions with partial observations. In this work, we focus on active sensing in a large-scale urban road network with utilities grounded in dynamic traffic states, while prior work has rarely considered these factors jointly. We propose \emph{SenseAlign}, a Reinforcement Learning-based (RL) framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations for coordinating an urban sensing drone fleet. SenseAlign first trains a privileged teacher agent that exploits future ground-truth traffic for optimal sensing choices. The student agent has an auxiliary branch that learns to predict future traffic with partial observations, in addition to the RL-trained actor and critic branches. During student learning, our framework matches the action distributions of the teacher under ground-truth and student-predicted future traffic, while keeping the teacher's observations unchanged. Such a design shapes the latent space for decision-making instead of prediction alone. At inference time, the student agent has no overhead as all this learning is done in training. We conduct comprehensive experiments with the real road network of central Barcelona containing 1570 road segments, and demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baselines on multiple utility formulations. The codebase will be made publicly available upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 SenseAlign——基于强化学习的决策对齐预测表征框架，用于城市路网中主动感知无人机车队的协同调度。
AI.motivation: 主动城市感知需同时理解复杂时空演化并在部分观测下决策；现有工作很少联合考虑大规模路网、动态交通状态效用与部分可观测。
AI.method: 先训练可利用未来真值交通的教师智能体；学生智能体在RL的actor/critic外增加辅助分支，用部分观测预测未来交通；训练中对齐教师（真值 vs 学生预测未来交通下）的动作分布且保持教师观测不变，从而塑造面向决策的潜空间；推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那市中心真实路网（1570条路段）上，多种效用设定下均稳定优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过决策对齐的预测表征可有效支持大规模城市主动感知，且不增加推理成本。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

AI.tldr: DACA将3D视觉定位重构为语义-几何双锚点协作推理，用两类可双向通信的工具智能体闭环优化，零样本显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-VG智能体虽摆脱预处理点云依赖，但采用单向流水线式工具调用，语义理解与几何重建割裂，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。
AI.method: 提出双锚点协作智能体DACA，含语义锚工具（保存目标视觉语义特征，通过光流与VLM局部验证实现跟踪）和几何锚工具（保存3D空间几何特征，通过体素化与多关键点投影进行全局空间推理），二者经标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决策下一步感知-动作，形成闭环优化。
AI.result: ScanRefer上零样本Acc@0.25达73.6%，Nr3D整体准确率70.4%，远超最新零样本3D-VG方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义-几何双锚点协作范式有效克服流水线架构的误差累积问题，为3D视觉定位提供闭环可恢复的新方案。

title: The Delayed Societal Cost of Unfairness
summary: Fair machine learning typically evaluates the societal costs of a decision policy -- the loss incurred by the decision-maker (DM) and the unfair distribution of costs among demographic groups of decision-subjects (DS) -- on static data, where reducing one often comes at the expense of the other. Yet decisions change the populations on which they act, and prior work has shown that fairness interventions designed on static data may fail to benefit, or even harm, the disadvantaged group over time. We investigate a complementary question: When can a policy that is Pareto-optimal on pre-deployment data be outperformed by a fairer policy once each is evaluated on the population it induces, reducing costs for one stakeholder without increasing them for the other? In a setting where qualification scores evolve in response to binary decisions and their outcomes, we show that under Rawlsian fairness, which never lowers any group's acceptance rate, placing sufficiently high weight on fairness reduces societal costs whenever accepting disadvantaged DS at the DM's break-even point leaves them in a state less costly to the DM than rejecting them. Under egalitarian fairness, which may lower the advantaged group's acceptance rate, this additionally requires the reduction in DM loss on the disadvantaged group to outweigh the increase on the advantaged group. Under both fairness notions, however, when DM loss is accuracy-based, improvements in the post-deployment population may arise from declining DS qualification, revealing that gains for the DM do not necessarily translate into better outcomes for DS. Our results show that policy-induced population dynamics can overturn apparent performance-fairness trade-offs, allowing fairer policies to reduce the delayed societal costs of decision-making.

AI.tldr: 论文研究决策策略引发的群体动态如何改变公平与性能的静态权衡，证明在特定条件下更公平的策略可在部署后同时降低决策者与决策对象的延迟成本。
AI.motivation: 现有公平机器学习多在静态数据上评估社会成本，而决策会改变其作用的人群，静态数据上设计的公平干预可能随时间失效甚至伤害弱势群体。
AI.method: 假设资格分数随二元决策及其结果演化，比较预部署数据上Pareto最优的策略与更公平策略在各自诱导人群上的表现，分别分析Rawlsian公平（不降低任何群体接受率）与平均主义公平（可降低优势群体接受率）两类准则。
AI.result: Rawlsian公平下，只要在决策者盈亏平衡点接受弱势群体使其状态对决策者比拒绝成本更低，对公平赋予足够高权重即可降低社会成本；平均主义公平还需弱势群体上损失下降超过优势群体损失上升。当决策者损失基于准确率时，部署后的改善可能源于决策对象资格下降，即决策者获益未必等于决策对象受益。
AI.conclusion: 政策诱导的人群动态可以逆转看似存在的性能—公平权衡，使更公平的策略降低延迟社会成本，但需警惕决策者收益与决策对象福利之间的错位。

title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
summary: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. Across eight independently optimized anchors in long-context reading comprehension and instruction following, AdaObs raises the mean score from $66.4$ to $73.7$ under a matched data budget, outperforming FixedObs, the anchor-only baseline. The evolved harness further improves the seven-task average on the independent PostTrainBench across two agent backends. These results identify observation adaptation as a missing mechanism of harness evolution for sustaining post-training RSI.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaObs：在锚点分数停滞时自适应调整"观测"（诊断粒度、难度、相关任务），保持锚点目标不变，使后训练递归自我改进持续有效。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练RSI循环仅用固定锚点基准的聚合分数作为唯一观测，一旦增益停滞便陷入重复探索；作者认为平台期可能源于观测枯竭而非能力枯竭。
AI.method: AdaObs是一种"观测侧"的harness演化机制：锚点目标固定，平台期时由控制器细化诊断粒度、升级难度、增加相关任务；经验证的增量融合回训练，所有检查点仍以锚点评估。对比锚点-only基线FixedObs，并经独立PostTrainBench与两种agent后端验证。
AI.result: 在长上下文阅读理解与指令遵循共八个独立优化锚点上，匹配数据预算下平均分从66.4提升至73.7，优于FixedObs；演化后的harness在PostTrainBench七任务均值上跨两种agent后端均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 观测自适应是维持后训练RSI所需的、此前缺失的harness演化机制；平台期不必然意味着能力上限。

title: Verifying Before Enhancing: Target Evidence Chain Verification for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection is essential for early warning, surveillance, remote sensing, and space-based target perception. However, infrared small targets are typically tiny, weakly textured, and boundary-blurred, making them difficult to distinguish from complex backgrounds. Moreover, target-like background structures can produce salient responses across multiple scales, making response strength alone insufficient for reliable target discrimination. To address this challenge, we propose VBE-UNet, a Target Evidence Chain Verification Network that assesses candidate reliability beyond response magnitude through complementary evidence cues. Specifically, counterfactual background explanation models local target evidence, while joint evidence verification integrates cross-scale support and perturbation-based contribution verification to guide feature recomposition. The resulting reliability estimates guide selective feature refinement, promoting target-relevant responses while reducing unsupported background activations. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUDT-SIRST, and NUAA-SIRST demonstrate that VBE-UNet achieves superior detection accuracy and lower false-alarm rates compared with state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies and evidence reliability analysis further validate the effectiveness of the proposed verification framework.

AI.tldr: VBE-UNet提出"目标证据链验证网络"，通过反事实背景解释与联合证据验证（跨尺度支持+扰动贡献验证）评估候选目标可靠性，而非仅依赖响应强度，在多个红外小目标数据集上取得更优精度与更低虚警率。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标极小、纹理弱、边界模糊，易与复杂背景混淆；且类目标背景结构在多尺度上产生显著响应，仅凭响应强度无法可靠区分真实目标与虚假响应。
AI.method: 构建目标证据链验证网络：1）反事实背景解释模块建模局部目标证据；2）联合证据验证整合跨尺度支持与基于扰动的贡献验证，指导特征重组；3）由可靠性估计引导选择性特征精化，增强目标相关响应、抑制无支撑背景激活。
AI.result: 在IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST、NUAA-SIRST上实验表明，检测精度优于现有SOTA方法且虚警率更低；消融实验与证据可靠性分析验证了验证框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 引入"证据验证"思想超越单一响应强度判别，可有效缓解复杂背景下的误检问题，为红外小目标检测提供可靠的候选筛选机制。

title: When Do Rankings Beat Signs? Gradient Direction Recovery under Even Nuisance
summary: Can ranking a batch of antipodal query pairs recover a gradient direction with fewer evaluations than using within-pair signs alone? We study fixed-center recovery in $d$ dimensions for a linear signal plus an unknown differentiable even nuisance, counting function evaluations and feedback rounds separately. Shared pair offsets create an information hierarchy: Mirror retains within-pair signs, Reverse couples reversed cross-pair orders to cancel offsets, and Full enforces all ranking inequalities. Relative shell variation is the nuisance range over the query sphere normalized by the linear-signal scale. When it is at most $c\varepsilon/\sqrt{d}$, Reverse localizes every consistent direction to angular accuracy $\varepsilon$ using $\widetilde{O}(d+\sqrt{d/\varepsilon})$ evaluations in one round at fixed confidence, without a variation bound supplied to the decoder. This matches a lower bound up to logarithmic factors, versus the $Θ(d/\varepsilon)$ one-round sign-only minimax cost on the same class. Over well-conditioned positive-definite quadratics with no common relative-curvature bound, the $R$-round minimax cost is instead $Θ(dR(\varepsilon^{-1/R}-1))$, even with cumulative rankings. We extend validity beyond exact evenness under supplied error bounds. Matched-endpoint experiments certify information beyond signs and short cycles. On two ridge tasks under joint evaluation and round caps, short-cycle recovery attains lower terminal mean gaps than the tested batch-capable controls. An additional optimization benefit from fitting the complete ranking remains unestablished.

AI.tldr: 该文研究批量对立查询对（antipodal pair）的排序能否比仅用配对符号更省评估地恢复梯度方向，提出 Reverse/Full 等排序模式并证明在相对壳变化较小时可达到近最优复杂度。
AI.motivation: 希望用批量的对立查询对排序反馈，在更少函数评估下恢复梯度方向，超越仅利用配对符号（sign-only）的Θ(d/ε)代价。
AI.method: 将评估次数与反馈轮数分开计数，构造信息层次：Mirror（仅配对符号）、Reverse（反向跨对顺序以抵消偏移）、Full（全部排序不等式）；以相对壳变化刻画干扰项范围，给出算法与下界，并扩展到非精确偶函数及正定二次情形。
AI.result: 当相对壳变化≤cε/√d时，Reverse 单轮以Õ(d+√(d/ε))次评估将一致方向定位到角度ε，且无需向解码器提供变化界，上界与下界在日志因子内匹配；二次情形R轮最小最大代价为Θ(dR(ε^{-1/R}-1))；实验验证排序包含超越符号的信息，并在两 ridge 任务上取得更低终端平均间隙。
AI.conclusion: 批量对立对排序可在温和条件下以近最优评估量恢复方向，短循环恢复与完整排序拟合是实用方向，但拟合完整排序带来的额外优化收益尚未确立。

title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
summary: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.

AI.tldr: FrontierOR Challenge 提出以竞赛形式构建 agentic workflow，让 LLM agent 自动为多种运筹优化问题设计、测试并改进算法，分两阶段（60道基准题 + 未见新题）、两条赛道（隔离沙箱 / 自托管），以可行性与目标值比值排名。
AI.motivation: 传统运筹学算法需专家针对每个问题手工定制，耗时数周；LLM agent 已能写改代码，但其能否设计出适配真实规模实例的算法尚不明确——现有 FrontierOR 一次性评测中，最强模型仅在 39% 的大规模实例上接近 Gurobi（目标值差 1% 内且不更慢）。
AI.method: 公开赛事设计：Stage 1 从 180 道审计题中释放 60 道（六大应用类别、五种建模形式），每周 15 题分批；Stage 2 引入基准外新题与未见实例。设两条独立排名赛道：Main 赛道在仅含开源依赖的网络隔离沙箱中运行提交算法；Self-hosted 赛道允许队伍在自有机器上使用任意软件限时求解。所有解进行可行性检验，可行解按目标值与冻结参考解的比值在隐藏实例上平均计分。
AI.result: 提供了可复现、防作弊的多阶段评测框架：分周难度递进、隐藏实例评分、参考目标冻结、双赛道并行，可系统性衡量 agentic 算法设计的泛化与规模化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战将 LLM agent 的算法设计能力从一次性评测推进到可规模化、可泛化、可验证的竞赛式基准，为运筹自动算法设计建立统一比较平台。

title: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
summary: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.

AI.tldr: WhisperBox 让扬声器激发箱体振动，经激光散斑-相机阵列远距测振，学习隐表示并解码出箱内物体的2D占据布局，实现无接触、无视线条件下的内容推断。
AI.motivation: 箱内物体会改变箱体的机械响应，若能仅从可见壁面的表面振动读出这些变化，就可"看穿"不透明箱体；现有方法多需接触激励/传感或依赖可见光视线，缺乏纯远程的布局推断手段。
AI.method: 用一个附近扬声器做非接触激励，在单一可见壁上布置激光点阵，用相机测量每个点散斑图案的位移以获取振动；训练模型把振动编码为隐表示，再解码为箱内物体的二维占据图；训练/测试覆盖多种箱体与单/多物体场景，并考察对未见物体实例、位置、朝向、重量以及激光布点和激励源变化的泛化。
AI.result: 在多种箱体与单/多物体场景下实现布局恢复，并对未见实例、位置、朝向、重量、激光布置与激励源变化保持泛化；分析表明最有信息量的频带不必与箱体共振频率重合，且学到的隐空间编码了物体位置并支持算术运算。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明远程振动传感可在不可见的条件下推断空间布局，为"隔箱感知"提供了可行的非接触方案，并揭示了频带选择与非共振信息利用等有价值的机理线索。

title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. At matched settings with uniform ranks and WikiText-2 calibration, Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. Replacing the $L_2$ distance by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL-SVD), with the same estimation framework, lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods throughout.

AI.tldr: Complete-SVD is a post-training low-rank compression method for LLMs that minimizes the L2 distance between original and compressed model logits (all logit changes weighted equally), reducing the objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution via network linearization and Kronecker-factored approximation; an unbiased random-probe estimator handles the intractable output-side factor.
AI.motivation: Post-training low-rank compression must preserve the model's input-output behavior, not just approximate weights. Existing output-aware methods weight logit changes by the observed next token or predicted probabilities—an arbitrary/unequal weighting. The authors argue all logit changes should be weighted equally, i.e., directly minimize model-output L2 error.
AI.method: Linearize the network around original weights and apply a Kronecker-factored approximation, turning the logit-L2 objective into a weighted SVD with closed-form solution. The output-side factor is intractable, so it is estimated without bias from random probes at a cost of K backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. A KL-divergence variant (KL-SVD) reuses the same estimation framework.
AI.result: At matched settings (uniform ranks, WikiText-2 calibration), Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. KL-SVD lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also consistently improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods.
AI.conclusion: Equal weighting of all logit changes yields a principled, closed-form low-rank compression that generalizes better across corpora and preserves instruction-following; KL-based weighting trades cross-corpus robustness for calibration fit and downstream accuracy.

title: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
summary: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions. In laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), melt pool width, depth, and melting mode (conduction, transition, or keyhole) govern process stability and defect formation. Conventional ML models typically use dimensional process parameters, which represent laser-material interactions only implicitly and may limit cross-material transfer. This study evaluates whether two physics-informed dimensionless features, normalized enthalpy and Peclet number, combining laser processing conditions with material thermophysical properties, improve melt pool prediction over raw process parameters. We systematically benchmark seven models: four classical ML methods (Gaussian process, support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost) and three pretrained tabular foundation models (TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICLv2). Experiments span 316L stainless steel, IN625, IN718, and combined-material datasets, covering regression of melt pool width and depth and classification of melting modes. Dimensionless features yield comparable or superior predictive performance in most settings, with the largest gains in cross-material depth prediction (R^2 = 0.96). Tabular foundation models generally achieve stronger classification performance than classical baselines, particularly for multi-material datasets. These findings indicate that combining physically meaningful dimensionless representations with pretrained tabular models can improve data-efficient melt pool modeling and support more transferable process-window identification in LPBF.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估无量纲物理特征（归一化焓与Peclet数）能否提升LPBF熔池预测的泛化性，并系统对比7种模型在多种材料上的表现。
AI.motivation: 先进制造ML模型缺乏泛化性与数据效率：实验数据有限，且工艺-性能关系随材料和工况变化。常规模型使用有量纲工艺参数，仅隐式表达激光-材料相互作用，限制跨材料迁移。
AI.method: 引入两个物理信息无量纲特征——归一化焓与Peclet数（融合激光工艺条件与材料热物性），基准测试7个模型：高斯过程、SVM、随机森林、XGBoost，以及预训练表格基础模型TabPFN、TabDPT、TabICLv2；数据集覆盖316L、IN625、IN718及混合材料，任务为熔池宽度/深度回归与熔化模式（导热/过渡/匙孔）分类。
AI.result: 无量纲特征在多数情形下性能相当或更优，跨材料深度预测提升最大（R²=0.96）；表格基础模型分类性能普遍强于经典基线，尤以多材料数据集明显。
AI.conclusion: 将物理意义明确的无量纲表征与预训练表格模型结合，可改善数据高效的熔池建模，并支持LPBF中更具可迁移性的工艺窗口识别。

title: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection
summary: Skeleton graph attention for autism video analysis weights joints by content alone, giving an erratic wrist the same standing as a still one. Stereotypy, however, is defined by how unpredictably movement unfolds rather than how much of it occurs: in our cohort, every amplitude-based kinematic descriptor falls in stereotyped clips, while windowed Sample Entropy of angular velocity alone rises (Hedges' g = +1.05). We compute this irregularity as a per-joint, per-frame tensor that structurally drives computation. The proposed chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts model (CGM) couples two mechanisms. First, a learned pairwise term added to the graph-attention logit concentrates attention on irregular joints and re-ranks the remaining edge weight toward jointly irregular pairs; its unconstrained coefficient neither vanishes nor inverts, and zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips. Second, a gate conditioned on the same signal routes each frame to two of four experts, whose weights track frame-level irregularity. Under subject-grouped five-fold cross-validation on 116 clips, CGM reaches 0.930 balanced accuracy, exceeding the graph-attention baseline by +0.187; the component ordering replicates on the public MMASD dataset, and on held-out Panoptic Studio sessions, CGM keeps 0.86 specificity without retraining, against at most 0.35 for chaos-free baselines. In ablation, routing without irregularity yields no reliable gain, whereas chaos modulation alone contributes +0.132. A severity index from the same tensor reaches 0.87 split-half reliability, separates the cohorts with Hedges' g = +1.08, and stays consistent within children across therapy recordings, supporting video-only monitoring of stereotypy during intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出混沌引导图注意力与专家混合模型（CGM），用角速度样本熵刻画关节运动的不规则性，并将其作为逐关节逐帧张量直接驱动注意力与路由，用于自闭症刻板行为视频识别。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架图注意力仅按内容给关节加权，使"乱晃的手腕"与"静止的手腕"权重相同；而刻板行为的本质是运动展开的不可预测性，而非运动幅度。数据也显示幅度类运动学指标无法区分，唯有角速度的窗口样本熵上升（Hedges' g=+1.05）。
AI.method: 以角速度窗口样本熵计算逐关节、逐帧的不规则性张量；机制一在图注意力logit中加入学习到的成对项，聚焦不规则关节并向联合不规则关节对重排边权；机制二用同一信号作为门控，将每帧路由到4个专家中的2个。采用受试者分组的五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 116段视频上CGM达到0.930平衡准确率，比图注意力基线高+0.187；组件顺序在公开MMASD数据集上复现；在未重训练的Panoptic Studio留出会话上保持0.86特异度（无混沌基线至多0.35）。消融显示：不含不规则性的路由无可靠增益，仅混沌调制即贡献+0.132。同一张量导出的严重度指数分半信度0.87、组间Hedges' g=+1.08，且儿童跨治疗录像内保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 运动不规则性应作为结构性计算信号而非辅助特征；该框架支持仅凭视频在干预过程中监测刻板行为及其严重度，并具备跨数据集、跨会话的泛化能力。

title: Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support
summary: Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity scores to trajectories and an \emph{Explorer} that performs guided generation of high-scarcity and high-return trajectories, thereby bootstrapping from the narrow support with such self-generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on the industrial AuctionNet benchmark demonstrate that ISGE, starting from cold-start datasets, effectively surpasses the performance of the Full-Dataset baseline within three iterations. Code is available at https://github.com/alimama-tech/ISGE

AI.tldr: 针对在线广告自动出价冷启动场景中扩散式AIGB方法在迭代训练时外推停滞的问题，论文将停滞归因于信噪比(SNR)崩溃，并提出迭代稀缺引导探索(ISGE)框架，通过“稀缺性信号”接管引导来突破狭窄数据支撑，三个迭代内即超越全量数据基线。
AI.motivation: 实际冷启动场景历史数据质量低、支撑狭窄，需靠迭代训练弥补；但代表性扩散式AI生成出价(AIGB)方法在迭代训练中无法外推到数据支撑之外，停滞在次优水平，亟需解释并解决这一停滞。
AI.method: 理论分析：将停滞归因于SNR崩溃——微弱的径向回报信号被曲率诱导的惩罚淹没。方法ISGE引入“引导交接”机制：当回报信号崩溃时，由稀缺性接管作为探索信号，把SNR提升到临界阈值以上。具体交替迭代执行两个模块：Judger为轨迹分配稀缺性分数，Explorer在引导下生成高稀缺且高回报的轨迹，以自生成轨迹从狭窄支撑中自举。
AI.result: 在工业级AuctionNet基准上，ISGE从冷启动数据集出发，在三次迭代内即有效超越Full-Dataset基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: ISGE通过理论揭示的SNR崩溃机制与稀缺性引导交接设计，有效打破扩散式自动出价在冷启动迭代训练中的外推停滞，实现从狭窄数据支撑的自举式性能提升，并具备工业落地价值。

title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
comment: https://twinlab-bench.github.io/ contains tasks and code. 33 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. LLM-agent benchmark for autonomous experimental design in digital twins of real labs (physics, chemistry, wet-lab biology, materials, engineering). 13 agents evaluated: Claude Fable 5.2 45.0, Opus 5.5 40.2, GPT-6.1-sol 31.7, plus DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and others
summary: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.

AI.tldr: 提出 TwinLab-Bench 基准，用 52 个真实实验室任务评估 AI 科学家"自主设计实验"的能力，每任务配一个 TwinLab agent 作为环境执行设计并给出基于真实记录的读数，前沿模型最高仅 45.0 分。
AI.motivation: AI agent 被期望充当 AI 科学家，需具备三级开放能力：正确执行给定流程、从给定设计空间选下一步测量、自主设计实验。现有基准主要只评估前两项（终端操作或在预定义候选中闭环选择），缺乏对第三项能力——且需要真实实验室读数支撑——的可靠评测。
AI.method: 构建 TwinLab-Bench，覆盖物理、生命科学与工程领域的 52 个任务、100+ 种实验动作类型。每个任务配备一个 TwinLab agent 充当环境：读取实验室原始材料、调用由其记录构建的计算器，执行被测 agent 设计的实验；被测 agent 的报告与取自真实实验室记录的隐藏答案比对。另用闭卷探针控制模型从记忆直接作答，并对比仅看任务描述的纯语言模型。
AI.result: TwinLab agent 相比仅见任务描述的 LLM，几乎消除了偏离真实记录的读数和对重复请求的不一致回答。任务对前沿模型仍属困难：最强模型 Claude Fable 5.2 平均得分仅 45.0，并对其失败模式进行了实证分析。
AI.conclusion: 自主设计实验是当前 AI 科学家的显著短板，TwinLab-Bench 提供了首个以真实实验室记录为锚的评测方案，并揭示了前沿模型的主要失败点。

title: Towards High-Fidelity Learned Video Compression
summary: Professional video workflows operate at qualities that learned video codecs do not reach. We measure how much of a professional quality range a codec covers, from the lowest quality of the standard test conditions, VVC at QP 37, to the highest 4:2:2 grade of the production codec ProRes. To compare inter-frame coding alone, every codec receives original frames as references at the intra positions. On 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 test sequences, four recent learned codecs cover 24 to 38% of this range. Their encoders are feed-forward networks with a fixed latent capacity, the number of latent values per sample, of at most 0.25, and removing their quantization raises the quality by at most 1 dB. We propose a learned inter-frame codec whose encoder searches, as the encoders of conventional codecs do. It searches block motion, which a learned network refines, and it searches among learned block transforms whose latent capacity ranges up to 1, selecting the partition, the skip decisions, and the quantized coefficients by a rate-distortion cost. Our codec reaches the upper end of the range on all six sequences. With all residual blocks fixed to 16x16, whose latent capacity is 0.25, the same codec covers 55% of the range, with or without quantization.

AI.tldr: 现有学习型视频编解码器无法覆盖专业级视频质量范围；本文提出一种"搜索式"学习帧间编解码器，用编码器搜索运动、学习变换与量化决策，在10-bit 4:2:2序列上覆盖了该质量范围的高端。
AI.motivation: 专业视频工作流（如ProRes 4:2:2级）所需的质量远超当前学习型视频编解码器所能达到的水平。作者希望量化这一差距，弄清学习型编解码器为何达不到高专业质量：其编码器为前馈网络、隐容量固定且偏低（≤0.25），去除量化后质量提升至多1 dB，说明瓶颈不在量化而在编码器结构与容量。
AI.method: 1）定义专业质量范围：从VVC QP 37（标准测试条件最低质量）到ProRes 4:2:2最高等级，在10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2序列上测量各编解码器覆盖比例；帧间位置均输入原始参考帧，只比较帧间编码能力。2）提出学习型帧间编解码器，编码器像传统编解码器一样进行搜索：搜索块运动并由学习网络精化；在隐容量最高达1的学习块变换中选择，通过率失真代价联合选择划分、skip决策与量化系数。
AI.result: 四个近期学习型编解码器仅覆盖该质量范围的24–38%，去除量化最多提升1 dB。所提编解码器在全部六条序列上达到该范围的高端；当所有残差块固定为16×16（隐容量0.25）时，同一编解码器覆盖55%的范围，且有无量化结果相当。
AI.conclusion: 学习型编解码器的核心限制在于前馈、固定低隐容量的编码器设计，而非量化。引入类似传统编解码器的搜索机制（运动、变换、划分与量化决策的率失真优化）可显著提升质量覆盖，使学习型编解码器具备进入专业质量区间的潜力。

title: RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed
summary: When a familiar rule stops working, an agent has to weigh what pre-training taught it against what it now observes. We ask how outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) changes this balance, in a puzzle world where both sides are known: small language models trained from scratch on games played by a Bayesian player, so that the prior and the right answer are exact. Base models hedge as their corpus did, and RL turns that hedging into decisions, in whichever direction the reward favours. But RL can only reinforce what it sees succeed. When the right action is rare, each run either learns it everywhere or not at all, and which runs take off is predicted before training by one count: the expected number of groups of attempts in which the action wins. About 35 such groups give even odds. The count holds for new and repeated problems and for groups of 4 to 256 attempts, and across learning rates, optimizers, GRPO variants and model sizes from 1.3M to 85M parameters, which move the threshold but not what is counted.

AI.tldr: 论文以小语言模型在"贝叶斯玩家博弈"拼图世界从头训练来同时精确已知先验与正确答案，研究结果奖励 RL 如何改变"预训练先验 vs 当前观察"的权衡。核心发现：RL 只能强化它见到的成功；当正确动作稀有，单次训练要么处处学会、要么完全学不会，而能否起飞可在训练前用一个量预测——"尝试组中该动作获胜的期望组数"，约 35 组时胜率为五五开。
AI.motivation: 当熟悉规则失效时，agent 必须在预训练所学与当前观察之间权衡。已有研究难以分离先验与观察的贡献，因为二者通常无法精确已知。作者希望厘清结果奖励 RL 如何改变这一权衡，并解释 RL 训练为何表现出"要么学会、要么学不会"的高方差现象。
AI.method: 构建一个拼图世界，其中由贝叶斯玩家进行博弈，用其轨迹从头训练小语言模型，从而先验与正确答案都精确已知。基础模型会像其训练语料一样"对冲"，RL 将该对冲转化为决策（方向由奖励决定）。随后系统扫描：新问题与重复问题、每组 4–256 次尝试、不同学习率、优化器、GRPO 变体、以及 1.3M–85M 参数模型规模。
AI.result: RL 只能强化其见到的成功。当正确动作稀有，单次训练要么在所有地方学会、要么完全学不会；哪些训练能成功可在训练前用"期望成功尝试组数"预测，约 35 组时胜率为 50%。该计量在新问题、重复问题、4–256 次尝试分组，以及多种学习率、优化器、GRPO 变体和 1.3M–85M 参数模型上均成立；这些因素改变的是阈值大小，而非所计量的对象本身。
AI.conclusion: RL 的效果由"奖励导向的对冲转决策"与"成功采样的可得性"共同决定；后者可用一个简单可预测量（期望成功尝试组数）刻画，为预测 RL 训练成败提供了理论性、可操作的判据。改变超参数与模型规模只影响阈值，不改变底层计量。

title: Learning to Compare Neural Representations from Parameterized Computation Graphs
summary: Comparing internal representations across trained models is important for identifying corresponding layers and selecting components for model reuse. Yet, direct comparisons at inference require evaluating candidate models on known reference inputs and collecting their internal activations. In this paper, we study whether internal representation similarity measured across independently trained models can instead be learned to predict in unseen models from their parameterized computations. We introduce a framework that applies a graph metanetwork for mapping each internal site to an embedding derived from its upstream computations while accounting for hidden-coordinate permutation and internal attention-basis transformations. We analyze the structural properties of our estimators and derive conditional guarantees for layer retrieval and stitching candidate selection. Empirically, we find that the learned predictors support relation estimation and low-regret layer retrieval. They also select useful stitching connections while not being trained on stitching outcomes. This opens up a new way to study representation similarity directly from trained neural networks: representational relations learned across a collection of trained models can generalize to new computations, and that the predicted relations can guide candidate selection before direct measurement or adapter fitting for functional evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用图元网络从模型参数计算中直接预测跨模型内部表示的相似性，无需参考输入与激活采集，并给出层检索与拼接选择的条件性保证。
AI.motivation: 比较不同训练模型的内部表示对识别对应层、选择可复用组件很重要，但现有方法需要在推理时用已知参考输入跑候选模型并收集内部激活，代价高且无法在未见模型上预先预测。
AI.method: 构建一个图元网络框架，将每个内部站点映射为由其上游计算导出的嵌入，并对隐藏坐标置换与内部注意力基变换保持等变/不变；随后分析估计器的结构性质，推导层检索与拼接候选选择的条件性保证。
AI.result: 学习到的预测器能较好估计表示关系，实现低遗憾的层检索；在未针对拼接结果训练的情况下仍能选出有用的拼接连接。
AI.conclusion: 表示相似性可直接从训练好的网络中学习并泛化到新计算，预测的关系可在直接测量或适配器拟合之前用于候选筛选。

title: Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
summary: We present an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature (OSF) logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs. Fuzzy OSF logic is a knowledge representation and reasoning language where feature symbols denote functions and sort symbols denote fuzzy sets. Sorts are organized in a fuzzy subsumption relation that extends to OSF terms, record-like structures representing classes of entities. The unification algorithm for these structures provides a calculus of fuzzy type subsumption. The latest release of fosf introduces support for similarity-based reasoning by extending the OSF language with a similarity relation among sorts, alongside a translation engine for compiling OSF terms into standard SPARQL. Queries expressed as OSF terms undergo fuzzy ontology-aware rewriting prior to translation. This process incorporates an OSF theory of sort definitions, feature domain and range declarations, and fuzzy subsumption and similarity relations through fuzzy OSF constraint normalization. This rewriting enables flexible query answering by returning approximate solutions, allowing queries that would otherwise be inconsistent with the underlying ontology to yield relevant results.

AI.tldr: fosf推理器更新版，支持相似性推理，并将OSF项翻译为SPARQL，实现RDF知识图谱上的柔性查询。
AI.motivation: 标准SPARQL查询无法处理与本体不一致的查询，缺乏灵活性与近似匹配能力，需要支持模糊OSF逻辑的推理与查询机制。
AI.method: 在fosf中为OSF语言扩展排序间相似关系以支持相似性推理，构建OSF项到标准SPARQL的翻译引擎；查询先经模糊OSF约束归一化，结合排序定义、特征域/值域声明、模糊包含与相似关系进行本体感知重写，再翻译。
AI.result: 实现柔性查询回答，返回近似解，使原本与本体不一致的查询也能得到相关结果。
AI.conclusion: fosf新版本将模糊OSF推理与SPARQL查询相结合，通过本体感知重写提升RDF知识图谱查询的柔性与可用性。

title: SAM 3 Sees More Than It Detects: Promptable Concept Maps Beyond Categories
summary: Promptable segmenters answer what a thing is. Dense prediction tasks also ask class-agnostic questions, such as what stands out or hides, how light is blocked, transmitted or reflected, and where structure lies. Robots, surveillance systems and image editors build on their answers. We study promptable concept maps (PCM), which extend SAM 3's promptable concept segmentation from noun instances to maps of concepts named by short noun phrases such as `"transparent object", with "none" as an answer. PCM-Bench groups the standard test sets of seven such tasks by the question they ask. On it, we find that SAM 3 sees more than it detects. Its semantic path responds to many of these concepts, yet a low image-level presence score can block every detection of its instance path. We present UNVEIL, which trains a copy of SAM 3's semantic path for these maps, with LoRA on copies of its last blocks. A separate presence decoder learns from verified negatives whether a concept occurs. With one text phrase per query, UNVEIL maps region concepts such as salient and camouflaged objects, shadows, transparent objects and mirrors. The same weights map thin structures such as edges and skeletons as well as object categories. Run next to SAM 3, it leaves SAM 3's own outputs unchanged. On each of the seven tasks, UNVEIL reaches the highest score among the compared promptable models, including SAM 3's official fine-tuning and pipelines built on multimodal LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhuan-wu/UNVEIL.

AI.tldr: UNVEIL 在冻结 SAM 3 实例路径的前提下，训练一份语义路径副本并加独立 presence 解码器，把可提示分割从名词实例扩展到七类"概念图"任务，全部取得最优。
AI.motivation: 可提示分割器只回答"是什么"（名词实例），但稠密预测还需回答与类别无关的问题：什么突出、什么隐蔽、光如何被遮挡/透射/反射、结构在哪里。作者将此类任务统一为 promptable concept maps (PCM)，并发现 SAM 3 "看得比检测得多"——语义路径对许多概念有响应，却常被低图像级 presence 分数阻断，导致实例路径零检测。
AI.method: 在 SAM 3 语义路径副本上用 LoRA 微调最后若干 block；另设 presence 解码器，从经核验的负样本中学习概念是否出现，以替代原 presence 分数。每查询仅用一个短名词短语（如"transparent object"），"none"作为可能的答案。同一套权重同时覆盖显著/伪装目标、阴影、透明物体、镜面等区域概念与边缘、骨架等细结构。
AI.result: 在 PCM-Bench（七个任务标准测试集的按问句分组）上，UNVEIL 在每个任务上均取得对比的各类可提示模型中最高分，优于 SAM 3 官方微调及基于多模态 LLM 的流水线；同时不改动 SAM 3 原有输出，可与之并列运行。
AI.conclusion: 把可提示分割从实例转向概念图是可行且高效的：仅需修正语义路径与 presence 判定、单短语提示、一套共享权重，即可跨异构稠密任务通用。

title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
summary: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"农业世界模型"任务：仅凭单张照片、品种与相机视角，预测同一植株在未来数天至数月的外观；并给出 AgroWM 框架，先推理发育状态再生成生长图像。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型只能想象未来几秒的物理场景演化，而种植者需要的是数周至数月的作物发育预测（如一个月后是否抽穗、收获期形态）。初步分析发现，即使最先进的图像生成器也会失败：生长量偏差、颜色与形态错配到错误生育期。作者认为其根源在于模型未显式推算植株的发育状态——该状态在照片中只有间接线索。
AI.method: AgroWM 采用"先推理发育、再绘制生长"的两段式设计：(1) 推理模块 PhenoClock 判定当前生育期、预测未来生育期，并写出包含株高、株面积、颜色等数值目标的 Growth Script；(2) 生成模块 Rooted Renderer 依据该脚本对原照片做编辑，为被拍摄植株添加新器官与颜色。评价上不使用像素分数（易偏好"原图复制"），而是将该预测的性状与发育时序同该植株自身后续照片比对。
AI.result: 水稻上，AgroWM 的阶段匹配率（Stage R@1）为 54.6%，高于 GPT Image 2.5 的 34.8%、Qwen Image 2.1 的 24.0%，以及最强领域基线（同骨干微调但无 Growth Scripts）的 47.4%；在 9–20 周远期预测下仍达 46.4%，基线为 35.7%。在株型与生育期尺度不同的玉米上，同一设计在全部四项指标上均最优。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模发育状态并以其为中间表示（Growth Script）驱动图像编辑，是长时程作物生长预测的关键；该设计跨作物（水稻、玉米）具备可迁移性，且以植株自身后续照片为参照的评估方式比像素指标更合理。

title: Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
summary: Textual recommendations generated by large language models (LLMs) can be difficult to inspect. This paper introduces \emph{Client Exits}, a lightweight mechanism for enriching LLM responses while separating semantic intent from client-specific presentation. The model inserts predefined, machine-interpretable markers into its output, and the receiving client decides whether and how to realize the corresponding enrichments. This allows supplementary information to be presented as graphics, text, speech, or other modalities without prescribing a concrete interface. We implement a prototype combining a finetuned Qwen model with a modified LibreChat client. Using the Question--Option--Criteria (QOC) approach including three XML-based client exits. We evaluate two QOC-oriented model variants trained on essentially the same examples, with client-exit annotations added for one variant. Across 100 test questions, the client-exit model includes all three markers in every response. An LLM judge, informed about the mechanism without being instructed to favor it, prefers this model's answers in 66\% of the comparisons. These results demonstrate successful marker generation on the evaluated test set and support the feasibility of client-controlled enrichment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Client Exits 机制，让 LLM 在输出中插入机器可解析的预定义标记，由客户端决定如何呈现补充信息，从而将语义意图与界面呈现解耦。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的文本推荐难以审阅、难以检查，且模型输出常把语义内容与具体界面呈现绑定在一起，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 采用 Question–Option–Criteria (QOC) 方法，定义三种基于 XML 的 client exits；用微调的 Qwen 模型配合改造后的 LibreChat 客户端实现原型；训练两个 QOC 导向的模型变体（训练样本基本相同，仅其中一个加入 client-exit 标注），在 100 个测试问题上评测，并用未被告知偏好该机制的 LLM 评审进行比较。
AI.result: client-exit 模型在全部 100 个测试问题的回答中均包含全部三种标记；LLM 评审在 66% 的对比中更偏好该模型的回答。
AI.conclusion: 在评测集上成功实现了标记生成，验证了客户端控制式信息增强（client-controlled enrichment）的可行性。

title: AdaptReg: Skip-level FiLM Adapter for Task-Specific Adaptation of a Frozen Registration Foundation Model
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Paper for the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge (PSMA-PET/CT longitudinal registration), 4th place among 16 teams on the hidden test set
summary: Longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT registration is a key step in assessing treatment response in prostate cancer, and it requires more than generic alignment accuracy: the deformation must preserve lesion volume, so that measured changes in metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) reflect treatment response rather than registration artifacts. We propose AdaptReg, which adapts a frozen registration foundation model to such task-specific requirements through a lightweight trainable adapter branch with identity-preserving initialization. Keeping uniGradICON fully frozen, we apply FiLM-style per-voxel affine modulation ($γ$, $β$) to its decoder skip connections; the modulation is generated from anatomical semantic features of a frozen TotalSegmentator encoder and supervised by a lesion volume-preservation loss. On the official Codabench validation set (20 pairs), AdaptReg achieves DSC 0.7585, HD95 6.33 mm, MTV/TLG errors of 1.68%/2.11%, and 0.0022% non-diffeomorphic voxels, improving on the uniGradICON + instance optimization baseline by $+0.05$ DSC and reducing the MTV/TLG errors by 70.9%/67.7%. On the hidden official test set (160 pairs), AdaptReg achieves CT DSC 0.816, PET DSC 0.598, and MTV/TLG errors of 4.02%/3.46%, ranking fourth among 16 teams in the final PSMAReg evaluation. Code: https://github.com/shishuyue/AdaptReg

AI.tldr: AdaptReg 通过轻量适配器分支将冻结配准基础模型 uniGradICON 适配到 PSMA-PET/CT 纵向配准任务，在保持病lesion体积的前提下显著降低 MTV/TLG 误差。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌疗效评估中，纵向 PSMA-PET/CT 配准不仅要几何对齐准，还必须保持病灶体积，否则 MTV 与 TLG 的变化会混入配准伪影而非真实治疗反应，通用配准模型难以满足这一任务特定需求。
AI.method: 保持 uniGradICON 完全冻结，引入带恒等初始化、可训练的轻量适配器分支：在解码器 skip 连接上施加 FiLM 风格的逐体素仿射调制（γ、β），调制参数由冻结的 TotalSegmentator 编码器提取的解剖语义特征生成，并用病灶体积保持损失进行监督。
AI.result: Codabench 官方验证集（20 对）上 DSC 0.7585、HD95 6.33 mm、MTV/TLG 误差 1.68%/2.11%、非微分同胚体素 0.0022%，相比 uniGradICON + 实例优化基线 DSC 提升 0.05，MTV/TLG 误差分别降低 70.9%/67.7%；隐藏测试集（160 对）CT DSC 0.816、PET DSC 0.598、MTV/TLG 误差 4.02%/3.46%，在 PSMAReg 最终评测 16 支队伍中排名第四。
AI.conclusion: 以冻结基础模型 + 轻量语义条件适配器的范式，可在不重训练大模型的情况下有效注入任务特定约束（体积保持），在 PSMA-PET/CT 配准上取得有竞争力的精度与优异的体积测量一致性。

title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
summary: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 现有Thinking with images (TwI)模型虽提升准确率,但工具使用不忠实(常调用缩放却不依赖证据);作者将问题归因于训练数据,提出按模型能力自适应选数据+可验证问题合成+自适应奖励,显著提升忠实度并刷新visual search基准。
AI.motivation: TwI模型通过裁剪放大细粒度区域来提升VLM感知,但分析发现其准确率提升并不代表忠实使用工具——模型常调用工具却不真正依赖缩放区域,损害了工具辅助推理的可信性。作者将这种不忠实行为追溯到训练数据:当问题无需缩放即可作答时,模型会忽略返回证据而答对,且随着训练模型脱离工具能力增强,该问题会加剧。
AI.method: (1)使训练数据适配模型演进能力:在训练中选取"正确的缩放证据仍能帮助模型答对"的问题,保持缩放始终有用;(2)数据合成流水线:定位小目标并围绕其细节构建可验证问题;(3)自适应奖励:在缩放非必要时偏好无工具回答。
AI.result: 推理忠实度大幅提升,visual search基准达到SOTA:V* +11.6%,HR-Bench 4K +7.9%,HR-Bench 8K +9.4%;在多模态幻觉基准上优于对比的TwI基线。
AI.conclusion: 提升TwI忠实度并不牺牲准确率,二者均可通过合适的训练数据学习得到,且无需直接监督推理过程。

title: Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models
summary: Differentiable programming enables online calibration of numerical models by minimizing errors accumulated along simulated trajectories. This includes estimating physical parameters and training neural sub-models in hybrid configurations. Gradients are typically computed using adjoint methods, or backpropagation through time (BPTT), whose computational and memory costs grow with the length of the training window. This limits the duration and resolution of hybrid-model training, a major bottleneck for realistic geophysical applications.
