Approaches like truncated BPTT reduces memory use by discarding sensitivities across truncation boundaries, introducing gradient bias and neglecting long-range dependencies. We propose a class of gradient approximation methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators within it. Exact pullbacks are computed by automatic differentiation at sparse anchor states only. Between anchors, sensitivities propagate either through the identity (Zero-order) or through a reused, frozen pullback (Pullback Reuse). This approximation makes the parameter pullback constant within each chunk, allowing the gradient sum to factorize so that a single evaluation per chunk replaces one per time step. We evaluate both on three systems of increasing complexity, an incomplete Lorenz-63 model, a large-eddy closure for two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic turbulence, and bias correction in a multilayer quasi-geostrophic ocean model. Peak memory falls by up to an order of magnitude and runtime up to fourfold, with Pullback Reuse staying closest to the exact gradient direction. In all three cases, approximate gradients support hybrid-model training at comparable accuracy, showing that effective online learning does not require exact gradients.

AI.tldr: 提出一类梯度近似方法，在完整轨迹上保留伴随递推，仅在稀疏锚点用自动微分计算精确 pullback，锚点间用恒等（Zero-order）或冻结复用 pullback（Pullback Reuse）传播，使梯度可因式分解，单块只需一次求值。
AI.motivation: BPTT/伴随方法的计算与内存随训练窗口长度增长，限制混合模型在线校准的时长与分辨率；截断BPTT虽省内存，却引入梯度偏差并忽略长程依赖。
AI.method: 保留全轨迹伴随递推，只近似其中的 pullback 算子：仅在稀疏锚点状态用自动微分算精确 pullback，锚点间通过恒等或复用的冻结 pullback 传播敏感性；由此参数 pullback 在每个 chunk 内恒定，梯度求和可因式分解。
AI.result: 在 Lorenz-63、二维准地转湍流的大涡闭包、多层准地转海洋模式偏差订正三个递进系统上测试：峰值内存最多降低一个数量级，运行时间最多缩短四倍，Pullback Reuse 最接近精确梯度方向；三种情形下近似梯度均支持精度相当的混合模型训练。
AI.conclusion: 有效的在线学习并不需要精确梯度；该方法能在显著降低内存与计算成本的同时保持训练精度。

title: Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
summary: One fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is enforcing temporal safety constraints, such as satisfying formal specifications. Existing methods often transform logic formulas into automata for state augmentation and reward shaping. However, this approach assumes that automaton construction is both feasible and tractable, which limits its applicability to small specifications and linear temporal logic (LTL). This paper proposes Actor-Predictor, a framework that learns a surrogate representation of logic progress without explicitly constructing an automaton. The predictor continuously estimates whether a partial trajectory will satisfy the formal specification in a later step, and its learned features are provided as auxiliary inputs to the actor, which is then optimized using GRPO and RWR. We show theoretically that, under sufficient predictive accuracy, the learned representation is equivalent to the automaton state. Experiments on grid world and robotic tasks in Isaac Lab demonstrate that Actor-Predictor outperforms automaton-based baselines on LTL-constrained tasks. It also performs well on non-regular formal specifications, such as $(a^n b^n)$, for which finite-automaton-based approaches are not applicable.

AI.tldr: 提出 Actor-Predictor 框架，无需显式构建自动机，通过学习预测器估计部分轨迹的未来满足性，并将学到的表示作为辅助输入指导策略优化，在 LTL 与非正则规格任务上优于自动机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习中处理时序安全约束（如形式化规格）的方法通常把逻辑公式转换为自动机进行状态增强与奖励塑形；但该方法假设自动机构造既可行又可处理，从而将适用范围限制在小规格与线性时序逻辑（LTL）上。
AI.method: 提出 Actor-Predictor 框架：不显式构造自动机，而是学习逻辑进展的代理表示。预测器持续估计部分轨迹在后续步骤是否将满足形式化规格，其学习到的特征作为辅助输入提供给 actor；actor 使用 GRPO 与 RWR 优化。理论上证明在预测精度充分时，所学表示等价于自动机状态。
AI.result: 在网格世界与 Isaac Lab 机器人任务上，Actor-Predictor 在 LTL 约束任务中优于基于自动机的基线；对有限自动机方法不适用的非正则形式化规格（如 a^n b^n）同样表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 用学习的预测表示替代显式自动机，可突破自动机方法对规格规模与 LTL 片段的可处理性限制，将时序安全约束 RL 扩展到非正则规格，同时保持理论等价性与实验优势。

title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
summary: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. Experiments evaluate the framework using three public gaze datasets, a laboratory test using Cityscapes road scenes and self-collected gaze data, and the Look Both Ways (LBW) dataset. The complete framework achieves an overall Top-1 gaze target identification accuracy of 96.27% in the laboratory experiment. After sequence-specific calibration, it achieves Top-1 accuracies of 79.92% for task-relevant objects and 85.58% for the road class on LBW. MFGaze achieves the lowest mean angular errors among the compared methods, with 4.06$^\circ$, 4.23$^\circ$, and 10.52$^\circ$ on MPIIFaceGaze, ETH-XGaze, and Gaze360, respectively, and demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Sensitivity analyses show stable performance under hyperparameter perturbations. These results support the framework as a source of object-level gaze information for driver monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化框架，从同步的车内驾驶员图像与前向道路图像中识别对象级或区域级的注视目标，在实验室实验达到96.27%的Top-1准确率。
AI.motivation: 注视区域分类和连续注意力定位只能提供有限信息，无法确定被注视场景目标的身份（对象级信息），而这对智能车辆的视觉注意力监测很重要。
AI.method: 框架含四个组件：(1) MFGaze，结合MAE预训练的Vision Transformer与通过FiLM进行头部姿态条件化；(2) 全景场景理解，构建结构化候选集；(3) 多项式岭回归，通过个性化标定将注视特征映射到2D场景图像坐标；(4) 熵驱动的目标推断，自适应融合边界距离几何与类别级语义先验。
AI.result: 实验室实验整体Top-1注视目标识别准确率96.27%；LBW数据集经序列特定标定后，任务相关对象Top-1为79.92%，道路类为85.58%。MFGaze在MPIIFaceGaze、ETH-XGaze、Gaze360上平均角度误差分别为4.06°、4.23°、10.52°，为对比方法中最低，并具强跨数据集泛化性；敏感性分析显示超参数扰动下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该框架作为驾驶员监测中对象级注视信息的来源。

title: Revealing Pathway Interactions in Network Computations with Complete Path Contribution
summary: Networks pass signals through many layers of interconnected units, so explaining what they compute means tracing how information travels from input to output and how pathways interact. Most existing approaches analyze only pairwise interactions between components such as units, layers or attention heads. Even when these measurements are combined post hoc into a circuit, they do not capture higher-order interactions along full causal chains (paths) from input to output, and so cannot address how exponentially many paths interact to construct network computation. This leaves a large set of mechanistic questions unanswerable, for example whether inhibitory pathways veto excitatory ones, and how the two combine to yield network decisions. To address this gap, we introduce Complete Path Contribution, a method to decompose the network output into mathematically complete contributions of individual paths to study path-level interactions directly and at scale. Partial summation then induces definitions of contributions for any circuit at any granularity level, with completeness guaranteed at every level. We further present an efficient algorithm that identifies the $k$ strongest paths without examining all of them, with runtime empirically linear in $k$ rather than exponential in depth. By applying Path Contribution to benchmark image classification networks, we quantify excitatory-inhibitory interactions and show how they collectively construct network decisions at a level of detail previously unmeasurable. Furthermore, in an interpretable model of the mouse retina, it reveals how dynamic receptive fields emerge from excitatory-inhibitory interaction motifs among pathways between different cell types in response to time-varying natural stimuli. Overall, Path Contribution reveals how a network's causal pathways interact at scale to transform input to output.

AI.tldr: 提出 Complete Path Contribution 方法，将网络输出数学完备地分解为各条从输入到输出的路径贡献，并给出线性于 k 的高效 top-k 路径检索算法，从而在规模化层面分析路径间的高阶（兴奋-抑制）交互。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法多只分析单元、层或注意力头之间的成对交互，即使事后拼成电路，也无法刻画从输入到输出完整因果链（路径）上的高阶交互，难以回答指数级路径如何相互作用构成计算的问题（如抑制性路径是否否决兴奋性路径）。
AI.method: 提出 Complete Path Contribution：把网络输出分解为单条路径贡献的完备求和；通过部分求和自然导出任意粒度、任意电路层级的贡献定义且保证完备性；并设计高效算法，在不必枚举全部路径的情况下找出 k 条最强路径，运行时间经验上随 k 线性、而非随深度指数增长。
AI.result: 在基准图像分类网络上量化了兴奋-抑制交互，展示它们如何共同构造网络决策；在可解释的小鼠视网膜模型中，揭示了不同细胞类型间路径上的兴奋-抑制交互基序如何响应时变自然刺激而产生动态感受野。
AI.conclusion: Path Contribution 能够在大规模下揭示网络因果路径如何交互、将输入变换为输出，为机制可解释性提供了路径级、完备且可扩展的分析框架。

title: Rigel-Ladon: An Option-Count Law for a One-Pass Decision Encoder, Tested on Held-Out Option Counts and Held-Out Schemas
summary: Laya is a small neural network that reads a text, a question and K written options, and returns one probability per option in a single pass. We ask how its accuracy falls as K grows from 2 to 35 and whether that can be predicted. We score nested option sets (every K-option question contains the smaller ones) on four question pools, for the released model (Base) and our fine-tune (FT), and score every item against each single rival. FT trained on one 12-option topic question (in-family); a 12-option HR (department-routing) question is out-of-family. Logit accuracy (the log of correct over incorrect answers) is linear in log(K-1) with slope 0.68 to 0.88. Fitted on K up to 6, the law predicts K=7 to 12 within 0.6 points and K up to 24 within 1.2 (a log-linear rule: 1.6 and 6.7). Taking the slope from the topic question and measuring only two-option accuracy on HR predicts its other K within 0.3 points (FT) and 0.7 (Base). On a 35-label pool of five schemas the law fails (5 to 11 points). Independence of irrelevant alternatives is rejected: the gold-versus-rival log-odds shifts by +0.24 to +2.07 nats per doubling of K, yet pairwise answers reproduce K-way accuracy within 4.7 points. Order averaging (averaging over several orderings of the options), shortlists, a temperature law and calibrated prediction sets did not transfer (FT's 90% sets cover 84% on HR). 2 of 10 predictions made in advance held. Caveats: one model family and LLM-labelled synthetic text.

AI.tldr: Laya 是一个单次前向即可对 K 个选项打分的小型神经网络；本文研究其准确率随 K 从 2 增至 35 如何下降，并检验日志-线性律能否预测该下降。
AI.motivation: 需要知道小型多选项读取模型的准确率随选项数 K 增长的衰减规律，以及该规律是否可被简单标度律预测、能否跨题目族迁移。
AI.method: 在四个题库上构造嵌套选项集（每个 K 项题包含更小的子集），对发布的 Base 模型与微调 FT 模型逐项打分并与各单选项对手比较；在 in-family 的 12 选项主题题上微调，HR（部门路由）12 选项题为 out-of-family；考察 logit 准确率对 log(K-1) 的线性拟合与预测外推，并检验 IIA、顺序平均、短名单、温度律与校准预测集。
AI.result: logit 准确率对 log(K-1) 线性，斜率 0.68–0.88；仅用 K≤6 拟合可预测 K=7–12 误差 0.6 点、K≤24 误差 1.2 点（对数线性规则为 1.6 与 6.7）。用主题题斜率加 HR 上两点准确率可预测其余 K 误差 0.3（FT）/0.7（Base）点。但在 35 标签、五 schema 池上失效（5–11 点）。IIA 被拒绝：gold-vs-rival log-odds 每翻倍 K 偏移 +0.24 至 +2.07 nats，但成对答案可在 4.7 点内重现 K 路准确率。顺序平均、短名单、温度律、校准预测集均未迁移（FT 的 90% 集在 HR 上仅覆盖 84%）。事先做出的 10 项预测中 2 项成立。
AI.conclusion: 多选项准确率随 K 呈可预测的对数-线性衰减，可跨主题迁移，但在大标签池与异分布任务上失效；模型违反 IIA，虽有若干鲁棒性方法但均未成功迁移。局限：单一模型族、LLM 标注的合成文本。

title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/VETO.

AI.tldr: 提出VETO方法，通过在微调更新的正交补空间上投影，抑制VideoLLM对文本规律的捷径依赖，使其真正基于视频作答。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM在SFT中会学习仅凭训练数据的文本规律作答，绕过视频内容形成捷径；该捷径难以在数据层面定义，且与训练轮次、数据规模、骨干无关，隐藏在训练分布内的准确率提升背后，并在分布偏移下牺牲了视频带来的收益。
AI.method: VETO干预微调更新本身而非数据：先校准基座模型激活中"仅文本"所占的子空间，再将SFT更新投影到其正交补空间，从而在捷径形成时即被抑制。
AI.result: 在七个VideoLLM上，VETO保持SFT在训练分布上的增益并抑制捷径；在六个分布偏移基准上收益超过SFT，且模型基于完整输入而非捷径作答。
AI.conclusion: 从更新方向上而非数据层面干预捷径是可行且有效的，VETO在不损失训练分布性能的前提下提升了分布偏移下的泛化与视频grounding能力。

title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
summary: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.

AI.tldr: 提出 BADAS-3.0：10亿参数视频编码器+四个小头，仅用单目前视相机2秒输入，50ms内预测车速、已驶路径、碰撞风险分与6.4秒内六个候选未来；在轨迹基准上minADE6比34B的Alpamayo 2 Super低44%（速度要求实时、后者慢100倍），并新增两个安全基准且在通过率上领先所有已发表规划器。
AI.motivation: 探究在单相机、实时延迟约束下驾驶模型能达到何种水平；现有基准多为常规驾驶场景，缺乏安全性（碰撞/近失、Euro NCAP场景）评估，且大模型多相机方案延迟过高。
AI.method: BADAS-3.0：1B参数视频编码器配四个小型预测头。输入为单个前视相机2秒视频；输出为当前速度、刚驶过的度量路径、碰撞风险评分，以及6.4秒内的六个候选未来轨迹；整体推理延迟<50ms。同时构建两个开环安全基准（真实行车记录仪碰撞与近失事件、Euro NCAP 场景）。
AI.result: 给定当前车速，在五个轨迹基准上minADE6比34B Alpamayo 2 Super低44%（后者用六相机、慢100倍以上）；该优势来自两模型均未训练过的相机配置，在共同配置上两者持平。两个新增安全基准上，通过率高于所有测试的已发表规划器。
AI.conclusion: 单目+实时延迟的轻量驾驶模型可媲美甚至超越大规模多相机模型，尤其在跨相机配置泛化上占优；同时指出现有基准偏常规驾驶，需引入真实碰撞与标准化安全场景评估，BADAS-3.0在安全通过率上表现最佳。

title: How Network Topology and Data Heterogeneity Shape Decentralized Learning: A Spectral Analysis
summary: Network topology influences decentralized federated learning through information mixing and the relative contribution of individual nodes. While existing analyses primarily focus on spectral mixing properties, they often assume doubly stochastic aggregation, overlooking topology-dependent influence under irregular communication networks. We develop a spectral framework that separates two complementary mechanisms: the dominant eigenmode determines the consensus trajectory and node influence, while non-dominant eigenmodes govern the propagation and attenuation of disagreement. Under uniform neighborhood averaging, we show that the stationary influence is proportional to node degree plus one and derive a bound relating model disagreement to spectral mixing and gradient heterogeneity. We then investigate how these mechanisms interact with the data distribution across nodes. Experiments across regular and heterogeneous network topologies reveal nearly identical learning dynamics under IID data, while network size and connectivity affect how unevenly distributed information is learned under non-IID data. For non-IID settings, we characterize how the distribution of data across nodes shapes the relative contribution of local information to consensus dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出谱框架分析去中心化联邦学习中网络拓扑的影响，将共识轨迹（主导特征模，决定节点影响力）与分歧传播衰减（非主导特征模）分离，并揭示均匀邻域平均下稳态影响力正比于节点度数加一。
AI.motivation: 现有分析多聚焦谱混合性质，且常假设双随机聚合，忽略了不规则通信网络下拓扑相关的节点影响力差异，无法刻画非IID数据分布与拓扑的交互。
AI.method: 建立谱分析框架，分离主导特征模（共识轨迹与节点影响力）与非主导特征模（分歧传播与衰减）；在均匀邻域平均下推导稳态影响力与度数的关系，并给出模型分歧与谱混合、梯度异质性的界；实验对比规则与异构拓扑、IID与非IID数据。
AI.result: IID数据下不同拓扑学习动态几乎一致；非IID数据下网络规模与连通性影响不均匀信息的习得方式；给出非IID场景中数据分布如何塑造局部信息对共识动态相对贡献的刻画。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑通过主导模（影响力不均）与非主导模（分歧衰减）两条机制影响去中心化联邦学习，非IID数据下数据分布与拓扑共同决定学习效果，双随机假设不足以刻画不规则网络。

title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
comment: Accepted at the 20th International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning (NeSy 2026). Conference version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TEaW3pdZOZ
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source. Current evaluations fail to distinguish these two aspects, as they are usually interwoven with other reasoning demands. We present ClosureBench, a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow the stated rules for dealing with missing information. Every base scenario is tested under OWA, CWA, and LCWA, and only the treatment of missing information changes between variants. ClosureBench provides a verified base benchmark as well as agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates. A model is considered correct on a base scenario only if it provides correct answers in all of its closure variants. Across 960 instances, overall accuracy can mask substantial closure mistakes. Models achieve overall accuracy from 71.18% to 99.86% across replicated runs, but their core switch accuracy, measured on the scenarios whose gold label actually changes with the contract, varies between 18.23% and 99.31%. Large discrepancies emerge under LCWA. For example, some agents choose unknown despite the prompt indicating that missing information should be treated as false. Our findings demonstrate that evaluations of AI agents should not only measure whether agents can reason over existing facts but also whether they use the appropriate assumption when information is absent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ClosureBench，一个专门检验LLM智能体是否遵守缺失信息处理规则（OWA/CWA/LCWA）的基准，发现总体准确率会掩盖大量的"闭合"错误。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体在信息不完整的记录上作答时，缺失信息可能被解读为"未知"或"假"，取决于三值/闭合假设；但当前评测把这一能力与其他推理需求交织在一起，无法区分模型是否真正遵守了所声称的缺失信息处理规则。
AI.method: 构建ClosureBench：每个基础场景在OWA、CWA、LCWA三种假设下各测一次，变体之间只改变对缺失信息的处理；提供经核验的基础基准，以及面向动作选择、来源范围和知识更新的智能体扩展。只有当一个场景在所有闭合变体下都答对，模型才被判定为该场景正确。共960个实例。
AI.result: 总体准确率在多次复现中从71.18%到99.86%，但在金标确实随闭合约定而改变的场景上，核心"切换准确率"仅在18.23%–99.31%之间。LCWA下出现明显偏差，例如提示已指明缺失信息应视为假，部分智能体仍回答"未知"。
AI.conclusion: 当前总体准确率指标会显著掩盖模型在缺失信息假设上的错误；对AI智能体的评测不应只衡量其能否在已有事实上推理，还应衡量其在信息缺失时是否采用了恰当的假设。

title: GeoPillars: A Large-Kernel Pillar Detector for Single-Sweep LiDAR Under Point Sparsity, and a Decomposition of Its Gain
summary: GeoPillars is a pillar-based 3D detector for single-sweep LiDAR under a hard budget of eight points per 0.4 m pillar, a budget that discards 46.6% of in-range points. It adds geometric pillar features, grouped vector attention within each pillar, a learned absolute positional prior on the bird's-eye-view (BEV) grid, a large-kernel backbone, auxiliary surface-normal supervision and a full-resolution detection head. Trained on 123k synthetic CARLA scans and evaluated on cars, it reaches 81.33 BEV AP@0.7, 13.76 points above CenterPoint at the same input budget and 1.91 points above CenterPoint at its native, denser budget. These are in-distribution figures, because the validation split is per-frame rather than scene-disjoint. A rung-by-rung decomposition shows that the new components explain little of the gain. Raising the detection-head resolution alone recovers 10.19 of the 13.76 points, the joint change of encoder, backbone, neck and positional prior adds 3.37, and the normal-supervision branch adds 0.20, which is within run-to-run variation. With heading reversals folded out, orientation error is similar for all seven models, although GeoPillars reverses headings about half as often as a resolution-matched baseline. It is also the slowest of the seven models. Evaluated zero-shot on 6,743 real nuScenes keyframes, no model transfers, and each retains 3.7% to 12.2% of its CARLA accuracy. A collection defect left LiDAR intensity constant, so every model learned from geometry alone. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GeoPillars 在每 0.4 m 柱体 8 点的严格预算下提出多种模块改进，BEV AP@0.7 达 81.33，但其增益主要来自检测头分辨率提升，零样本迁移到真实 nuScenes 全部失败。
AI.motivation: 在极低点预算（每 0.4 m 柱体 8 点，丢弃 46.6% 有效点）下提升单帧 LiDAR 3D 检测性能，并厘清各改进模块的实际贡献。
AI.method: 在 pillar 检测器中加入几何 pillar 特征、pillar 内分组向量注意力、BEV 网格学习式绝对位置先验、大核主干、表面法向辅助监督与全分辨率检测头；在 123k 合成 CARLA 扫描上训练，并做逐级消融。
AI.result: BEV AP@0.7 达 81.33，较同预算 CenterPoint 高 13.76，较其原生稠密预算高 1.91；但消融显示仅提升检测头分辨率即贡献 10.19 点，编码器/主干/颈/位置先验联合贡献 3.37，法向监督仅 0.20（属波动范围）。方向误差折返后七模型相近，GeoPillars 掉头率约为分辨率匹配基线一半，但速度最慢。零样本迁移到 6,743 real nuScenes 帧全部失败，仅保留 3.7%–12.2% 精度。
AI.conclusion: 定位为诚实的负面/复现性分析：架构创新带来的收益有限，主要增益源于检测头分辨率；合成数据到真实域差距显著；因采集缺陷 LiDAR 强度恒定，模型仅从几何学习；验证集按帧划分而非场景分离，指标属分布内；代码与权重已公开。

title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
summary: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.

AI.tldr: HiSA 提出在隐藏（特征）维度而非 token 维度做稀疏注意力：保留 query/key 投影，仅按 token 位置确定的无参数静态规则计算部分点积，借助 RoPE 结构分解可省略分量，仅需约 1/3 的 QK 点积即可提升性能并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力几乎都在 token 维度上稀疏，而注意力本质是对每个 query 与每个 key 做完整点积，计算开销大。作者想探究：点积是否必须完整计算才能保证注意力有效，并探索较少涉及的隐藏（特征）维度稀疏。
AI.method: 提出 HiSA：保持 query/key 投影完整，但只计算部分点积；稀疏模式由 token 位置决定的静态、无参数规则给出。基于 RoPE 的结构将 key/query 分解为计算时可省略的部分。从头训练 LLM 验证，并将 HiSA 扩展到 FlashAttention-3 训练与推理 kernel。
AI.result: 部分点积不仅不损害反而提升性能，同时 QK 点积计算量降至约 1/3；推理阶段提升解码速度、缩小内存占用；并成功集成到 FlashAttention-3 kernel。分析表明稠密注意力本身会学习抑制 HiSA 所丢弃的注意力分数部分，为该设计提供依据。
AI.conclusion: 在隐藏维度上按位置规则做静态稀疏注意力是可行且有效的，可同时提升效果与效率，且与高效 kernel 兼容；稠密注意力的行为也佐证了该稀疏方式的合理性。

title: Loss-Guided Tsetlin Machines: Making the Learning Objective Explicit
summary: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) has no explicit notion of a loss function. Its learning signal is fixed to an implicit, margin-based update rule (MBUR), with no way to choose an objective function suited to a specific task. This paper introduces Loss-Guided TM, which replaces MBUR with an explicit and swappable loss function. In our proposed method, clause feedback and weight updates are driven by the loss, while keeping the Tsetlin Automaton and clause logic unchanged. The approach incorporates cross entropy (CE), symmetric cross entropy (SCE), and asymmetric loss (ASL). We evaluate Loss-Guided TM across six datasets that span multiclass, multilabel, and binary classification tasks. With a suitable loss, Loss-Guided TM matches or improves accuracy and F1 over MBUR on five of the six datasets. The gains are greatest for the imbalanced multilabel datasets, where ASL improves macro F1 by up to 9 percentage points. With CE, Loss-Guided TM is also significantly better calibrated than MBUR on all six datasets, reducing calibration error by a factor of 3 to 11. A qualitative inspection shows that the clause-based global interpretability, examined at the per-class level on image and text data, is preserved when using the Loss-Guided mechanism. These results show that our explicit TM learning objective allows direct targeting of uncertainty calibration, data imbalance, and task structure, opening the TM to the broader literature on loss functions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loss-Guided TM，用可替换的显式损失函数取代 Tsetlin Machine 固定的隐式 margin 更新规则，在保持 TA 与 clause 逻辑不变的前提下支持 CE/SCE/ASL 等目标。
AI.motivation: TM 没有显式损失函数概念，学习信号固定为隐式的 margin-based 更新规则（MBUR），无法针对具体任务（如类别不平衡、不确定性校准）选择合适的目标函数。
AI.method: 用显式可互换的损失函数替换 MBUR：clause 反馈与权重更新由损失驱动，Tsetlin Automaton 与 clause 逻辑保持不变；引入交叉熵（CE）、对称交叉熵（SCE）与非对称损失（ASL）。
AI.result: 在覆盖多分类、多标签与二分类的六个数据集上评估：合适损失下五个数据集准确率与 F1 持平或提升；不平衡多标签数据收益最大，ASL 使 macro F1 最高提升 9 个百分点；CE 下校准误差降低 3–11 倍；定性检查显示逐类别的全局可解释性得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 显式 TM 学习目标可针对性处理不确定性校准、数据不平衡与任务结构，将 TM 接入更广泛的损失函数文献。

title: Sirius-Tiamat: How Small Can a One-Pass Decision Encoder Get Before Its Decisions Change?
summary: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change. We count decisions that differ from Laya's own full-precision (fp32) answer, and track calibration (how well confidence matches accuracy, measured by expected calibration error, ECE), on 1,221 synthetic items with the training schemas, 273 with an unseen schema, and 800 out-of-family questions from ARC, MMLU and HellaSwag. Layer pruning of a related model family is known; we add flips, calibration, held-out data and retraining. bf16 changes 0.2% of in-family decisions but 2.2% out of family; 6-bit grouped rounding 1.3% and 5.9%; deleting 6 layers 0.9% and 9.1%, while ECE rises from 5.9% to 39.2%. One fitted temperature, needing no labels, restores it to 3.6%. One scale per tensor fails below six bits, and CPU dynamic int8 changes 30% of decisions, nearly all through one layer. Total variation tracks flips for rounding but not for deletion, and an early exit saves layers over a static cut only if its confidence gate is first recalibrated. Distilling a 16-layer student cuts its in-family flips from 44% to 9% (45% out of family). At equal stored size, rounding flips fewer decisions than deletion. Data are synthetic and LLM-labelled, for one architecture.

AI.tldr: 论文考察421M参数的one-pass决策编码器Laya在压缩到什么程度前决策会改变，比较bf16、低位量化、层剪枝、int8动态量化与蒸馏，并用ECE跟踪校准。
AI.motivation: 关注压缩对one-pass决策编码器"最终决策"的影响而非仅精度，需同时度量决策翻转与置信校准，并覆盖分布内、未见过schema及分布外数据。
AI.method: 在1221条训练schema合成项、273条未见schema、800条ARC/MMLU/HellaSwag分布外问题上，对比bf16、6-bit分组舍入、删6层、CPU动态int8、温度校准、早退与16层蒸馏学生。
AI.result: bf16翻转0.2%内/2.2%外，6-bit舍入1.3%/5.9%，删6层0.9%/9.1%但ECE从5.9%升至39.2%，单一温度恢复至3.6%；每张量单尺度在6 bit以下失效，int8翻转30%且几乎集中在一层；蒸馏把学生内分布翻转从44%降到9%（外45%）；同等存储下舍入优于删层。
AI.conclusion: 决策翻转与校准需分别评估；分布外显著更脆弱，温度校准和置信门重校准很关键；等存储下量化优于剪枝。结论受合成/LLM标注数据与单一架构限制。

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
comment: 28 pages, 9 pages of main text. 16 figures
summary: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: https://www.jinkuncao.com/FAB.

AI.tldr: FAB是一种人体估计器，同时提升推理效率与身体重建保真度。它直接预测骨架关节与稠密表面点，而非仅预测参数化网格模型参数；其ViT-L学生模型FAB-L由微调SAM 3D Body蒸馏而来，在RTX 4070 Ti SUPER上单人实时运行，速度是SAM 3D Body的4.6倍且多数相机空间基准上更准。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多只预测参数化网格模型参数，或以SAM 3D Body为代表的高精度方法推理过慢，难以兼顾效率与保真度；同时人体与场景的接触、世界空间运动、以及人到人形机器人（Unitree G1）的real-to-sim迁移缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: FAB直接预测骨架关节和稠密表面点：图像中预测稠密2D/3D身体点及参数化MHR头部，再以一次学习式拟合加两步Gauss-Newton拟合SMPL。ViT-L学生由微调SAM 3D Body蒸馏得到。同一网络预测脚跟、脚趾、手、膝接触点，用于连接人体与场景；还估计世界空间运动，融合可见人附近的静态场景深度，并利用预测接触对齐人体与场景。另含模型内G1头部与FAB-Retarget运动级重定向器，读取稠密点或拟合网格，将动作映射到Unitree G1。
AI.result: FAB-L从检测到拟合完整身体在RTX 4070 Ti SUPER上实时（单人），速度为SAM 3D Body eager-PyTorch仅身体路径的4.6倍，且在多数相机空间基准上精度更优。FAB-Retarget生成的参考动作比SOMA、GMR、UMR、OmniRetarget等专用重定向器更贴近人体动作，并显著优于Fast SAM 3D Body配合序列IK的重定向结果。
AI.conclusion: FAB以稠密点预测加轻量拟合实现高效高保真的身体估计，统一支持接触估计、世界空间运动、人体-场景对齐与人到Unitree G1的real-to-sim动作迁移，性能与速度均优于基线。

title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.

AI.tldr: NariQ 提出一种基于 trellis 编码的量化后训练（PTQ）方法，用 BF16 模型在 agent 会话中生成的 token 做校准，在 Qwen3.8-27B 上 3.0/2.5 bit 达到与 BF16 持平的长期智能体任务表现，属首个 ≤3 bit 仍匹配全精度的量化。
AI.motivation: 长期智能体任务需在 100K+ 上下文中多步调用工具，但现有低比特量化多用短网页文本校准、以困惑度评估，导致在 DeepSWE 等长程基准上表现远逊于 BF16（≤3 bit 现有方法最多仅达 BF16 的 72%），校准与评估存在严重错配。
AI.method: 提出 NariQ：trellis 编码（trellis-coded）的量化后训练方法，校准数据改用 BF16 模型在真实 agent 会话中生成的 token，而非短网页文本；提供 GGUF 权重与 llama.cpp fork 推理实现。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，NariQ 于 3.0 和 2.5 bit/权重在 DeepSWE、Terminal Bench 两个长程智能体基准及 AIME、RealWorldQA 上均与 BF16 持平；2.0 bit 略低于该水平。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批在 ≤3 bit/权重下于长期智能体任务上匹配全精度版本的量化；校准数据与任务分布对齐（agent 生成 token）是低比特量化的关键，2.0 bit 仍为当前下限。

title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse. Supervised fine-tuning on full trajectories forces the model to imitate an entire demonstration, overconstraining its output distribution, while trajectory-level reinforcement learning provides only weak credit assignment, rewarding or penalizing whole completions without identifying where they succeed or fail. We propose edit-based training, a general framework for learning from a model's own trajectories via localized textual corrections. Given a sampled completion, an editor identifies the first point of failure under a specified criterion and proposes a minimal replacement span. The model is then supervised only on these edited spans. By design, this concentrates supervision where the model's reasoning first breaks down and aims to preserve its existing reasoning patterns elsewhere. The method applies both offline and online, with the latter continually adapting supervision to the model's evolving failure modes. We instantiate this approach on reasoning instruction following with Qwen3-32B on the ReasonIF benchmark. Compared to full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines, edit-based training substantially improves compliance with the reasoning instruction while largely preserving the model's skills on untargeted tasks. These results suggest that localized correction is an effective complement to these approaches for shaping how LLMs reason.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"编辑式训练"(edit-based training)框架：对模型自身采样轨迹，由编辑者定位首个失败点并给出最小替换片段，模型仅在这些编辑片段上接受监督，从而把监督精确集中在推理首次崩溃处。离线/在线两种形式均可，在ReasonIF上用Qwen3-32B验证，优于全轨迹模仿与轨迹级强化学习，且基本保留未针对任务的技能。
AI.motivation: 现有塑造LLM长推理行为的训练信号过于粗糙：全轨迹SFT迫使模型模仿整条示范，过度约束输出分布；轨迹级RL仅有弱信用分配，只能对整条完成给奖励/惩罚，无法指出对错具体发生在哪里。
AI.method: 提出编辑式训练：采样一条completion后，编辑者按指定准则找到首个失败点并提出最小替换span；仅对该编辑span做监督。可离线使用，也可在线使用——在线模式持续根据模型演化中的失败模式自适应地更新监督信号。
AI.result: 在推理指令遵循任务上以Qwen3-32B和ReasonIF基准实例化。与全轨迹模仿、轨迹级RL基线相比，编辑式训练显著提升对推理指令的遵循度，同时基本保持模型在未被针对任务上的能力。
AI.conclusion: 局部化纠正是塑造LLM推理方式的有效补充手段，可与全轨迹SFT和轨迹级RL互补使用。

title: World-delta: Continually Integrating Observations for Incremental 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing 3D generation methods synthesize visually compelling scenes from fixed inputs, yet struggle to continually expand and revise a 3D world as new observations arrive. Iterative approaches often fuse real observations and generated content into a single representation, treating generated content as established structure rather than revisable predictions. Consequently, early generation errors can persist and accumulate despite new evidence. We propose World-delta, an incremental 3D scene generation framework combining uncertainty-aware persistent world modeling with delta-guided diffusion for continual scene expansion and correction. Our framework comprises three components: 1) Visual Evidence Encoding integrates geometric and semantic cues from incoming images into unified world tokens. 2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling maintains a persistent latent world state that distinguishes observation-supported content from provisional completion hypotheses. New evidence drives selective world deltas to revise conflicting hypotheses while preserving well-supported content. 3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation uses delta-derived masks to restrict diffusion to regions requiring updates, freezing unchanged regions. Only affected 3D chunks are decoded and integrated into the existing scene. Together, these components enable continual world expansion and revision while reducing redundant generation and preserving scene consistency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of World-delta in incremental 3D scene generation, observation-driven correction, scene consistency, and update efficiency over successive scene updates.

AI.tldr: World-delta 是一个增量式 3D 场景生成框架，结合不确定性感知的持续世界建模与 delta 引导扩散，实现场景的持续扩展与观测驱动修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法在固定输入下效果不错，但难以随新观测持续扩展和修订 3D 世界。迭代方法常把真实观测与生成内容融合为单一表示，将生成内容视为既定结构而非可修正预测，导致早期错误不断累积。
AI.method: 框架含三部分：(1) 视觉证据编码，将新图像的几何与语义线索整合为统一 world tokens；(2) 观测校准世界建模，维护持续隐世界状态，区分观测支持内容与临时补全假设，新证据触发选择性 world delta 修正冲突假设；(3) 增量世界扩散生成，用 delta 派生掩码限定扩散更新区域，仅解码受影响 3D chunk 并整合进现有场景。
AI.result: 实验表明 World-delta 在增量 3D 场景生成、观测驱动修正、场景一致性及更新效率上均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分可靠观测与可修正假设、并以 delta 限定生成更新范围，可在保持场景一致性的同时高效完成持续扩展与纠错式修订。

title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
summary:
Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters.
  Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens.
  Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance--parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI{}, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo{} (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0\% and a median latency of 92.9\,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1\%.

AI.tldr: GLiDE 是一族 0.4B–27B 的决策模型，通过去除全注意力层的因果掩码实现上下文-问题-答案的双向交互，并结合多教师软目标蒸馏（含推理模型）与渐进式后训练，将推理能力迁移到单次前向推理；27B 模型隐藏集得分 71.52，ECE 2.0%，单 GPU 中位延迟 92.9ms，经检查点平均与无参数循环深度进一步提升至 73.37。
AI.motivation: 决策模型通过单次前向打分为候选答案打分，快速且具备置信度感知，无需生成文本或中间推理；但推理能显著提升决策质量。核心问题是：能否在不付出生成推理成本的前提下保留推理带来的收益。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen 混合语言模型构建 GLiDE（0.4B–27B）；去除全注意力层的因果掩码，使上下文、问题与候选答案之间形成双向交互；采用来自多个教师（含一个推理模型）的软目标蒸馏，并在多样化决策任务上进行渐进式后训练，将推理能力迁移至单遍推理；此外探索无参数循环深度以在不生成 token 的情况下增加推理期计算量。
AI.result: 五个规模下 GLiDE 均位于 Hugging Face 某评测的性能-参数 Pareto 前沿，每个模型均优于同等或更小规模的对比方法；GLiDE 27B 隐藏集得分 71.52，期望校准误差 2.0%，单 GPU 中位延迟 92.9ms；进一步结合检查点平均与无参数循环深度后达到 73.37，ECE 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可以在不生成显式推理的前提下继承推理能力：通过双向注意力、多教师蒸馏与渐进式后训练，GLiDE 在性能-参数权衡、校准性与延迟上均有良好表现，说明"无生成式推理的决策"是可行且高效的路线。

title: Budget Internalization: Fixed-Budget RLVR Trades Test-Time Scaling for In-Budget Accuracy
summary: Reasoning models often become more accurate when they can generate longer answers at test time. This behavior is known as test-time scaling. However, RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually trains them with a fixed rollout cap. We find that this cap changes model behavior, not only training cost. After training, models use few additional tokens beyond the training budget. They outperform the base models near that budget, but their accuracy stops improving and falls below the base model at larger budgets. The rollout cap thus becomes a learned constraint, that limits model's test-time scaling. We call this effect budget internalization. We observe it across Qwen3.5-4B, Gemma4-E2B, and Nemotron-3-Nano-4B and two reasoning training tasks: mathematical reasoning and diverse, procedurally generated problems. This effect also transfers from math training to science and coding tasks. Training-objective level ablations on Qwen3.5-4B show that most changes recover little test-time scaling. Stronger KL regularization and lower training-data truncation preserve more scaling, but stronger KL reduces in-budget accuracy. Forcing an answer on truncated training rollouts largely removes budget internalization, but also removes most of the in-budget gain. SFT on artificially truncated traces reproduces budget internalization, whereas SFT on naturally short traces does not, which shows that the effect is not specific to RL. This result links budget internalization to length-censored post-training rather than to an RL-specific objective term. Thus, a rollout cap does not only control training cost. It can trade low-budget gains for lower performance when additional inference compute is available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并验证了"预算内化"（budget internalization）现象：RLVR训练时固定的rollout长度上限会被模型学习为一种约束，导致训练后模型在超出该预算时不再继续受益于测试时计算扩展，甚至不如基座模型，且该效应不局限于RL。
AI.motivation: 推理模型通常能在测试时通过生成更长答案提升准确率（test-time scaling），但RLVR实践普遍采用固定的rollout上限。已有工作多把这当作成本控制手段，作者质疑它是否也改变了模型行为，即是否限制了模型利用更多推理预算的能力。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-4B、Gemma4-E2B、Nemotron-3-Nano-4B上，针对数学推理与程序化生成任务两类训练任务做实验；分析训练后token使用与不同预算下准确率曲线；做训练目标层面的消融（KL强度、训练数据截断程度、对截断rollout强制给答案）；并用SFT在人工截断轨迹与自然短轨迹上做对照，检验该效应是否RL特有。
AI.result: 训练后模型仅使用略超训练预算的token数；在预算附近优于基座模型，但在更大预算下准确率停止提升并低于基座模型。该效应可跨模型、跨任务复现，并从数学迁移到科学与编程任务。消融显示：更强KL与更低数据截断能保留部分扩展能力（但更强KL损害预算内准确率）；对截断rollout强制给答案基本消除预算内化但损失大部分预算内收益；SFT于人工截断轨迹可复现该效应，而SFT于自然短轨迹不会。
AI.conclusion: rollout上限不仅控制训练成本，还会被模型内化为行为约束，从而以牺牲大预算下的性能换取低预算收益。作者将该效应归因于"长度截断的后训练"而非RL特有的目标项，提示实践者在使用固定rollout上限时需权衡推理预算下的收益。

title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. The full framework achieves an audit-assessed scientific finding rate of 95.24%, outperforming both general-purpose executors and domain-specific research agents. This scientific finding rate remains stable across literature corpora and evaluator model families. Representative findings concern neuropsychiatric symptoms and dementia risk, longitudinal amyloid spatial stability, and neocortical tau-associated clinical impairment, with key associations supported in independent ADNI and AIBL cohorts. These results show how aligning knowledge gaps, data feasibility, and evidence auditing can turn automated research into traceable, evidence-supported scientific discovery. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeepQuest-3066/

AI.tldr: DeepQuest：以知识缺口驱动的阿尔茨海默病AI科学家框架，将综述中的未解问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，结合数据可行性筛选与分组Elo排序，实现95.24%的科学发现率并在ADNI/AIBL中获独立验证。
AI.motivation: 自动化实验不等于科学进步。研究智能体需判断哪些知识缺口有意义、现有数据能否解决，以及结果是否真正推进已有知识，而这三点在现有自动化研究流程中普遍缺失。
AI.method: 从领域综述中提取未解决问题，转化为可追溯、可检验的假设；经数据可行性筛选与分组Elo排序确定优先级；实验迭代与两级审计并行，将实验可靠性与相对两个冻结文献语料的知识贡献分开评估。在OASIS-3数据上运行，由三种大模型评审在15个评估维度上对比通用执行器与领域专用智能体，并做跨语料、跨评审模型家族的稳健性检验及ADNI、AIBL外部验证。
AI.result: 生成42个可行假设，在15个评估维度中的14项优于最强基线；框架整体审计判定的科学发现率为95.24%，优于通用执行器与领域专用研究智能体，且该比率在文献语料与评审模型家族间保持稳定。代表性发现涉及神经精神症状与痴呆风险、纵向淀粉样蛋白空间稳定性、新皮层tau相关临床损害，关键关联在ADNI与AIBL独立队列中得到支持。
AI.conclusion: 对齐知识缺口、数据可行性与证据审计，可将自动化研究转化为可追溯、有证据支撑的科学发现，为AI科学家提供了可评估的知识贡献标准。

title: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
summary: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划的双语（英语-马拉地语）检索系统，将BM25与句向量相似度以等权方式融合，在人工构建的双语查询上评估BM25、稠密检索与混合检索，发现BM25基线很强（MRR 0.864），混合检索仅带来小幅提升。
AI.motivation: 公民检索政府计划时需将口语化的信息需求匹配到正式行政描述，且常跨语言、跨术语（英语-马拉地语），单一词法或语义检索难以兼顾；作者希望验证词法与语义信号在此类公共服务场景中是否具有互补性。
AI.method: 构建已对齐的英语-马拉地语政府计划描述索引，支持多语言、马拉地语单语及翻译中介等语义配置；检索端采用BM25与句嵌入相似度的等权分数融合，并用IndicSBERT与MahaSBERT两种嵌入模型；在人工整理的双语查询集上对比BM25、纯稠密检索与混合检索，指标为MRR、准确率与召回率。
AI.result: BM25基线MRR达0.864，表现强劲；混合检索配合IndicSBERT将MRR提升至0.872、配合MahaSBERT提升至0.879，而对应纯稠密系统仅为0.663与0.655；基于MahaSBERT的融合还将准确率从0.781提升到0.808，同时召回率与BM25持平，为0.946。整体提升幅度不大且依赖具体指标。
AI.conclusion: 在该语料上词法与语义信号确有互补价值，混合检索优于纯稠密检索并略优于强词法基线，但对强BM25基线的改进有限且因指标而异；研究提供了面向双语公共服务信息获取的、以应用为导向的混合检索分析。

title: Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State
summary: Over the past three centuries, many thermodynamics researchers have worked to develop fluid equations of state with both high accuracy and broad applicability, proposing various theoretical frameworks and models. Building on these efforts, this study uses Gibbs free energy as the starting point and introduces thermodynamically consistent neural networks to construct a fluid equation of state based on Gibbs free energy (GEoS). This approach establishes a novel machine learning framework that provides a unified representation of fluid states. GEoS performs well on the vapor- and liquid-phase density test sets, with average absolute relative deviations (AARDs) of 5.25% and 3.96%, respectively. It outperforms conventional volume-translated cubic equations of state and existing machine learning models, demonstrating its effectiveness. Further analysis using the UMAP dimensionality reduction method shows that most molecules in the test set belong to extrapolation systems, confirming the strong generalization ability of the model. Finally, the test results show that the PC-SAFT equation fitted using GEoS maintains high predictive accuracy, providing a reliable basis for its practical application in industry.

AI.tldr: 提出以Gibbs自由能为起点、引入热力学一致神经网络构建流体状态方程GEoS，实现流体状态的统一表示，在汽/液相密度测试集上AARD分别为5.25%和3.96%，优于体积平移立方方程与现有机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: 过去三百年热力学研究者致力于发展兼具高精度与广适用性的流体状态方程，但传统方法（如体积平移立方方程）与现有机器学习模型仍存在精度与泛化性不足的问题，亟需新的统一建模框架。
AI.method: 以Gibbs自由能为建模起点，引入满足热力学一致性的神经网络，构建基于Gibbs自由能的流体状态方程GEoS；并在汽相、液相密度测试集上评估，结合UMAP降维分析泛化性，并用GEoS拟合PC-SAFT方程检验其工业实用性。
AI.result: GEoS在汽相与液相密度测试集上AARD分别为5.25%和3.96%，优于传统体积平移立方方程和现有机器学习模型；UMAP分析表明测试集多数分子属于外推体系，模型泛化能力强；用GEoS拟合的PC-SAFT方程保持高预测精度。
AI.conclusion: GEoS提供了一种热力学一致、精度高且泛化性强的流体状态统一表示框架，并为PC-SAFT等工程模型的参数拟合提供可靠基础，具备工业应用潜力。

title: Context as a Resource
summary: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. Across three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families, our portable trial merge gate lifts true-conflict merges to 63.3%, while ClonAct's routerless virtualization attains this ceiling with 45.9% fewer prompt tokens and prevents compact-model router collapse. Under continuous surge streams, ClonAct matches top completion (95.0%) with the lowest median wait and zero timed-out status checks.

AI.tldr: 提出无路由架构 ClonAct，通过可插拔的 Context MMU 与 Context Cell 等机制虚拟化上下文块，避免跨话题约束渗透与队头阻塞，在真冲突合并上达 63.3%，且节省 45.9% prompt token。
AI.motivation: 单界面常驻个人代理需管理多个并发会话，但共享冻结权重下单线性会话会导致跨话题约束渗透与队头阻塞；而路由-票据式层级架构存在有损文本交接、路由开销大和盲目合并问题（真冲突合并仅 33.3%）。
AI.method: ClonAct：不使用拟人化角色调度，而是无路由地直接虚拟化上下文块，包含可插拔的单遍非生成式 Context MMU、原地 Context Cell、带隔离试验合并门的占用感知 Synaptic Bus，以及波式冲刷的 Shared Trunk。
AI.result: 在三个程序化多流基准和三个模型族上，可移植试验合并门将真冲突合并提升至 63.3%；ClonAct 以少 45.9% 的 prompt token 达到该上限，并防止小模型路由崩溃；持续激增流下完成率 95.0% 持平最优，中位等待最低，零超时状态检查。
AI.conclusion: 无路由的上下文虚拟化方案可在保持高完成率与低等待的同时，显著提升真冲突合并成功率并降低 token 开销，避免路由崩溃，是常驻多会话代理的可行架构方向。

title: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知归因框架，用Shapley-Shubik原理随机恢复顺序平均贡献，解释TAL检测器的边界定位。
AI.motivation: TAL检测器需识别动作并估计时间边界，但定位仍是主要误差源；理解边界由何决定需要忠实归因时间证据，而现有归因方法未充分考虑TAL的时间结构及边界定位需求。
AI.method: 沿Shapley-Shubik原理对随机证据恢复顺序求平均贡献；用检测器感受野限制需个别排序的时间步、以软梯度路径近似每个顺序；针对边界预测引入单元结构恢复顺序和锚定边界参考（选择性移除邻近证据）；并适配忠实度评估以考察连续时间证据的联合效应与边界位移方向。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14、EPIC-KITCHENS-100上以TriDet和ActionFormer验证，归因忠实度优于现有方法；归因分析与受控干预显示类分数变化不能可靠反映边界位移，即分类依赖的内容对边界定位信息较少。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知归因有效解释TAL边界定位，揭示分类与边界定位的输入级证据差异，代码与评估工件将公开。

title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
summary:
Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples.
  Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment.
  We benchmark PCF on controlled transports, sample-efficiency studies, and high-dimensional alignment tasks. PCF matches the accuracy of kernel MMD on the controlled benchmark and on raw-pixel MNIST--USPS at a cost linear in the batch size, and it is more sample-efficient, achieving lower endpoint error than MMD in 13 of 15 paired runs across library sizes. By avoiding pairwise kernel evaluation, it reduces discrepancy memory by 29.8% and trains at batch sizes where kernel MMD exceeds GPU memory. These results show that PCF provides accurate and efficient invertible transport, particularly in sample- and memory-limited settings.

AI.tldr: PCF：一种无需密度的可逆传输框架，用投影经验特征函数对齐只能采样的先验与数据分布。
AI.motivation: 许多有用的潜先验只能采样、没有可解密度（经验样本、模拟器、黑盒生成模型），无法直接用于需要评估先验密度的基于似然的标准化流。
AI.method: 用投影经验特征函数对齐分布，避免密度估计、对抗训练和配对观测；并引入可选的传输正则器，在保持端点对齐的同时选择位移更小的映射，以缓解传输映射不唯一问题。
AI.result: 在受控传输任务上与kernel MMD精度相当；原始像素MNIST–USPS上成本随batch线性；15组配对实验中13组端点误差更低、样本效率更高；无需成对核评估，差异计算内存降低29.8%，并可在kernel MMD超出GPU显存的batch规模下训练。
AI.conclusion: PCF在样本与内存受限场景下提供了准确、高效的可逆传输。

title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条让LLM agent从自身历史轨迹中学习「经验」的流水线：先从轨迹中挖掘简短lessons，再合并为guidelines，推理时按需注入。核心发现是「合适的记忆量取决于模型而非记忆本身」——强模型随guideline增多持续提升，弱模型则更适合少量精选子集。系统已落地于altk-evolve库、IBM CUGA与watsonx Orchestrate。
AI.motivation: LLM agent在长时程任务中会以重复性、程序化的方式失败（如API分页错误、实体解析错、无问而答）。作者希望让agent能够从自身历史经验中学习，避免同类错误反复发生。
AI.method: 构建一条流水线：（1）从agent自身轨迹中挖掘1–3条简短lessons/episode；（2）将lessons整合为更少的guidelines，并记录每条guideline合并了多少lesson（保留支持度/来源信息）；（3）推理时注入全部或选定的guideline子集。以AppWorld为评测主平台，覆盖基线完成率40%–92%的多款模型，并记录工程化与产品化中的踩坑经验。
AI.result: 强模型随guideline数量增加而持续提升：DeepSeek-V3.2用全部191条guideline获得任务完成率+9.5分、场景完成率+16.1分。弱模型反而受益于少量精选子集：gpt-oss-120b基线39.9%，用全部199条为51.2%，而用约29条精选子集达55.4%（两次运行均值）。此外报告了若干失败教训：高支持度guideline反而有害、整合过程中provenance被静默丢弃、吞掉API错误导致全部失败却输出貌似合理的日志、以及基线混淆险些造成与先前方法的误导性比较。
AI.conclusion: 「最优记忆量」是模型的属性而非记忆的属性，应按模型能力适配guideline规模（强模型可用全集，弱模型宜用精选子集）。作者将工程与评测中的陷阱提炼为面向agent记忆落地的部署建议。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
comment: to appear in Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
summary: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.

AI.tldr: 提出SCCV-6D，一种全稀疏多视图RGB-D单阶段6D位姿估计器，面向工业bin picking；以毫米级3D重建、分阶段热图剪枝背景、canonical坐标投票闭式求解位姿，并用注意力门控蒸馏提升性能，在IPD/MV-YCB/ROBI上兼具精度与速度。
AI.motivation: 工业bin picking中零件存在堆叠、部分遮挡、反光无纹理等问题，需要准确6D位姿；现有多阶段方法精度高但内存与耗时大，难以满足工业部署约束，而单阶段hólistic方法多依赖无差别下采样或降分辨率来控制成本。
AI.method: 全稀疏多视图RGB-D单次估计：毫米级3D空间重构；分阶段热图机制剪除背景；在最高分辨率下同时预测类别、平移偏移与旋转；旋转以canonical坐标投票表示，各点带置信度投票，配合对称性感知加权Procrustes得到闭式位姿；通过偏移投票诱导簇内点恢复，省去耗时后处理；复用热图的任务监督注意力先验，提出注意力门控蒸馏目标重加权师生特征对齐。
AI.result: IPD测试集0.826 AP、每场景1.13 s，显著快于领先方法；MV-YCB达96.1 ADD-S；在ROBI密集料箱场景仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SCCV-6D以单阶段全稀疏多视图架构在精度与速度间取得良好平衡，去除后处理并借助注意力门控蒸馏，适合工业bin picking部署。

title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/AI4Bharat/LeFT-activation-transfer, Interactive figures: https://arunprakash-a.github.io/papers/learn-freeze-transfer/
summary: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch. We study this complementary form of transfer through a learn-freeze-transfer protocol, in which the activation is optimized jointly with a source network in a single training run, and is then frozen and reused in target networks trained from scratch. A pointwise activation with globally shared parameters is independent of layer dimensions and can therefore be incorporated into networks of different architectures trained from scratch. We instantiate this protocol with FAct, a five-parameter activation represented by a two-harmonic truncated Fourier series, initialized from a Fourier approximation of GELU and learned in a Vision Transformer (ViT) on ImageNet-1K. When reused in a ViT of the same architecture trained from scratch on ImageNet-1K, the frozen activation (Frozen FAct) improves top-1 accuracy by 1.46 percentage points over GELU. Across four smaller target architectures (standard ViT, Swin Transformer, linear-attention ViT, and MLP-Mixer) and four image-classification datasets, it achieves the highest mean accuracy among eleven activation functions in 15 of 16 settings under a common training configuration, with improvements of up to 1.71 percentage points over the best conventional activation. When the learning rate and weight decay are tuned separately for each activation under the same search budget, Frozen FAct still ranks first in 11 of the 16 settings, second in four, and fourth in one. These results provide empirical evidence that a learned activation function can retain its usefulness when transferred across vision architectures, independently of the weights with which it was learned.

AI.tldr: 提出"学习-冻结-迁移"协议，将源网络中学习到的激活函数（FAct，5参数双谐傅里叶级数）冻结后迁移到从头训练的视觉网络中，跨架构、跨数据集普遍优于11种常用激活函数。
AI.motivation: 传统迁移学习只迁移权重；作者想探究"激活函数"本身能否作为一种独立于层维度、可跨架构复用的知识被迁移，从而形成一种互补的迁移形式。
AI.method: 采用learn-freeze-transfer协议：激活函数与源网络联合单次训练后冻结，再用于从头训练的目标网络。设计FAct——由GELU的傅里叶近似初始化、具全局共享参数的逐点双谐截断傅里叶级数激活，先在ImageNet-1K上的ViT中学习。
AI.result: 同架构ViT上Frozen FAct比GELU提升1.46个百分点top-1；在4种较小架构（ViT、Swin、线性注意力ViT、MLP-Mixer）×4个数据集共16种设置中，统一训练配置下15/16取得最高均值精度，最高较最佳常规激活提升1.71个百分点；在相同搜索预算下逐个调参后仍11次第一、4次第二、1次第四。
AI.conclusion: 学到的激活函数可脱离其学习时的权重，跨视觉架构与数据集保持有效性，为激活函数作为可迁移知识提供了实证支持。

title: World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence
summary: World models are increasingly used to simulate physical interactions, but training a separate model for each environment limits scalability. Cross-environment prediction requires identifying the current physical rule, which appearance alone may not reveal. We therefore study visual calibration: using object motion and interactions in a short video as direct evidence to infer the current rule and predict motion under that rule from a different initial state. However, differences in data availability across physical conditions can yield a long-tailed training distribution, biasing models toward common rules even when evidence supports rare ones. To study this challenge, we introduce TailWorld, which evaluates the transfer of demonstrated rules across initial states while independently controlling training imbalance and calibration informativeness. The benchmark compares predictions with two reference futures from the same prediction initial state, one following the demonstrated rule and the other a common rule, to measure prediction bias toward common dynamics. We further propose Rule Inference for Transfer (RIFT), which learns how different rules affect object motion, infers the current rule from calibration interactions, and applies it to prediction from a new initial state. RIFT explicitly controls the influence of training frequency on rule inference, allowing sufficiently informative observational evidence to support rare rules. Experiments on TailWorld show that RIFT improves prediction accuracy and physical consistency across varying training imbalances and distribution shifts, with gains in predicting rare dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"视觉校准"任务：用短视频中物体的运动与交互推断当前物理规则，并据此从新初始状态预测运动。作者提出TailWorld基准，可独立调控训练长尾程度与校准信息量，并用"演示规则未来"与"常见规则未来"两个参考对比来度量预测对常见动力学的偏好；并提出RIFT方法，显式控制训练频率对规则推断的影响，使得信息充分的证据能支撑罕见规则。
AI.motivation: 为每个环境单独训练世界模型难以扩展，跨环境预测需先识别当前物理规则，而外观往往无法揭示规则；同时不同物理条件的数据量不均会造成长尾训练分布，使模型偏向常见规则（即便证据支持罕见规则）。
AI.method: 构建TailWorld基准：在评估已演示规则跨初始状态迁移的同时，独立控制训练不平衡与校准信息量，并用同一预测初始状态下的两个参考未来（遵循演示规则 / 遵循常见规则）来衡量预测偏向常见动力学的程度。提出RIFT（Rule Inference for Transfer）：学习不同规则如何影响物体运动，从校准交互中推断当前规则，再将其应用于新初始状态的预测，并显式控制训练频率对规则推断的影响。
AI.result: 在TailWorld上的实验表明，RIFT在不同训练不平衡程度与分布偏移下都提升了预测准确性和物理一致性，尤其在罕见动力学预测上有增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦"规则推断"与"预测"并抑制训练频率偏差，模型可依据视频证据采纳罕见规则，从而实现更可扩展、更可靠的跨环境世界模型预测。

title: Limits of local curvature for constructing search subspaces in segmentation models
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Includes an appendix
summary: We examine how well subspaces constructed from local curvature represent the change in the gradient update field after a finite step in semantic segmentation models. The local response is the action of the curvature operator on the actual input displacement. In a study of 50 images and two models, we measure the ratio of the loss increase attained in a fixed subspace to that attained in the full space. This ratio decreases as the search radius increases. On ten images from the same sample, we compare the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the initial gradient with two rank-16 subspaces for both models. The two equal-rank subspaces are assessed at the same initial states, using the same actual steps and measured vectors. Adding generalised Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient reduces the mean relative error in representing the field change from 0.922 to 0.874 for the first model and from 0.819 to 0.763 for the second. At the same rank, including the response direction for the initial gradient nearly eliminates the error in representing the local response. The mean error in representing the field change does not decrease. A decomposition with fixed pixel weights shows that the finite-step remainder is comparable in norm to the field change and makes the largest diagonal contribution to the squared projection error of the field after the step. Evaluation of a search subspace should measure how accurately it represents the field change and the local response.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语义分割模型中由局部曲率构造的子空间对有限步梯度更新场变化的表征能力，发现曲率子空间对局部响应的表征随步长增大而变差，评估搜索子空间需同时衡量其对场变化与局部响应的表征精度。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常用局部曲率构造低维子空间以近似优化中的梯度更新，但缺乏对有限步长下该子空间能否准确表征梯度更新场变化及局部响应的系统评估。
AI.method: 在50张图像和两个语义分割模型上，测量固定子空间与全空间损失增量之比随搜索半径的变化；在10张图像上比较初始梯度张成的1维子空间与两个16秩子空间（加入广义Gauss-Newton方向、加入初始梯度的响应方向），在相同初始状态与实际步长下测量场变化与局部响应的表征误差，并用固定像素权重的分解分析有限步余项。
AI.result: 损失增量比值随搜索半径增大而下降；加入广义Gauss-Newton方向使场变化表征的平均相对误差从0.922降至0.874（模型一）、从0.819降至0.763（模型二）；同秩下纳入响应方向几乎消除局部响应误差，但场变化误差不降；有限步余项范数与场变化相当，并对投影平方误差的对角贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 局部曲率子空间对局部响应表征良好但难以准确表征有限步的场变化；评估搜索子空间应同时测量其对场变化与局部响应的表征精度。

title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
summary: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多头注意力中注意力头的功能特化如何依赖训练数据量，发现特化是关于样本复杂度的真实相变（测试误差等量的非解析性），并区分其统计起源与动力学起源。
AI.motivation: 以往关于注意力头特化（如出现分阶段涌现、伴随模型行为的急剧变化）的研究主要从训练时间角度考察，作者转而追问：头的特化如何依赖可用训练数据量的多少，并希望区分特化的统计来源与动力学来源。
AI.method: 实证上，作者在随数据规模增大的设置下训练BERT，观察特化到句法关系的注意力头的涌现；理论上，构建一个可解析求解的高维多注意力头模型，分析其样本复杂度下的相变行为，并考察数据结构和正则化的影响，最后将统计相变与在线学习中的分阶段涌现联系起来。
AI.result: 实证发现：随着数据集规模增大，BERT中特化到句法关系的注意力头才会涌现。理论表明：该模型中头特化是关于样本复杂度的真实相变，对应测试误差等可观测量的非解析性；依数据结构和正则化的不同，特化可能先经历无信息性的头分化，或通过一系列相变逐步恢复较弱的潜在特征，构成一种统计形式的简单性偏好。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头特化可由训练数据量驱动，是一种统计相变现象；通过与在线学习中分阶段涌现的对应关系，作者得以将特化的统计起源与动力学起源分开。

title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
summary: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

AI.tldr: ZeroVLN提出慢-快导航框架，通过对VLM"大脑"零导航域SFT，用语义工具调用接口把移动决策以自然语言传给动作专家，并以闭环强化学习联合优化，在VLN-CE上超越代表性SFT方法且几乎不损害VLM通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN方法把VLM大脑与可学习动作头耦合，并在导航域数据上微调VLM去预测几何目标，这会大幅改变VLM权重、损害其通用视觉能力。
AI.method: 慢-快双部分架构：冻结/极少改动的VLM大脑作为"慢"策略，通过语义工具调用接口以自然语言向"快"的动作专家下达移动请求；先适配动作专家执行这些请求，再用闭环强化学习联合优化大脑的移动决策与动作专家的连续执行。
AI.result: 在相同导航episode训练下，于标准VLN-CE基准上显著优于代表性SFT式分层VLN方法，同时大脑权重仅有微小变化，通用能力基本保持。
AI.conclusion: ZeroVLN是首个对VLM大脑零导航域SFT的慢-快VLN框架，也是首个在VLN-CE中通过闭环智能体RL联合优化慢、快策略的工作。

title: Fusing Multimodal CNN Features with Structurally-Masked Transformers for Hierarchical Sub-Pixel Tree Species Mapping
summary: Precise forest species mapping using spaceborne hyperspectral data is challenging due to high spectral similarity and the inherent sub-pixel heterogeneity of natural forest stands. While traditional deep learning models exploit spatial context through convolutional architectures, these approaches can introduce noise in fragmented or mixed-species forests. In this paper, we propose a hierarchy-aware, multimodal deep learning framework to resolve sub-pixel forest composition by integrating PRISMA (PRecursore IperSpettrale della Missione Applicativa) hyperspectral imagery, high-resolution panchromatic data, and digital elevation models. The architecture features a multi-branch encoder combining an EfficientNetV2-based one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) for spectral signatures and twin two-dimensional CNNs for spatial and topographic features, coupled with a novel structurally-masked Transformer. By using a binary transition tensor to condition the Transformer slot embeddings and constrain inference, the model enforces taxonomic consistency between broad forest categories and fine-grained species distributions. The framework is validated across three diverse Italian biogeographical regions (the Alps and the Central and Southern Apennines) using field-surveyed plots. The proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-label and ranking-based paradigms, particularly in identifying subordinate species and their relative dominance. The bidirectional learning mechanism allows sub-pixel compositional features to refine macroscopic forest type predictions, while the integration of topographic priors effectively resolves spectral ambiguities in complex terrains. This knowledge-driven method supports regional-scale biodiversity monitoring and forest characterization within the evaluated PRISMA scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层级感知的多模态深度学习框架，融合PRISMA高光谱、高分辨率全色与DEM数据，用带结构掩码的Transformer解决亚像元森林树种组成问题，在意大利三个生物地理区优于现有多标签与排序方法。
AI.motivation: 星载高光谱森林树种制图困难：树种光谱高度相似，天然林分存在固有亚像元异质性；传统CNN利用空间上下文时，在破碎林分或混交林中反而引入噪声。
AI.method: 多分支编码器：基于EfficientNetV2的一维CNN提取光谱特征，孪生二维CNN分别处理空间与地形特征（全色影像+DEM）；并引入结构掩码Transformer，用二值转移张量对Transformer槽嵌入进行条件化并约束推断，从而强制宽泛森林类别与细粒度树种分布之间的分类学一致性。
AI.result: 在阿尔卑斯、亚平宁中部与南部三个意大利生物地理区、基于实地样地验证，所提方法稳定优于最先进的多标签与排序范式，尤其在识别次要树种及其相对优势度方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 双向学习机制使亚像元组成特征可反过来优化宏观森林类型预测，地形先验有效消解复杂地形下的光谱歧义；该方法属知识驱动型，可支持区域尺度生物多样性监测与森林表征（限于所评估的PRISMA场景）。

title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
summary: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity. ITPD takes a local-to-global learning approach that discovers the global graph by sequentially discovering the parent set for each variable. ITPD exploits temporal structural priors, graph partitioning, and the local Markov condition to swap higher-order conditional independence tests for lower-order alternatives. With an exact oracle, ITPD performed the least number of tests and used the smallest average conditioning set sizes relative to baselines. In benchmarking simulations, ITPD sat on the Pareto frontier with respect to F1 and wall-clock time and was faster than baselines on large graphs ($\geq$ 1000 nodes). For graphs with 2000 nodes, ITPD ran $2.3\times$, $9.1\times$, and $40.9\times$ faster than iterative IAMB, DF-PC, and PCMCI, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出ITPD——一种针对因果非平稳多元时间序列的可靠且完备的约束型因果结构学习算法，通过"局部到全局"策略逐变量发现父集以构建全局图，显著降低条件独立性检验的数量与条件集规模。
AI.motivation: 时间序列上的学习与推断面临自相关观测、分布漂移和维数灾难等统计挑战，而一般情形下因果发现算法本身计算与样本复杂度很高，二者叠加使实际应用困难。作者希望在存在因果非平稳性的多元时间序列上高效地进行因果结构学习。
AI.method: ITPD采用局部到全局（local-to-global）的约束型学习流程：依次发现每个变量的父集，再由局部父集组装全局图。它利用时间结构先验、图分割以及局部马尔可夫条件，将高阶条件独立性检验替换为低阶检验，从而降低计算与样本需求。算法被证明在给定假设下是可靠（sound）且完备（complete）的。
AI.result: 在精确oracle条件下，ITPD相较基线使用了最少的检验次数与最小的平均条件集规模。基准仿真中，ITPD在F1与墙上时间上处于Pareto前沿；在≥1000节点的大图上快于基线；对2000节点图，分别比iterative IAMB、DF-PC、PCMCI快2.3倍、9.1倍、40.9倍。
AI.conclusion: ITPD为因果非平稳多元时间序列提供了一种理论上可靠完备、实践上高效的因果发现方法，在大规模图上显著优于主流基线，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate Q-matrices for diagnostic classification models that approximate expert specifications, but evaluations have focused on the final matrices, leaving the basis of individual item-attribute assignments unexamined. This opacity limits the responsible use of AI in measurement. We propose Reasoning-Trace Analysis (RTA), a framework in which an LLM generates attribute-labeled reasoning steps through chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and these steps are analyzed to reconstruct, compare, and inspect each assignment. RTA is intended to supplement expert review and empirical validation. In a simulation study with perturbed fraction subtraction items, four LLMs recovered the required attributes and withheld attributes the items did not require. In an empirical study with 11 fraction subtraction items, responses from 536 examinees, four LLMs, up to three temperatures, and 100 replications per condition, CoT-derived Q-matrices overlapped substantially with the reference Q-matrix (mean overlap .809) but less than directly generated Q-matrices (.877), and they varied more across replications. Inspection of the traces linked disagreements to item-type coding, labeling rules, and how operations were expressed as steps. Q-matrices with similar overlap differed in fit to examinee responses. RTA provides inspectable evidence that matrix-level agreement and fit do not.

AI.tldr: 提出推理轨迹分析(RTA)框架，用CoT prompting让LLM生成带属性标签的推理步骤，从而重建、比较并检查Q矩阵中每个项目-属性分配的依据，弥补以往只评估最终矩阵的不足。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成近似专家标注的Q矩阵，但现有评估仅关注最终矩阵，未考察单个项目-属性分配的依据，这种不透明性限制了AI在测量学中的负责任使用。
AI.method: RTA框架：LLM通过链式思维(CoT)提示生成带属性标签的推理步骤，再分析这些步骤以重建、比较、检查每一项分配；定位为专家评审与实证验证的补充。采用扰动分数减法题的模拟研究（4个LLM），以及实证研究（11道分数减法题、536名被试、4个LLM、最多3种温度、每条件100次重复）。
AI.result: 模拟研究中4个LLM均能识别所需属性并排除不需要的属性；实证中CoT推导的Q矩阵与参考矩阵重叠度高（均值.809），但低于直接生成的Q矩阵（.877），且跨重复变异更大。轨迹检查将分歧归因于题型编码、标注规则及操作表述方式；重叠度相近的Q矩阵在拟合被试反应上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: RTA提供了矩阵级一致性指标和拟合度无法提供的可检查证据，有助于在测量实践中更透明、负责任地使用LLM生成Q矩阵。

title: Rank2Replace: VLM-Ranked Slot Replacement for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
summary: Spurious correlations can give image predictors high in-distribution accuracy but poor generalization under distribution shift. We introduce $\textbf{Rank2Replace}$, which transfers knowledge of task-relevant evidence from pretrained vision--language models (VLMs) to small predictors through training-time augmentation for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The VLM ranks object-centric slots by task relevance and guides rank-dependent replacement with same-rank slot embeddings from another image. This augmentation retains the original image's label, encouraging reliance on preserved task evidence as incidental cues change, and supports combination with existing OOD methods. Across four datasets and six splits under shared frozen slot embeddings, the default cross-entropy configuration reaches macro-averaged average-group and worst-group accuracies of $80.43\%$ and $65.28\%$ without environment labels or dataset-specific replacement tuning. Slot corruption improves both macro-averaged metrics for all fourteen OOD training methods. Combining it with slot ranking and IRM reaches $81.96\%$ and $72.68\%$. Controlled ablations support the ranking and replacement design, with gains across five ranking VLMs and six extractor--predictor combinations. Permutation-invariant predictors further improve both macro-averaged metrics over their unaugmented counterparts while using VLM guidance only during training for efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rank2Replace，利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）对任务相关证据的排序知识，通过训练时增强（按相关性排序进行同秩槽位替换）提升小模型的分布外（OOD）泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 图像预测器易依赖虚假相关，在分布偏移下泛化差。希望将 VLM 掌握的"任务相关证据"知识迁移给小型预测器，且无需环境标签或针对数据集的替换调参。
AI.method: 用 VLM 按任务相关性对以对象为中心的槽位（slot）排序，并引导"秩依赖替换"——用另一张图像中相同秩的槽位嵌入替换，保留原标签。可与现有 OOD 方法结合，推理时无需 VLM 指导。
AI.result: 在 4 个数据集、6 种划分下，默认交叉熵配置达宏平均 avg-group 80.43%、worst-group 65.28%；槽位破坏对全部 14 种 OOD 方法均提升；与排序 + IRM 结合达 81.96%/72.68%。消融支持排序与替换设计，在 5 个排序 VLM、6 种提取器-预测器组合上均有增益。
AI.conclusion: VLM 引导的秩依赖槽位替换是有效、通用且高效的 OOD 训练增强，不需环境标签，置换不变预测器进一步受益。

title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation. This work introduces a simple CRL benchmark that varies observation representations while preserving environment dynamics and rewards, supporting proof-of-concept demonstrations, inexpensive experimentation, and easily reproducible sanity checks. Using this benchmark, we demonstrate the stability gap in CRL: a substantial drop in prior-task performance after the introduction of new tasks, followed by partial or complete recovery. This pattern occurs despite the agent having complete access to past tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个简单的持续强化学习基准，通过改变观测表征（保持环境动态与奖励不变）来暴露"稳定性差距"：引入新任务后旧任务性能大幅下降，随后部分或完全恢复。
AI.motivation: 持续强化学习（CRL）评估常依赖最终聚合指标，会掩盖适应过程中的临时性能退化，需要一个低成本、可复现的基准来显式观察这一现象。
AI.method: 构建一个简单CRL基准，任务间仅改变观测表征、保持环境动态和奖励不变，支持概念验证、低成本实验与可重复的健全性检查，并用其检验稳定性差距。
AI.result: 观察并证实了CRL中的稳定性差距：新任务引入后，先前任务性能出现显著下降，随后部分或完全恢复。
AI.conclusion: 即使智能体完全能访问过往任务数据，稳定性差距依然出现，说明该现象是CRL的固有挑战，最终聚合指标会掩盖这一问题。

title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
