summary: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.

AI.tldr: 提出 Seer，一种推理时本地引导框架，将智能体的动作提议与「后果预测」和「价值估计」分离：用共享轨迹语料离线训练工具响应模拟器与价值估计器，跨智能体复用，只执行最终选中动作，从而在不增加真实工具调用的情况下提升小型端侧深度研究智能体的表现。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体需反复做搜索/阅读/验证决策，通常依赖云端大模型提动作；但隐私与本地控制需求推动端侧部署，而端侧内存算力有限，只能用小模型且难以训练。推理时引导面临三大障碍：真实执行候选会增加工具调用；提示式自我评估受限于模型自身判断力；模型专用引导方案导致重复适配成本。
AI.method: Seer 将动作提议与后果/价值评估解耦：从共享的真实研究轨迹语料中离线训练两个模型——基于观测到的调用-响应对训练工具响应模拟器，基于以折扣终端正确性标注的历史训练价值估计器；二者离线训练后可在不同智能体间复用、无需再训练。推理时仅在"想象"中展开候选动作后果并择优，只真实执行被选中的动作，仅将真实工具响应写入提交历史，避免对丢弃候选产生额外工具调用成本。
AI.result: 在多个深度研究基准上显著提升不同语言模型的智能体表现，例如 GAIA 准确率：Qwen3.5-4B 从 13.6% 升至 41.7%，Qwen3.5-9B 从 22.3% 升至 50.5%。分析表明更广的候选覆盖可补偿不完美的模拟，而预测与打分误差会限制更宽想象搜索的收益。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的预测与评估模型能通过额外本地计算（而非真实执行被丢弃候选）增强小型研究智能体，凸显端侧深度研究智能体的可行性。

title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: https://rainzor.github.io/contextrenderer/

AI.tldr: 提出ContextRenderer——面向交互式游戏世界模型的自回归视频扩散渲染框架，通过DCL、RHC、CRFA三项机制实现动态条件跟随与跨代理表示泛化，并配套构建WorldPrism数据集，在长时交互渲染中兼顾视觉连续性与条件更新。
AI.motivation: 交互式游戏世界模型将可执行的世界演化与视觉生成分离，由视频模型把引擎提供的场景表示渲染成细节观测。但在持续游玩过程中，现有生成式渲染器难以在跟随不断变化的条件的同时，在多样代理（proxy）表示与目标风格之间保持视觉连续性。
AI.method: 1) 动态上下文学习（DCL）：以chunk级交互监督训练模型响应条件更新；2) 循环历史压缩（RHC）：在有限token预算下保持视觉连续性；3) 跨表示流对齐（CRFA）：通过共享的高保真重建，将代理重建与外观/交互变化联系起来，实现跨代理泛化；4) 构建WorldPrism数据集，来自智能体搭建世界、AAA游戏与开源视频，提供对应渲染与chunk级标注。
AI.result: 在GWM-Bench与Solar-Bench上，重建质量与视觉质量均有提升；定性结果显示，在提示词与主体参考不断变化的情况下可进行分钟级的交互式渲染。
AI.conclusion: ContextRenderer通过动态条件学习、历史压缩与跨表示对齐，配合专用数据集，有效解决了长时交互游戏渲染中的条件跟随与视觉连续性矛盾，并具备跨代理泛化能力。

title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
summary: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill.png：将"技能"以图像形式表示，通过对冻结 VLM 视觉编码器做梯度优化来获得可迁移的技能图像，替代纯文本技能。
AI.motivation: 文本技能是离散的，无法连续优化；微调等梯度方法又依赖特定模型，难以跨智能体迁移。而多数智能体基于 VLM，可用视觉输入弥合这一矛盾。
AI.method: 在冻结的 VLM 上，将技能编码为图像，对其像素通过视觉编码器做梯度下降优化；图像技能对任意 VLM 兼容，并可对一个模型集成联合优化；也支持文本+图像混合技能。
AI.result: 在 4 个 VLM、4 个基准的 16 种设定中，9 种显著优于前沿 LLM 优化的文本技能；推理时仅需 64–256 个图像 token（对比约 900–2000 文本 token）。混合技能进一步提升性能，集成优化的图像技能可跨模型迁移。
AI.conclusion: Skill.png 是首个既可用梯度下降优化、又保留文本技能迁移优势的智能体技能形式。

title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
summary: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).

AI.tldr: 提出零梯度、闭式"电路嫁接"原语，把确定性多位数算术直接编译进预训练语言模型权重，无需训练样本与运行时钩子，同时保持自然语言能力。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型在精确多位数算术上不可靠，现有方案依赖梯度微调或外部工具解释器，成本高、破坏自然语言能力且不易内联到生成过程。
AI.method: 三大解析机制：(1)无偏置SwiGLU/GeGLU上两层Mellin-GLU求积，将未知的逐token RMSNorm缩放转化为对数间隔门控网格上的平移；(2)借有符号Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink注意力与无记忆SiLU反对称GatedDeltaNet移位实现跨token尺度抵消；(3)沿轴宽度扩展d→d+K配√(d/(d+K))范数补偿、Base-1000 BPE发射与差分(+254,−256)绑定去嵌入；并用全自动5阶段编译器在TC⁰常数深度内合成电路。
AI.result: 6位数算术(N=1200,BF16)上，Granite 4.2 3B达99.17%、Qwen 3.5 4B达100% ALU前缀准确率(加FP32侧车为100%)，句中续写98%–100%，远超12.8K样本LoRA(42.2%/61.7%，内联续写为0%)；3字面量布尔与5位Majority/Parity均100%；侧车显存7.89/10.65 GiB，并全部通过14/14 Tango长文本切分。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以零训练样本、零运行时钩子实现高精度内联算术，显著优于LoRA微调且不损害自然语言能力，为向预训练LM注入确定性计算提供了可扩展、低开销的编译式途径。

title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Qiming Huang, Hanze Dong, and Jipeng Zhang contributed equally
summary: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mask-Evidence MedVQA 基准，分离“证据使用”与“分割质量”，揭示医学视觉语言智能体直接使用工具的两种缺陷（呈现方式敏感、证据权衡），并提出 TUNE 证据管理框架。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把“拿到好的掩码”当作工具使用终点，但智能体是否能有效利用掩码证据未被检验；已有医学 VQA 数据集无法同时满足：区分证据使用与分割质量、覆盖多种影像、允许同一掩码多种呈现。
AI.method: 构建 2.5K 示例的 Mask-Evidence MedVQA 基准，覆盖四类影像，每题配答案相关真值掩码及多种渲染方式；据此分析直接工具使用的局限，并设计 TUNE 框架，显式管理“获取何种证据、如何呈现、是否接受答案更新”。
AI.result: 同一固定掩码的不同渲染会显著改变模型行为；掩码存在证据权衡——既能暴露此前遗漏的诊断证据，也会诱发错误关联，使原本正确的答案变错。TUNE 在三个医学 VQA 基准上使 Qwen3.5-9B 平均准确率提升 4.0 个百分点；在七个基准上平均比直接工具使用高 9.1 点，并与现有医学 VLM 和智能体有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 获得正确掩码并不足够，智能体还需决定证据如何呈现以及是否据此更新答案；显式证据管理是提升医学多模态智能体可靠性的关键方向。

title: A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant method for training deep neural networks, but its reliance on non-local computations has motivated the search for biologically plausible alternatives. Two prominent frameworks, predictive coding (PC) and deep feedback control (DFC), offer distinct approaches to local learning, yet their relationship remains unclear. Here, we show that DFC arises as a local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, with exact equivalence in shallow linear networks and systematic deviations arising with depth, nonlinearity, and distance from equilibrium. We characterize how this approximation, which we call Approx PC, deviates from PC in its activity dynamics, and show that these deviations can be mitigated by relinearizing the feedback controller and approaching the output target through a sequence of intermediate nudges. In networks trained on MNIST and FashionMNIST, Approx PC reaches task performance comparable to PC trained with the same nudges, and weights learned with it transfer directly to PC inference. Our results unify energy-based and control-theoretic perspectives on learning and open the door to applying tools from control theory to the training of predictive coding networks.

AI.tldr: DFC 可视为预测编码（PC）在不动点附近的局部近似（Approx PC），二者在浅层线性网络等价，深度/非线性下出现偏差，并可通过重线性化与分步 nudging 缓解。
AI.motivation: 反向传播依赖非局部计算，缺乏生物合理性；PC 与 DFC 两种局部学习框架关系不明，本文旨在揭示两者的联系。
AI.method: 从理论上推导 DFC 为 PC 动力学在不动点附近的局部近似（Approx PC），分析其在深度、非线性及远离平衡时的偏差，并采用反馈控制器重线性化与序列化中间 nudges 来减小偏差。
AI.result: 浅层线性网络下二者精确等价；在 MNIST 和 FashionMNIST 上，Approx PC 达到与同等 nudge 训练的 PC 相当的任务性能，且所学权重可直接迁移至 PC 推理。
AI.conclusion: 统一了基于能量与基于控制论的学习视角，为将控制理论工具应用于 PC 网络训练开辟了道路。

title: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
summary: Set pieces produce about a third of non-penalty expected goals (xG), yet they are usually evaluated by what happened next. We present Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS) for set pieces, which treats a corner or a lofted free kick as a distribution over plausible executions and plausible futures instead of a single realised event. From the pre-kick state, MCPS proposes counterfactual deliveries and counterfactual set-ups (where the attackers stand at the kick), plays each out many times in a world model (3D ball physics, a generative model of all 22 players, the keeper's come-or-stay decision and a Player-to-Touch model) and scores every future with a value model. On 249 deliveries from 30 Serie A 2025/26 matches, with every model applied only to matches it never saw, the best available delivery is worth 0.0085 xG more than the one kicked (+28 %), mainly because it reaches an attacker before the keeper. Searching where the attackers stand as well adds +0.0027 xG with the observed ball and +0.0033 on top of the best ball; designing their runs too adds +0.0007 more. We show how to keep such a search honest, and estimate how much more data each component needs before a club could rely on it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出蒙特卡洛传球搜索(MCPS)框架，将角球和传中任意球视为"可能执行方式×可能未来"的分布，而非单一已发生事件，通过世界模型与价值模型评估反事实传球与跑位，量化定位球决策的改进空间。
AI.motivation: 定位球贡献了约三分之一的非点球预期进球(xG)，但传统评估只看"事后发生了什么"，无法回答"是否有更好的执行方式或布置"，缺乏反事实评估手段。
AI.method: 从踢球前状态出发，MCPS生成反事实传球路线和反事实站位（以及可选的跑位设计），每个方案在世界模型中多次推演——包含3D球物理、全部22名球员的生成模型、门将出击/留守决策和"球员触球"模型——并用价值模型为每个未来打分。在30场意甲2025/26赛季的249次传球上，所有模型仅用于未见过的比赛以保持评估诚实。
AI.result: 最佳可选传球比实际传球多0.0085 xG(+28%)，主因是球能先于门将到达进攻球员；额外搜索站位在观测球上增加+0.0027 xG，在最佳球基础上再增+0.0033；进一步设计跑位再增+0.0007。论文还给出保持搜索诚实的做法，并估计各组件需要多少额外数据才能被俱乐部可靠使用。
AI.conclusion: 基于生成式世界模型的反事实搜索能有效量化定位球决策的提升空间，且传球选择是关键杠杆、站位与跑位有增量价值；但当前增益幅度仍小，各组件的数据需求尚需满足才能投入实战应用。

title: TrajCal: Trajectory-Calibrated Time Schedules for Few-Step Flow Sampling
summary: Flow matching enables high-quality image and video generation, but its iterative sampling process requires repeated evaluations of large neural networks. Existing few-step methods can distort the output and reduce its agreement with a many-step reference. We propose TrajCal, a training-free calibration framework for few-step sampling. Based on scatter search, a well-established metaheuristic for difficult optimization problems, TrajCal starts with diverse seed schedules, deforms and combines these candidates, and selects one fixed schedule by final output fidelity for reuse on new inputs. For both image and video generation, TrajCal achieves higher reference fidelity than all compared baselines at low evaluation budgets while maintaining competitive visual quality. The search is effective even with randomly generated seeds, while trajectory-based seeds further improve fidelity. For cross-style generalization, photography-calibrated schedules also improve fidelity on unseen image styles.

AI.tldr: TrajCal 是一个免训练的小步数采样校准框架，借用 scatter search 元启发式固定一套采样时间表，在图像与视频生成中提升对多步参考的保真度。
AI.motivation: Flow matching 采样质量高，但需反复调用大网络做迭代采样，代价高。现有少步方法容易使输出失真，并降低与多步参考结果的一致性。
AI.method: 免训练框架：以多样化的种子时间表为起点，通过变形与组合候选解进行 scatter search，并按最终输出保真度选出一条固定时间表，复用于新输入；支持随机种子与轨迹种子。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成上，低评估预算下参考保真度优于全部对比基线，同时视觉质量有竞争力；随机种子已有效，轨迹种子进一步提升；摄影图像校准的时间表在未见风格上也有保真度提升。
AI.conclusion: 将少步采样视为优化问题、离线搜索并固定一次时间表即可有效缩小与多步参考的差距，且具有一定跨风格泛化性。

title: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
summary: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations. This study presents a two-branch graph attention network (GAT) to predict three-dimensional surface displacement directly from STL-derived graphs. The first branch learns geometric relationships among connected vertices of a densified STL surface mesh, while the second incorporates 12 part-level descriptors of mass distribution, build-plate contact, overhang, size, and shape. Displacement labels from ANSYS Additive Print simulations are mapped onto STL vertices using Gaussian-kernel weighted averaging. Evaluated on 117 parts using five-fold cross-validation split by part, the model achieves an R^2 of 0.946 and a mean absolute error of 0.0178 mm for displacement magnitude. Relative to a node-wise multilayer perceptron, GAT improves R^2 from 0.913 to 0.946; for build-direction displacement, R^2 increases from 0.903 to 0.939. GAT also outperforms GraphSAGE (R^2 = 0.936) and a graph convolutional network (R^2 = 0.934) across all five folds. Ablation experiments show that removing mass-distribution descriptors reduces magnitude R^2 to 0.900, while removing build-plate contact and overhang descriptors reduces it to 0.920. These results demonstrate the value of combining local mesh connectivity with global geometric descriptors to predict LPBF distortion, enabling faster design iteration and earlier identification of distortion-prone geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支图注意力网络（GAT），直接从STL网格图预测LPBF零件三维表面位移，R²达0.946、MAE 0.0178 mm，优于MLP、GraphSAGE和GCN。
AI.motivation: LPBF成形前的零件变形预测困难：热力耦合仿真计算代价高，难以支撑反复的设计评估，需要快速代理模型。
AI.method: 双分支GAT：第一分支学习加密STL表面网格顶点间的几何关系（局部连通性），第二分支引入12个部件级描述符（质量分布、基板接触、悬垂、尺寸、形状）。以ANSYS Additive Print仿真位移为标签，用高斯核加权平均映射到STL顶点。117个零件、按零件划分的五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 位移幅值R²=0.946、MAE=0.0178 mm；较节点级MLP的R²由0.913提升至0.946，构建方向位移R²由0.903升至0.939；优于GraphSAGE（0.936）与GCN（0.934）。消融：去除质量分布描述符R²降至0.900，去除基板接触与悬垂描述符降至0.920。
AI.conclusion: 局部网格连通性与全局几何描述符相结合可有效预测LPBF变形，支持更快设计迭代与早期识别易变形几何。

title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
summary: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

AI.tldr: FLUID 是一个面向多模态任务引导的统一框架，用真实人-人引导数据将干预动作与其证据、必要性和时间灵活性绑定，既能评估灵活引导，也能构建实时引导智能体。
AI.motivation: 实时任务引导本质上是灵活的：说什么、何时说都有多种合理选择，有时最好的行动是保持沉默。现有基准把合成对话当作固定的"内容+时机"目标，无法刻画这种灵活性。
AI.method: 基于 WTaG 与 HoloAssist 中自然发生的人-人引导数据，FLUID 将干预动作锚定到支撑证据、必要性判断与时机灵活性上，形成统一表示，并用该表示同时进行评估与实时智能体构建。
AI.result: 该智能体在响应正确性、干预精确度、引导及时性和响应延迟上综合表现最佳，但在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: FLUID 推动情境化任务引导从僵化的参考匹配走向更自然、更自适应的人机交互；项目主页见 fluid-guidance.github.io。

title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: https://egowitness.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/egowitness/EgoWitness
summary: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoWitness基准（8,453问、约324小时第一人称视频）测试实例级空间记忆；现有12个VLM最高准确率46.97%，提出EgoClue智能体经两阶段训练将4B模型从23.64%提升至72.65%。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频基准多关注事件、物体类别或相对位置，忽视"是否同一实例"的跨天跨人空间记忆；多模态模型缺少识别同一物体实例、回忆其位置时间及目击者的评测。
AI.method: 构建EgoWitness：7项能力、约324小时周级与短时录制、百万级审核掩码（34个注册地标+21类可移动物体）经房间时间线关联。提出EgoClue空间记忆智能体：检索候选区间、验证实例身份，用5个工具计算时空关系；采用SFT+GRPO两阶段训练4B控制器。
AI.result: 12个VLM中开源权重最高46.97%，"谁最后看到"任务无一超35%；EgoClue在1,320道留出题上由23.64%升至72.65%；证据轨迹合成在周级问题上达74.85%（追平最佳直接VLM），未训练环境中达80.56%。
AI.conclusion: 实例级空间记忆是现有VLM显著短板；工具增强+强化学习训练的智能体配合证据追踪，可大幅提升长时程第一人称空间记忆与推理，并具跨环境泛化性。

title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出主动空间推理任务与ProSpace-Bench/ProSpace-Train，并设计ProSpace-VLM：将因果估计的显式几何编码注入VLM中间层，用KV cache作空间记忆、空间token选择实现高效流式处理。
AI.motivation: 流式视频中判断空间条件何时成立，需要在视角变化下持续维护与更新空间知识；现有VLM缺乏"是否响应、何时响应"的主动空间推理能力。
AI.method: 构建含九项任务（物体、相机、场景推理）的ProSpace-Bench与ProSpace-Train监督数据；提出ProSpace-VLM，把从输入帧因果估计的几何编码注入VLM中间层，复用KV cache作为空间记忆，并采用空间token选择以支持高效流式推理。
AI.result: VLM与人类存在显著差距；相比微调基线，ProSpace-VLM在及时响应与正确弃答（正确不响应）上均有提升，并分析其如何表示随视角变化的已观测空间信息。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何编码注入与KV cache空间记忆可有效支持主动流式空间推理，但机器与人类仍有较大差距。

title: TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting supports healthcare monitoring, environmental analysis, and activity recognition. Channel-independent (CI) approaches capture each variable's temporal patterns but do not explicitly use observations from other variables. Channel-dependent (CD) modeling exploits relationships among variables, yet asynchronous measurements make these relationships difficult to learn. Incorporating cross-variable information while preserving each variable's irregular history therefore remains a key challenge. We propose Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting (TRCF), a framework that augments a compact CI forecaster with a complementary CD branch. ANCHOR aggregates observed values and timestamps at shared temporal locations, retaining observation support to form compact CI features. BRIDGE constructs complementary features through history completion. It first estimates each variable's historical values from its own observations, then uses differences between other variables' observed and estimated values at nearby times to correct missing entries. The completed history preserves observed values and is encoded to supply context alongside the direct CI representation. Finally, the two representations are fused, combined with the query-time embedding, and passed to a shallow multilayer perceptron for forecasting. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that TRCF achieves the lowest mean squared error and mean absolute error in the main benchmark comparison, while reducing measured peak inference memory by 17.28% to 87.98% relative to APN.

AI.tldr: 提出TRCF框架，在保持通道独立（CI）不规则历史表示的同时，通过历史补全引入跨变量（CD）信息，并以低内存开销实现更优预测。
AI.motivation: 不规则多变量时间序列预测中，CI方法忽略变量间关系，CD方法因异步测量难以学习关系。核心挑战是既要利用跨变量信息，又要保留各变量自身的不规则历史。
AI.method: TRCF由紧凑CI预测器加互补CD分支构成：ANCHOR在共享时间位置聚合观测值与时间戳，保留观测支撑形成紧凑CI特征；BRIDGE通过历史补全构建互补特征——先由变量自身观测估计其历史值，再用邻近时刻其他变量的观测值与估计值之差修正缺失项，补全历史保留观测值并编码为上下文；最后融合两种表示并结合查询时刻嵌入，输入浅层MLP进行预测。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上，主基准比较中取得最低MSE与MAE，同时相较APN将实测峰值推理内存降低17.28%–87.98%。
AI.conclusion: TRCF有效兼顾了通道独立的不规则历史保留与跨变量信息利用，在精度与推理内存效率上均优于对比方法。

title: LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
summary: Intersectional bias arises when a model treats people who hold several marginalised identities at once differently from what their separate identities would predict. Auditing such intersectional subgroups remains a challenge: their number grows quadratically, and there is no agreed baseline for what independent attributes would predict. Without such a baseline, many existing audits flag a subgroup when it exceeds each attribute alone, a condition that attributes acting independently already satisfy. We test this standard criterion on 150 synthetic datasets built with no interaction. With the shuffle null, it flags 66.1 false subgroups per dataset on average, and at least one in every dataset. When we plant interactions of known size into these datasets, a repaired null lets the criterion recover only 32% of them. We introduce ADDIS (Additive Intersectional Screen), which fits an additive model over all attributes, scores each subgroup by its Additive Residual Distance (ARD) from that model's prediction, and tests it against a Freedman-Lane null. On our synthetic benchmark, ADDIS flags 0.09 false subgroups per dataset and recovers 84% of the same planted interactions. We then build IndiPersona, 10,000 synthetic Indian personas with six identity attributes, and audit 13 open language models. The standard criterion flags 7.1% of the 738 tested subgroups on average; ADDIS flags 3.0%. Gender identity crossed with sexual orientation is the largest pairing in every model, and counterfactual personas confirm it and additionally reveal a caste x class interaction in all but one model that the observational test lacked the data to detect. Much of what audits report as intersectional bias can thus arise from independent single-attribute effects alone, yet a small core of interactions survives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ADDIS 方法审计交叉性偏见：用可加模型作基线、以 Additive Residual Distance 度量子群偏离，并用 Freedman-Lane 零假设检验。合成数据上误报从 66.1 降至 0.09/数据集，检出率 84%；在 1 万印度人设、13 个开源大模型审计中，标准判据标记 7.1% 子群，ADDIS 仅 3.0%，并揭示性别认同×性取向、种姓×阶级等交互。
AI.motivation: 交叉性偏见审计的难点：(1) 子群数量随属性数二次增长；(2) 缺乏"属性独立时应有的表现"的公认基线。现有审计常以"子群效应超过任一单属性效应"为判据，但独立属性相加本身就能满足该条件，导致大量误报。
AI.method: 1) 在 150 个无交互合成数据集上测试标准判据（shuffle null），并植入已知大小的交互；(2) 提出 ADDIS：对所有属性拟合可加模型，以子群预测残差距离（ARD）打分，再用 Freedman-Lane 置换零假设检验；(3) 构建 IndiPersona——10,000 个含六种身份属性的印度人设，审计 13 个开源语言模型，并辅以反事实人设验证。
AI.result: 合成基准：标准判据每数据集平均误报 66.1 个子群（每个数据集至少 1 个）；修正零假设后仅能检出 32% 植入交互。ADDIS 误报 0.09 个/数据集，检出 84%。真实审计：738 个测试子群中标准判据平均标记 7.1%，ADDIS 标记 3.0%；所有模型中性别认同×性取向为最大配对；反事实人设进一步揭示种姓×阶级交互（12/13 模型），而观察性检验因数据不足未能检出。
AI.conclusion: 现有审计报告的交叉性偏见中很大一部分可能仅源于独立的单属性效应，但存在一小部分真实交互的核心。ADDIS 提供了更可靠、可解释的交叉性偏见检测工具，也说明需要反事实数据来捕捉观察数据无法覆盖的交互。

title: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
summary: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布WHU-Road3D——首个面向精细路面要素制图的大规模多模态数据集，含约100km中国公路与城市街道的MLS点云、全景影像、轨迹及矢量/逐点标注，覆盖15类路面要素，并综述了现有数据集与方法，指出其在语义丰富度、模态多样性和场景复杂性上的不足。
AI.motivation: 高精度地图、道路资产管理及智能交通系统需要精确提取与制图路面要素，但现有基准数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂性方面仍有欠缺，缺乏覆盖全面路面要素的多模态基准。
AI.method: 先对路面要素提取与制图的基准数据集（从俯视到透视、从大范围到局部、从粗到细）及现有提取方法进行系统综述；据此构建WHU-Road3D数据集：约100km中国公路与城市街道，融合MLS点云、全景影像、车辆轨迹、详细矢量化标注与逐点实例标注，精细标注15类路面要素（道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线等常见标线及10类方向符号）。
AI.result: 据作者所知，WHU-Road3D是首个可制图如此全面路面要素范围的多模态数据集，支持路面实例分割、全要素提取与制图等前沿研究，并为分层道路拓扑推理、地图更新与街景生成提供数据来源；数据集与基准方法代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: WHU-Road3D弥补了现有路面要素数据集在语义、模态与场景复杂度上的不足，可作为多任务研究的基础数据资源，并已承诺开源数据集与基准代码以促进后续研究。

title: Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. XX pages, X figures. Code: https://github.com/Cosmonaught/Mambaflownp
summary: Interpolating a spatial field, such as daily maximum temperature, from sparse, irregularly located observations recurs across the environmental and health sciences. Standard Gaussian-process kriging refits hyperparameters and solves an $O(N^3)$ system for every new field. When many related fields are observed, such as daily maps from one sensor network, neural processes (NPs) instead learn the interpolation map from past fields and predict a new field in one forward pass. Joint-predictive variants, which sample whole fields rather than independent per-location values, typically use self-attention over context and query points, costing $O(K^2)$ in the combined point count $K$ and limiting practical use to a few thousand points. State-space models offer a linear-time alternative, but a direct state-space adaptation compresses the context into one hidden state before reading queries, reducing what the decoder sees. We propose MambaFlowNP, a linear-compute joint-predictive NP trained with conditional flow matching. A multi-directional Mamba-2 scan reads context and query tokens in one shared sequence, so each query's velocity is read from its own scan position rather than a compressed context summary, and because queries only read the scan state, predictions are consistent across query sets. MambaFlowNP is competitive with the strongest attention-based joint-predictive baselines on synthetic Matérn Gaussian-process benchmarks, and on regional to continental-scale NOAA temperature interpolation it attains the lowest RMSE and CRPS and near-nominal coverage on every tier, while running 114--784$\times$ faster than the strongest joint-predictive baseline. A single forward pass scales to $10^6$ points on one NVIDIA L40S GPU in under a second. This makes joint prediction feasible for continental-scale, irregularly sampled sensor networks; predictive quality is evaluated up to $K=5{,}580$.

AI.tldr: 提出 MambaFlowNP：用多方向 Mamba-2 扫描 + 条件流匹配，实现线性复杂度、联合预测的神经过程，可对上百万点做一次性前向插值。
AI.motivation: 空间场（如日最高气温）插值中，GP kriging 需对每个新场重拟合超参数并解 O(N^3) 方程；神经过程可一次前向完成，但联合预测变体依赖自注意力，O(K^2) 复杂度限制在数千点；状态空间模型虽线性，但先把上下文压缩为单一隐状态，削弱了解码器可见信息。
AI.method: MambaFlowNP：把上下文点与查询点 token 拼成一条共享序列，用多方向 Mamba-2 扫描读取，使每个查询的流速度直接取自自身扫描位置而非压缩摘要；因查询只读取扫描状态，预测对不同查询集合保持一致；以条件流匹配训练，实现联合（整场）采样。
AI.result: 在合成 Matérn GP 基准上与最强注意力联合预测基线相当；在区域至大陆尺度 NOAA 气温插值上，各层级 RMSE 与 CRPS 最低、覆盖率接近名义值，速度比最强联合预测基线快 114–784 倍；单张 L40S 上单次前向可在 1 秒内扩展到 10^6 点，预测质量评估至 K=5,580。
AI.conclusion: 线性复杂度的状态空间联合预测神经过程可在大陆尺度、不规则采样的传感器网络上实用化，兼顾精度、校准与速度。

title: The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
summary: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. On lies about knowledge, persona directions mainly track a reply's wording: where lies and honest denials share their words, our three main contrasts stay inside the random-direction band on Llama and Qwen and reach only its edge on Gemma, though on Mistral one clears it. A knowledge direction contrasts questions the model can answer with ones nobody can, each followed by the same scripted denial. It separates lies from identical honest denials on two models and narrowly on a third, but not on the fourth; its other results partly depend on the benchmark's wording. On the Gender-Secret fine-tune it clears the band by a few hundredths on Llama and fails on Mistral. The sum of the two directions ranks lies better than a supervised probe at the same depth on all four models (on one, both near chance) but is level with the persona direction on Llama's average and behind that probe on held-out lies. More varied role-play questions do not help the persona direction on Liars' Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文测试了从"诚实/欺骗角色扮演"对比中提取的无需标签的persona方向在70B规模LLM上的谎言检测能力，并将其扩展到"关于知识的谎言"场景；结果表明persona方向跨基准略优于单数据集探针但多处与随机方向带难以区分，需补充一个"知识方向"来覆盖措辞相同的情形。
AI.motivation: 线性探针是最廉价的LLM谎言检测器，但难以跨谎言类型迁移。此前基于角色扮演的无标签方向尚未在70B规模上验证，也未在"关于知识的谎言"上测试——而在这一场景中，一句谎言与一句诚实的否认在文本上可能完全相同，构成对现有方法的严峻挑战。
AI.method: 扩充已发表的persona bank，加入"否认自己实际掌握的知识"的角色及其诚实对照；在各模型中间层提取persona方向。另构造一个knowledge方向：对比模型能回答的问题与无人能回答的问题，均接同一段脚本化否认。用随机方向带（random-direction band）、单数据集探针、已发表方向、监督探针作为对照基线，在Liars' Bench与Gender-Secret微调上评估，并测试更多样化的角色扮演问题是否有效。
AI.result: persona方向在Liars' Bench四个模型中三个上优于单数据集探针，但在Qwen上失败（尽管Qwen更常保持角色）。Llama-3.3-70B上优于随机persona bank的方向，但相对已发表方向的增益落在随机扩充的波动范围内。在"知识谎言"上，persona方向主要追踪措辞：当谎言与诚实否认用词相同时，三个主要对比均落在随机带内（Llama、Qwen）或仅达边缘（Gemma），仅Mistral超过。knowledge方向在两个模型上分开谎言与完全相同的诚实否认，第三个接近，第四个失败，部分结果依赖基准措辞。Gender-Secret微调上Llama超出随机带几百分之一，Mistral失败。两方向之和在四个模型同层均优于监督探针（其中一个两者均接近随机），但在Llama均值上与persona方向持平、在留出谎言上落后于该探针。更丰富的角色扮演问题未能改善Liars' Bench表现。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演导出的无标签方向可作廉价的跨谎言类型检测器，但在大模型与"措辞相同"的知识谎言上收益有限且不稳定，单一方���不足以覆盖；组合persona与knowledge方向在部分指标上有优势但并不全面领先，且更多样化的角色扮演提问无帮助。

title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
summary: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: EvoMem 是一个自进化检索技能引导的时间感知长视频记忆智能体，通过分层时间索引记忆与状态驱动检索技能提升长视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强 LVLMs 的视频检索依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏状态驱动的时间控制，导致证据碎片化、冗余，难以维持连贯证据链。
AI.method: 1) 构建分层时间索引记忆，将多类证据对齐到统一时间线；2) 检索时将已获证据的时间线索转为显式信号约束后续访问；3) 引入检索技能提供过程级指导，动态调整检索内容、记忆操作与目标时间范围并决定停止时机；4) 将技能进化建模为奖励引导的策略改进，候选技能视作外部策略补丁，依据验证集答案正确性状态转移给奖励，无需更新模型参数即可接受或拒绝技能。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上显著优于现有基线，平均准确率 60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提升 8.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 时间感知记忆与自进化检索技能相结合可有效解决长视频证据链不连贯问题，无需微调即可实现显著性能提升。

title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
summary: Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values. A coordinate's own corrupted state can make prediction easy, potentially reducing the pressure to learn dependencies between coordinates. We study leave-one-out (LOO) prediction, in which each coordinate is predicted from the corrupted states of the other coordinates. We show that, under stated assumptions, jump diffusions with complete coordinate resets and state-independent clocks preserve the prescribed marginals when reset destinations use exact LOO probabilities and the drift uses the full endpoint posterior. We further show that this drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities by analytic likelihood completion without additional network evaluations. We evaluate unrestricted, LOO, and completed predictions on Text8 and LM1B text generation and ZINC250k molecular graph generation. LOO-based variants improve key generation metrics over matched unrestricted controls on all three datasets. Controlled interventions assess reliance on local inputs and context, and we analyze the effect of analytic likelihood completion.

AI.tldr: 提出带坐标重置的跳跃扩散模型，用留一法(LOO)预测避免模型依赖自身已损坏状态，并通过解析似然补全构造漂移，在文本与分子图生成任务上优于对照。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型在嵌入空间生成离散数据时，每个坐标自身的损坏状态会使预测变得过易，从而削弱模型学习坐标间依赖关系的压力，导致生成质量受限。
AI.method: 研究带完整坐标重置和状态无关时钟的跳跃扩散：重置目标使用精确LOO概率、漂移使用完整端点后验时可保持规定边缘分布；并证明该漂移可由LOO概率通过解析似然补全构造，无需额外网络评估。在Text8、LM1B文本生成和ZINC250k分子图生成上对比无约束、LOO及补全预测三种变体，并做受控干预实验。
AI.result: 基于LOO的变体在三个数据集上均较匹配的无约束对照改善关键生成指标；受控干预实验揭示了模型对局部输入与上下文的依赖程度，并分析了解析似然补全的效果。
AI.conclusion: LOO预测结合解析似然补全能在不增加网络评估的情况下有效提升离散数据生成质量，是一种可推广的扩散建模改进方案。

title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.

AI.tldr: 提出 MM-SystemOneBias，用 6 类配对干预（选项顺序、标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息、评分量表）在 9 个公开数据集、11 个任务场景、5,323 条实例上对比 13 个多模态决策模型及其骨干模型，首次给出统一评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把"决策接口偏差"与"多模态模型行为"分开评估，缺少可比对决策模型与骨干模型的统一协议，难以判断决策模型是否真正保住语义决策。
AI.method: 构建 MM-SystemOneBias 基准：13 个模型、5,323 条原始实例（来自 9 个公开数据集）、11 类任务场景，施加 6 种配对干预（选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息、评分量表），并配对比较 7 组"决策模型—骨干模型"。
AI.result: 7 组配对中，决策模型在标签、无关信息、评分量表变化下全部更稳定，6 组选项顺序翻转率更低；错误外部判断下 7 组准确率损失更小，冲突描述下 6 组更小；但 6 组从正确外部判断和一致描述中获益更少。语义决策不变时，答案概率平均绝对变化达 4.56–11.55 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型显著提升对表面扰动和错误线索的鲁棒性，但对有用线索的利用也变弱；仅看准确率会掩盖输入端的影响，概率层面的变化必须纳入评估。

title: Does It Depend on the Split? Frozen Satellite Features vs. Fine-Tuned CNNs for Tree Species Mapping
summary: Self-supervised foundation models are often said to need fewer labels than supervised training. We test this on a forestry task: classifying 20 tree species classes in 0.2 m aerial images from the TreeSatAI dataset. We compare a frozen DINOv3 model pretrained on 493 million satellite images, with only a linear classifier trained on top, against an ImageNet ResNet-50 that is fine-tuned end to end. On the official split, fine-tuning wins clearly (macro F1 0.764 vs. 0.685). However, 28.8% of the official test patches overlap a training or validation patch, and copying the label of the nearest such patch is correct for 83.6% of them. We therefore build a spatial split that holds out whole 2 km squares with a 200 m buffer. On this split the comparison becomes inconclusive (0.648 vs. 0.640, paired 95% CI of the difference [-0.054, 0.016]), and the learning curves of the two models overlap at every label budget from 343 to 33,126 training patches. On the five rarest classes, the frozen model achieves a higher mean F1 (0.566 vs. 0.445), although the confidence interval for this difference includes zero ([-0.05, 0.23]). Diagnostics show that the frozen features mainly miss differences between closely related species, such as the two native oaks. Choosing the input size and layer on validation data (224 px, block 16) raises the frozen model to 0.662 on the spatial split. A comparison that looks decisive on the official split is thus inconclusive under geographically separated evaluation. We release the spatial split and our code.

AI.tldr: 在林业20类树种分类任务上，官方划分显示端到端微调ResNet-50显著优于冻结DINOv3+线性分类器（macro F1 0.764 vs 0.685），但官方测试集28.8%的图块与训练/验证集重叠（复制最近邻标签即达83.6%正确率）。改用带200米缓冲的2公里空间划分后，两者差异不显著（0.648 vs 0.640），学习曲线在各标签预算下重叠。
AI.motivation: 检验"自监督基础模型比监督训练需要更少标签"这一常见论断，并质疑遥感/林业领域常用随机划分因空间泄漏而高估性能、导致模型比较结论失真的问题。
AI.method: 基于TreeSatAI数据集0.2米航拍影像做20类树种分类。对比冻结的DINOv3（4.93亿卫星影像预训练，仅训线性头）与端到端微调的ImageNet ResNet-50；量化官方划分的空间重叠度，构建保留整块2km方格并设200m缓冲的空间划分，在343至33,126个训练图块的多个标签预算下比较学习曲线，并做诊断分析。
AI.result: 官方划分下微调明显胜出（0.764 vs 0.685），但存在严重空间泄漏；空间划分下二者不可区分（0.648 vs 0.640，差值95% CI [-0.054, 0.016]），学习曲线全程重叠。五个最稀有类别上冻结模型平均F1更高（0.566 vs 0.445，但CI含零）。冻结特征主要难以区分近缘物种（如两种本土栎树）。在验证集上选择输入尺寸与层（224px，block 16）后冻结模型提升至0.662。
AI.conclusion: 官方划分上看似决定性的比较，在地理分离评估下变为不确定；随机划分的空间泄漏会严重误导模型对比结论。作者公开了空间划分与代码，呼吁遥感评测采用空间划分。

title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
summary: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational autoencoder that encodes a design into one shared spatial prototype and one candidate vector per layer. Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its corresponding RGBA layer. For $N$ layers, the representation contains $HW+N$ tokens before backbone-specific packing, compared with $NHW$ for full-grid-per-layer representations. ProtoDiffusion jointly denoises the prototype and a fixed set of candidate slots, conditioned on an image or text, with bounding boxes as optional layout guidance. The model leaves unneeded slots empty and determines the number of layers and, in absence of boxes, their layout, requiring neither as input. The same architecture supports both image-to-design and text-to-design. ProtoVAE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction from its compact shared latent representation, reaching 40.43 dB PSNR on layer crops. On the LayerD evaluation split, image-to-design achieves RGB L1 scores of 0.040 with bounding boxes and 0.057 without, with box-guided alpha soft IoU (0.850) comparable to the strongest fine-tuned baseline (0.871). On merged images, text-to-design reaches 66.41 FID versus 86.84 for FLUX.2 [klein], achieves a 0.860 text-accuracy score, and runs $19.1\times$ faster than the same-backbone generation-then-decomposition cascade.

AI.tldr: ProtoDiffusion 提出基于 ProtoVAE 的潜在扩散框架，用共享空间原型＋每层候选向量替代逐层全网格表示，实现紧凑的图层化设计生成。
AI.motivation: 现有图层表示每层用全画布或区域大小的空间潜变量网格，表示规模随图层累计空间范围增长（N 层为 NHW）。作者希望用与层数近似无关的紧凑表示，并同时支持图生设计与文生设计、无需给定层数或布局。
AI.method: ProtoVAE：多层变分自编码器，把设计编码为一个共享空间原型加每层一个候选向量，每个候选条件化共享解码器重建对应 RGBA 层，N 层共 HW+N 个 token。ProtoDiffusion 联合去噪原型与固定数量候选槽，以图像或文本为条件，包围盒作为可选布局引导；空槽自动留空，自行决定层数与布局。同一架构支持 image-to-design 与 text-to-design。
AI.result: ProtoVAE 在层裁剪上达 40.43 dB PSNR。LayerD 图像到设计：有框 RGB L1 0.040，无框 0.057；有框 alpha soft IoU 0.850，接近最强微调基线 0.871。合并图像上文生设计 FID 66.41（FLUX.2 [klein] 为 86.84），文本准确率 0.860，比同骨干的"先生成再分解"级联快 19.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: 用共享原型＋每层候选向量可大幅压缩图层表示且保持高保真重建；统一扩散架构可同时完成图/文到设计并自动推断层数与布局，质量与效率均优于主流基线。

title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
summary:
Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios.
  In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpatialMem，一种双层记忆框架，帮助 VLM 智能体积累工具使用经验并据此编排视觉专家完成定量空间推理，同时提出 MetricBench 基准。
AI.motivation: VLM 在定性空间推理上表现良好，但定量空间推理仍受限。现有做法让智能体调用外部视觉工具进行计算，却将每个功能需求绑定到单一预定义专家，导致工具流程固定僵化；而多样化场景与任务需要更丰富的流程编排和专家选择，这又带来组合爆炸的执行空间，使智能体难以找到最优方案。此外，现有基准存在质量问题，且场景类型和任务覆盖有限。
AI.method: SpatialMem 采用双层记忆结构：任务记忆记录工具编排方式，场景记忆记录工具选择；并引入双状态轨迹优化过程，保留成功的工具使用经验、修正次优经验。同时构建 MetricBench，覆盖室内外场景和三类定量空间推理任务。
AI.result: 在 MetricBench、Q-Spatial 和 SpatialRGPT-Bench 上取得 SOTA；在 MetricBench 上比最佳 VLM 基线高 32%，记忆设计相比无记忆智能体带来 9.1% 绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆积累与优化的工具编排机制，可有效缓解固定工具管线的局限，显著提升 VLM 智能体的定量空间推理能力，并提供了更全面的评测基准。

title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
summary: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, with the training objective fixed and random seeds varied. Despite similar test performance, mean pairwise Top-10 overlap on a separate screening catalogue was about two candidates. Our study moves DTI model evaluation beyond benchmark performance to assess whether model predictions can guide meaningful experimental decisions in drug discovery and target identification.

AI.tldr: 系统比较13个已发布的药物-靶点相互作用(DTI)模型的双向推荐，发现不同模型对同一靶点/药物的Top-10推荐高度不一致，且部分模型的命中率并不随推荐匹配关系改变而下降，说明基准指标难以反映实验决策价值。
AI.motivation: DTI模型可对数以万计的药物-靶点对排序，但实验验证能力有限；现有评估只关注基准性能，未考察模型预测能否真正指导药物发现与靶点鉴定的实验决策。
AI.method: 在711个FDA批准药物分子结构和614个人类蛋白上比较13个已发布系统的双向推荐；统计模型对间Top-10列表的不一致率与重叠情况；利用79个分子与65个激酶的已发表抑制实测数据评估命中率及其对推荐匹配的敏感性；并在同一架构、同一数据、固定训练目标下仅改变随机种子重训，考察Top-10重叠度。
AI.result: 同一靶点或药物下，77.8%（分子）和70.1%（蛋白）的模型对比较中Top-10列表完全不重叠；即使重叠，也多源于对各系统反复偏好的相同候选的偏好。部分系统能富集活性候选，但命中率几乎不随推荐与药物/靶点的匹配改变而变化；另一些系统则损失显著更多命中。前者中还有系统在两种药物偏好不同激酶时很少同时正确排序分子和激酶。相同架构与数据下改变随机种子，测试性能相近，但独立筛选目录上的平均Top-10重叠仅约2个候选。
AI.conclusion: DTI模型的评估应超越基准性能，转向考察其预测能否指导药物发现与靶点鉴定中真正有意义的实验决策；当前模型间的高度不一致与随机种子敏感性凸显了这一评估范式的必要性。

title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态Jacobian透镜MC-Lens，将视觉编码器与语言解码器的中间状态映射到共享语义空间，揭示VLM的概念可及性、选择性访问及跨模态对齐规律，为在多模态人工系统中研究全局工作空间理论提供实验基础。
AI.motivation: VLM融合视觉与文本信息，但其输出无法揭示内部概念表示；借助全局工作空间理论(GWT)来考察VLM内部概念如何被选择、整合与供专门过程使用，是一个待填补的研究空白。
AI.method: 提出多模态Jacobian透镜MC-Lens：分别为视觉编码器和语言解码器构建透镜，把中间状态映射到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，以跨模态比较概念可及性；支持内部概念干预的反事实实验；将"readout carrier"从单个name token扩展到token集合以更好捕捉概念信息；并提出两个J-space指标追踪跨模态概念对齐的发展。
AI.result: (i)多模态概念信息在中间状态可读取，并按任务需要被选择性获取；(ii)反事实实验显示被访问的概念信息参与下游计算与推理；(iii)两个J-space指标比隐状态余弦相似度更清晰地追踪跨模态对齐发展，且可靠的选择性访问晚于概念可及性出现；(iv)跨VLM家族与规模存在共享模式：概念可及性、查询依赖的选择性及跨任务干预效应一致，尽管内部组织不同。
AI.conclusion: MC-Lens为在多模态人工系统中实验性研究GWT提供了工具与证据，并可用于指导跨模态对齐的改进。

title: Why Flat Drafts Stay Flat: Region-Mean Latents Govern Texture in Flow-Based Image Generation
summary: Flat color-block drafts specify layout and regional color while leaving interior detail unspecified, yet pretrained flow-based generators can preserve their flat appearance even under photorealistic prompts. We trace this behavior to a cross-scale mechanism linking fine pixel variation to regional means in variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. Flattening photo regions systematically shifts their latent means, with offsets concentrated along a shared channel direction within each backbone. Controlled field exchanges in FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image establish the effect of this displacement on texture generation: adding the photo-derived regional mean field to a flat latent restores texture, whereas adding its complementary field alone largely preserves flatness. A second-order encoding expansion explains how encoder curvature can convert zero-mean perturbations into mean shifts. An analytically solvable conditional Gaussian flow shows how regional noise averaging enables near-unit endpoint sensitivity at high signal-to-noise ratios. This mechanism motivates training-free rendering through pixel dither before encoding, mean-field scaling, and early boundary holding. Paired low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with draft conditioning improves content recovery and produces photo-like regional means under the standard velocity objective. Explicit regional mean guidance remains effective after adaptation, continuously controlling texture and improving color fidelity. These findings connect encoding shifts to persistent generation behavior and support interventions evaluated for texture, spatial fidelity, and semantic recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扁平色块草图在光写实提示下仍保持扁平外观的跨尺度机制：VAE隐空间中细粒度像素变化与区域均值通过通道方向位移耦合，并据此提出免训练渲染与LoRA适配方案。
AI.motivation: 扁平色块草图只指定布局与区域颜色，内部细节缺失，但预训练流生成器在光写实提示下仍保持扁平外观；作者希望追踪这一顽固行为背后的机制并加以利用/控制。
AI.method: 在FLUX.1-dev与Qwen-Image上做受控场交换实验；发现区域扁平化会沿各骨干网络共享的通道方向系统性移动隐空间均值，并用二阶编码展开解释编码器曲率如何把零均值扰动转为均值偏移，用可解析求解的条件高斯流说明区域噪声平均导致高信噪比下端点的近单位敏感度。基于此提出免训练渲染（编码前像素抖动、均值场缩放、早期边界保持）、配对LoRA草稿条件化，以及显式区域均值引导。
AI.result: 加入照片衍生的区域均值场可恢复纹理，而仅加入其补场则基本保持扁平，证实位移对纹理生成的作用；LoRA提升内容恢复并在标准速度目标下产生类照片的区域均值；适配后显式区域均值引导仍能持续调控纹理并改善色彩保真。
AI.conclusion: 编码偏移与持续生成行为之间存在因果联系，提供了可控纹理/保真度的干预手段，并从纹理、空间保真与语义恢复三方面进行评估。

title: Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Internal benchmark and controlled ablation study; not peer-reviewed
summary: We present an internal, pre-registered evaluation of the UCMT causal discovery algorithm family alongside established alternatives across heterogeneous benchmark regimes, complemented by a separately pre-registered, controlled study of UCMT v2 Global components. The contribution is both empirical and methodological: a family-stratified comparison of three actively developed algorithm configurations and targeted evidence about which internal stages affect their outcomes. In the main benchmark, UCMT v2 Global has higher directed F1 than NOTEARS and DAGMA in selected real, semi-synthetic and Gaussian-network comparisons at the paired-run level, while trailing leading permutation-search methods in other settings. The BOSS-based UCMT v4 produces a CSuite-specific directed-F1 improvement over BOSS (mean paired difference +0.279; pair-level Holm p < 0.001), but the dataset-level adjusted result is not significant (p = 0.188). In a separate fixed-skeleton ablation, UCMT v2 Global exceeds an adapted R^2-SortnRegress orientation baseline on standardized iSCM data (directed F1 0.537 vs 0.468, dataset-level Holm p = 0.031); absolute orientation accuracy is 0.563 and there is no established broad advantage over RESIT, ANM or DirectLiNGAM. Controlled ablations show that sparsity and BIC-based refinement materially affect some outcomes, whereas the examined arbitration and automatic regime-selection mechanisms do not yield confirmed general improvements. We report performance shortcomings, multiple-testing correction, runtime costs, evaluation limitations and reproducibility checks. The results support UCMT as an implemented and empirically investigated algorithm family, not a claim of overall superiority, independent validation or demonstrated commercial impact.

AI.tldr: 本文对UCMT因果发现算法族（含v2 Global、v4等配置）进行了内部预注册评测，并与NOTEARS、DAGMA、BOSS、RESIT等基线比较。结果显示UCMT在部分场景（特定真实/半合成/高斯网络、CSuite上的定向F1、iSCM固定骨架定向）有局部优势，但未证实总体优越性。
AI.motivation: 作者希望对内部开发的UCMT因果发现算法族进行严格的、预注册的实证检验，弄清各内部阶段（稀疏化、BIC精炼、仲裁机制、自动机制选择）对结果的实际影响，并诚实界定其相对已有方法的真实优势与局限，避免过度宣称优越性或商业价值。
AI.method: 采用预注册的、按算法族分层的对比评测：主基准上比较三种UCMT配置与NOTEARS、DAGMA及置换搜索类方法，以配对运行层面的定向F1为指标，并做Holm多重检验校正与数据集层面校正；另设单独预注册的UCMT v2 Global组件受控研究，以及固定骨架消融实验（对比适配的R^2-SortnRegress定向基线、RESIT、ANM、DirectLiNGAM），并报告运行时成本与可复现性检查。
AI.result: UCMT v2 Global在部分真实、半合成与高斯网络比较中定向F1高于NOTEARS和DAGMA，但落后于领先的置换搜索方法；基于BOSS的UCMT v4在CSuite上较BOSS提升（平均配对差+0.279，配对级Holm p<0.001），但数据集层面校正后不显著（p=0.188）；固定骨架消融中UCMT v2 Global优于适配R^2-SortnRegress（0.537 vs 0.468，p=0.031），绝对定向准确率仅0.563，对RESIT/ANM/DirectLiNGAM无广泛优势；消融显示稀疏化与BIC精炼有实质影响，而仲裁与自动机制选择未带来确证性提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将UCMT定位为一个已实现并经过实证研究的算法族，而非总体优越性、独立验证或商业影响的宣称；论文同时如实报告了性能短板、多重检验、运行时开销、评测局限与可复现性问题。

title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

AI.tldr: PlayCraft 是一个自动化框架，用视觉智能体试玩游戏并根据其详细游玩经验迭代修改游戏，以提升游戏的"可精通性"（mastery）。
AI.motivation: AI 已能生成可玩的游戏，但这些游戏未必有吸引力；精通是吸引力的关键来源，而为精通而设计通常需要大量人类试玩与调参。
AI.method: 从初始游戏出发，交替进行"游玩"与"制作"两个阶段。游玩阶段：玩家智能体观看游戏画面、使用控件、在多个回合中追求目标并保留记忆，每回合后报告进度、结果、决策与反思。制作阶段：制作智能体基于这些报告估计玩家能力、预测不同熟练度下的表现、与目标学习曲线比较，诊断游戏并通过让玩家在决策和执行上有意义的提升机会来弥补差距。
AI.result: 在三种智能水平设置下用玩家智能体全新试玩评测，以学习增益与学习斜率为指标；相比初始游戏，PlayCraft 在多数游戏中取得更大学习增益和更陡学习斜率，且在每个智能水平设置的两项指标宏平均值上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于智能体真实游玩体验的自动迭代改游戏，可有效提升游戏的可精通性与学习曲线，减少对人类试玩的依赖。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP 2026). Recipient of the Best Paper Award
summary:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution.
  Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models.
  Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出推理时多孔径渲染框架AGSR，通过收缩3DGS投影协方差缓解有限高斯足迹导致的带宽限制，实现即插即用的超分辨率增强。
AI.motivation: 3DGS支持实时新视角合成，但其基于每个高斯基元投影协方差的光栅化会衰减细粒度场景结构，形成有限的"有效带宽"限制；作者发现推理时收缩投影协方差可缓解该问题，由此引出多孔径渲染的超分辨率思路。
AI.method: 构建AGSR作为预训练3DGS模型的轻量级插件：在推理阶段生成多孔径渲染结果，利用基于不确定性的特征聚合以及来自透射率(transmittance)与深度线索的几何条件逐步融合，且不重新训练底层高斯。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360基准上，AGSR优于轻量级图像空间超分辨率基线，且底层高斯表示越差时增益越明显；参数量最多139k，仍保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明协方差收缩能揭示被原生高斯光栅化衰减的带宽敏感结构线索；AGSR以极小开销实现实时超分辨率增强，为3DGS质量提升提供实用方案。

title: A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
comment: 44 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Ancillary files: exact-arithmetic verifier, certificate and companion notebook for the Platonic color-atom computation
summary:
Three-dimensional point clouds are a fundamental data modality, and a large family of machine learning architectures has been developed to respect their natural symmetries to rigid motions and permutations. A principled way to compare these architectures, which vary widely in complexity and cost, is through their expressive power. That is, an architecture is complete if it can distinguish any two inputs not related by the symmetries it respects. Simple distance-based message-passing networks are known to be incomplete, and while there exist complete alternatives, they typically rely on computationally intensive mechanisms like high-order representations of the rotation group or higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman-type tests.
  In this work, we devise a novel, simple, equivariant message-passing architecture for point clouds, and prove that it is complete. We complement our theoretical result with experiments showing that our architecture separates challenging point clouds that distance-based message passing provably cannot distinguish. Our results suggest that high-order equivariant features may not be necessary to enhance the expressivity of point cloud architectures, and can help settle completeness for other equivariant architectures for which such results are currently unknown. We give initial evidence for this by proving completeness of a slightly modified version of SEGNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单、等变的消息传递架构，可证明其对三维点云（考虑刚体运动与置换对称性）是完备的，即能区分所有非对称等价的输入；实验验证其能分离距离型消息传递无法区分的数据，并据此论证高阶等变特征并非提升表达力的必要手段。
AI.motivation: 点云架构复杂度和代价差异巨大，需要以表达力作为原则性比较标准。已知简单的距离型消息传递网络不完备，而现有的完备替代方案往往依赖计算昂贵的高阶旋转群表示或高阶WL型检验，因此作者希望寻找一种既简单又完备的架构。
AI.method: 设计了一种新颖、简单、等变的消息传递架构用于点云，并从理论上证明其完备性；同时通过实验检验其在距离型消息传递无法区分的挑战性点云上的分离能力；此外，对SEGNN稍作修改并证明其完备性作为佐证。
AI.result: 理论证明了所提架构的完备性；实验表明该架构能分离距离型消息传递可证明无法区分的挑战性点云；并证明了修改版SEGNN的完备性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，提升点云架构表达力可能并不需要高阶等变特征；该思路还有助于解决其他等变架构目前未知的完备性问题，并以SEGNN为例给出了初步证据。

title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
summary: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. Recent generators synthesize the entire face and leave no traces of blending. On a benchmark of 19 datasets released from 2019 to 2026, the best prior facial deepfake detector reaches a mean AUROC of 96.2% on ten blending datasets, but none exceeds 78.1% on five datasets of entire face synthesis (EFS). AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors do not close this gap. We propose TwinD, a detector trained on FaceForensics++ fakes and two kinds of twins: fakes made from a real frame. A reconstruction twin is a real frame reconstructed by an autoencoder, with the real pixels put back in a random region. It targets the neural traces of a decoder. A blob twin blends an altered copy of a real frame with the frame itself, targeting blending artifacts. It needs no generator and no face-shaped mask. Together, these twins provide two complementary forensic cues that generalize to unseen manipulations. TwinDreaches a mean AUROC of 96.3%, 8.9 points above the prior state-of-the-art, with 98.1% on the blending datasets and 95.6% on the EFS datasets. Trained on twins alone, without a deepfake dataset, single models still reach 94.3% on average over three seeds. For reproducibility, the code, trained model, and training data are at: https://github.com/yermandy/TwinD

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TwinD 检测器，通过在真实帧上构造"重建孪生"和"斑块孪生"两类自监督伪样本，学习互补的取证线索，从而在整脸合成（EFS）深度伪造上实现显著泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有面部深度伪造检测器主要基于"混合伪造"（blending fakes，生成脸贴回真实帧）训练，在 10 个混合数据集上平均 AUROC 达 96.2%，但在 5 个整脸合成（EFS）数据集上无一超过 78.1%；现有 AIGC 检测器也无法弥补这一差距。因此需要能泛化到无混合痕迹的全脸生成伪造的检测方法。
AI.method: 以 FaceForensics++ 伪造样本加两类"孪生"样本训练：1）重建孪生——用自编码器重建真实帧并在随机区域还原真实像素，针对解码器的神经痕迹；2）斑块孪生——将真实帧的改动副本与原帧混合，针对混合伪影，无需生成器和人脸形状掩码。两类孪生提供互补的取证线索。
AI.result: TwinD 平均 AUROC 达 96.3%，比此前最优高 8.9 个百分点；混合数据集 98.1%，EFS 数据集 95.6%。仅用孪生数据（不借助深度伪造数据集）训练，单模型在三个随机种子上平均仍达 94.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过孪生自监督构造的互补取证线索，可显著提升对整脸合成伪造的检测泛化能力；方法简洁、可复现（代码、模型与数据已开源）。

title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
summary: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model. Much of this cost is wasted: a fixed budget is applied to every prompt, although the computation required by prompts varies widely. Adaptive methods halt once sampled answers appear settled, but their thresholds are tuned heuristics with no statistical control over early-stopping errors. We instead seek an anytime-valid stopping rule that takes an error tolerance $α$ as input and halts only once an answer is certified to hold a majority ($θ_a > 1/2$) under the generator's distribution. We aggregate candidates by final answer with a reward-weighted self-consistency (RWSC) score and treat stopping as a sequential test over the resulting clusters. Applying Wald's sequential probability ratio test to these clusters yields SPRT-RWSC, which performs well empirically, but its guarantee fails because the leading answer shifts during sampling, and the run is continuously monitored. Our main contribution, e-RWSC, replaces Wald's test with a betting supermartingale (an e-process) for every answer the policy produces, bounding the probability of ever certifying a non-dominant answer by $α$, uniformly over time and across all answers. The RWSC scores drive the bets, so they affect only how quickly a dominant answer $a^\star$ is certified, not validity; certification takes $O(\log(1/α)/d_{\mathrm{KL}}(θ_{a^\star}\|1/2))$ samples. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm the predicted $1/d_{\mathrm{KL}}$ scaling of cost and show that accuracy improves over baselines at substantially lower token cost.

AI.tldr: 提出e-RWSC，用e-process（betting supermartingale）对每个候选答案做时间一致（anytime-valid）的序贯检验，在误差容忍度α下仅当某答案被证明占据多数时才停止推理搜索，从而在自适应分配计算预算的同时提供严格统计保证。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N等推理时对齐方法对每个prompt施加固定预算，但不同prompt所需计算量差异极大，浪费严重；已有自适应方法依赖启发式阈值，对早停错误没有统计控制，且因领先答案在采样中会变化、连续监控导致Wald SPRT的保证失效。
AI.method: 以最终答案聚合候选并用奖励加权自洽（RWSC）打分，把停止问题建模为对答案簇的序贯检验；先用SPRT-RWSC（Wald检验），但指出其保证不成立；主方法e-RWSC为策略产生的每个答案构造betting supermartingale（e-process），由RWSC分数驱动下注，对“任何时刻、任何答案被错误认证”的概率一致界为α。
AI.result: 认证主导答案a*所需样本数为O(log(1/α)/d_KL(θ_a*‖1/2))；在多个语言模型、数据集和奖励模型上的实验验证了1/d_KL的成本缩放预测，并在显著更低的token成本下取得优于基线的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将推理时对齐的早停从启发式规则升级为具统计保证的anytime-valid检验，奖励分数只影响认证速度而非有效性，实现更优的准确率–成本权衡。

title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
summary: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

AI.tldr: 将动力学预测与视觉渲染解耦，以3D点动力学作为中间代理，显著提升机器人世界模型中物体运动的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人世界模型虽能较好跟随给定动作，但被操纵物体常出现塌陷或与动作不一致的移动。作者认为根因在于条件化方式：动作或机器人渲染只指明机器人去哪，却不说明场景如何响应，迫使单一视频模型隐式推断交互动力学并同时负责渲染外观。
AI.method: 提出分离动力学预测与视觉渲染，用3D点动力学作为二者之间的代理：将首帧提升为3D点，用学习到的点动力学模型模拟点对机器人运动的响应，再把模拟点渲染成像素对齐的视频供任意视频模型读取。在DROID数据集上用两种不同架构的视频渲染器做受控实验，并在真实双臂机器人上验证。
AI.result: 点动力学代理使物体运动误差分别降低8.6%和6.2%且不损失图像质量，在真实双臂机器人上降低8.1%。视频跟随仿真：动力学越准确物体运动越准确，编辑点可引导视频变化。
AI.conclusion: 动力学建模的进步可转化为更忠实的机器人世界模型，解耦式点动力学代理是有效途径。

title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
summary: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. The proposed architecture combines a material encoder, a Spiking Neural Network memory block that tracks the long-term internal state of the material, and transformer blocks that learn the short-term applied strain state. The system is trained in three stages: material architecture encoding, base training on short time windows, and recursive fine-tuning with scheduled sampling to suppress cumulative error drift. The trained model is disassembled at inference and coupled to a non-linear FE solver, enabling structural scale simulation of composites containing embedded defects. Benchmarks against experimental results for IM7/8552 laminates under tension, compression and transverse shear, for pristine and wrinkled composites, show that the SNN memory block successfully tracks the material internal state and results in prediction errors between 0.4% and 4.8%.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多模态脉冲Transformer的复合材料世界模型，作为材料尺度代理模型，可实时跟踪含缺陷局部架构的不可逆内部状态，并嵌入非线性有限元求解器实现结构尺度仿真。
AI.motivation: 纤维增强复合结构存在制造缺陷导致的局部材料变化，需在结构每个位置实时求解材料尺度响应；并发多尺度计算成本随规模急剧上升，而现有代理模型难以同时满足：表示任意含缺陷局部架构、跟踪未知步数下的不可逆材料状态、递归自驱动下保持稳定、并适配每个积分点有限内存。
AI.method: 构建Composites World Model：材料编码器+脉冲神经网络(SNN)记忆块跟踪长期内部状态+Transformer块学习短期应变状态。三阶段训练：材料架构编码、短时间窗基础训练、带计划采样的递归微调以抑制误差漂移。推理时模型被拆解并与非线性FE求解器耦合。
AI.result: 针对IM7/8552层合板在拉伸、压缩、横向剪切下的基准测试（含无缺陷与褶皱试样），SNN记忆块成功跟踪材料内部状态，预测误差在0.4%–4.8%之间，与实验结果吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该世界模型可满足实时、稳定、低内存的材料尺度替代需求，并支撑含嵌入缺陷复合材料的结构尺度仿真。

title: MorphTwin: Enriching Deformable Material Responses from Videos for Morphable and Interactive Physical Twins
summary: Reconstructing interactive physical twins from video requires accurately capturing how objects deform while maintaining efficient simulation. We observe that reproducing motion in a video does not guarantee correct responses to new forces when the physical representation restricts how an object can deform. In spring-based twins, coupling between volume and shape responses creates such a limitation. We present MorphTwin, which enriches local deformation modes to capture and independently control these responses while retaining standard spring forces and explicit simulation. To support interpretable material editing and transfer, we use offline calibration to map shared relative response changes to stiffness updates on each reconstructed graph. Under identical inverse settings on synthetic scenes, MorphTwin reduces the mean absolute error of Poisson's ratio by 75.8% and the mean relative error of Young's modulus by 22.1% compared to PhysTwin. We introduce an egocentric stereo and RGB-D benchmark covering interactions with objects of varying stiffness. Real-world experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and up to 14.4% lower future tracking error than PhysTwin at interactive speeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MorphTwin，通过丰富弹簧模型的局部形变模式，使物体对体积变化与形状变化的响应可独立控制，从而在重建视频中的交互式物理孪生时更准确地匹配真实材质特性，并支持可解释的材质编辑与迁移。
AI.motivation: 从视频重建交互式物理孪生需要既准确捕捉物体形变、又保持仿真高效。作者观察到：仅复现视频中的运动并不能保证对新手部/外力做出正确响应，因为物理表示本身限制了物体可能的形变方式；在基于弹簧的孪生模型中，体积响应与形状响应相互耦合正是这种限制的来源（如泊松比与杨氏模量无法独立拟合）。
AI.method: MorphTwin 在标准弹簧力与显式仿真的框架下，为每个物体图增加局部形变模式，使体积响应和形状响应可被独立捕捉与控制；为实现可解释的材质编辑与迁移，采用离线标定，将共享的相对响应变化映射为各重建图上的刚度更新。此外构建了以自我中心立体与 RGB-D 数据组成的、涵盖不同刚度物体交互的基准。
AI.result: 在合成场景相同逆问题设置下，相较 PhysTwin，泊松比平均绝对误差降低 75.8%，杨氏模量平均相对误差降低 22.1%；真实世界实验中重建精度提升，未来跟踪误差最多降低 14.4%，并保持交互级仿真速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦体积与形状响应，MorphTwin 在保持高效显式弹簧仿真的同时显著提升了材质参数重建精度与对未知力的响应正确性，并支持无需重标定的材质编辑与跨物体迁移，为视频驱动的交互式物理孪生提供了更可靠的方案。

title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
summary: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation.
